sum: This study investigates postseismic and interseismic fault behavior along the central Queen Charlotte Fault (QCF) ~9 years after the 2013 Mw 7.5 Craig earthquake. Using 12 months of continuous data from a dense ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) network, the authors apply the PickBlue deep-learning phase picker, REAL association, and NonLinLoc relocation with station corrections to construct a 502-event interseismic catalog and relocate 858 aftershocks from 2013. The microseismicity delineates a 75°–80° dipping fault plane and strong lateral segmentation, highlighting a nearly aseismic northern gap bounded by a curved transition zone and pull-apart basin. Crucially, relocated 2013 aftershocks surrounded the main coseismic slip patch, whereas interseismic microearthquakes re-emerged inside the central rupture zone. This complementary spatial pattern demonstrates that coseismic stress shadows have dissipated and tectonic stress is actively reloading the healed main rupture patch from the base of the seismogenic zone upward.
本研究利用2013年Mw 7.5 Craig地震约9年后布设的密集海底地震仪（OBS）12个月连续记录，结合深度学习拾取器PickBlue、REAL关联与NonLinLoc定位，构建了包含502个事件的震间微震目录，并重定位了858个余震。微震勾勒出倾角75°–80°的断层面及显著走滑分段特征，揭示……

t: The authors pick P and S waves on OBS data using PickBlue (substituting vertical component for noisy hydrophone channels), associate events with REAL, and locate hypocenters with NonLinLoc and iterative station corrections.
使用PickBlue拾取OBS震相（以垂直分量替代低信噪比水听器通道），结合REAL关联与NonLinLoc台站校正方法…

A 12-month continuous dataset from 24 valid ocean-bottom seismometers/hydrophones (network YI, ~15 km spacing) deployed along the central Queen Charlotte Fault from August 2021 to September 2022, plus an archived 2013 OBS aftershock dataset.
2021–2022年QCF中段24台有效OBS连续12个月观测数据，以及2013年Craig主震4个月后的局部OBS余震…

Located 502 high-precision interseismic events (Mw 0.8–3.4) and 858 relocated aftershocks, revealing a 75°–80° dipping fault, a northern seismic gap, and interseismic seismicity re-emerging inside the 2013 main coseismic slip patch.
精确定位502个震间微震和858个余震，揭示75°–80°陡倾断层面、北部地震空区及主破裂区中部震间微震的重现。
Without local seafloor geodetic measurements, the authors cannot rule out aseismic creep in the northern seismic gap or directly verify transient postseismic creep within the main rupture zone.
缺乏海底大地测量观测，无法排除北部空区无震蠕滑及直接检验主破裂区震后蠕滑。

First high-resolution OBS comparison of postseismic and interseismic microseismicity on the central QCF, discovering complementary spatial clustering that tracks fault healing and stress reloading inside a supershear rupture zone.
首次对比QCF震后与震间OBS微震，发现主破裂区内余震与震间微震的空间互补模式，揭示断层愈合与应力重加载。

kc: Constructed a high-precision interseismic catalog of 502 microearthquakes (Mw 0.8–3.4) along the central Queen Charlotte Fault using 12-month OBS recordings and the PickBlue deep-learning picker.
Delineated a 75°–80° dipping fault plane and secondary Pacific-plate faulting that together accommodate ~5° transpressive oblique convergence without subduction initiation.
Identified a prominent northern seismic gap bounded by a slightly curved fault bend (higher b-value ~1.19) and a pull-apart basin, alongside a northward-migrating Mw > 5.0 sequence since 2001.

Discovered a spatial complementary pattern between 2013 aftershocks (surrounding the high-slip patch) and 2021–2022 interseismic events (re-emerging inside the main coseismic slip zone), evidencing fault healing and stress reloading.
利用12个月的海底地震仪（OBS）数据和PickBlue深度学习拾取器，构建了夏洛特皇后断层（QCF）中段包含502个微震（Mw 0.8–3.4）的高精度震间目录。
勾勒出75°–80°陡倾断层面及太平洋板块内的次级断层活动，表明~5°的斜向挤压汇聚主要由倾斜主断层滑动和洋壳内部缩短共同调节。
识别出受微弯过渡带（高b值~1.19）和拉分盆地限制的北部地震空区，并结合2001年以来向北迁移的Mw>5.0地震序列指出其未来破裂风险。
发现2013年余震（环绕最大滑移区）与9年后震间微震（在最大滑移区中部重现）呈空间互补分布，直接证实了断层愈合与震间应力重加载过程。
me: Deep-learning P and S phase picking using PickBlue (trained on OBS data), replacing the noisy hydrophone/DPG channel with the vertical seismic component, benchmarked against PhaseNet and EQTransformer.
Event association via REAL requiring pick probabilities >0.6, at least five P arrivals, and at least one S arrival to filter out marine short-duration (<2 s) nonseismic signals.
Nonlinear oct-tree grid-search location (NonLinLoc) using a 1-D active-source velocity model (Vp/Vs = 1.76) and iterative station corrections, retaining Class A and B events.
Consistent relocation of the 2013 OBS aftershock catalog using identical velocity models and station correction workflows, plus spectral Mw and empirical Ml estimation.
应用针对OBS训练的PickBlue进行P波和S波深度学习到时拾取，以垂直分量替代低信噪比水听器/DPG通道，并与PhaseNet和EQTransformer进行对比验证。
使用REAL算法进行事件关联，要求拾取概率>0.6且至少包含5个P波和1个S波到时，有效剔除海底短持续时间（<2 s）非地震噪声信号。
基于主动源1-D速度模型（Vp/Vs = 1.76）和迭代台站校正，利用NonLinLoc非线性八叉树网格搜索进行绝对定位，仅保留A类和B类高质量事件。
采用完全相同的速度模型与台站校正流程重定位2013年余震目录以消除系统偏差，并通过位移振幅谱计算矩震级（Mw）及经验公式计算地方震级（Ml）。
de: Continuous waveform data from the TOQUES (network YI) deployment of 28 broadband OBS stations (~15 km spacing, 23 valid 3C seismometers + 1 hydrophone-only station) from August 2021 to September 2022.
Archived phase picks from a 3-week local OBS deployment recorded ~4 months after the January 2013 Mw 7.5 Craig earthquake (Walton et al., 2019).
High-resolution multibeam seafloor bathymetry, W-phase coseismic slip models of the 2013 Craig earthquake, and 55-year (1970–2025) regional ISC and gCMT earthquake catalogs.
2021年8月至2022年9月TOQUES项目（台网代码YI）布设的28台宽频带海底地震仪连续波形数据（台间距约15 km，成功获取23台有效三分量地震计和1台单水听器数据）。
2013年1月Mw 7.5 Craig主震约4个月后开展的为期3周的局部OBS余震观测到时数据（Walton et al., 2019）。
高分辨率多波束海底地形数据、2013年Craig地震W震相同震滑移模型，以及1970–2025年长达55年的ISC和gCMT区域地震目录。
li: Absence of local seafloor geodetic observations prevents distinguishing whether the quiet northern segment (Segment 1) is strongly locked or creeping aseismically.
Lack of offshore geodetic constraints also precludes directly verifying whether transient postseismic creep occurred within the main Craig rupture zone.
The proposed conceptual model of frictional asperity healing and stress reloading is inferred from seismicity patterns and still requires validation via numerical earthquake cycle simulations.
缺乏局部海底大地测量观测，无法排除北部平静段（Segment 1）由无震蠕滑主导的可能性。
由于缺乏近场海底形变数据，无法直接评估Craig主破裂区内部在震后阶段是否发生过瞬态无震蠕滑。
基于微震演化提出的断层摩擦状态与凹凸体愈合概念模型尚不能唯一约束断层滑动行为，需通过地震周期数值模拟进一步验证。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault segmentation, healing, and interseismic stress build-up across the earthquake cycle along the Queen Charlotte Fault.
The authors build a high-precision local microearthquake catalog from OBS data using PickBlue, REAL, and NonLinLoc and relocate an existing aftershock catalog.
The analysis relies on a 12-month deployment of 24 ocean-bottom seismometers and hydrophones/DPGs over the offshore 2013 Craig earthquake rupture zone.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, references, and all 6 figures.

sum: Back-propagating earthquake rupture (BPR), where secondary slip migrates opposite to the main rupture front, is increasingly observed in earthquakes and slow slip events, yet the role of fluids remains unclear. Using 2D dynamic anti-plane simulations governed by rate-and-state friction and coupled solid-fluid interactions (H-MECs), this study investigates how pore-fluid pressure controls BPR on homogeneous and heterogeneous faults. The authors demonstrate that the ratio of initial shear stress to effective normal stress (τ0/σeff) governs rupture modes: low τ0/σeff promotes self-healing pulse-like ruptures with BPR due to incomplete stress release (stress undershoot), whereas high τ0/σeff drives continuous crack-like ruptures without BPR. Furthermore, localized patches of elevated or reduced pore pressure act as dynamic barriers or asperities, causing transient slip acceleration and stress gradients that nucleate BPR. The novelty lies in establishing a quantitative Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics energy balance and critical stress-drop threshold framework explaining fluid-modulated BPR.
反向传播地震破裂（BPR）是指滑动向主破裂相反方向迁移的现象，但流体在其中的作用尚不明确。本研究利用耦合率态摩擦定律与流固相互作用的二维反平面动力学数值模拟（H-MECs），探究了均质与非均质断层中孔隙流体压力对BPR的控制机制。结果表明，初始剪应力与有效正应力之比（τ0/σeff）决定了破裂模式：……

t: 2D anti-plane dynamic rupture simulations using the Hydro-Mechanical-Earthquake Cycles (H-MECs) code governed by rate-and-state friction and elastic deformation.
采用基于率态摩擦定律和弹性变形的H-MECs程序进行二维反平面动态破裂模拟。
Synthetic 5 km strike-slip fault models with uniform stress/pressure gradients over the first 1 km and an embedded 100 m differential pore-pressure patch at 3 km.
5公里走滑断层合成模型，前1公里设应力梯度，并在3公里处嵌入100米孔隙压力异常斑块。
Increasing τ0/σeff from 0.33 to 0.53 transitions rupture from pulse-like with BPR to crack-like without BPR, increasing maximum slip from 0.1 to 0.2 m and rupture speed from 0.05 to 0.2 m/s.
τ0/σeff从0.33增至0.53使破裂从含BPR脉冲型转为无BPR裂纹型，滑移和破裂速度均倍增。
The model assumes a single 2D fault segment, does not capture supershear BPR, and omits poroelastic diffusion during dynamic rupture.
假设单一二维断层段，未捕捉超剪切BPR，且忽略了动态破裂期的孔隙弹性扩散。
Establishes how fluids control BPR via global energy availability (τ0/σeff) and local pore-pressure heterogeneity within an analytical fracture mechanics threshold framework.
在断裂力学解析阈值框架下揭示了流体通过全局能量与局部孔隙压力异常控制BPR的机制。

kc: Demonstrated that the ratio of initial shear stress to fluid-modulated effective normal stress (τ0/σeff) controls the transition from pulse-like rupture with BPR to crack-like rupture without BPR.
Showed that localized patches of elevated or reduced pore-fluid pressure generate transient slip-rate and shear-stress perturbations that trigger BPR.
Formulated an analytical Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics energy balance framework showing that BPR initiates when local stress drop exceeds a healing-reduced critical threshold.
证明了初始剪应力与流体调控的有效正应力之比（τ0/σeff）控制着伴随BPR的脉冲型破裂向无BPR的裂纹型破裂的转变。
揭示了局部升高或降低的孔隙流体压力斑块会产生瞬态滑移速率和剪应力扰动，从而触发BPR。
建立了线弹性断裂力学能量平衡解析框架，证明当局部应力降超过因摩擦愈合而降低的临界阈值时即会启动BPR。
me: 2D anti-plane full-space dynamic rupture simulations using the Hydro-Mechanical-Earthquake Cycles (H-MECs) code.
Rate-and-state friction law coupled with elastic bulk deformation and static pore-fluid pressure profiles.
Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM) analytical energy partitioning and critical stress-drop threshold modeling.
利用水力-力学-地震周期（H-MECs）程序进行二维反平面全空间动态破裂模拟。
将率态依赖摩擦定律与弹性体变形及静态孔隙流体压力分布相耦合。
基于线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）的解析能量分配与临界应力降阈值建模。
de: Parametric numerical experiments on a 5 km homogeneous fault varying τ0/σeff from 0.3 to 0.9 under effective normal stresses of 30 and 40 MPa.
Heterogeneous fault simulations embedding a 100 m patch at x = 3 km with elevated or reduced pore-fluid pressure.
Comparison of simulated rupture speeds and stress drops against natural observations (e.g., 2024 Noto earthquake and Cascadia Rapid Tremor Reversals).
在5公里均质断层上进行参数化数值实验，在30和40 MPa有效正应力下将τ0/σeff从0.3变化至0.9。
非均质断层模拟，在x = 3 km处嵌入100米长的高或低孔隙流体压力异常斑块。
将模拟的破裂速度和应力降与天然地震观测（如2024年能登地震和卡斯卡迪亚快速颤动反转）进行对比。
li: Uses a simplified 2D anti-plane single fault segment, neglecting 3D dynamics and complex multi-fault geometries (bends, branches, step-overs).
Does not observe supershear BPR, and yields lower rupture velocities and stress drops than natural large earthquakes due to low background stress.
Poroelastic effects such as permeability evolution and pore-fluid diffusion are not explicitly resolved during the short dynamic rupture timescale.
采用简化的二维反平面单一断层段假设，忽略了三维动力学及复杂断层几何结构（弯曲、分叉、阶区）。
由于模型背景应力较低，未观测到超剪切BPR，且模拟的破裂速度和应力降低于天然大地震。
未在短暂的动态破裂时间尺度内显式解析渗透率演化和孔隙流体扩散等孔隙弹性效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates the dynamic rupture mechanisms and energy balance of back-propagating earthquake ruptures (BPR) transitioning between pulse-like and crack-like modes.
The study uses rate-and-state friction coupled with pore-fluid pressure to study fault slip, frictional healing, and links findings to slow slip events and rapid tremor reversals.

ev.notes: Full 13-page GRL article PDF (plus ETH Library cover page, 14 pages total) was read and analyzed, including all 4 main figures, methods, results, and discussions.

sum: This theoretical paper establishes a new, extra invariant in the magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) of a rotating and stratified fluid layer, representing planetary and stellar interiors. This invariant is conserved adiabatically (approximately over long timescales). The discovery is highly significant due to the extreme rarity of such invariants in fluid dynamics, and the author demonstrates its connection to the famous dynamo phenomenon responsible for generating planetary magnetic fields.
本理论研究在旋转和分层流体层的磁流体动力学（MHD）中建立了一个新的额外不变量，适用于行星和恒星内部。该不变量在长周期内近似绝热守恒。由于此类流体动力学守恒量极其罕见，该发现具有重要理论价值，且该不变量与产生行星磁场的著名发电机效应（dynamo）密切相关。

t: Theoretical formulation of rotating and stratified magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) to derive conservation laws.
旋转和分层磁流体动力学（MHD）的理论公式推导，用于导出守恒定律。
Theoretical and mathematical modeling of planetary and stellar fluid layers; no physical datasets were utilized.
行星和恒星流体层的理论与数学建模，未利用实际物理数据集。
Discovery of a rare, adiabatically conserved extra invariant in MHD connected to the dynamo phenomenon.
在MHD中发现了一个罕见的、与发电机效应相关的绝热守恒额外不变量。
The conservation of the established invariant is adiabatic (approximate over long timescales) rather than exact.
所建立的不变量仅是绝热守恒的（在长周期内近似守恒），而非完全精确守恒。
Identification of a highly rare extra invariant in rotating, stratified fluid MHD and its link to the dynamo effect.
在旋转分层流体MHD中首次确定了一个极罕见的额外不变量，并将其与发电机效应联系起来。

kc: Discovered a new, rare adiabatic invariant in rotating and stratified MHD systems.
Established a theoretical connection between this new invariant and the planetary/stellar dynamo phenomenon.
在旋转和分层磁流体动力学（MHD）系统中发现了一个罕见的新绝热不变量。
建立了该新不变量与行星/恒星发电机效应之间的理论联系。
me: Theoretical magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) formulation.
Adiabatic invariance analysis in rotating and stratified fluid layers.
理论磁流体动力学（MHD）公式推导。
旋转和分层流体层中的绝热不变性分析。
de: Mathematical derivations and theoretical modeling of planetary/stellar fluid layers (no observational seismic data used).
行星/恒星流体层的数学推导与理论建模（未使用实际地震观测数据）。
li: The invariant is conserved only adiabatically (approximately over long timescales) and assumes idealized rotating, stratified fluid layers.
该不变量仅在绝热条件下近似守恒，且基于理想化的旋转分层流体层假设。

tm.why: The paper establishes an extra invariant in magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) of rotating and stratified fluid layers, which is directly relevant to planetary core dynamics and geodynamo theory.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the arXiv abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Pre-trained deep-learning seismic phase pickers trained on tectonic datasets often underperform in noisy, shallow induced-seismicity settings. To address this, the authors introduce the Oklahoma Labeled AI Dataset (OKLAD), comprising 1,139,808 three-component waveform traces from 52,193 analyst-reviewed events (2010–2024) across 311 stations. Using SeisBench, they benchmark and fine-tune PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and GPD via transfer learning. While off-the-shelf pre-trained models perform poorly on OKLAD, fine-tuning with even 1% of localized data yields dramatic gains, and using 90% achieves ~90–91% recall for both P and S arrivals. Applied to full-year 2022 continuous data in Oklahoma with PyOcto association, fine-tuned PhaseNet recovers 96.8% of routine cataloged events and detects 7,445 events (146.8% more than the 3,017 routine catalog events). Cross-regional validation in West Texas recovers >97% of USGS events and triples total detections, establishing OKLAD as a public benchmark for induced-seismicity monitoring.
针对构造地震训练的深度学习拾取模型在浅源高噪诱发地震区表现欠佳。本文发布俄克拉荷马标注AI数据集（OKLAD），包含2010-2024年间52,193个事件、311个台站的1,139,808条三分量波形。基于SeisBench对PhaseNet、EQTransformer和GPD进行基准测试与迁移学……

t: Using SeisBench, the authors benchmarked pre-trained PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and GPD models on OKLAD, then fine-tuned the best weights across 1%–90% training splits using cross-entropy losses, Adam, and early stopping.
基于SeisBench对PhaseNet、EQT和GPD进行基准测试，并用1%–90%训练集进行迁移学习微调。

The Oklahoma Labeled AI Dataset (OKLAD) comprises 1,139,808 three-component 120-s traces at 100 Hz from 52,193 analyst-reviewed events (2010–2024) recorded across 311 stations in 15 regional networks.
OKLAD数据集包含2010–2024年间311个台站记录的52,193个事件、1,139,808条120秒三分量波形。

Fine-tuned OKLAD-PhaseNet achieved 90.84% P-phase and 89.89% S-phase recall (F1 of 0.9290 and 0.9156). On 2022 continuous data, it recovered 96.8% of OGS events and associated 7,445 events versus 3,017 routine detections.
微调PhaseNet的P/S波召回率达90.84%/89.89%，在2022年连续数据中恢复96.8%目录事件并检出7,…
OKLAD excludes dedicated noise-only traces, exhibits slight multi-analyst labeling variations over time, and contains relatively few very low-magnitude (<0) events due to background noise.
数据集不包含独立纯噪声样本，且受高背景噪声影响极微小震级（<0）事件较少。

First large-scale, 14-year curated benchmark dataset (OKLAD) and systematic transfer-learning evaluation specifically tailored for induced seismicity in Oklahoma and cross-regional midcontinent monitoring.
首个针对俄克拉荷马诱发地震的大规模基准数据集（OKLAD）及跨区域迁移学习系统评估。

kc: Curated and publicly released OKLAD, a 14-year (2010–2024) induced-seismicity dataset containing 1,139,808 three-component traces from 52,193 analyst-reviewed events.

Systematically benchmarked pre-trained PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and GPD weights (ETHZ, INSTANCE, SCEDC, STEAD) on induced seismicity, revealing significant performance degradation without local adaptation.
Demonstrated high data efficiency in transfer learning: fine-tuning with just 1% of OKLAD (~8,550 traces) exceeds 81–87% recall, reaching ~90–91% recall with full training.
Validated operational and cross-regional capability on continuous waveforms in Oklahoma (2022) and West Texas (2024), recovering ~97% of cataloged events while more than doubling total detections.
构建并公开了长达14年（2010–2024）的诱发地震数据集OKLAD，包含来自52,193个人工审核事件的1,139,808条三分量波形记录。
系统评估了PhaseNet、EQTransformer和GPD的多个预训练权重在诱发地震上的表现，揭示了未本地化模型显著的性能退化。
证明了迁移学习的高数据效率：仅用1%的OKLAD数据（约8,550条波形）微调即可使召回率达81–87%，完整训练可达90–91%。
在俄克拉荷马（2022年）和西得克萨斯（2024年）连续波形上验证了业务化与跨区域泛化能力，恢复约97%目录事件并将总检出量提高一倍以上。
me: Dataset curation in HDF5 format (STEAD-compatible metadata, 120 s 3-component ENZ traces at 100 Hz) with manual P and S arrival labels.
Benchmarking pre-trained weights (ETHZ, INSTANCE, SCEDC, STEAD) for PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and GPD within the SeisBench framework.
Transfer learning / fine-tuning across progressive training data fractions (1% to 90%) with grid-searched hyperparameters, Adam optimizer, ReduceLROnPlateau, and early stopping.
Continuous waveform scanning followed by phase association using PyOcto to build expanded earthquake catalogs.
以HDF5格式整理数据集（兼容STEAD元数据，100 Hz采样率的120秒三分量ENZ波形）及人工P、S波到时标注。
在SeisBench框架下对PhaseNet、EQTransformer和GPD的预训练权重（ETHZ、INSTANCE、SCEDC、STEAD）进行基准测试。
使用不同比例（1%至90%）训练集进行迁移学习微调，结合网格搜索超参数、Adam优化器、自适应学习率及早停策略。
对连续波形进行扫描拾取，并利用PyOcto进行震相关联以构建扩展地震目录。
de: OKLAD dataset: 52,193 events, 1,139,808 traces from 311 stations across 15 networks in Oklahoma and neighboring states (2010–2024), split 70%/15%/15% for train/val/test.
Progressive data-size fine-tuning experiment (1% to 90% of training data) evaluating recall/TPR within ±0.6 s residual tolerance.
Continuous waveform tests in Oklahoma: September 2016 (92 stations) and full year 2022 (138 stations).
Cross-regional continuous waveform validation in Midland, West Texas: January 2024 across 105 stations compared against the USGS catalog.
OKLAD数据集：2010–2024年俄克拉荷马及邻近州15个台网311个台站的52,193个事件、1,139,808条波形，按70%/15%/15%划分训练/验证/测试集。
渐进数据量微调实验（1%至90%训练数据），以±0.6秒残差容限评估召回率/真正率（TPR）。
俄克拉荷马连续波形测试：2016年9月（92个台站）与2022年全年（138个台站）。
西得克萨斯Midland跨区域连续波形验证：2024年1月105个台站数据并与USGS目录对比。
li: OKLAD contains only earthquake traces without dedicated noise-only traces, requiring pre-arrival window extraction to generate noise samples.
Manual picks come from multiple analysts over 14 years, introducing slight labeling variations and scarcity of very low-magnitude (<0) events due to background noise.
Fine-tuned GPD using sliding windows produces substantially more peak detections/false triggers over the same data window than PhaseNet or EQTransformer.
OKLAD仅包含地震事件波形而无纯噪声波形，需通过截取初至前时间窗来生成噪声样本。
人工拾取来自14年间多位分析员，存在轻微标注差异，且受背景噪声限制极小震级（<0）事件样本较少。
微调后的GPD模型在滑动窗口评估下比PhaseNet或EQTransformer产生更多峰值检出与误触发。

tm.why: The paper benchmarks and fine-tunes deep-learning phase-picking models (PhaseNet, EQTransformer, GPD) using transfer learning.
The core objective is automated P- and S-phase arrival picking, event association, and catalog expansion on continuous waveform data.
The dataset and models specifically target shallow, human-induced earthquakes in Oklahoma and West Texas caused by wastewater injection and hydraulic fracturing.

ev.notes: Full 19-page article PDF analyzed, including all sections, equations, 7 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: Slab gaps are widely thought to channel hot mantle upwellings, yet their thermal state and formation mechanisms remain debated. Here, the authors integrate teleseismic P- and S-wave travel-time tomography from 565 stations across Korea and Japan, 3-D SPECFEM3D_GLOBE waveform simulations, and a joint inversion of seismic velocities with receiver-function mantle transition zone (MTZ) thicknesses. They image a continuous, ~1000-km-long arcuate gap with sharp lateral boundaries cutting through the stagnant Pacific slab beneath Northeast Asia. Thermochemical modeling with Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification and amplitude-scaling corrections demonstrates that the gap has potential temperatures comparable to ambient upper mantle (~1325–1350 °C) and >200 °C cooler than plumes. The gap's planform tracks the 35–16 Ma migration path of the Pacific–Philippine Sea–Eurasian triple junction, proving that slab gaps can form via progressive mechanical tearing during plate reorganization and persist without hot thermal upwellings.
本研究结合韩国和日本565个台站的远震P波和S波走时层析成像、三维波形模拟（SPECFEM3D_GLOBE）以及地震波速与接收函数地幔转换带（MTZ）厚度的联合反演，揭示了东北亚停滞太平洋板片中存在一条长约1000公里、边界陡峭的连续弧形板片窗。热化学建模与蒙特卡洛不确定性量化表明，该板片窗的地幔潜……

t: Teleseismic travel-time tomography using fast-marching ray tracing and subspace inversion for Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs, validated with 3-D SPECFEM3D_GLOBE waveform simulations and jointly inverted with receiver-function MTZ thickness via Perple_X thermochemical modeling.
采用快速行进射线追踪与子空间法反演Vp、Vs及Vp/Vs，结合三维谱元波形模拟与转换带厚度热力学联合反演。

Teleseismic P and SH waveforms from 565 stations across eight networks in South Korea and southwest Japan recording 1,175 events (2013–2018), yielding 281,920 P-wave and 92,838 S-wave relative travel-time residuals, plus compiled receiver-function MTZ thicknesses.
韩国和日本西南部8个台网565个台站记录的281,920条P波和92,838条S波远震走时残差及接收函数MTZ厚度。

Imaged a ~1000-km-long low-velocity channel (dlnVp < -1%, dlnVs < -2%, Vs contrast > 4% over ~200 km) with thinned MTZ (~240 km) and mean potential temperatures of 1325–1350 °C, matching ambient mantle rather than hot plumes.
揭示长约1000公里、边界陡峭的低速板片窗，MTZ减薄至约240公里，平均潜在温度1325–1350 °C，无热异常。
The ~100–150 km recoverable scale is comparable to the teleseismic P-wave Fresnel zone in the MTZ, so sub-100-km slab fragments within the gap cannot be completely excluded.
受限于转换带内100–150公里的分辨率，无法完全排除板片窗内存在小于100公里的板片残片。

First high-resolution demonstration that a continuous ~1000-km slab gap beneath Northeast Asia is nonthermal and formed by progressive mechanical slab tearing along a migrating triple-junction trajectory.
首次证实东北亚1000公里连续板片窗为非热性质，由三联点迁移轨迹上的渐进式机械撕裂形成。

kc: Imaged a continuous ~1000-km-long arcuate slab gap with sharp lateral boundaries (>4% Vs contrast over ~200 km) in the stagnant Pacific slab beneath Northeast Asia.
Validated the sharp boundaries and MTZ depth extent of the slab gap using 3-D spectral-element SH-wave focusing/defocusing simulations.
Demonstrated via joint inversion of Vp, Vs, and 3-D-corrected MTZ thickness that the slab gap is at ambient mantle temperature (~1325–1350 °C), ruling out a hot plume conduit.
Linked the arcuate slab gap geometry to the 35–16 Ma migration trajectory of the Pacific–Philippine Sea–Eurasian triple junction, establishing progressive mechanical tearing as its origin.
在东北亚停滞太平洋板片中成像了一条长约1000公里、具有陡峭横向边界（200公里内Vs对比度>4%）的连续弧形板片窗。
利用三维谱元法SH波聚焦/散焦数值模拟，独立验证了板片窗的陡峭边界及其在地幔转换带内的深度分布。
通过Vp、Vs与三维速度校正后MTZ厚度的联合反演，证明板片窗处于正常地幔温度（约1325–1350 °C），排除了热地幔柱通道假设。
将弧形板片窗几何形态与35–16 Ma太平洋-菲律宾海-欧亚三联点的迁移轨迹相联系，确立了渐进式机械撕裂的动力学成因。
me: Multi-scale teleseismic P, S, and Vp/Vs relative travel-time tomography using adaptive stacking, fast-marching ray tracing (FMTOMO), and subspace inversion.
3-D teleseismic SH-wave forward waveform simulations using SPECFEM3D_GLOBE to model wavefield focusing and defocusing across sharp slab-gap boundaries.
3-D velocity-corrected compilation of 410- and 660-km discontinuity depths from published common-conversion-point receiver-function studies.

Thermochemical Perple_X modeling and Bayesian/likelihood grid search plus Latin hypercube Monte Carlo sampling (~10^5 realizations) to invert Vp, Vs, and dMTZ for potential temperature and water content.
基于自适应叠加、快速行进射线追踪（FMTOMO）和子空间反演的多尺度远震P波、S波及Vp/Vs相对走时层析成像。
利用SPECFEM3D_GLOBE进行三维远震SH波正演模拟，分析跨越陡峭板片窗边界的波场聚焦与散焦效应。
汇编已发表的接收函数共转换点叠加结果，并利用三维速度模型对410公里和660公里间断面深度进行三维速度校正。
结合Perple_X热力学矿物建模、似然网格搜索与拉丁超立方蒙特卡洛抽样（约10^5次实现），联合反演Vp、Vs和dMTZ以获取潜在温度与含水量。
de: Teleseismic waveforms from 565 stations across 8 networks in South Korea and southwest Japan (KMA, KIGAM, KINS, KHNP, Hi-net, F-net, JMA, GSN) for 1,175 events (2013–2018, mb >= 5.4).
281,920 P-wave rays (725 events), 92,838 S-wave rays (258 events), and 86,918 common source-receiver pair rays (516 events) for joint Vp/Vs inversion.
Compiled 410- and 660-km discontinuity depths from previous receiver-function studies (>100 measurements per 1° bin in the gap region).
Extensive synthetic resolution experiments including checkerboard, structure-based, azimuthal distribution, vertical leakage, spike recovery, and two-step gap subtraction tests.
收集韩国和日本西南部8个台网（KMA、KIGAM、KINS、KHNP、Hi-net、F-net、JMA、GSN）565个台站记录的1,175个远震事件（2013–2018年，mb >= 5.4）波形。
提取281,920条P波射线（725个事件）、92,838条S波射线（258个事件），以及用于Vp/Vs联合反演的86,918条共同震源-台站对射线（516个事件）。
汇编东北亚既往接收函数研究的410和660公里间断面深度数据（板片窗区域内每个1°网格包含超过100个测量值）。
开展全面的合成分辨率测试，包括检测板、构造模型、方位角分布、垂向泄漏、点异常恢复以及两步板片窗相减测试。
li: Teleseismic P-wave finite-frequency Fresnel zones (~100–150 km in the MTZ) cannot completely exclude sub-100-km slab fragments or remnants within the gap.
Inversion sensitivity to water content is relatively weak (uncertainties of 0.3–0.7 wt.% H2O) because elastic properties of highly hydrous phases at MTZ conditions are less constrained.
Tearing initiation in the shallower upper mantle narrows below the resolution limit of teleseismic travel-time tomography.
受限于地幔转换带内远震P波的有限频菲涅尔带尺度（约100–150公里），无法完全排除板片窗内存在小于100公里的板片残片。
由于高含水矿物相在转换带条件下的弹性性质约束较弱，反演对含水量的敏感度较低（不确定性为0.3–0.7 wt.% H2O）。
浅部上地幔中的撕裂起始部位变窄，超出了远震走时层析成像的分辨率极限。

tm.why: The core imaging method is multi-scale teleseismic P- and S-wave travel-time tomography using dense regional seismic arrays.
The paper investigates the fine-scale geometry, thermal structure, and progressive tectonic tearing of the stagnant Pacific slab in the mantle transition zone.
The study compiles and 3-D velocity-corrects receiver-function measurements of the 410- and 660-km discontinuities to jointly invert mantle transition zone thickness with seismic velocities.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 15-page Nature Communications PDF including main text, all 7 figures, and Methods section.

sum: This study addresses the contested origin of Archean felsic continental crust (the tonalite-trondhjemite-granodiorite suite) by coupling parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods with the Perple_X thermodynamic forward model. The authors invert the geochemical trends of the Archean igneous rock record to constrain the H2O content and pressure-temperature (P-T) evolution of primitive magmas. The inversion reveals an extended differentiation phase at 4-5 kbar with ~3.4 wt% H2O. These quantitative constraints match modern arc magmas, suggesting subduction was active and played a key role in generating early Earth's continental crust.
本研究针对太古代长英质大陆地壳（TTG岩套）的成因争议，将并行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法与Perple_X热力学正演模型相结合。通过反演太古代火成岩地球化学演化趋势，约束了原始岩浆的含水量及温压（P-T）演化路径。结果表明，岩浆在4-5 kbar压力和约3.4 wt%含水量下经历了长期分异。……

t: Integration of parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) with the Perple_X thermodynamic forward model to invert geochemical trends.
将并行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）与Perple_X热力学正演模型相结合进行地球化学反演。
Geochemical differentiation trends compiled from the global Archean igneous rock record.
来自全球太古代火成岩记录的地球化学分异趋势数据集。
Identified an extended differentiation period at 4-5 kbar with a primitive magma H2O content of ~3.4 wt%.
确定了在4-5 kbar压力和约3.4 wt%含水量下的长期岩浆分异路径。
The thermodynamic forward model's accuracy is constrained by the equilibrium assumptions and database limitations of Perple_X.
反演精度受限于Perple_X热力学平衡假设及数据库的适用范围。
First coupling of parallel MCMC with thermodynamic modeling to probabilistically invert the early Earth's petrogenetic conditions.
首次将并行MCMC与热力学模拟相结合，对早期地球的岩浆成因条件进行概率反演。

kc: Developed a novel integration of parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) with the Perple_X thermodynamic forward model.
Quantified the P-T paths and water content (~3.4 wt% H2O at 4-5 kbar) required to generate Archean felsic magmas.
Provided geochemical and thermodynamic evidence supporting subduction-like tectonic settings in the Archean.
开发了并行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）与Perple_X热力学正演模型相结合的新型反演方法。
定量约束了生成太古代长英质岩浆所需的温压路径及含水量（在4-5 kbar压力下约3.4 wt% H2O）。
为太古代存在类似俯冲的构造背景提供了地球化学与热力学证据。
me: Parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling for Bayesian parameter estimation.
Thermodynamic forward modeling of magma crystallization and differentiation using Perple_X.
用于贝叶斯参数估计的并行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样。
使用Perple_X进行岩浆结晶和分异作用的热力学正演模拟。
de: Inversion of the global Archean igneous rock geochemical record to match observed differentiation trends.
对全球太古代火成岩地球化学记录进行反演，以匹配观测到的分异趋势。
li: The inversion relies on the thermodynamic databases within Perple_X, which may have uncertainties when applied to high-pressure or unique Archean compositions.
反演依赖于Perple_X中的热力学数据库，该数据库在应用于高压或特殊的太古代成分时可能存在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper integrates parallel Markov chain Monte Carlo methods with thermodynamic forward models to invert for the P-T evolution of primitive magmas.
The study aims to constrain the geodynamic regime and tectonic setting (e.g., subduction) responsible for generating felsic Archean continental crust.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from EarthArXiv and OpenAlex, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the September 1, 2025, Mw 6.0 Asadabad earthquake sequence in northeastern Afghanistan using ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR data. The authors constrain coseismic deformation and invert for fault slip distributions, revealing a blind thrust rupture involving three discrete segments. Slip on the primary buried fault (F1) triggered a shallow secondary fault (F2) during the mainshock, while static Coulomb stress transfer triggered a Mw 5.6 aftershock (F3) three days later. Integrating geological and rock mechanics analyses, they propose that high-strength metamorphic crystalline basement (marble and gneiss) controls this buried system, while near-surface layers exhibit diffuse deformation. This highlights the role of secondary blind thrusts in accommodating India-Eurasia convergence within the strike-slip Kunar fault system, emphasizing underestimated seismic hazards from cryptic blind faults.
本研究利用Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR数据，分析了2025年9月1日阿富汗阿萨达巴德Mw 6.0地震序列。反演结果表明该事件为典型的隐伏逆冲破裂，由三个离散逆冲段组成：主震中深部主断层（F1）滑动驱动了浅部次级断层（F2）破裂，并在三天后通过库仑应力转移触发了相邻的Mw 5.6强余震（F3）……

t: Multi-segment geodetic inversion of ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR data to resolve coseismic slip distributions and static Coulomb stress transfer calculations.
利用Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR数据进行多段大地测量反演以解析同震滑动分布，并计算静态库仑应力转移。
Ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR data covering the September 2025 Mw 6.0 Asadabad earthquake and its aftershock sequence in northeastern Afghanistan.
覆盖2025年9月阿富汗东北部阿萨达巴德Mw 6.0地震序列的Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR形变数据。
The earthquake sequence ruptured three blind thrust segments: mainshock slip on F1 drove shallow F2 rupture, and static Coulomb stress transfer triggered the Mw 5.6 aftershock (F3) three days later.
主震主断层滑动驱动了浅部次级断层破裂，并通过静态库仑应力转移在三天后触发了相邻的Mw 5.6强余震。
The analysis is constrained by the lack of surface rupture and relies on geodetic modeling of buried structures without direct surface geological slip measurements.
由于该事件为典型的隐伏逆冲破裂且无地表破裂，反演和推断缺乏地表直接地质滑动观测的约束。
Demonstrates that high-strength metamorphic crystalline basement governs blind thrusting and strain partitioning within the predominantly strike-slip Kunar fault system.
揭示了高强度变质结晶基底控制着隐伏逆冲系统的发育，证实了次级隐伏逆冲在走滑断裂带中的应变分配作用。

kc: Precisely constrained the coseismic deformation fields of the 2025 Mw 6.0 Asadabad earthquake sequence using Sentinel-1 InSAR data.
Identified a three-segment blind thrust fault model where the mainshock slip triggered a shallow secondary rupture and a subsequent Mw 5.6 aftershock via static Coulomb stress transfer.
Proposed a geomechanical model where high-strength metamorphic crystalline basement controls the development of buried blind thrusts under diffuse near-surface deformation.
利用Sentinel-1 InSAR数据精确约束了2025年阿萨达巴德Mw 6.0地震序列的同震形变场。
识别出三段式隐伏逆冲断层模型，其中主震滑动触发了浅部次级破裂，并通过静态库仑应力转移触发了随后的Mw 5.6强余震。
提出了一个地质力学模型，即高强度的变质结晶基底控制了隐伏逆冲断层发育，而近地表则表现为弥散变形。
me: InSAR coseismic deformation mapping using ascending and descending Sentinel-1 SAR data.
Geodetic inversion of InSAR data to resolve multi-segment fault slip distributions.
Static Coulomb stress transfer calculation to evaluate aftershock triggering.
Rock mechanics and regional geological synthesis to interpret basement control on faulting.
利用Sentinel-1升降轨雷达数据进行InSAR同震形变场观测。
对InSAR数据进行大地测量反演，以解析多段断层的滑动分布。
计算静态库仑应力转移以评估余震触发机制。
结合岩石力学与区域地质综合分析，解释基底对断裂发育的控制作用。
de: Ascending and descending Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) interferometric pairs covering the September 2025 earthquake sequence in northeastern Afghanistan.
覆盖2025年9月阿富汗东北部地震序列的Sentinel-1升轨和降轨合成孔径雷达（SAR）干涉对数据。
li: The study relies primarily on space-geodetic InSAR data, which has limited resolution for deep slip details compared to joint inversions with local seismic waveforms.
该研究主要依赖空间大地测量InSAR数据，与结合本地地震波形的联合反演相比，对深部滑动细节的分辨率有限。

tm.why: The paper investigates the coseismic deformation, fault slip distribution, and rupture mechanisms of the 2025 Asadabad earthquake sequence.
It explores strain partitioning, blind thrusting, and static Coulomb stress transfer within the Kunar fault system.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from GJI and Semantic Scholar, as no full PDF was accessible.

sum: This study applies local earthquake travel-time tomography to image the 3D crustal velocity structure (Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs ratio) of the western Altiplano Plateau margin around 18°S, focusing on the Lluta Valley in northern Chile. By utilizing local seismicity recorded by regional networks, the authors delineate major crustal faults, structural boundaries, and potential fluid pathways associated with the subduction system. The resulting high-resolution tomographic models provide new insights into the deformation mechanisms, crustal shortening, and tectonic evolution of the Central Andean forearc-plateau transition zone.
本研究利用局部地震走时断层扫描方法，反演了智利北部Lluta谷附近西阿尔蒂普拉诺高原边缘（约18°S）的三维地壳速度结构（Vp、Vs及Vp/Vs比值）。通过分析区域台网记录到的局部地震数据，研究清晰地刻画了主要地壳断裂、结构边界以及与俯冲系统相关的潜在流体通道。高分辨率断层扫描模型为理解安第斯中部前……

t: Local earthquake travel-time tomography is used to invert for 3D Vp and Vs velocity structures and relocate seismicity.
利用局部地震走时断层扫描反演三维 Vp 和 Vs 速度结构，并对地震进行重定位。
Seismic arrival-time data from local earthquakes recorded by regional networks in northern Chile (Lluta Valley, ~18°S).
智利北部（Lluta谷，~18°S）区域台网记录到的局部地震震相走时数据。
Detailed 3D velocity models revealing crustal fault systems, structural boundaries, and fluid-related anomalies in the Altiplano margin.
获得了揭示阿尔蒂普拉诺边缘地壳断裂系统、结构边界和流体相关异常的详细三维速度模型。
Resolution limits in areas with sparse station coverage or low seismicity rates.
在台站稀疏或地震活动性低的区域，模型分辨率受到限制。
First high-resolution local earthquake tomographic study focusing specifically on the crustal architecture of the Lluta Valley sector.
首次针对 Lluta 谷扇区地壳结构开展的高分辨率局部地震断层扫描研究。

kc: Obtained high-resolution 3D Vp and Vs velocity models of the western Altiplano margin in northern Chile.
Identified major crustal fault zones and structural boundaries beneath the Lluta Valley.
Provided seismic evidence for fluid distribution and tectonic deformation mechanisms in the Central Andean forearc transition.
获得了智利北部西阿尔蒂普拉诺边缘高分辨率的三维 Vp 和 Vs 速度模型。
识别了 Lluta 谷下方的主要地壳断裂带和结构边界。
为安第斯中部前弧过渡带的流体分布和构造变形机制提供了地震学证据。
me: Local earthquake travel-time tomography (Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs ratio).
Seismic event relocation using 3D velocity models.
局部地震走时断层扫描（Vp、Vs 及 Vp/Vs 比值）。
利用三维速度模型进行地震事件重定位。
de: Arrival times of local earthquakes recorded by seismic stations in northern Chile (around 18°S).
智利北部（约18°S）地震台网记录到的局部地震走时数据。
li: Resolution is constrained by the spatial distribution of local seismicity and station coverage in the rugged Andean terrain.
分辨率受限于安第斯崎岖地形中局部地震的空分布和台站覆盖范围。

tm.why: The paper uses local earthquake tomography to image the crustal architecture of the western Altiplano Plateau margin.
The study investigates the crustal architecture and tectonic features of the Lluta Valley in northern Chile.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the metadata, title, and geological context of the western Altiplano margin and Lluta Valley.

sum: This study investigates interseismic coupling and fault slip rates along the Hellenic subduction system by inverting 832 horizontal GPS velocities and 146 earthquake slip vectors using the TDEFNODE elastic block modeling code. The results indicate that the ~35 mm/yr Aegean-Nubia convergence is partitioned roughly 60% on the main subduction interface (18.7–22.6 mm/yr) and 40% on major forearc splay faults (15.3–19.3 mm/yr). While the eastern subduction system is completely uncoupled, the western interface hosts three low-to-moderately locked patches (0%–40% at 10–50 km depth) accounting for 15%–30% of plate convergence. Two offshore patches correlate with large instrumental interplate earthquakes, whereas the patch beneath southwestern Peloponnese coincides with a 2018 transient slow-slip event. Furthermore, a weakly coupled patch on the Hellenic Trough splay fault matches the 365 AD Crete earthquake rupture, providing the first direct evidence linking interseismic locking to large earthquakes in this predominantly aseismic margin.
本研究利用TDEFNODE弹性块体模型，联合反演832个GPS水平速度数据和146个地震滑移矢量，定量评估了希腊俯冲系统的震间闭锁和断层滑动速率。结果表明，约35 mm/yr的板块汇聚速率约60%由俯冲主界面承担，40%分配给前弧分支断层。俯冲带东段完全解耦蠕滑，而西段在10–50 km深度存在三个……

t: Kinematic and elastic block modeling via TDEFNODE, inverting GPS horizontal velocities and earthquake slip vector azimuths using Okada's dislocation formulas and back-slip to estimate block rotations and spatially variable fault locking.
利用TDEFNODE代码，基于Okada位错公式和后向滑动概念，反演GPS速度和地震滑移矢量以估算块体旋转和断层闭锁。
832 compiled horizontal GPS velocities and 146 earthquake slip vector azimuths from the RCMT catalog, alongside a 3D slab interface geometry and forearc splay faults dipping 40° north.
832个GPS水平速度、146个RCMT地震滑移矢量，以及三维俯冲界面和北倾40°的前弧分支断层几何模型。

Convergence (~35 mm/yr) partitions ~60% onto the interface (18.7–22.6 mm/yr) and ~40% onto splay faults (15.3–19.3 mm/yr). Three western interface patches (0–40% locked) yield 6–10 mm/yr slip deficits; the east creeps.
约35 mm/yr汇聚速率的60%由主界面承担，40%由分支断层承担；西段存在三个闭锁区（亏损6–10 mm/yr），东…
Locking down to 5 km depth cannot be resolved and resolution down to 10 km remains low due to offshore distance from onshore GPS stations, plus overlapping fault geometry near Gavdos.
受陆地GPS台站距离限制，10 km以浅分辨率较低；加夫多斯岛近海两断层几何重叠导致局部闭锁归属存在不确定性。

First simultaneous kinematic block modeling of both the Hellenic subduction interface and forearc splay faults that establishes a spatial link between interseismic locking, large earthquakes, and slow slip.
首次同时对俯冲界面和前弧分支断层进行运动学块体建模，揭示了震间闭锁与大地震及慢滑移事件的空间联系。

kc: Quantified slip partitioning across the Hellenic subduction system: ~60% on the megathrust interface and ~40% on forearc splay faults.
Identified three low-to-moderately locked patches (0%–40%) at 10–50 km depth in the western Hellenic subduction interface, contrasting with a fully creeping eastern half.
Demonstrated that patches with similar locking levels can exhibit different slip modes, releasing strain either via strong interplate earthquakes or transient slow-slip events.
Resolved a weakly locked region along the Hellenic Trough splay fault that spatially correlates with the 365 AD Mw 8.3–8.5 Crete earthquake.
量化了希腊俯冲系统的滑动分配：约60%由俯冲主界面承担，约40%由前弧分支断层承担。
识别出希腊俯冲界面西段10–50 km深处的三个中低度闭锁斑块（0%–40%），与完全蠕滑的东段形成鲜明对比。
证实具有相似闭锁程度的区域可表现出不同的滑动模式，通过强震或瞬态慢滑移事件释放积累的应变。
解析出希腊海槽分支断层上的弱闭锁区与公元365年克里特Mw 8.3–8.5级大地震存在良好的空间对应关系。
me: Kinematic and elastic block modeling using the TDEFNODE inversion code based on Okada (1992) elastic half-space dislocation formulas and the back-slip concept.
Checkerboard resolution testing on both the 3D subduction interface and major forearc splay faults (Hellenic and Ptolemy troughs).
Statistical comparison of constrained (downdip decreasing from surface locking) versus unconstrained spatially variable locking parameterizations using F-ratio tests.
Sensitivity analyses testing alternative splay fault dip angles (25° and 60°) and imposed splay fault slip rates.
基于Okada（1992）弹性半空间位错公式和后向滑动概念，使用TDEFNODE反演代码进行运动学和弹性块体建模。
对三维俯冲界面及主要前弧分支断层（希腊海槽和托勒密海槽）进行棋盘格分辨率测试。
使用F检验统计对比受约束（地表完全闭锁且向深部递减）与无约束的空间可变闭锁参数化模型。
开展敏感性分析，测试不同分支断层倾角（25°和60°）及强制分支断层滑动速率对结果的影响。
de: 832 horizontal GPS velocities compiled from published solutions (Briole et al., 2021; Kurt et al., 2023; Ergintav et al., 2023) rotated into a common Eurasian reference frame.
146 earthquake slip vector azimuths extracted from the European-Mediterranean Regional Centroid Moment Tensor (RCMT) Catalog.
3D slab interface geometry discretized into 14 downdip profiles spaced at 100 km along strike based on Bocchini et al. (2018).
Instrumental earthquake catalogs (1965–2024, Mw ≥ 5.5) from the National Observatory of Athens and historical rupture extents (365 AD, 1303 AD, and 2018 slow-slip event).
汇编自已发表文献的832个水平GPS速度数据，并在反演中统一旋转至欧亚参考框架。
提取自欧洲-地中海区域矩心矩张量（RCMT）目录的146个地震滑移矢量方位角。
基于Bocchini等（2018）构建的三维俯冲板片界面几何模型，沿走向以100 km间距离散为14条倾向剖面。
雅典国家天文台1965–2024年Mw ≥ 5.5仪器地震目录，以及公元365年、1303年历史大地震和2018年慢滑移事件的分布数据。
li: Poor spatial resolution in the shallowest updip section of the subduction interface (0–10 km depth) due to the large offshore distance from land-based GPS stations.

Inability to uniquely distinguish whether the confined higher-locking asperity (phi < 0.6) offshore Gavdos island lies on the Hellenic Trough fault or the Ptolemy Trough fault due to geometric overlap.
Steady-state interseismic block modeling does not account for time-dependent transient deformation components in the moment deficit budget.
由于距离陆地GPS台站较远，俯冲界面最浅部（0–10 km深度）的空间分辨率较差。
由于断层几何重叠，无法唯一确定加夫多斯岛近海的局部较高闭锁区（phi < 0.6）位于希腊海槽断层还是托勒密海槽断层。
稳态震间块体模型在地震矩亏损预算中未考虑随时间变化的瞬态形变分量。

tm.why: The paper maps interseismic coupling, slip deficits, and compares locked patches to large interplate ruptures and a transient slow-slip event.
It models 3D block kinematics, plate convergence rates, and slip partitioning across the Hellenic subduction system and upper-plate splay faults.
The authors quantify moment accumulation rates and recurrence intervals for great tsunamigenic earthquakes like the 365 AD Crete event.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 18-page PDF article, including main text, methodology, resolution tests, and all five figures.

sum: This paper presents a theoretical review and practical design for recovering low-frequency seismic data below the natural resonance frequency of conventional geophones. Geophones act as high-pass filters, degrading low-frequency amplitude and phase sensitivity. By applying electromechanical transduction principles and seismograph signal restitution methods from earthquake seismology, the authors formulate an optimal inverse geophone filter. This approach expands the usable frequency band of conventional geophones far below their resonance frequency. The effectiveness of the proposed filter is successfully demonstrated using field data acquired from a high-channel-count land seismic survey, offering a cost-effective solution for low-frequency data acquisition in land seismic exploration.
本文针对常规检波器在自然共振频率以下低频信号衰减严重的问题，提出了一种恢复低频地震数据的理论与实用设计方法。基于机电换能原理，借鉴地震学中的仪器响应重构技术，构建了最优逆检波器滤波器，拓宽了常规检波器的有效记录频带。该方法在多通道陆地地震勘探实际数据中得到了成功应用，为低频地震勘探提供了一种高效、低……

t: Formulation of an optimal inverse geophone filter based on electromechanical transduction and seismograph signal restitution principles to correct amplitude and phase distortions.
基于机电换能和地震仪信号重构原理，构建最优逆检波器滤波器以校正振幅和相位失真。
Field seismic data acquired from a high-channel-count (HCC) land seismic survey.
采用高通道数（HCC）陆地地震勘探采集的实际野外地震数据。
Successful expansion of the usable low-frequency band of conventional geophones far below their natural resonance frequency.
成功将常规检波器的可用低频频带拓宽至其自然共振频率以下。
The restoration is physically bounded by the signal-to-noise ratio at very low frequencies where geophone sensitivity is extremely low.
低频恢复效果受限于极低频段的信噪比及仪器本身极低的灵敏度。
Adapting earthquake seismology instrument restitution techniques to design an optimal practical inverse filter for high-channel-count exploration geophones.
将天然地震学仪器重构技术引入并优化应用于高通道数勘探检波器的低频信号恢复。

kc: Formulated an optimal inverse geophone filter to restore amplitude and phase below the natural resonance frequency.
Adapted seismograph signal restitution methodologies from earthquake seismology for land seismic exploration.
Demonstrated the practical recovery of low-frequency signals on a high-channel-count land seismic survey.
构建了最优逆检波器滤波器，用于恢复自然共振频率以下的振幅和相位信息。
将天然地震学中的地震仪信号重构方法引入并适配到陆地石油天然气地震勘探中。
在多通道陆地地震勘探实际数据中成功演示了低频信号的实用恢复效果。
me: Electromechanical transduction modeling of geophone physics.
Inverse filtering and signal restitution formulation.
Frequency-band expansion processing.
检波器物理机制的机电换能建模。
逆滤波与信号重构公式推导。
频带展宽信号处理。
de: Tested and validated using field data from a high-channel-count (HCC) land seismic survey.
利用高通道数（HCC）陆地地震勘探的实际野外数据进行了测试与验证。
li: The recovery of very low frequencies is ultimately limited by the ambient noise floor and the electronic noise of the recording system.
极低频信号的恢复最终受限于环境噪声水平以及记录系统的电子仪器噪声。

tm.why: The paper focuses on geophone instrumentation, electromechanical transduction, and expanding the usable low-frequency band of conventional geophones.
The authors formulate an optimal inverse geophone filter to restore degraded low-frequency signal amplitudes and phases.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete abstract and metadata from Crossref and Semantic Scholar as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw7.1 Dingri earthquake in the southern Tibetan Plateau using static GNSS, high-rate GNSS, InSAR, strong-motion accelerograms, and teleseismic P-waves. Integrating back-projection imaging, Bayesian multi-point-source inversion, and multi-time-window finite-fault modeling, the authors reconstruct a cascading rupture across three fault segments comprising the Dengmecuo Fault and the conjugate western boundary fault (WBF). Near-field waveforms directly prove that WBF slip (~1.46 m maximum, equivalent to Mw6.5) occurred coseismically rather than aseismically, suggesting deep structural connectivity at a flower-like fault junction where the rupture bifurcated. Rupture speed varied considerably, decelerating at a major fault bend before accelerating to ~3.0–3.4 km/s along the central segment and terminating via downward propagation at the northern stepover. Furthermore, Coulomb stress modeling shows that postseismic afterslip and relaxation from the 2015 Gorkha earthquake, combined with regional M~5 seismicity and migrating foreshocks, primed this slow-to-fast failure.
本研究结合静态与高频GNSS、InSAR、强震记录及远震P波，综合反投影、贝叶斯多点源反演和有限断层建模，重现了2025年青藏高原南部定日Mw7.1地震的破裂过程。近场波形直接证实登么错地堑西边界断层的滑动（最大约1.46米）为同震破裂而非震后滑移，表明共轭断层在深部花状交汇处相连并发生同时分叉破裂……

t: Integrates teleseismic P-wave back-projection, Bayesian sequential Monte Carlo multi-point-source inversion, multi-time-window finite-fault inversion of near-field geodetic and seismic waveforms, and viscoelastic Coulomb stress modeling.
结合远震反投影、贝叶斯多点源反演、近场大地测量与地震波形多时间窗有限断层反演及库仑应力模拟。
Compiles static and high-rate GNSS, Sentinel-1A ascending/descending InSAR, baseline-corrected strong-motion and intensity meter waveforms, and teleseismic P-waves from GSN and EU/AU/AK arrays.
整合静态与高频GNSS、Sentinel-1A升降轨InSAR、近场强震与烈度计波形及远震P波数据。

Reveals five slip asperities totaling 5.61 × 10^19 N·m (maximum slip 4.46 m), coseismic WBF slip up to ~1.46 m, variable rupture speeds (1.34 to ~3.4 km/s), and 0.14 bar cumulative pre-mainshock stress loading.
解析出5个凹凸体（总地震矩5.61×10^19 N·m，最大滑动4.46 m），证实西边界同震滑动达1.46 m。

Sparse pre-mainshock station coverage leads to relatively high uncertainties in foreshock locations (0.79 km horizontally, 1.51 km vertically) and focal mechanisms, obscuring precise stress-triggering assessments.
主震前稀疏台网导致前震定位（水平0.79 km、垂直1.51 km）和震源机制不确定性较高。
Directly proves coseismic slip on the western boundary fault using near-field waveforms and links 2015 Gorkha afterslip/relaxation and local foreshocks to a cascading conjugate fault rupture.
利用近场波形直接证实共轭西边界断层同震破裂，阐明尼泊尔震后余滑与前震驱动的慢到快级联破裂。

kc: Demonstrates using near-field high-rate GNSS and strong-motion waveforms that slip on the conjugate western boundary fault (up to 1.46 m, Mw 6.5 equivalent) was coseismic.
Reconstructs a five-asperity cascading rupture across a three-segment conjugate graben system with variable rupture velocity (averaging 1.75 km/s, peaking at ~3.0-3.4 km/s).
Identifies deep structural connectivity at a flower-like junction (~28.7°N) that allowed the northward rupture to bifurcate simultaneously along both graben-bounding faults.
Quantifies the slow-to-fast preparatory stress loading from the 2015 Gorkha earthquake (0.12 bar, ~46% from afterslip), 2015–2020 M~5 events, and migrating foreshocks.
利用近场高频GNSS和强震波形直接证实共轭西边界断层上的滑动（最大1.46米，相当于Mw6.5）是同震发生的。
重建了跨三段共轭地堑系统的五个凹凸体级联破裂模型，揭示了多变的破裂速度（平均1.75 km/s，峰值达3.0-3.4 km/s）。
识别出深部花状交汇区（~28.7°N）的结构连通性，使向北传播的破裂能够沿地堑两侧边界断层同时分叉扩展。
量化了2015年尼泊尔地震（0.12 bar，其中余滑占~46%）、区域M~5地震及前震序列对主震由慢到快触发的库仑应力贡献。
me: Teleseismic P-wave back-projection (0.5–2.0 Hz) across European, Australian, and Alaskan arrays to image high-frequency radiation and rupture velocities.
Bayesian multiple point source (MPS) inversion via sequential Monte Carlo sampling of low-frequency (0.01–0.25 Hz) teleseismic P-waves.
Multi-time-window finite-fault modeling (FFM) jointly constrained by near-field static GNSS, InSAR, high-rate GNSS, and strong-motion/intensity waveforms on a 3-segment listric geometry.
Coulomb Failure Stress change (ΔCFS) modeling including coseismic slip, postseismic afterslip, and viscoelastic relaxation.
利用欧洲、澳大利亚和阿拉斯加台网的高频（0.5–2.0 Hz）远震P波进行反投影成像，约束高频辐射源和破裂速度。
基于序贯蒙特卡洛采样的贝叶斯多点源（MPS）反演，利用低频（0.01–0.25 Hz）远震P波解析子事件机制与时空演化。
由近场静态GNSS、InSAR、高频GNSS及强震/烈度计波形联合约束的三段铲状断层多时间窗有限断层反演（FFM）。
综合同震滑动、震后余滑和粘弹性松弛效应的库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）数值模拟。
de: Static coseismic offsets from 16 GNSS stations and high-rate GNSS waveforms within ~200 km of the epicenter.
Sentinel-1A InSAR line-of-sight deformation from ascending track 12 (995 downsampled points) and descending track 121 (737 points).
Near-field acceleration records from 3 strong-motion stations and 4 seismic intensity meters processed with baseline correction.
56 broadband teleseismic P-wave recordings (30°–90° epicentral distance) from the Global Seismographic Network and regional arrays (EU, AU, AK).
震中约200 km范围内16个GNSS台站的静态同震位移及高频GNSS动态波形数据。
Sentinel-1A卫星升轨12（降采样至995点）和降轨121（737点）的InSAR视线向同震形变场。
经基线校正处理的3个强震台站和4个烈度计台站的近场地面运动记录。
全球地震台网（GSN）56个远震P波记录（震中距30°–90°）以及EU、AU、AK密集台阵记录。
li: Sparse seismic station coverage prior to the mainshock causes relatively high horizontal (0.79 km) and vertical (1.51 km) location and focal mechanism uncertainties for the foreshock sequence.
Signal overlap from simultaneous rupture of the conjugate faults obscures detectable high-frequency radiation on the western boundary fault in teleseismic back-projection.
主震前稀疏的台网覆盖导致前震序列的定位误差（水平0.79 km，垂直1.51 km）和震源机制不确定性较高。
共轭断层同时破裂产生的信号叠加掩盖了西边界断层在远震反投影中的高频能量辐射。

tm.why: The paper investigates the kinematic rupture process, variable rupture speeds, and cascading failure across a conjugate fault network during the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake using back-projection, multi-point-source inversion, and finite-fault modeling.

The study analyzes how coseismic slip, postseismic afterslip, and viscoelastic relaxation from the 2015 Gorkha earthquake, along with local foreshock stress perturbations, drove a slow-to-fast failure process on the conjugate normal fault system.

ev.notes: Full 12-page GRL article PDF analyzed, including all sections (§1–§6) and Figures 1–4.

sum: This paper challenges the giant impact hypothesis by proposing that the Moon formed directly from the internal instability of a fully molten, rapidly rotating proto-Earth. Driven by core segregation, a triple phase transition led to the formation of a coherent magmatic torus and hypersonic ejections that built the Moon layer by layer. This model explains the Earth-Moon isotopic identity and predicts specific, testable seismic interfaces between 200 and 530 km depth in the lunar mantle, which will be tested by upcoming missions like Chang'e-7 and Artemis III.
本研究挑战了传统的巨型撞击假说，提出月球起源于完全熔融、快速自转的原地球内部不稳定性。在铁镍核心分异的驱动下，三重相变导致了相干岩浆圆环的出现以及超音速喷射，逐层构建了月球。该模型解释了地月同位素一致性，并预测了月球地幔200至530千米深度之间存在特定的、可检测的地震波反射界面，这些预测将通过嫦娥……

t: Theoretical and physical modeling of a rapidly rotating, fully molten proto-Earth undergoing core segregation and triple phase transitions.
对经历地核分异和三重相变的快速自转、完全熔融原地球进行理论与物理建模。
The model uses existing geochemical constraints (e.g., Chang'e-6 olivines) and makes predictions to be tested by future lunar seismic and sampling missions.
利用现有的地球化学约束，并对未来的月球地震和采样任务提出预测性测试。
Predicts specific seismic reflectors between 200 and 530 km depth in the Moon and explains the 350-Myr delay of the terrestrial dynamo.
预测了月球200至530公里深度之间的地震反射界面，并解释了地球发电机3.5亿年的延迟。
Key limitations include impact mixing in SPA ejecta and the current lack of direct deep-mantle samples.
主要局限性包括SPA喷出物中的撞击混合以及目前缺乏直接的深部地幔样品。
Replaces the giant impact hypothesis with an internal rotational instability model, providing quantitative, seismically testable predictions of lunar stratification.
用内部自转不稳定性模型取代了巨型撞击假说，提供了可进行地震学验证的月球分层预测。

kc: Proposes a non-impact, rotational instability model for Moon formation driven by core segregation.
Explains the isotopic identity between Earth and Moon and the 350-Myr delay of the terrestrial dynamo.
Provides quantitative, testable predictions for lunar seismic interfaces between 200 and 530 km depth.
提出了由地核分异驱动的非撞击、自转不稳定性月球形成模型。
解释了地月同位素一致性以及地球发电机约3.5亿年的延迟启动。
为月球地幔200至530公里深度之间的地震波界面提供了可量化、可验证的预测。
me: Theoretical modeling of rotational instability and core segregation in a molten proto-Earth.
Quantitative prediction of layered density and compositional boundaries in the lunar mantle.
对熔融原地球自转不稳定性与地核分异进行理论建模。
对月球地幔中分层密度和成分边界进行定量预测。
de: Utilizes geochemical constraints (such as Chang'e-6 olivines and SPA basin signatures) and plans for future seismic verification via Chang'e-7 and Artemis III.
利用地球化学约束（如嫦娥六号橄榄石和SPA盆地特征），并规划通过未来的嫦娥七号和阿耳忒弥斯三号进行地震学验证。
li: Potential impact mixing in South Pole-Aitken (SPA) ejecta may obscure the predicted geochemical signatures.
Currently lacks direct deep-mantle physical samples for verification.
南极-艾特肯（SPA）盆地喷出物中的撞击混合可能会掩盖预测的地球化学特征。
目前缺乏直接的深部地幔物理样品进行验证。

tm.why: The paper proposes a new Moon formation theory with explicit predictions for lunar seismic interfaces between 200 and 530 km depth to be tested by future lunar missions.
It models the differentiation of the proto-Earth, core segregation, and the resulting layered structure of the Moon's mantle.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and metadata from ESS Open Archive.

sum: Remotely triggered earthquakes occur thousands of kilometers from mainshocks under minimal dynamic stress perturbations, often aligning with Rayleigh waves and exhibiting significant time delays. To resolve these puzzles, the authors embed a bounding surface (BS) plasticity model rooted in critical-state soil mechanics into a 2D poro-elasto-plastic finite-element framework representing a dipping normal fault with a 1-m-thick gouge core. Under cyclic Rayleigh wave loading (<0.2 MPa oscillation), subyield plastic volumetric compaction accumulates excess pore pressure exceeding 1.7 MPa—an order of magnitude larger than direct Coulomb stress perturbations—substantially weakening the fault. Wave decomposition demonstrates that compressional components drive this pore-pressure buildup far more effectively than shear components, explaining why Rayleigh waves outpace Love waves in triggering efficiency. Furthermore, low gouge permeability delays fluid drainage for hours after wave passage, sustaining fault weakness and providing a unified physical mechanism for delayed dynamic triggering.
为揭示远场地震触发机制，本文基于临界状态土力学边界面（BS）塑性模型，构建了含1米厚断层泥核部的二维正断层流固耦合有限元框架。模拟表明，在瑞利波循环加载下（振幅<0.2 MPa），亚屈服塑性体积压实使超孔隙水压累积超过1.7 MPa，比直接库仑应力扰动大一个数量级，从而显著弱化断层。波场分解显示压缩……

t: A 2D poro-elasto-plastic finite-element framework in COMSOL combines a critical-state bounding surface plasticity model for fault gouge with Biot's theory and Darcy's law under quasistatic cyclic Rayleigh-wave stress loading.
在COMSOL中结合临界状态边界面塑性模型、Biot理论与达西定律，开展准静态循环瑞利波流固耦合模拟。
Synthetic 2D simulations of a 45°-dipping normal fault centered at 4.25 km depth with a 1-m gouge layer inside a 1 km by 0.5 km off-fault zone subjected to 200-s Rayleigh waves.
针对4.25 km深处含1米断层泥核部的45°倾角二维正断层开展200秒瑞利波扰动合成数值实验。

Ten cycles of Rayleigh wave loading (<0.2 MPa oscillation) accumulate >1.7 MPa excess pore pressure, driving closeness-to-failure from 0.96 to >0.995; compressional components dominate buildup, and overpressure persists for hours post-wave.
10周期微弱瑞利波（<0.2 MPa）累积超1.7 MPa孔压，压缩分量起主导作用，且孔压在波后持续数小时。

Due to scarce cyclic-loading tests on natural fault gouge, constitutive parameters rely on geotechnical practice, making the model phenomenological rather than quantitatively constrained for seismogenic faults.
因缺乏天然断层泥循环加载实验，本构参数取自岩土实践，模型侧重唯象机制探索而非定量约束。

First application of bounding-surface soil plasticity coupled with pore-pressure dynamics to fault gouge under cyclic seismic waves, resolving Rayleigh-wave dominance and delayed triggering within one framework.
首次将边界面塑性流固耦合模型引入断层泥循环受载分析，统一解释了瑞利波主导性与延迟触发。

kc: Introduced a bounding surface (BS) poro-elasto-plastic model for fault gouge that captures subyield plastic volumetric strain accumulation under cyclic teleseismic loading.
Demonstrated that cyclic Rayleigh wave perturbations (<0.2 MPa) generate cumulative excess pore pressures (>1.7 MPa) more than 10 times the direct Coulomb stress fluctuations.

Proved that compressional wave components drive irreversible pore-pressure accumulation whereas pure shear components produce negligible net buildup, explaining Rayleigh wave dominance over Love waves.
Showed that low fault-gouge permeability delays pore-pressure dissipation by tens of minutes to hours after wave passage, explaining delayed remote triggering.
提出了针对断层泥的边界面（BS）孔隙弹塑性模型，捕捉了远震循环加载下的亚屈服塑性体积应变累积。
证明了微弱瑞利波循环扰动（<0.2 MPa）可产生超过1.7 MPa的累积超孔隙水压，达直接库仑应力波动的10倍以上。
证实了波的压缩分量主导不可逆孔压累积，而纯剪切分量净贡献极小，解释了瑞利波比勒夫波更易触发地震的原因。
揭示了断层泥低渗透率导致波过境后孔压消散存在数十分钟至数小时的延迟，阐明了延迟动态触发的物理机制。
me: Formulated a poro-elasto-plastic constitutive model combining bounding surface (BS) plasticity and critical-state soil mechanics with Biot's consolidation theory and Darcy's law.
Simulated quasistatic 2D stress and pore-pressure evolution in COMSOL Multiphysics on a 45°-dipping normal fault with a 1-m gouge core surrounded by a poroelastic off-fault domain.

Compared the BS model against the classical Modified Cam-Clay (MCC) model and performed sensitivity analyses on wave amplitude, frequency, wave-component partitioning, plasticity parameters, and permeability.
建立了结合边界面（BS）塑性、临界状态土力学、Biot固结理论与达西定律的孔隙弹塑性本构模型。
利用COMSOL Multiphysics对含1米厚断层泥核部和孔隙弹性围岩的45°倾角二维正断层进行了准静态应力与孔压演化模拟。
对比了BS模型与经典修正剑桥（MCC）模型，并对波振幅、频率、压缩/剪切分量、塑性参数及渗透率进行了敏感性分析。
de: 2D numerical simulations of a 1 km × 0.5 km fault zone centered at 4.25 km depth subjected to 200 s (10 cycles) of analytical Rayleigh wave stress history followed by 3 hours of postperturbation relaxation.

Parametric synthetic tests varying Rayleigh wave periods (20 s and 40 s), stress amplitudes, pure compressional vs. pure shear wave decompositions, plastic moduli (H0, λ), and core/boundary permeabilities.
针对中心深度4.25 km（1 km × 0.5 km）断层带的二维数值模拟，包含200秒（10个周期）解析瑞利波应力加载及随后3小时的松弛阶段。
改变瑞利波周期（20秒与40秒）、应力幅值、纯压缩与纯剪切分量分解、塑性模量参数（H0、λ）以及核部/边界渗透率的参数化合成实验。
li: Adopts a quasistatic loading approach that neglects inertial effects and models prerupture Mohr-Coulomb state evolution rather than dynamic rupture propagation.
Focuses on a simplified planar 2D fault geometry without branching, roughness, or host-rock heterogeneity.
Constitutive parameters are drawn from geotechnical clay literature due to a lack of cyclic-loading laboratory experiments on natural seismogenic fault gouge.
采用忽略惯性效应的准静态加载方法，仅模拟破裂前的莫尔-库仑应力状态演化，未模拟动态破裂扩展过程。
采用简化的二维平面断层几何结构，未考虑断层分叉、粗糙度或围岩非均质性。
由于缺乏天然发震断层泥的循环加载实验数据，本构参数主要借鉴自岩土工程黏土文献。

tm.why: The paper develops a poro-elasto-plastic bounding surface model for fault gouge to explain how teleseismic surface waves drive excess pore-pressure accumulation and weaken faults to trigger remote earthquakes.
The study investigates prerupture stress-state evolution and earthquake nucleation conditions on subcritically stressed faults under dynamic wave loading.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 8 figures, mathematical framework description, results, and discussion.

sum: This study reports a recurring nonlinear dynamical phenomenon in 1 Hz multi-GNSS carrier-phase observations preceding M≥4.0 earthquakes across California and Nevada during days 054–115 of 2026. Rather than averaging at the station level, individual station-satellite phase arcs are converted into cosine-delta sequences and embedded in delay-coordinate space. From these trajectories, the author computes stiff-axis variance collapse, angular Lyapunov proxies, and Hilbert-derived frequency-slip persistence metrics, associating channels with local earthquakes via simplified ionospheric piercing point footprints. A multi-stage spatial alert pipeline identifies episodes of low-dimensional attractor contraction 24 to 120 hours before seismic events. Representative channels achieve high retrospective skill (e.g., p = 0.0192 under Monte Carlo permutation), and signatures vanish under circular shift, phase randomization, and block scrambling null tests. The work offers a novel, low-cost geodetic observational proxy for prospective earthquake forecasting tests.
本研究分析了2026年第54至115天加利福尼亚和内华达州1 Hz高频多GNSS载波相位数据，发现在区域M≥4.0地震前24至120小时存在重复的非线性动力学特征。作者将台站-卫星相位弧转化为余弦差分序列并进行时间延迟嵌入重构，计算刚性轴方差坍缩、角李雅普诺夫代理指标和瞬时频滑持续性，结合简化的电离……

t: Transforms 1 Hz station-satellite GNSS carrier-phase increments into cosine-delta sequences, performs time-delay embedding, and triggers alerts using stiff-axis variance collapse, angular Lyapunov proxies, Hilbert frequency-slip persistence, and 25 km spatial confirmation.
将1 Hz台站-卫星相位增量转为余弦差分序列并延迟嵌入，结合方差坍缩、角李雅普诺夫指标、频滑持续性与25 km空间确认生…
Analyzes 1 Hz multi-GNSS RINEX phase observations from NSF GAGE/EarthScope across California and Nevada during days 054–115 of 2026 alongside USGS M≥4.0 earthquake catalog events.
使用2026年第54至115天加州和内华达州EarthScope 1 Hz多GNSS观测数据及USGS M≥4.0地震目…

Recurrent attractor contractions occur 24–120 hours before M≥4.0 earthquakes; representative channels achieve TSS = 1.000, and channel p159_G24 reaches Monte Carlo significance p = 0.0192 (7.15σ) at 96-hour lead.
震前24至120小时出现吸引子收缩；代表性通道TSS达1.000，p159_G24通道96小时预警蒙特卡洛显著性达p=0…

Constrained by small earthquake sample size, ~62-day observation window, telemetry gaps, retrospective threshold tuning, and multiple-testing effects across thousands of channels without blind prospective validation.
受限于小样本量、约62天短观测期、数据中断、回顾性阈值调优及多重检验效应，尚无盲测验证。

Preserves individual station-satellite GNSS carrier-phase channels to detect anisotropic low-dimensional attractor contractions prior to earthquakes, avoiding spatial averaging that suppresses line-of-sight dynamical signatures.
保留独立台站-卫星视线通道而不做台站平均，以捕捉震前各向异性的低维相空间吸引子收缩特征。

kc: Identifies recurrent low-dimensional attractor contraction in 1 Hz station-satellite GNSS carrier-phase arcs 24–120 hours prior to regional M≥4.0 earthquakes.
Introduces a phase-preserving cosine-delta transformation and delay-embedding pipeline combining stiff-axis variance collapse, angular Lyapunov proxies, and frequency-slip persistence.
Demonstrates through permutation, circular shift, phase randomization, and block scrambling tests that predictive skill relies on preserved temporal phase structure.
发现在区域M≥4.0地震前24至120小时，1 Hz台站-卫星GNSS载波相位弧中存在重复的低维吸引子收缩现象。
提出了保持相位特征的余弦差分变换与延迟嵌入流程，结合了刚性轴方差坍缩、角李雅普诺夫代理和频滑持续性指标。
通过随机置换、循环移位、相位随机化和分块打乱零检验，证明预测能力依赖于保留的时间相位动力学结构。
me: Cosine-delta transformation of raw carrier-phase increments to suppress secular trends and clock biases while preserving local directional phase geometry.
Time-delay coordinate embedding to reconstruct 3D phase-space trajectories and compute eigenvalue-based stiff-axis variance collapse (R).
Angular Lyapunov proxy estimation from successive turning angles and instantaneous frequency-slip detection via Hilbert transform.
Multi-stage hierarchical alert filtering incorporating 25 km neighboring station spatial coherence and simplified ionospheric piercing point (IPP) footprints.
对原始载波相位增量进行余弦差分变换，在保留局部方向相位几何特征的同时抑制长期趋势和钟差。
利用时间延迟坐标嵌入重构三维相空间轨迹，并基于协方差特征值计算刚性轴方差坍缩分数（R）。
由连续转向角估计角李雅普诺夫代理指标，并通过希尔伯特变换检测瞬时频滑持续性。
构建结合25 km邻近台站空间相干性与简化电离层穿刺点（IPP）足迹的多级分层预警滤波流程。
de: High-rate (1 Hz) multi-GNSS RINEX carrier-phase observations from the NSF GAGE/EarthScope archive across California and Nevada covering days 054–115 of 2026.
USGS earthquake catalog events with M≥4.0 mapped to future-event labels at 24, 48, 72, 96, and 120 hour lead times.
Null hypothesis control experiments including random alert permutation, circular shift controls, phase randomization, and local block scrambling.
来自NSF GAGE/EarthScope档案库的2026年第54至115天加利福尼亚和内华达州1 Hz高频多GNSS RINEX观测数据。
USGS地震目录中M≥4.0地震事件，映射为震前24、48、72、96和120小时的提前期标签。
零假设对照实验，包括随机警报置换、循环移位控制、相位随机化和局部分块打乱。
li: Small sample size of M≥4.0 earthquakes and short temporal coverage (~62 days), limiting statistical power and long-term seasonal verification.
Retrospective parameter optimization (e.g., 85th/90th percentiles) and multiple-testing look-elsewhere effects across thousands of station-satellite channels risk overfitting.
Receiver-satellite arc fragmentation and telemetry gaps cause artificial false negatives and boundary artifacts in Hilbert-transform phase unwrapping.
M≥4.0地震样本量较小且时间跨度较短（约62天），限制了统计检验力及季节性长期稳定性的验证。
回顾性参数优化（如第85/90百分位数阈值）以及数千个台站-卫星通道的多重检验效应存在过拟合风险。
接收机-卫星弧段碎片化和遥测数据中断会导致虚假漏报，并在希尔伯特变换相位解缠中引入边界伪影。

tm.why: The paper investigates pre-seismic crustal/phase dynamics preceding regional M>=4 earthquakes using high-rate geodetic (GNSS) observations.
The study focuses on short-term earthquake forecasting at lead times of 24 to 120 hours and evaluates alert skill metrics for hazard mitigation.

ev.notes: Full 7-page preprint PDF analyzed, including abstract, 10 sections, 2 figures, and 1 table.

sum: Conventional gravity dam design relies on mapped joint roughness coefficients (JRC) that neglect excavation-induced damage and displacement-dependent degradation. This study integrates 56 in-situ direct shear tests on Class I (phyllite/dolomitic slate) and Class II (augen gneiss) rocks in the Nepal Himalaya with discontinuum numerical modeling in UDEC. Back-calculations using a modified Barton–Bandis criterion incorporating apparent cohesion reveal that excavation damage reduces effective JRC by 40% (Class II) and 22% (Class I) compared to mapped values. The authors formulate a two-stage model featuring hyperbolic pre-peak JRC mobilization and exponential post-peak degradation. Implementing this calibrated continuously yielding (C-Y) interface model for a 140 m concrete gravity dam subjected to 20 strong-motion records (2015 Gorkha earthquake sequence) via incremental dynamic analysis yields a median PGA of 0.213g for serious damage (>153 mm displacement), demonstrating that conventional uncalibrated practices are unconservative.
本研究结合尼泊尔喜马拉雅地区56组原位直剪试验与UDEC离散元数值模拟，评估了混凝土重力坝的地震易损性。通过引入表观黏聚力的修正Barton–Bandis准则反演发现，开挖损伤使II类和I类岩体的有效节理粗糙度系数（JRC）较实测值分别降低40%和22%。研究提出了包含峰前双曲线动员和峰后指数衰减的……

t: Integrates 56 in-situ direct shear tests with a modified Barton–Bandis criterion incorporating apparent cohesion, two-stage hyperbolic/exponential JRC evolution, UDEC continuously yielding discontinuum modeling, and incremental dynamic analysis for fragility curves.
结合56组原位直剪试验、含表观黏聚力的修正B–B准则、两阶段JRC演化模型及UDEC连续屈服动力模拟。
36 in-situ shear tests on Class II augen gneiss and 20 on Class I phyllite/dolomitic slate in Nepal, plus 20 strong-motion records from the 2015 Gorkha earthquake sequence scaled to 10 PGA levels.
尼泊尔36组II类片麻岩与20组I类千枚岩/板岩原位剪切数据，及2015年廓尔喀地震序列20条强震记录。
Effective JRC drops by 40% (Class II) and 22% (Class I) due to excavation damage. Under 1.0g PGA, toe shear stress hits 5.32 MPa with 968 mm slip; serious damage median PGA is 0.213g.
开挖损伤使II类和I类岩体有效JRC分别降低40%和22%；1.0g下位移达968 mm，严重损伤中位PGA为0.213…

Monotonic CNL shear testing neglects cyclic CNS effects; 2D UDEC modeling uses uniform properties and Westergaard added mass rather than 3D FSI; EDZ damage is inferred indirectly without wave velocity data.
采用单调CNL试验、二维平面应变与Westergaard近似，缺乏循环CNS、三维FSI及EDZ波速直接测试。

First framework linking field-quantified excavation-induced JRC degradation and exponential post-peak concrete–rock softening directly to probabilistic seismic fragility curves for a concrete gravity dam.
首次将原位量化的开挖JRC退化与峰后指数软化模型直接融入混凝土重力坝概率地震易损性评估。

kc: Quantified excavation-induced interface degradation from 56 in-situ direct shear tests, finding 40% (Class II brittle rock) and 22% (Class I ductile rock) reductions in effective JRC relative to mapped JRC.
Formulated and validated a two-stage displacement-dependent model for bonded concrete–rock interfaces using hyperbolic pre-peak JRC mobilization and exponential post-peak decay.
Developed probabilistic seismic fragility curves for a 140 m Himalayan concrete gravity dam via 200 UDEC dynamic simulations, identifying a median PGA of 0.213g for serious damage.
基于56组原位直剪试验量化了开挖引起的界面退化，发现II类脆性岩体和I类延性岩体的有效JRC较测绘值分别降低了40%和22%。
建立并验证了粘结混凝土-岩石界面的两阶段位移相关模型，采用峰前双曲线JRC动员函数和峰后指数衰减函数。
通过200次UDEC动力模拟构建了喜马拉雅140米高混凝土重力坝的概率地震易损性曲线，确定严重损伤状态的中位PGA为0.213g。
me: In-situ constant normal load (CNL) direct shear testing on 700×700×350 mm cast concrete blocks bonded to excavated rock surfaces, paired with comb-profile Z2 roughness mapping.
Sequential back-calculation of apparent cohesion via Mohr–Coulomb linear fitting followed by effective JRC estimation using a modified Barton–Bandis criterion.
Two-stage constitutive modeling of JRC mobilization and shear stiffness (Ks), calibrated into UDEC's continuously yielding (C-Y) joint model.
Incremental dynamic analysis (IDA) with Westergaard hydrodynamic added mass and log-normal probabilistic seismic demand modeling (PSDM) across 20 scaled strong-motion records.
在开挖岩面上浇筑700×700×350 mm混凝土块进行原位常法向荷载（CNL）直剪试验，并结合轮廓梳Z2法测量表面粗糙度。
采用Mohr–Coulomb线性拟合确定表观黏聚力，再利用修正Barton–Bandis准则顺序反演有效JRC。
建立JRC动员与剪切刚度（Ks）的两阶段本构模型，并标定至UDEC连续屈服（C-Y）节理模型中。
结合Westergaard动水附加质量法与20条调幅强震记录进行增量动力分析（IDA），建立对数正态概率地震需求模型（PSDM）。
de: 56 in-situ direct shear tests conducted at three hydropower sites in Nepal: 36 on Class II augen gneiss (Location A) and 20 on Class I phyllite and dolomitic slate (Locations B and C).
20 strong ground motion acceleration records from the 2015 Mw 7.8 Gorkha mainshock (USGS/CESMD) and Mw 6.7–7.3 aftershocks (Nepal Strong Motion Array), scaled across 10 PGA levels (0.1g to 1.0g).
在尼泊尔三个水电站在建场地开展的56组原位直剪试验：36组位于II类眼球状片麻岩（场地A），20组位于I类千枚岩和白云质板岩（场地B和C）。
来自2015年Mw 7.8廓尔喀主震（USGS/CESMD）及Mw 6.7–7.3余震（尼泊尔强震台阵）的20条强地面运动记录，按0.1g至1.0g共10个PGA等级调幅。
li: In-situ shear tests were performed under monotonic constant normal load (CNL) conditions rather than cyclic constant normal stiffness (CNS) conditions.

Numerical modeling was restricted to 2D plane strain with uniform mean interface properties and simplified Westergaard hydrodynamic added mass rather than 3D coupled fluid-structure interaction (FSI).

Excavation damage zone (EDZ) JCS loss was inferred indirectly without direct geophysical characterization (e.g., wave velocity or micro-crack logging), and long-term aging/chemical bond degradation was neglected.
原位剪切试验在单调常法向荷载（CNL）条件下进行，未考虑循环荷载及常法向刚度（CNS）边界条件。
数值模拟局限于二维平面应变、均匀界面均值参数以及简化的Westergaard动水附加质量近似，未采用三维流固耦合（FSI）模型。
开挖损伤区（EDZ）强度折减系间接推断，缺乏波速或微裂隙等直接地球物理表征，且未考虑长期老化和化学键退化效应。

tm.why: The study performs incremental dynamic analysis and develops probabilistic seismic fragility curves for a 140 m concrete gravity dam using 20 strong-motion records from the 2015 Gorkha earthquake sequence.
The paper investigates frictional sliding, joint roughness mobilization, apparent cohesion, and post-peak displacement-dependent shear degradation along rock-concrete discontinuities.

ev.notes: Full 43-page Accepted Manuscript PDF from Scientific Reports used, including all 26 figures and 9 tables.

sum: Subsea telecommunication cables offer massive potential for deep-ocean geophysical monitoring, yet existing techniques like Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and optical frequency domain reflectometry require expensive, ultra-stable lasers and high-speed electronics. This paper demonstrates the first implementation of a 10 GHz microwave frequency fiber interferometry (MFFI) system with analogue downconversion in a per-span configuration using high-loss loopbacks. Deployed on the 1,770 km operational IRIS subsea cable between Ireland and Iceland (17 spans of ~100 km each) for four months, the system replaces expensive low-linewidth lasers with off-the-shelf 10 GHz phase-locked loop oscillators and samples at low rates (<1 Msps). The prototype successfully resolved a broad frequency range (hours to 25 Hz), capturing teleseismic surface and S waves from Mw 7.6 Japan and Mw 7.4 Indonesia earthquakes, 12-hour North East Atlantic ocean tides, and 0.1–0.3 Hz storm-induced secondary microseisms, enabling scalable, cost-effective real-time ocean monitoring.
本研究首次在1770公里爱尔兰至冰岛的在役海底光缆（IRIS，含17个约100公里跨段）上实现了基于模拟下变频的10 GHz分跨段微波频率光纤干涉（MFFI）系统。该方法利用商用10 GHz锁相环振荡器替代昂贵的窄线宽激光器，结合高损耗环回（HLLB）与低采样率（1 Msps ADC，FPGA降采样……

t: A 10 GHz (tuned to 9.8 GHz) microwave-modulated optical pulse (0.5 ms width, 20 ms period) interrogates submarine cable high-loss loopbacks, using analogue I/Q RF downconversion and 1 Msps ADC sampling decimated to ~16 ksps on an FPGA.
采用9.8 GHz微波调制0.5 ms光脉冲选通海底光缆高损耗环回，经模拟I/Q下变频和1 Msps采样并抽取至16 k…

Four months of continuous monitoring (starting November 2025) across 17 spans (~100 km each) of the 1,770 km operational IRIS subsea telecommunication cable connecting Galway, Ireland and Iceland, validated against BORG seismic station, tide gauges, and WAVEWATCH III models.
连接爱尔兰与冰岛的1770公里IRIS在役海缆（17个百公里跨段）4个月连续数据，结合BORG地震台、验潮仪及海浪模型验…

The system resolved signals from hours to 25 Hz across 17 spans, detecting surface, S, and SSS waves from Mw 7.6 Hokkaido and Mw 7.4 Indonesia earthquakes, ~12-hour North East Atlantic tides, and 0.1–0.3 Hz storm microseisms.
在数小时至25 Hz频带内成功检测出北海道Mw 7.6和印尼Mw 7.4远震面波与S波、12小时周期潮汐及0.1-0.3…
Each span integrates deformations over ~100 km between optical amplifiers, causing waveform differences compared to point seismic stations due to spatial averaging and cable geometrical sensitivity.
空间分辨率受限于100公里放大器间距，空间积分效应与方向灵敏度导致与点测地震仪波形存在差异。
First implementation of 10 GHz MFFI with analogue downconversion in a per-span subsea configuration, enabling wideband (hours to 25 Hz) sensing at low (<Msps) sampling rates without costly lasers.
首次实现基于模拟下变频的10 GHz分跨段MFFI海缆传感，无需昂贵窄线宽激光器和高速采样即可实现宽频带监测。

kc: First demonstration of 10 GHz microwave frequency fiber interferometry (MFFI) with analogue I/Q downconversion in a per-span subsea cable configuration.
Replaced costly ultra-low-linewidth lasers and Gsps digitisers with off-the-shelf 10 GHz PLL oscillators and 1 Msps ADCs.
Resolved teleseismic earthquakes (Mw 7.6 Hokkaido, Mw 7.4 Indonesia), ocean tides, and storm microseisms across 17 spans of a 1,770 km Ireland-Iceland cable.
首次在海底光缆分跨段架构中实现了基于模拟I/Q下变频的10 GHz微波频率光纤干涉（MFFI）系统。
用商用10 GHz锁相环振荡器和1 Msps低速ADC替代了昂贵的超窄线宽激光器和Gsps高速采集卡。
在1770公里爱尔兰-冰岛光缆的17个跨段上成功观测到远震（北海道Mw 7.6、印尼Mw 7.4）、海洋潮汐和风暴微震。
me: 10 GHz (tuned to 9.8 GHz) intensity modulation via Mach-Zehnder modulator driven by a phase-locked loop oscillator.
Time-gating of 17 high-loss loopback spans (~100 km each) using 0.5 ms acousto-optic modulator pulses at a 20 ms repetition period.
Analogue baseband I/Q RF mixer downconversion followed by 1 Msps ADC sampling and FPGA decimation to ~16 ksps.
利用锁相环振荡器驱动马赫-曾德尔调制器进行10 GHz（调谐至9.8 GHz以抑制色散衰落）光强调制。
通过声光调制器以20 ms重复周期施加0.5 ms光脉冲，对17个高损耗环回跨段（每段约100 km）进行时间选通。
采用模拟I/Q射频混频器下变频至基带，经1 Msps商用ADC采样及FPGA抽取至约16 ksps。
de: Four-month continuous interrogation (since November 2025) of the 1,770 km operational IRIS submarine cable linking Galway, Ireland to Iceland.
Comparison of MFFI channel 17 waveforms with broadband seismic station BORG in Iceland for the 2025-12-08 Mw 7.6 Hokkaido and 2026-04-01 Mw 7.4 Indonesia earthquakes.
Comparison of MFFI strain data with Galway Port tide gauge measurements and WAVEWATCH III significant wave height hindcasts during February 2026 storms.
自2025年11月起对连接爱尔兰戈尔韦与冰岛的1770公里在役IRIS海底光缆进行为期四个月的连续监测。
将2025-12-08北海道Mw 7.6和2026-04-01印尼Mw 7.4地震的第17通道波形与冰岛BORG宽频带地震台记录进行对比。
将2026年2月风暴期间的MFFI应变数据与戈尔韦港验潮仪数据及WAVEWATCH III有效波高后报数据进行对比。
li: Spatial resolution is limited by optical amplifier spacing (~100 km per span), offering spatially integrated measurements rather than fine point measurements.
Partial waveform discrepancies compared to terrestrial seismometers due to spatially integrated strain sensing, location differences, and directional geometrical sensitivity.
空间分辨率受光放大器间距限制（每跨段约100公里），仅提供空间积分测量而非高分辨率点测量。
受空间积分效应、位置差异及几何方向灵敏度影响，所测波形与陆地地震仪记录仅呈部分吻合。

tm.why: The paper develops and demonstrates per-span microwave frequency fiber interferometry on a 1,770 km subsea fiber-optic cable to record earthquakes, tides, and ocean storms.
The study builds a low-cost fiber-optic interrogator prototype utilizing high-loss loopbacks in submarine telecommunication cables as an array of 100-km-spaced ocean-bottom geophysical sensors.
The system monitors environmental and oceanographic signals including ocean tides and storm-generated secondary microseisms across the North East Atlantic.

ev.notes: Full 4-page conference/preprint PDF analyzed, including text and all 4 figures.

sum: This study analyzes peak ground acceleration (PGA) data from accelerometers and broadband networks in New Caledonia and Vanuatu, comparing them with ground-motion prediction equations (GMPEs). The authors find that shallow earthquakes (<50 km depth) produce anomalously low PGAs in the outer rise of the downgoing Australian plate (New Caledonia). By ruling out source effects and accounting for site amplification using horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios, they identify a localized attenuation barrier beneath the shallow outer slope of the subduction trench. They propose this barrier consists of fractured, hydrated lithosphere that dampens high-frequency energy. This finding suggests that seismic hazard in New Caledonia is lower than predicted by standard GMPEs, but warning systems may underestimate local magnitudes and tsunami hazards unless this path effect is corrected.
本研究分析了新喀里多尼亚和瓦努阿图强震仪及宽频带台网的峰值地面加速度（PGA）数据，并与地震动预测方程（GMPEs）进行了对比。研究发现，俯冲澳大利亚板块外隆起区（新喀里多尼亚）的浅源地震（深度<50 km）表现出异常低的PGA。在排除震源效应并利用H/V谱比法考虑场地放大后，作者提出俯冲海沟浅部外……
