t: Comparison of observed peak ground accelerations (PGA) against ground-motion prediction equations (GMPEs), combined with horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (HVSR) to isolate site amplification from path attenuation.
将观测到的PGA与GMPE进行对比，并结合水平垂直向谱比法（HVSR）以区分场地放大与路径衰减。
PGA and waveform data recorded by accelerometers and broadband seismometers across two networks in New Caledonia and one network in Vanuatu.
新喀里多尼亚两个台网和瓦努阿图一个台网的强震仪及宽频带地震仪记录的PGA和波形数据。
Shallow earthquakes (<50 km) show anomalously low PGAs in New Caledonia due to a localized attenuation barrier of fractured hydrated lithosphere beneath the shallow outer slope of the trench.
海沟浅部外侧坡下方的破碎水化岩石圈局部衰减屏障导致新喀里多尼亚浅源地震的PGA异常偏低。
There is insufficient data to fully evaluate the presence and impact of suspected localized attenuation barriers directly beneath Grande Terre.
由于数据量不足，无法充分评估格朗德特尔岛下方可能存在的局部衰减屏障效应。
Identification of a shallow, highly attenuating barrier of fractured hydrated lithosphere in a subduction footwall/outer-rise setting that significantly dampens shallow earthquake ground motions.
首次在俯冲带下盘/外隆起背景下发现并提出海沟下方存在破碎水化岩石圈构成的浅部高衰减屏障。

kc: Identified anomalously low peak ground accelerations (PGAs) from shallow subduction earthquakes recorded in the footwall (outer rise) of the Vanuatu subduction zone.
Proposed a physical mechanism of a shallow attenuation barrier composed of fractured, hydrated lithosphere beneath the trench slope.
Demonstrated that standard GMPEs overestimate seismic hazard in New Caledonia, while local magnitude and tsunami hazard calculations may be underestimated.
发现了瓦努阿图俯冲带下盘（外隆起）记录到的浅源俯冲地震具有异常低的峰值地面加速度（PGA）。
提出了海沟坡下方由破碎、水化岩石圈构成的浅部衰减屏障这一物理机制。
证实了标准GMPE高估了新喀里多尼亚的地震灾害，而本地震级和海啸预警计算则可能被低估。
me: Comparison of observed peak ground acceleration (PGA) data with standard Ground-Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs).
Horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) analysis to evaluate local site amplification effects.
Path-specific attenuation analysis distinguishing between shallow (<50 km) and deep (>50 km) earthquake paths.
将观测到的峰值地面加速度（PGA）数据与标准地震动预测方程（GMPEs）进行对比分析。
利用水平与垂直向谱比法（HVSR）评估局部场地放大效应。
针对浅源（<50 km）和深源（>50 km）地震路径进行特定路径衰减分析。
de: Seismic waveform and PGA data from two seismic networks in New Caledonia (Grande Terre and Loyalty Islands) and one network in Vanuatu.
Geological maps and site characterization data from Grande Terre and the Isle of Pines.
来自新喀里多尼亚（格朗德特尔岛和洛亚蒂群岛）两个台网以及瓦努阿图一个台网的地震波形与PGA数据。
新喀里多尼亚格朗德特尔岛和松树岛的区域地质图及场地特征数据。
li: Limited data density to fully map and evaluate potential localized barriers directly beneath Grande Terre.
数据密度有限，不足以完全评估和制图格朗德特尔岛正下方的潜在局部屏障。

tm.why: The paper compares peak ground acceleration (PGA) data with ground-motion prediction equations (GMPEs) to evaluate seismic hazard and ground shaking.
The study identifies a localized attenuation barrier of fractured hydrated lithosphere beneath the shallow subduction trench.
The paper proposes a structural barrier of fractured hydrated lithosphere in the footwall of the Vanuatu subduction zone.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from BSSA, OpenAlex, and Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: The paper introduces a six-criterion consensus framework to identify seismically critical zones using only standard seismic catalog data. It combines three new magnitude variance signals (compression, quiescence, and skewness anomaly) with three established parameters (b-value, 90-day event count, and coefficient of variation of inter-event times). Applied to catalogs in Japan (JMA) and Turkey (AFAD), the method successfully captures a high percentage of major mainshocks (including the 2011 Tohoku M9.0 and 2023 Kahramanmaraş M7.7) in prospective assessments. The novelty lies in using a multi-parameter consensus approach on catalog data alone to generate falsifiable forecasts.
本文提出了一种仅利用标准地震目录数据识别地震关键区的六准则共识框架。该方法结合了三种新定义的震级方差信号（压缩、平静和偏度异常）与三种经典地震学参数（b值、90天事件数和地震间隔时间变异系数）。在对日本JMA和土耳其AFAD目录的应用中，该方法成功预测了大部分强震（包括2011年东北M9.0和202……

t: A six-criterion consensus framework combining three new magnitude variance signals with three traditional seismological parameters to rank and identify critical earthquake zones.
结合三种新震级方差信号与三种传统地震学参数的六准则共识框架，用于评估和识别关键地震带。
Standard seismic catalog data from the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) and the Turkish AFAD, spanning from 2000 to 2026.
使用日本气象厅（JMA）和土耳其 AFAD 的标准地震目录数据（时间跨度为 2000 年至 2026 年）。
Identified 81% of M>=5.5 and 100% of M>=7.0 mainshocks in Japan, and 100% of onshore M>=6.0 events in Turkey, including the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake.
成功捕获了日本 100% 的 M>=7.0 地震以及土耳其 100% 的陆上 M>=6.0 地震（含 2023 年强震）…
The framework exhibits reduced performance for offshore events, with all missed M >= 6.0 earthquakes located more than 200 km offshore.
对远海地震的检测能力有限，所有漏报的 M >= 6.0 地震均位于离岸 200 公里以外。
Integration of three newly defined magnitude variance signals (compression, quiescence, skewness) into a multi-parameter consensus framework using catalog data alone.
首次将新定义的压缩、平静和偏度异常三种震级方差指标整合入仅依赖目录的多参数共识框架中。

kc: Developed a novel six-criterion consensus framework for identifying critical earthquake zones.
Introduced three new magnitude variance metrics: compression (C), quiescence (Q), and skewness anomaly (S).
Demonstrated high success rates in capturing M >= 6.0 and M >= 7.0 earthquakes in Japan and Turkey catalogs.
开发了一种用于识别关键地震带的新型六准则共识框架。
引入了三种新的震级方差指标：压缩（C）、平静（Q）和偏度异常（S）。
在日本和土耳其地震目录的应用中，展示了对 M >= 6.0 和 M >= 7.0 地震的高成功率捕获。
me: Consensus scoring using six independent functions based on magnitude variance and seismicity parameters.
Grid-based spatial analysis filtering cells with seismicity rate drops (Q > 0.9).
Statistical validation using Mann-Whitney U tests on pre-earthquake compression patterns.
基于震级方差和地震活动性参数，利用六个独立函数进行共识评分。
基于网格的空间分析，过滤出地震活动率下降的网格单元（Q > 0.9）。
对震前压缩模式进行 Mann-Whitney U 检验等统计学验证。
de: Tested on the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) unified catalog (178,577 events, M >= 3.0, 2000-2023).
Cross-validated on the Turkish AFAD catalog (53,340 events, 2000-2026).
在日本气象厅（JMA）统一目录上进行了测试（178,577个事件，M >= 3.0，2000-2023年）。
在土耳其 AFAD 目录上进行了交叉验证（53,340个事件，2000-2026年）。
li: All missed M >= 6.0 events were located more than 200 km offshore, indicating reduced sensitivity in far-offshore regions.
所有漏报的 M >= 6.0 地震均位于离岸 200 公里以外，表明该方法在远海区域的敏感度较低。

tm.why: The paper presents a framework to identify critical earthquake zones using standard seismic catalog data.
The framework aims to forecast critical zones for large earthquakes, which is directly relevant to seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is strictly based on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: The authors present a unified, homogenized, and declustered earthquake catalog for continental Chile (15°–60° S) by integrating 12 global, regional, and historical datasets. They implement a depuration scheme to resolve duplicates and classify events by tectonic mechanism. A key contribution is the comparative evaluation of four declustering algorithms (Gardner & Knopoff, Reasenberg, Poulos et al., and Zaliapin & Ben-Zion) using interevent time and event count tests. The results show that while recurrence estimates are consistent at aggregated scales, they diverge in regions with major aftershock sequences, demonstrating how catalog processing choices impact seismic hazard recurrence parameters.
该研究整合了12个全球、区域和历史数据集，构建了智利大陆（15°–60° S）统一且经震级统一化的地震目录。研究采用显式排序和事件优先级标准解决重复事件，并根据几何和构造信息进行分类。核心创新在于对比评估了四种去余震算法（GK、Reasenberg、Poulos等及Zaliapin-Ben-Zion……

t: Integration of 12 datasets with duplicate resolution, tectonic classification, and comparative evaluation of four declustering algorithms (GK, Reasenberg, Poulos, and Zaliapin & Ben-Zion).
整合12个数据集并去重分类，对比评估了四种去余震算法（GK、Reasenberg、Poulos和Zaliapin等）。
12 global, regional, and historical earthquake datasets covering continental Chile (15°–60° S).
覆盖智利大陆（15°–60° S）的12个全球、区域和历史地震数据集。
Declustering results show consistent recurrence estimates at aggregated scales, but significant divergence in regions dominated by major aftershock sequences.
去余震结果在整体尺度上一致，但在强余震序列主导的区域，复现率估算存在显著差异。
Inferred magnitude recurrence parameters are highly sensitive to catalog processing and declustering choices in active aftershock regions.
在活跃余震区，推导出的震级复现参数对目录处理和去余震方法的选择高度敏感。
First unified, multi-catalog framework for Chile evaluating and comparing four distinct declustering algorithms systematically.
首次在智利统一多目录框架下，系统性对比和评估了四种不同的去余震算法。

kc: Developed a unified, homogenized earthquake catalog for continental Chile integrating 12 datasets.
Evaluated and compared four distinct declustering algorithms within a unified framework.
Quantified the impact of declustering choices on magnitude recurrence parameters for seismic hazard analysis.
整合12个数据集，构建了智利大陆统一且震级标定的地震目录。
在统一框架下对比评估了四种不同的去余震算法。
量化了去余震算法的选择对地震危险性分析中震级复现参数的影响。
me: Duplicate resolution using explicit ranking and event-priority criteria.
Tectonic classification based on geometrical and tectonic information.
Declustering using Gardner & Knopoff (1974), Reasenberg (1985), Poulos et al. (2019), and Zaliapin & Ben-Zion (2013) nearest-neighbor methods.
Temporal consistency testing using interevent times and event counts.
使用显式排序和事件优先级标准解决重复事件的去重方案。
基于几何和构造信息的地震构造机制分类。
采用Gardner & Knopoff (1974)、Reasenberg (1985)、Poulos等 (2019) 以及 Zaliapin & Ben-Zion (2013) 最近邻方法进行去余震处理。
利用地震间隔时间和事件计数测试进行时间一致性评估。
de: Integration of 12 global, regional, and historical earthquake datasets covering continental Chile (15°–60° S).
整合了覆盖智利大陆（15°–60° S）的12个全球、区域及历史地震数据集。
li: Recurrence estimates can diverge significantly in regions dominated by major aftershock sequences depending on the chosen declustering method.
在由主要余震序列主导的区域，震级复现参数的估算高度依赖于所选的去余震方法，存在一定偏差。

tm.why: The paper presents a unified, homogenized, and declustered earthquake catalog for continental Chile.
The catalog is specifically designed and evaluated for seismic hazard applications and recurrence parameter estimation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract from Seismological Research Letters and cross-referenced metadata.

sum: This study tracks the subsurface evolution of Askja volcano, Iceland, from 2008 to 2024, focusing on the rapid 76.5 cm ground inflation that began in August 2021. The authors integrate ambient noise coda wave interferometry (dv/v) via wavelet cross-spectrum transform, network covariance matrix spectral width, Displacement Seismic Amplitude Ratio (DSAR) attenuation proxy, and 3D multiscale sensitivity kernel inversions, alongside GNSS and meteorological records. Prior to August 2021, dv/v exhibited regular ±0.2% seasonal oscillations driven by snow loading and pore pressure. Inflation onset triggered an abrupt dv/v drop to -0.7% near the caldera and a 0.4-unit DSAR increase through June 2022, followed by frequency-dependent recovery and DSAR decrease. Sensitivity kernels confirm waves probe down to the 3 km shallow magma reservoir. The novelty lies in combining four complementary continuous seismic techniques over 16 years to separate environmental loading, magma intrusion, and shallow hydrothermal reorganization.
本研究利用2008至2024年连续地震记录，追踪了冰岛阿斯基亚火山2021年8月开始的快速地表隆升（76.5厘米）期间的地下演化。作者结合了环境噪声尾波干涉（dv/v）、网络协方差矩阵谱宽、位移地震振幅比（DSAR）和三维多尺度敏感核反演，并辅以GNSS与气象数据。2021年8月前，积雪荷载和孔隙压……

t: Integrates ambient-noise coda wave interferometry (MSNoise with wavelet cross-spectrum transform), network covariance matrix spectral width (CovSeisNet), single-station DSAR attenuation proxy, and iterative multiscale spatial inversion using 1D/2D surface and diffusive coda wave sensitivity kernels.
结合环境噪声尾波干涉、协方差矩阵谱宽、单台DSAR衰减代理及基于面波和尾波敏感核的迭代多尺度空间反演。

Continuous 3-component seismic records from 15 stations at Askja volcano (2008–2024 across networks 4F, Z7, 8K), complemented by 4 GNSS stations, the IMO earthquake catalog, ERA5-Land meteorological data, and a 3D local velocity model.
2008至2024年阿斯基亚火山15个台站的连续三分量地震记录，辅以4个GNSS台站、地震目录、ERA5气象数据及三维速…

Following the August 2021 inflation onset (76.5 cm GNSS uplift), dv/v transitioned from ±0.2% seasonal cycles to a -0.7% drop within the upper 3 km inside Askja caldera, while DSAR rose by 0.4 units until June 2022 before dropping 0.5 units.
2021年8月膨胀开始后，dv/v从±0.2%季节性波动骤降至-0.7%（深达3 km），DSAR增加0.4后于2022…

Disentangling the individual contributions of magmatic melt injection, hydrothermal fluid circulation, snow loading, and discontinuous permafrost or buried ice at each station remains challenging, alongside winter data gaps.
难以在单台尺度精确区分岩浆注入、热液流体、积雪荷载与冻土/埋藏冰的贡献，且存在冬季数据缺失。

Integrates four continuous seismic methods (dv/v, DSAR, covariance spectral width, and 3D multiscale sensitivity kernel inversion) over 16 years to separate environmental loading from magma intrusion and hydrothermal reorganization at Askja.
首次综合四种连续地震监测方法跨越16年区分阿斯基亚火山的环境荷载、岩浆侵入与热液系统重组。

kc: Reconstructed a 16-year (2008–2024) continuous seismic baseline at Askja volcano, characterizing ±0.2% seasonal dv/v variations driven by snow mass and hydrological loading.
Detected a sharp transition at the August 2021 inflation onset, with dv/v dropping up to -0.7% near the inflation center and spatial inversions localizing the reduction within the caldera.
Demonstrated via network covariance matrix spectral width that persistent tremor sources (1–7 Hz) remained stable during inflation onset, confirming dv/v drops reflect true medium changes.

Revealed shallow volatile accumulation and subsequent depressurization after June 2022 using DSAR, alongside frequency- and component-dependent dv/v recovery indicating hydrothermal system reorganization.
重建了阿斯基亚火山16年（2008–2024年）的连续地震基线，表征了由积雪质量和文水荷载驱动的±0.2%季节性dv/v变化。
检测到2021年8月膨胀开始时的急剧转变，膨胀中心附近dv/v下降达-0.7%，空间反演将该降速定位于破火山口内。
通过网络协方差矩阵谱宽证明持续颤动源（1–7 Hz）在膨胀开始时保持稳定，证实dv/v下降反映了真实的介质性质变化。
利用DSAR揭示了浅层挥发分聚集及2022年6月后的减压过程，并结合频率和分量依赖的dv/v恢复揭示了热液系统重组。
me: Ambient noise cross-correlation (MSNoise) and wavelet cross-spectrum transform (WCT) using both static (2018–2019) and 10-day moving references to measure dv/v across 0.5–5 Hz.
Network-based covariance matrix spectral width analysis (CovSeisNet) to identify coherent seismic tremor sources and their seasonal frequency variations.
Single-station Displacement Seismic Amplitude Ratio (DSAR) between 6–9 Hz and 9–16 Hz vertical components to monitor shallow seismic attenuation.
1D surface-wave depth sensitivity kernels (Disba) and 2D Fresnel/diffusive coda kernels combined with an iterative multiscale inversion and adaptive grid refinement to map dv/v.
利用环境噪声互相关（MSNoise）和小波互谱变换（WCT），结合静态（2018–2019年）和10天滑动参考计算0.5–5 Hz频段的dv/v。
基于网络的协方差矩阵谱宽分析（CovSeisNet），用于识别相干地震颤动源及其季节性频率变化。
计算单台垂直分量6–9 Hz与9–16 Hz频段的位移地震振幅比（DSAR），以监测浅层地震衰减。
结合一维面波深度敏感核（Disba）与二维菲涅耳/扩散尾波核，采用自适应网格加密的迭代多尺度反演方法绘制dv/v空间分布。
de: Continuous 3-component broadband seismic records from 15 stations across networks 4F, Z7, and 8K at Askja volcano from July 2008 to July 2024.
GNSS ground deformation time series (stations OLAC, KASC, JONC, TANC) and Icelandic Meteorological Office earthquake catalog (2009–2024).
ERA5-Land meteorological reanalysis data including temperature, air pressure, precipitation, and snow depth water equivalent.
3D local body-wave velocity model of Askja (Han et al., 2024) and synthetic checkerboard, Gaussian, and fault-anomaly tests for spatial dv/v inversion.
2008年7月至2024年7月阿斯基亚火山4F、Z7和8K台网15个宽频带地震台站的连续三分量记录。
GNSS地表形变时间序列（OLAC、KASC、JONC、TANC台站）及冰岛气象局地震目录（2009–2024年）。
ERA5-Land气象再分析数据，包括温度、气压、降水量和雪深水当量。
阿斯基亚三维局部体波速度模型（Han et al., 2024）以及用于空间dv/v反演验证的合成棋盘、高斯和断层异常测试。
li: Disentangling the exact contributions of snow loading, buried ice/permafrost, magmatic melt injection, and hydrothermal fluids at each individual station remains challenging.
Data gaps (e.g., 2017 network reduction, 2019–2020 gap at JONS) and winter power loss from snow-covered solar panels limit temporal continuity and spatial resolution.
DSAR measurements in the 6–16 Hz band may be partially contaminated in summer by persistent local noise sources (e.g., rivers, Kárahnjúkar dam) extending up to 7 Hz.
在单个台站尺度上，精确区分积雪荷载、埋藏冰/永久冻土、岩浆熔体注入和热液流体的各自贡献仍然具有挑战性。
数据缺失（如2017年台网缩减、JONS台站2019–2020年中断）及冬季太阳能板积雪导致的断电限制了时间连续性和空间分辨率。
6–16 Hz频段的DSAR测量在夏季可能受到延伸至7 Hz的持续局部噪声源（如河流、Kárahnjúkar大坝）的部分干扰。

tm.why: The paper investigates subsurface evolution during the 2021-2024 volcanic inflation at Askja volcano, Iceland, alongside seasonal hydrological and snow loading effects.
Continuous seismic records from 2008 to 2024 are analyzed using ambient noise cross-correlations and coda wave interferometry to measure relative velocity changes (dv/v).
The study uses Displacement Seismic Amplitude Ratio (DSAR) to monitor temporal changes in seismic wavefield attenuation and models diffusive coda wave sensitivity kernels.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF read and analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), all 10 figures, and data/code availability statements.

sum: This study investigates active crustal deformation in the Lerma Valley of the Argentine Eastern Cordillera using a 13-month temporary seismic network (LEVARIS). The authors detected 1076 events (605 well-located), determined focal mechanisms with FOCMEC, refined depths via waveform cross-correlation, inverted for tectonic stress, and derived a local 1D velocity model using VELEST from 96 high-quality events. Results reveal a low average Vp/Vs ratio of 1.65 ± 0.03 and five crustal layers with P-wave velocities ~5% slower than IASP91A. Seismicity displays a bimodal depth distribution peaking at ~17 km and ~33 km, extending down to the Moho (~50 km), which indicates a dry, brittle granulitic lower crust pre-conditioned by Cretaceous rift magmatism. Focal mechanisms and stress inversion show NNW–SSE (10° rotated from E–W) compression driving high-angle reverse faulting that roots into a two-tiered, west-dipping detachment system at ~15 km and ~25 km depths.
本研究利用在阿根廷东科迪勒拉山脉莱尔马谷部署的13个月临时地震台网（LEVARIS）数据，结合HYPOSAT定位、波形互相关、FOCMEC震源机制求解、应力反演及VELEST一维速度反演，首次详细刻画了该盆地的微震活动与地壳结构。共检测到1076次地震（605次获得稳定解）。研究发现该区平均Vp/V……

t: The workflow combines LASSIE detection, manual picking, HYPOSAT location, Pyrocko waveform cross-correlation, FOCMEC focal mechanisms, Stressinverse stress inversion, Pseudo-Wadati Vp/Vs regression, and Monte Carlo 1D VELEST velocity inversion.
结合LASSIE检测、HYPOSAT定位、波形互相关、FOCMEC震源机制、应力反演、伪和达回归及VELEST速度反演。
Data come from the 12-station LEVARIS temporary seismic network operated for 13 months (August 2017–October 2018) across an 80 km by 30 km area around Salta, recording at 100 Hz.
使用萨尔塔周边80×30公里区域内部署的12台站LEVARIS临时台网13个月的100 Hz连续波形数据。
Out of 1076 detected events, 605 have stable depths showing bimodal crustal seismicity peaks at 16.9 and 33.2 km, a low Vp/Vs of 1.65 ± 0.03, and reverse faulting along 15 and 25 km detachments.
定位605个稳定事件，呈16.9和33.2公里双峰深度分布，波速比1.65±0.03，揭示15和25公里双层逆冲滑脱带。
Roughly 471 events yielded unstable depth solutions fixed at 0 km, and events deeper than 40 km lacked unambiguous focal mechanisms to constrain near-Moho fault kinematics.
约471个事件深度解不稳定被固定在0公里，且40公里以深事件缺乏明确震源机制解。
Provides the first detailed local velocity model, focal depths, and high-resolution microseismic evidence of active deformation along the 15-km and 25-km detachment system in the Lerma Valley.
首次提供莱尔马谷局部速度模型、精确震源深度及15和25公里双层滑脱带微震活动的直接证据。

kc: Compiled the first high-resolution microseismicity catalog (1076 events, 605 stable locations) for the intermontane Lerma Valley using the 13-month LEVARIS temporary network.
Derived a local 5-layer 1D crustal velocity model and a low Vp/Vs ratio of 1.65 ± 0.03 using Pseudo-Wadati analysis and Monte Carlo VELEST inversions.

Demonstrated that seismicity extends down to Moho depths (~50 km) with bimodal peaks at 16.9 km and 33.2 km, evidencing a two-tiered detachment system (~15 km and ~25 km) and a dry, brittle lower crust.
利用为期13个月的LEVARIS临时地震台网，编制了山间盆地莱尔马谷的首个高分辨率微震目录（共1076个事件，605个稳定定位）。
利用伪和达分析和蒙特卡洛VELEST反演，建立了当地5层一维地壳速度模型，并测得1.65 ± 0.03的低Vp/Vs波速比。
证实地震活动延伸至莫霍面深度（约50公里），在16.9公里和33.2公里处呈双峰分布，为双层滑脱系统（约15公里和25公里）及干燥脆性下地壳提供了证据。
me: Automated event detection with LASSIE followed by manual P- and S-phase picking and hypocenter location using HYPOSAT.
Waveform cross-correlation (template matching in Pyrocko, 1–10 Hz) to quantify cluster similarity and constrain unstable focal depths and oscillatory focal mechanisms.
Focal mechanism determination using FOCMEC (P and SH polarities) and regional tectonic stress tensor inversion using Stressinverse.
Pseudo-Wadati linear regression for Vp/Vs estimation and 1D P-wave velocity inversion via 1000 Monte Carlo realizations in VELEST.
使用LASSIE进行自动事件检测，随后进行人工P波和S波震相拾取，并使用HYPOSAT进行震源定位。
利用波形互相关（Pyrocko中的模板匹配，1–10 Hz）量化震群相似性，并约束不稳定的震源深度和振荡的震源机制解。
使用FOCMEC（基于P波和SH波极性）确定震源机制，并使用Stressinverse反演区域构造应力张量。
通过伪和达线性回归估计Vp/Vs波速比，并在VELEST中通过1000次蒙特卡洛实现进行一维P波速度反演。
de: Continuous 100 Hz 3-component seismic waveforms from the 12-site LEVARIS temporary network deployed around Salta, Argentina, from August 2017 to October 2018 (71% data recovery).
A subset of 96 well-constrained local earthquakes (depths <= 60 km) used for 1D velocity inversion, and 25 focal mechanisms (clusters 1, 2, and within-valley events) analyzed for fault kinematics.
2017年8月至2018年10月期间部署在阿根廷萨尔塔周边的12个台站LEVARIS临时台网记录的连续100 Hz三分量地震波形数据（数据回收率71%）。
选取96个约束良好的地方震（深度≤60公里）用于一维速度反演，并对25个震源机制解（震群1、2及盆地内事件）进行了断层运动学分析。
li: Roughly one-third of detected events (~471 out of 1076) yielded unstable or oscillatory depth solutions and had to be fixed at 0 km depth in the catalog.
Limited focal sphere coverage (large azimuthal gaps up to ~275°) at the western margin of the network caused uncertainties and oscillatory solutions in focal mechanism determinations.
Ambiguous focal mechanisms could not be derived for deep crustal events exceeding 40 km depth to directly constrain near-Moho fault kinematics.
约三分之一的检测事件（1076个中的约471个）产生了不稳定或振荡的深度解，在目录中不得不将其深度固定在0公里。
台网西缘有限的震源球覆盖（最大方位角空隙达约275°）导致震源机制确定中存在不确定性和振荡解。
无法为超过40公里深度的深部地壳事件推导出明确的震源机制解，从而难以直接约束莫霍面附近的断层运动学。

tm.why: The study builds a new 1076-event microseismicity catalog from a 13-month temporary seismic deployment (LEVARIS) using automated detection, manual picking, HYPOSAT relocation, and waveform cross-correlation.

The paper derives a 1D crustal velocity model, constrains a low Vp/Vs ratio (1.65), and interprets a two-tiered detachment system (~15 km and ~25 km) and dry lower-crustal rheology in the Central Andes.
Focal mechanisms are determined using FOCMEC and inverted for the local tectonic stress field using Stressinverse to characterize reverse faulting and reactivation of inherited rift faults.

sum: Quantifying the spatial migration of seismic swarms using conventional single-exponent diffusion models remains challenging due to crustal heterogeneity. This study analyzes ten persistent earthquake swarms (each with >200 events) extracted from the relocated Southern California earthquake catalog using a 27-realization consensus space-time clustering workflow. By examining the temporal evolution of interevent-distance moments ($q \in [-2, 15]$), the authors derive the multiscaling spectrum $\varepsilon(q)$. All swarms exhibit a dual-regime signature: an approximately linear spectrum for negative moments ($q < 0$) and a systematic nonlinear departure for positive moments ($q \ge 1$), indicating strong anomalous diffusion where small and large separations evolve differently. In contrast, the 1992 Landers tectonic sequence shows high-order saturation ($\varepsilon(q) \approx 0.1$), reflecting caged diffusion bounded by the fault plane. The novelty lies in establishing the multiscaling spectrum $\varepsilon(q)$ as a quantitative fingerprint to differentiate fluid-driven swarm migration from tectonic sequences.
本研究利用包含27组参数的共识时空聚类方法，从南加州重定位地震目录中识别出10个持续性地震群（事件数>200）。通过计算不同时间滞后下震间距离统计矩的演化，获取了多重标度谱$\varepsilon(q)$。结果显示，所有震群在负阶矩（$q<0$）呈近似线性，而在正阶矩（$q\ge 1$）系统性偏离单……

t: Swarms are detected via 27-realization consensus space-time clustering and moment-release filtering. Migration is quantified via the multiscaling spectrum $\varepsilon(q)$, estimated from log-log slopes of $q$-order interevent-distance moments $M_q(\theta)$ versus temporal lag $\theta$ for $-2 \le q \le 15$.
通过27组参数的共识时空聚类识别震群，并基于震间距离q阶矩随时间滞后的双对数斜率计算多重标度谱。

The relocated Southern California earthquake catalog (Hauksson et al., 2012) cut at completeness magnitude $m_c = 2.0$, yielding 95 persistent swarms; the 10 swarms with $>200$ events are analyzed alongside the Landers sequence.
采用南加州重定位地震目录（完备震级2.0），筛选出10个大于200次事件的持续性震群及兰德斯序列。

All 10 swarms show linear $\varepsilon(q) = H_- q$ for $q < 0$ ($H_-$ from 0.0417 to 0.73) and nonlinear polynomial scaling for $q \ge 1$, whereas the Landers sequence saturates at $\varepsilon(q) \approx 0.1$ for large $q$.
10个震群在负阶矩呈线性、正阶矩呈非线性演化；而兰德斯序列在大q值处饱和于约0.1。

The catalog completeness threshold ($m_c = 2.0$) neglects spatiotemporal variations and short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI), and regression errors omit statistical dependence among event pairs.
完备震级未考虑时空变化和短期余震不完备性，且回归误差忽略了事件对间的统计依赖性。

First systematic application of the multiscaling diffusion formalism to persistent seismic swarms, combined with a consensus clustering workflow, demonstrating $\varepsilon(q)$ as a fingerprint to distinguish swarms from tectonic sequences.
首次结合共识聚类将多重标度扩散框架系统应用于地震群，提出了区分震群与构造序列的定量指纹。

kc: Developed a consensus space-time clustering workflow across 27 parameter realizations to robustly identify 95 persistent seismic swarms in Southern California.

Demonstrated that persistent seismic swarms exhibit a nonlinear multiscaling spectrum $\varepsilon(q)$ for positive moments and linear scaling for negative moments, indicative of strong anomalous diffusion.
Showed that the multiscaling spectrum distinguishes unbounded heterogeneous swarm diffusion from the spatially bounded (caged) diffusion of classical tectonic sequences like Landers.
开发了跨越27组参数实现的共识时空聚类工作流，在南加州稳健识别出95个持续性地震群。
证明持续性震群在负阶矩呈线性标度、正阶矩呈非线性多重标度谱，揭示了强反常扩散行为。
表明多重标度谱可有效区分震群的非均匀扩散与传统构造序列（如兰德斯地震）受断层限制的笼状扩散。
me: Completeness magnitude estimation ($m_c = 2.0$) using the coefficient of variation ($c_V = 0.9$) method.
Consensus DBSCAN-like space-time clustering combined with normalized seismic moment release statistics (centroid time, skewness, kurtosis) across 27 parameter grid realizations.
Multiscaling moment analysis of epicentral interevent distances $M_q(\theta) \sim \theta^{\varepsilon(q)}$ over moment orders $-2 \le q \le 15$, with AICc polynomial model selection for $q \ge 1$.
利用变异系数法（阈值$c_V = 0.9$）估计地震目录完备震级（$m_c = 2.0$）。
结合类DBSCAN时空聚类与归一化地震矩释放统计量（质心时间、偏度、峰度），在27组参数网格上进行共识聚类。
在$-2 \le q \le 15$范围内对震中距进行多重标度矩分析$M_q(\theta) \sim \theta^{\varepsilon(q)}$，并用AICc准则拟合正阶矩多项式。
de: Relocated Southern California earthquake catalog (Hauksson et al., 2012) from SCEDC (1981–2011), filtered above $m_c = 2.0$.
Ten persistent seismic swarms containing more than 200 earthquakes each, plus the 1992 Landers tectonic sequence for comparison.
南加州地震数据中心（SCEDC）的Hauksson等（2012）重定位地震目录（滤除$m_c = 2.0$以下事件）。
筛选出的10个包含超过200次地震的持续性震群，以及用于对比的1992年兰德斯构造地震序列。
li: The constant completeness magnitude estimate ($m_c = 2.0$) does not account for spatial variability or short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI).
Reported regression uncertainties in $\varepsilon(q)$ do not incorporate the full statistical dependence among earthquake pairs.
The analysis uses 2D epicentral distances ($d=2$) and excludes pairs with $r_{ij} \le 0.05$ km due to location uncertainty.
固定完备震级估计（$m_c = 2.0$）未考虑空间变化及大震后的短期余震不完备性（STAI）。
$\varepsilon(q)$的回归不确定性未完全包含地震对之间的统计相关性。
分析仅基于二维震中坐标（$d=2$），且为避免定位误差剔除了间距$\le 0.05$ km的事件对。

tm.why: The paper analyzes the relocated Southern California earthquake catalog using a consensus space-time clustering approach to identify and characterize seismic swarms.
The study investigates the physical migration of seismic swarms associated with fluid diffusion and transient fault processes versus bounded fault-plane diffusion in tectonic sequences.

sum: This study presents a cost-effective seismic characterization of the deep supercritical geothermal reservoir (the K-horizon at 3–6 km depth) around the Venelle 2 exploration well in the Larderello field, Southern Tuscany, Italy. The authors acquired zero-offset and offset Vertical Seismic Profiling (VSP) data between 600 and 1600 m depth using airgun and Vibroseis sources, simultaneously recorded by a sparse piggyback surface array of 342 stations along two crossing profiles. A 3D migration velocity model was constructed using non-linear first-arrival traveltime tomography for the upper 1600 m, supplemented by sonic logs, neighbouring well checkshots, and laboratory measurements down to 3500 m. Applying 3D coherency migration (CM) to the sparse dataset successfully imaged the top and hanging wall of the K-horizon (around 2500–3500 m depth) and resolved a double-reflector boundary and steeply dipping fault structures, enhancing vertical resolution compared to legacy 3D surface seismic images.
本研究针对意大利托斯卡纳南部Larderello地热田Venelle 2探井周边的深部超临界地热储层（3-6 km深的K反射层），提出了一种低成本地震表征方法。研究结合了600-1600 m井段的零偏与非零偏垂直地震剖面（VSP）以及由342个台站组成的两条交叉测线地面“搭载”地震阵列数据。通过非线……

t: Joint non-linear turning-ray first-arrival traveltime tomography of surface piggyback and VSP data builds a 3D velocity model (extended with well and lab data), followed by 3D prestack Coherency Migration (CM) for target-oriented depth imaging.
联合地面搭载与VSP数据进行非线性初至走时层析成像构建三维速度模型，并应用三维叠前相干偏移（CM）进行目标深度成像。

Zero-offset (airgun) and offset (three Vibroseis trucks) VSP surveys recorded at 600–1600 m depth in the Venelle 2 well, accompanied by a piggyback surface array of 342 wireless geophones along four profile lines.
Venelle 2井600–1600 m深度的零偏（气枪）与非零偏（可控震源）VSP数据，以及沿四条测线布设的342个无…

Tomography achieved a 13 ms RMS traveltime residual down to 1600 m near the well (velocities 2000–6000 m/s), and 3D coherency migration imaged the K-horizon top at 2500–2600 m and a double reflector at 3250–3500 m.
层析成像走时RMS残差达13 ms（速度2000–6000 m/s），三维相干偏移清晰刻画了2500–2600 m处的K…
Sparse acquisition geometry creates migration smile artefacts, while velocity errors and neglected anisotropy produce a cumulative depth uncertainty of up to 225 m at 3400 m depth.
稀疏观测几何产生偏移画弧伪影，速度误差与各向异性忽略在3400 m深处导致高达225 m的累积深度不确定性。

Integrates a low-cost piggyback surface array with borehole VSP to bridge the near-surface velocity gap and achieve higher vertical resolution of the supercritical K-horizon than legacy 3D surface seismics.
将低成本地面搭载阵列与井中VSP结合，弥补近地表速度空白，以极低成本实现了优于传统三维地震的K层局部高垂向分辨率成像。

kc: Demonstrated a low-cost combined VSP and sparse surface piggyback seismic workflow for characterizing deep supercritical geothermal reservoirs.
Built an integrated 3D P-wave migration velocity model combining turning-ray first-arrival traveltime tomography, zero-offset VSP, sonic logs, checkshots, and laboratory rock physics data.

Successfully imaged the K-horizon and local steeply dipping fault structures using 3D coherency migration, resolving a double reflector at 3250–3500 m depth that appeared as a single reflector in legacy 3D surface data.
Quantified cumulative depth uncertainty across depth intervals, estimating an uncertainty of up to 225 m at 3400 m depth.
展示了结合VSP与稀疏地面搭载地震的低成本工作流在深部超临界地热储层表征中的应用潜力。
综合回折射线初至走时层析成像、零偏VSP、声波测井、邻井校深和实验室岩石物理数据，构建了集成三维P波偏移速度模型。
利用三维相干偏移成功对K反射层及局部陡倾断层成像，在3250–3500 m深处分辨出传统三维地震中呈单一反射的双反射层。
量化了随深度累积的深度不确定性，发现在3400 m深处的深度误差可达225 m。
me: Non-linear first-arrival traveltime tomography using a turning-ray approach, Gauss-Newton linearization, conjugate gradients, and shortest-path ray tracing.
Time-domain VSP and surface seismic signal processing including FK-filtering, median filtering, and deterministic source deconvolution.
3D Coherency Migration (CM) prestack depth imaging and comparison with Fresnel-Volume-Migration (FVM) of legacy 3D seismic data.
Statistical depth uncertainty quantification combining tomographic RMS misfits, checkshot standard deviations, and core sample velocity errors.
基于回折射线法、高斯-牛顿线性化、共轭梯度法和最短路径射线追踪的非线性初至走时层析成像。
包含FK滤波、中值滤波和确定性震源反褶积的时域VSP及地面地震信号处理。
三维相干偏移（CM）叠前深度成像，并与已有三维地震数据的菲涅耳体偏移（FVM）结果进行对比。
结合层析成像RMS残差、校深标准差及岩心样本速度误差的统计深度不确定性量化。
de: Zero-offset VSP (airgun array at 50 m offset) and offset VSP (three Vibroseis positions at 490, 840, and 1135 m offsets, 8–100 Hz sweep) recorded between 600 and 1600 m depth in the Venelle 2 borehole.
Piggyback surface seismic network of 342 wireless geophone stations (45 m spacing, up to 4000 m offset) along two crossing profiles.
Sonic logs from Venelle 2, checkshot data from neighbouring well Colla 2C (2150–3500 m depth), laboratory core measurements, and reprocessed 2004–2005 3D legacy seismic volumes.
Venelle 2井600–1600 m深度的零偏VSP（50 m偏移距气枪震源）和非零偏VSP（490、840和1135 m偏移距的可控震源，8–100 Hz扫频）。
沿两条交叉测线布设的342个无线检波器台站（间距45 m，最大偏移距4000 m）组成的地面搭载地震台网。
Venelle 2井声波测井、邻井Colla 2C校深数据（2150–3500 m）、实验室岩心测量数据以及重处理的2004–2005年三维历史地震数据体。
li: Sparse shot and receiver geometry limits lateral subsurface illumination to the western flank of the K-horizon and causes migration smile artefacts.
Poorly cemented borehole casing degraded VSP and sonic log data quality above 900–1000 m depth.
Isotropic velocity model building neglects 10%–15% seismic anisotropy in the metamorphic basement, introducing up to 225 m vertical depth uncertainty at 3400 m depth.
稀疏的炮检点几何分布将横向照明限制在K层西翼，并在深度剖面中产生偏移画弧伪影。
井筒套管固井质量差导致900–1000 m以上浅部VSP和声波测井数据质量下降。
各向同性速度建模忽略了变质基底10%–15%的地震各向异性，在3400 m深处引入高达225 m的垂向深度不确定性。

tm.why: The paper derives a 3D near-surface P-wave velocity model using non-linear first-arrival-traveltime tomography combining surface and borehole seismic data.
The study performs 3D prestack depth migration to image upper crustal metamorphic units and the K-horizon at 3–6 km depth in Southern Tuscany.
The primary target of the active-source seismic characterization is the deep supercritical geothermal reservoir at the Larderello field.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, geological context, velocity model building, signal processing, 3D coherency migration results, uncertainty analysis, and all 15 figures.

sum: This paper presents an efficient 3-D finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) scheme for seismic wave simulation in the presence of complex topography. The authors develop an overset grid framework that confines the computationally expensive curvilinear Lebedev-grid (LG) discretization to a near-surface patch to handle traction-free boundary conditions and topographic scattering. In the deeper region, a standard staggered-grid (SSG) scheme is used. The two domains are coupled via wavefield exchange across an overlap zone. Validated against homogeneous half-space benchmarks, layered models, and a modified GO_3D_OBS crustal model, the method eliminates artificial reflections at the coupling interface and significantly reduces computational runtime compared to full-domain LG simulations.
本文提出了一种高效的三维有限差分时域（FDTD）地震波数值模拟方法。作者开发了一种重叠网格框架，将计算量较大的曲线Lebedev网格（LG）离散限制在近地表区域，以处理起伏地形和自由表面牵引力释放边界条件；在深部区域则采用标准交错网格（SSG），两者通过重叠区域的波场交换进行耦合。通过均匀半空间、层……

t: An overset grid framework that confines curvilinear Lebedev-grid discretization to a near-surface patch and couples it to a standard staggered-grid scheme in the deeper region through wavefield exchange.
一种重叠网格框架，将曲线Lebedev网格离散限制在近地表，并通过波场交换与深部标准交错网格耦合。
Synthetic experiments including homogeneous half-space benchmarks with flat/Gaussian topography, a layered model with impedance contrasts, and a modified GO_3D_OBS crustal model.
采用平坦/高斯地形的均匀半空间、含波阻抗界面的层状模型以及修改后的GO_3D_OBS地壳模型进行数值合成测试。
The overset scheme produces receiver seismograms with no discernible artifacts at the coupling interface and achieves a marked reduction in wall-clock time compared to full-domain simulations.
该重叠方案在耦合界面无明显人工虚假反射，且相比全区域曲线网格模拟显著缩短了计算耗时。
The implementation details regarding the optimal thickness of the overset zone and potential stability limits under extreme topography are not fully detailed in the abstract.
重叠区域的最佳厚度选择以及在极端起伏地形下的稳定性边界在摘要中未详细阐述。
Confining the curvilinear Lebedev-grid discretization to a near-surface patch and coupling it with standard staggered grids to reduce domain-wide computational costs.
首次将曲线Lebedev网格局限在近地表薄层，并与深部标准交错网格高效耦合以降低整体计算成本。

kc: Developed an overset grid FDTD framework coupling near-surface curvilinear Lebedev grids with deep standard staggered grids.
Formulated a wavefield exchange scheme across the overlap zone that avoids artificial reflections.
Demonstrated significant computational efficiency gains and wall-clock time reduction compared to full-domain curvilinear simulations.
开发了一种重叠网格FDTD框架，将近地表曲线Lebedev网格与深部标准交错网格进行耦合。
构建了重叠区域内的波场交换方案，有效避免了耦合界面产生的虚假反射。
与全区域曲线网格模拟相比，在保证精度的前提下显著提高了计算效率并缩短了运行时间。
me: Overset grid coupling technique.
Curvilinear Lebedev-grid (LG) finite-difference scheme for near-surface topography.
Standard staggered-grid (SSG) finite-difference scheme for deep regions.
重叠网格（Overset grid）耦合技术。
用于近地表地形处理的曲线Lebedev网格（LG）有限差分格式。
用于深部区域的标准交错网格（SSG）有限差分格式。

Layered model with topography and impedance-contrast interfaces.
Modified GO_3D_OBS crustal model simulation.
具有平坦和高斯地形自由表面的均匀半空间基准测试。
包含地形和波阻抗对比界面的层状介质模型测试。
改进的GO_3D_OBS地壳模型数值模拟。

tm.why: The paper develops an overset Virieux-Lebedev finite-difference framework for efficient 3-D seismic wave modeling in the presence of topography.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract of the paper from Geophysical Journal International.

sum: This study investigates how outgassing and photochemistry jointly determine the atmospheric composition of rocky exoplanets. By coupling the PROTEUS planetary interior-atmosphere evolution framework with the FastChem and VULCAN chemical models, the authors simulate a grid of planetary evolutions spanning various mantle redox states, instellation fluxes, and host-star spectra. They find that while photochemistry strongly alters the upper atmosphere, the bulk atmospheric composition remains controlled by the mantle redox state. Specifically, photochemical SO2 is strongly enhanced at intermediate-to-oxidised states, producing distinct absorption features at 4, 7.3, and 8.7 micrometers in synthetic emission spectra. These signatures are detectable with the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), providing a direct observational link to the planet's interior geodynamics.
本研究探讨了排气作用与光化学如何共同决定岩石系外行星的大气成分。作者将PROTEUS行星内部-大气演化框架与FastChem和VULCAN化学模型耦合，模拟了不同地幔氧化还原状态、辐照通量和宿主恒星光谱下的行星演化。结果表明，尽管光化学显著改变了高层大气，但整体大气成分仍受地幔氧化还原状态控制。在中……

t: Coupling of the PROTEUS planetary interior-atmosphere evolution framework with FastChem and VULCAN chemical models for post-processed thermochemical and photochemical calculations.
将PROTEUS行星内部-大气演化框架与FastChem和VULCAN化学模型耦合，进行后处理热化学和光化学计算。
A grid of planetary evolution simulations spanning diverse mantle redox states, instellation fluxes, and Solar versus M-star host-star spectra.
跨越不同地幔氧化还原状态、星照通量以及太阳与M型恒星宿主光谱的行星演化模拟网格。
Photochemical SO2 generates detectable absorption features at 4 um and 7.3/8.7 um (reaching ~60 ppm and ~100 ppm) in synthetic spectra, tracing oxidised mantle states.
光化学SO2在合成光谱中产生4微米和7.3/8.7微米的吸收特征，可作为氧化型地幔状态的示踪剂。
The chemical calculations are post-processed rather than fully coupled dynamically with the interior evolution over time.
化学计算采用后处理方式，而非与内部随时间演化的动力学过程进行完全双向耦合。
Demonstrating that sulfur photochemistry can act as an observational proxy for the deep mantle redox state of rocky exoplanets using JWST.
首次证明了利用JWST观测硫光化学特征可以作为探测岩石系外行星深部地幔氧化还原状态的间接指标。

kc: Coupled the PROTEUS interior-atmosphere evolution framework with FastChem and VULCAN chemical models.
Demonstrated that bulk atmospheric composition remains controlled by mantle redox state and outgassing history even under disequilibrium chemistry.
Identified specific photochemical SO2 spectral features (at 4, 7.3, and 8.7 micrometers) that can trace mantle redox states and are detectable by JWST.
将PROTEUS行星内部-大气演化框架与FastChem和VULCAN化学模型进行了耦合。
证明了即使在非平衡化学条件下，整体大气成分仍受地幔氧化还原状态和排气历史的控制。
确定了可用于示踪地幔氧化还原状态且可被JWST探测到的特定光化学SO2光谱特征（4、7.3和8.7微米）。
me: Numerical modeling of planetary interior-atmosphere coupling using the PROTEUS framework.
Post-processed thermochemical equilibrium and disequilibrium (vertical transport and photochemistry) calculations using FastChem and VULCAN.
Synthetic emission spectroscopy modeling to simulate JWST observational capabilities.
使用PROTEUS框架对行星内部-大气耦合进行数值模拟。
使用FastChem和VULCAN进行后处理热化学平衡与非平衡（垂直输送和光化学）计算。
合成发射光谱建模，以模拟JWST的观测能力。
de: Grid of planetary evolution simulations spanning diverse mantle redox states, instellation fluxes, and host-star spectra (Solar versus M-star).
Synthetic emission spectra showing absorption features of photochemical SO2 at 4, 7.3, and 8.7 micrometers.
跨越不同地幔氧化还原状态、辐照通量和宿主恒星光谱（太阳与M型恒星）的行星演化模拟网格。
展示光化学SO2在4、7.3和8.7微米处吸收特征的合成发射光谱。
li: The study relies on post-processed chemistry calculations rather than fully self-consistent, time-dependent coupled simulations.
Atmospheric escape and other potential loss mechanisms for sulfur species were not fully explored.
该研究依赖于后处理化学计算，而非完全自洽、随时间演化的耦合模拟。
未充分探讨大气逃逸及其他潜在的硫流失机制。

tm.why: The paper models how mantle redox states and interior outgassing couple with atmospheric chemistry on rocky planets.
The paper focuses on planetary science, specifically the interior-atmosphere evolution and outgassing of rocky exoplanets.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Frequent rock bursts in high-stress wide chain pillars beneath thick, hard roofs pose severe hazards in deep coal mining, and existing minute- or hour-level acoustic emission (AE) indicators suffer from operational noise interference. This study investigates Working Face 3-1103 in the Xinjie mining area by combining laboratory cyclic loading–unloading uniaxial compression AE tests with in-situ geoacoustic/microseismic monitoring. Both laboratory AE and field geoacoustic signals exhibit a unified 'fluctuating growth' precursor pattern with high stage-wise linear correlation (R² > 0.91). To suppress shift-change noise, shift-level cumulative energy (ESN) and shift energy deviation (DEVSN) were selected as core warning parameters. A non-parametric Mann–Kendall (M–K) trend test model was constructed to detect statistically significant monotonic increases. Field verification across four rock burst events demonstrates that the model provides reliable early warnings 8–32 hours in advance, establishing a mechanism-linked warning framework for deep mining.
针对深部厚硬顶板高应力宽煤柱频繁发生冲击地压及现有分钟/小时级声发射指标易受生产干扰的问题，本文以新街矿区3-1103工作面为背景，结合室内单轴循环加卸载声发射试验与现场实时地音（微震）监测开展前兆识别研究。揭示了室内声发射与现场地音信号均呈“波动增长”的一致前兆规律（线性拟合R²>0.91）。优选……

t: Combines laboratory cyclic loading–unloading uniaxial compression AE experiments with in-situ geoacoustic monitoring, using the non-parametric Mann–Kendall trend test on shift-level cumulative energy and energy deviation to identify rock burst precursors.
结合煤样单轴循环加卸载声发射试验与现场地音监测，利用M-K趋势检验分析班次累计能量及偏差值以识别前兆。

Uses Φ50 mm × 100 mm coal cores from borehole 18-12 for MTS322 cyclic compression tests with PCI-2 AE acquisition, alongside ARES-5/E downhole geoacoustic records from four burst events at Working Face 3-1103.
采用3-1103工作面钻孔煤芯开展MTS322循环压缩声发射试验，并采集ARES-5/E系统记录的4次冲击地压现场地音数…

Laboratory AE and field geoacoustic stage energies correlate linearly (R² > 0.91). Mann–Kendall statistic L for shift energy ESN and deviation DEVSN exceeded the 95% threshold (1.96) 8–32 hours before four rock bursts.
室内声发射与现场地音阶段能量呈高线性相关（R²>0.91），班次能量及偏差值的M-K统计量L可提前8~32h超临界预警。
The model is tailored for deep wide panel pillars under thick, hard roofs; its effectiveness in narrow pillars, soft coal, fractured rock, and tectonic zones is unverified.
模型主要适用于深部厚硬顶板宽煤柱，对窄煤柱、软煤及强构造带的适用性尚待验证。
Establishes a mechanism-linked warning workflow combining cyclic AE mechanics, shift-level anti-interference parameters (ESN, DEVSN), and Mann–Kendall trend testing for high-stress wide coal pillars.
建立了机理研究、班次抗干扰参数优选与M-K趋势检验相结合的高应力宽煤柱冲击地压预警体系。

kc: Revealed a consistent 'fluctuating growth' pattern and strong linear correlation (R² > 0.91) between laboratory cyclic loading AE and in-situ geoacoustic signals prior to coal pillar bursts.
Identified shift-level cumulative energy (ESN) and shift energy deviation (DEVSN) as optimal anti-interference early warning parameters that eliminate intra-shift production noise.
Constructed a quantitative rock burst precursor identification model based on the Mann–Kendall non-parametric trend test, achieving 8–32 hour advance warnings across four field events.
揭示了煤柱冲击破坏前室内循环加卸载声发射与现场地音信号高度一致的“波动增长”前兆规律及强线性相关性（R² > 0.91）。
优选出抗干扰能力强的班次累计能量（ESN）及其偏差值（DEVSN）作为核心预警指标，有效屏蔽了班次交替与生产噪声干扰。
基于Mann-Kendall非参数趋势检验构建了冲击地压前兆识别模型，在4次现场冲击事件中实现了提前8~32小时的超前预警。
me: Laboratory cyclic loading–unloading uniaxial compression tests on coal specimens (30%, 45%, 60% uniaxial compressive strength) with synchronous PCI-2 AE monitoring.
Physical (cotton gauze borehole packing) and software command-based denoising of in-situ ARES-5/E underground geoacoustic monitoring data.
Mann–Kendall (M–K) non-parametric monotonic trend testing applied to minute-, hour-, and shift-level geoacoustic energy and deviation time series.
开展煤样单轴循环加卸载试验（加载水平30%、45%、60%单轴抗压强度）并利用PCI-2系统同步采集声发射信号。
采用钻孔填塞纱布的物理降噪与ARESOCENA软件命令滤波相结合的方法对井下地音监测数据进行降噪处理。
应用Mann-Kendall（M-K）非参数趋势检验方法分析分钟、小时及班次级地音能量及其偏差值的时间序列变化趋势。
de: Cylindrical coal core specimens (Φ50 mm × 100 mm) from borehole 18-12 at Working Face 3-1103 tested on an MTS322 machine at 0.2 mm/min.
In-situ continuous geoacoustic monitoring data acquired by SP-5.28/E probes installed 60 m and 110 m ahead of Working Face 3-1103 in the Xinjie mining area.
Field geoacoustic datasets from four rock burst events ('11.27', '6.10', '6.14', and '8.26') used for model calibration and verification.
采自3-1103工作面18-12钻孔的标准圆柱煤样（Φ50 mm × 100 mm），采用MTS322试验机以0.2 mm/min速率加载。
新街矿区3-1103工作面超前60 m和110 m处布置的SP-5.28/E地音探头实时采集的井下地音监测数据。
用于模型标定与验证的“11.27”、“6.10”、“6.14”和“8.26”四次现场冲击地压事件地音监测数据集。
li: The proposed early warning model is primarily validated for deep, wide panel pillars beneath thick and hard overlying strata.
Applicability to narrow pillars, soft coal seams, fractured rock masses, and strongly tectonized zones remains unverified.
所提出的预警模型主要适用于深部厚硬顶板条件下的高应力宽区段煤柱工作面。
模型对窄煤柱、软煤、破碎岩体及强构造带的适用性仍有待进一步验证。

tm.why: The paper focuses on microseismic and geoacoustic monitoring of mining-induced rock bursts in underground coal pillars.
It investigates rock fracture mechanics, cyclic loading damage evolution, and acoustic emission precursors (Kaiser and Felicity effects) in laboratory coal samples.
It develops an early warning model to forecast destructive rock burst hazards 8–32 hours in advance in deep coal mines.

ev.notes: Full 51-page accepted manuscript PDF (containing duplicate rendering of pages 2–26 on pages 27–51) was analyzed, including all text sections, equations, 11 figures, and 5 tables.

sum: Real-time microseismic localization during hydraulic fracturing is often hindered by velocity model inaccuracies and phase-picking errors. This paper introduces JGF-LocNet, a deep-learning framework integrating five three-component surface stations and 20 borehole Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) channels. The architecture combines Conv3D and Transformer encoders for surface waveforms, LSTM for vertical DAS sequences, and a Heterogeneous Graph Convolutional Network (HetGCN) built on an adaptive geometry-based adjacency matrix (Delaunay surface links, vertical fiber chains, and cross-device links). Trained on a QuakeMigrate reference catalog from the Luzhou shale gas field (augmented to 7,084 events using Eiko-Pigcnet synthetic waveforms to resolve spatial class imbalance), JGF-LocNet operates without a velocity model during inference. It achieves a mean 3D localization error of 31.4 m (AE-P90 of 54.1 m) in 0.26 s per event, outperforming REAL, hypoDD, SSA, and baseline deep networks while generalizing directly to two unseen borehole-surface arrays.
针对页岩气压裂微震实时监测对速度模型依赖强的问题，本文提出联合地面三分量台站与井下分布式声波传感（DAS）的深度学习定位模型JGF-LocNet。模型利用Conv3D和Transformer提取地面特征，LSTM处理井下DAS序列，并通过自适应异构图卷积（HetGCN）融合空间拓扑。基于泸州页岩气田……

t: JGF-LocNet integrates Conv3D and Transformer encoders for 3-C surface stations, LSTM for borehole DAS waveforms, an adaptive geometry-based adjacency matrix, and Heterogeneous Graph Convolution (HetGCN) to regress 3D hypocenters.
结合Conv3D、Transformer、LSTM与自适应异构图卷积（HetGCN），融合井地波形直接回归三维震源坐标。

Microseismic data from Luzhou shale gas field using three borehole-surface systems (five 3-C surface geophones and 20 DAS channels at 100 Hz), yielding 3,131 QuakeMigrate events and 7,084 augmented training samples.
四川泸州页岩气田3套井地联合系统（5个三分量地面台站+20通道井下DAS），含3131个真实事件及扩充后的7084个训练…
On Fiber-1, JGF-LocNet achieves mean horizontal, depth, and 3D absolute errors of 28.5 m, 11.3 m, and 31.4 m (AE-P90 = 54.1 m) at 0.26 s/event, transferring to Fiber-2/3 with 35.1–37.2 m mean AE.
Fiber-1平均水平、深度和三维误差分别为28.5、11.3和31.4米，单事件耗时0.26秒；盲测阵列平均误差35.…

Although velocity-model-free at inference, JGF-LocNet inherits velocity-model assumptions from the QuakeMigrate training catalog, ignores wave attenuation/anisotropy, and requires substantial representative training data.
训练标签继承了QuakeMigrate的速度模型假设，且纯数据驱动方法对训练样本质量与覆盖度依赖较强。

Fuses multimodal surface 3-C geophones and borehole DAS arrays via an adaptive-graph HetGCN for real-time, velocity-model-free 3D microseismic localization that generalizes across unseen array geometries.
提出自适应拓扑异构图网络融合地面三分量与井下DAS数据，实现跨阵列免重训的实时免速度模型微震定位。

kc: Designed a joint surface-borehole monitoring framework combining 5 pentagonal 3-C surface geophones with 20 downhole DAS channels for complementary horizontal and vertical constraints.
Developed JGF-LocNet, a hybrid CNN-Transformer-LSTM-HetGCN architecture with an on-the-fly geometry-driven adaptive adjacency matrix across ground, fiber, and cross-device edges.
Resolved spatial training class imbalance via physics-based synthetic waveform augmentation (Eiko-Pigcnet), boosting accuracy above 95%.
Achieved 0.26 s per-event inference latency and 31.4–37.2 m mean 3D error across three arrays without retraining or requiring a velocity model at inference.
设计了融合5个五边形分布地面三分量台站与20个井下DAS通道的井地联合微震监测系统，实现水平与深度方向约束互补。
提出集成CNN、Transformer、LSTM与异构图卷积（HetGCN）的JGF-LocNet架构，并构建基于几何拓扑的动态自适应邻接矩阵。
利用Eiko-Pigcnet物理合成波形扩充数据集，解决空间样本不平衡问题，使定位准确率超过95%。
推理阶段无需速度模型，单事件耗时0.26秒，在三个阵列的平均三维定位误差为31.4–37.2米，具备跨阵列免重训泛化能力。
me: Conv3D and 4-head Transformer encoder for extracting spatiotemporal features from 5 three-component surface stations.
Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network for sequential temporal feature extraction from 20 vertical borehole DAS channels.
Adaptive adjacency matrix generator combining Delaunay triangulation (ground-ground), vertical chain (fiber-fiber), and distance-weighted cross-network connections.
Heterogeneous Graph Convolution (HetGCN) with edge-specific MLPs and a hybrid MAE plus 2D/3D geometric loss function.
Physics-constrained synthetic waveform data augmentation using the Eiko-Pigcnet eikonal solver and Ricker wavelet convolution.
采用Conv3D与4头Transformer编码器提取5个地面三分量台站的时空特征。
利用长短期记忆网络（LSTM）处理20通道垂直井下DAS时序数据。
基于Delaunay三角剖分（地面）、垂直链式连接（光纤）及距离加权跨设备连接构建动态自适应邻接矩阵。
采用针对不同边类型配备独立MLP的异构图卷积（HetGCN），并结合MAE与几何距离混合损失函数进行回归预测。
基于Eiko-Pigcnet程函方程求解器与雷克子波褶积生成物理约束合成波形，用于平衡网格样本。
de: 85-day continuous monitoring dataset from Luzhou shale gas field, Sichuan, China, comprising 40 short-period surface stations and 3 vertical VSP DAS boreholes (Fiber-1 at 3,100 m, Fiber-2 at 1,200 m, Fiber-3 at 1,500 m), downsampled to 100 Hz.

sum: Deep borehole seismic stations mitigate surface environmental noise, yet quantitative evaluations in kilometer-scale boreholes remain scarce. This study assesses noise suppression and signal detection using two Chinese TDE-120VB very broadband seismometers deployed at 1,972.7 m depth in a repurposed oil/gas well in Changde, China, alongside a co-located surface reference station. Continuous observations from January 2025, including the Ms 6.8 Dingri earthquake, were analyzed via power spectral density (PSD) probability density functions and short-time Fourier transforms. Downhole ambient noise PSD was 20–40 dB lower than at the surface across 0.001–25 Hz (up to 60 dB in sub-bands), improving SNR by 2–4 orders of magnitude and reducing diurnal variations at 1–25 Hz from ~6–7 dB to ≤1–2 dB. Novel integration of spectral entropy with two-sided CUSUM change-point detection extended the post-Dingri low-entropy signal tracking window to ~4.5 h downhole versus ~2 h at the surface.

sum: This study presents a moment tensor catalog of 40 small-to-moderate earthquakes (Mw >= 3.5) in the Garhwal-Kumaon region of the northwestern Himalayas. Using the cut-and-paste (CAP) method, the authors invert waveforms from local and regional broadband networks and perform uncertainty analysis. They find that combining local and regional networks significantly reduces uncertainties, with local data providing more stable solutions. Incorporating first-motion polarities further improves robustness. The resulting catalog contains 21 thrust, 4 normal, and 15 oblique earthquakes. Systematically negative time shifts suggest the actual velocity structure is faster than the assumed 1D model, likely due to unmodeled 3D heterogeneity. These results provide insights into the seismotectonics of the region and offer constraints for future 3D seismic imaging.

sum: This study investigates pre-seismic and co-seismic ionospheric disturbances associated with the 2025 M7.9 Myanmar strike-slip earthquake using BeiDou geostationary (GEO) satellite and multi-GNSS Total Electron Content (TEC) data from CMONOC. Using a 27-day moving interquartile range method alongside solar-terrestrial indices, a negative TEC anomaly with an equatorial conjugate structure was identified three days prior to the mainshock. Wavelet analysis and 2–8 mHz band-pass filtering of co-seismic ionospheric disturbances (CIDs) revealed acoustic-gravity waves propagating at ~1.2 km/s with pronounced southeastward asymmetry. The authors propose a spatial density-weighted grid search inversion to locate the apparent CID source, reducing localization offset to 31.8 km southeast of the epicenter despite anisotropic station coverage. The findings highlight how strike-slip fault motion, geomagnetic field geometry, and the equatorial electrojet jointly modulate disturbance energy within the lithosphere-atmosphere-ionosphere coupling framework.

sum: This paper presents a novel control framework for Active Tuned Mass Damper (ATMD) systems to mitigate seismic vibrations in asymmetric floor buildings, accounting for Soil-Structure Interaction (SSI). To address frequency-matching challenges, the authors introduce a Born-Jordan Vibration Dose-based Eigensystem Frequency Distribution. They employ an Ebola-optimized Graph Multivariable Adaptive Neural Network (E-GMANN) to dynamically estimate damper mass and control force in real-time. Additionally, Frequency Domain-Cyclic Equivalent Linear Analysis (TD-CELA) is used to model non-linear soil behavior and moisture-induced variations. The proposed model significantly reduces structural vibration, acceleration, and displacement compared to existing methods, enhancing building resilience during earthquakes.

sum: This study uses 2-D time-dependent numerical experiments to investigate subduction-driven entrainment of a buoyant, low-viscosity asthenosphere. Exploring both Newtonian and non-Newtonian temperature-dependent rheologies, the authors find that only a thin (5–20 km) layer of asthenosphere is entrained along the subducting slab, yielding a volume flux of 100–1600 km²/Ma. This limited entrainment is dynamically linked to vigorous asthenospheric counterflow. The study shows that maximum entrainment occurs when mantle viscosity increases at a shallow 410-km depth, and non-Newtonian rheology further reduces entrainment. Additionally, vertical density stratification from plume melt-extraction leads to complex, buoyantly layered counterflow and local asthenosphere accumulation beneath the trench. These findings refine our understanding of asthenosphere-slab interactions and mantle recycling.
本研究利用二维时变数值模拟，探讨了俯冲带对具浮力、低粘度软流圈的夹带效应。通过测试牛顿与非牛顿温度相关流变学，研究发现俯冲板片下侧仅夹带5-20 km厚的软流圈薄层（通量为100-1600 km²/Ma），并伴随强烈的软流圈逆流。当粘度在410 km浅部增加时夹带量最大，而非牛顿流变学则会减少夹带。……

sum: To understand postseismic relaxation and aftershock decay in carbonate-hosted upper-crustal faults, this study investigates multi-stage stress ramp-relaxation cycles on Jinping dolomite marble under confining pressures of 2–70 MPa. Using Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing with 1-mm spatial resolution, the authors capture full-field micrometer-scale circumferential strains, quantifying spatial heterogeneity via the Gini coefficient and localization via normalized root-mean-square deviation. Results show that inelastic strain rate is highly sensitive to differential stress (apparent stress exponents n = 38–151), confirming that brittle creep driven by microcracking and frictional sliding dominates relaxation. Inelastic strain rates follow an Omori-like power-law decay with apparent exponent p' increasing from 0.6 to 1.0 as strain localizes near system-size failure and as confining pressure increases. Unlike homogeneous mean-field models predicting p' = 1, this work demonstrates how heterogeneous damage redistribution and confining pressure govern temporal relaxation decay across fault cores and damage zones.
为揭示上地壳碳酸盐岩断层的震后松弛机制，本研究对锦屏白云岩质大理岩在2–70 MPa围压下开展了多级应力加载-松弛实验。利用毫米级分辨率的分布式光纤传感技术实时监测全表面环向微应变，结合基尼系数和归一化均方根偏差量化应变非均质性与空间局部化。结果表明，非弹性应变率对差应力高度敏感（表观应力指数n=3……

t: Multi-stage triaxial stress ramp-relaxation experiments on cylindrical dolomite marble cores combined with 1-mm-resolution Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing, analyzed using Gini coefficient and normalized RMSD to link strain localization with Omori-like relaxation decay.
对大理岩开展多级三轴加载-松弛实验，结合1毫米分辨率分布式光纤传感，利用基尼系数和RMSD关联应变局部化与大森衰减。

Low-porosity (<0.2%) Jinping dolomite marble cores from 2,400 m depth tested under 2–80 MPa confining pressures in monotonic compression and multi-stage 30–60 min relaxation cycles, supplemented by post-mortem X-ray CT.

Inelastic strain rates during relaxation exhibit high stress sensitivity (apparent stress exponents n = 38–151, n' = 0.15–0.65) and follow an Omori-like power-law decay with exponent p' increasing from 0.6 to 1.0 as failure approaches.

Experiments were performed at room temperature (25°C) on a single fine grain size (~0.05 mm), leaving grain-size effects and high-temperature crystal plasticity unexplored.

Links lower p' values (<1) to internal stress redistribution and heterogeneous subcritical microcracking, while p' approaches 1 with increasing strain localization and higher confining pressure.
Proposes a conceptual fault-zone model partitioning postseismic relaxation into fast-decaying fault cores (p' ~ 1) and slower-decaying shallow/deep damage zones (p' < 1).

sum: Coastal Louisiana experiences severe subsidence alongside poorly understood seasonal vertical land motion. Combining 20 years (2004–2024) of continuous GNSS records, river-stage data, and deep monitoring-well hydraulic heads in Baton Rouge, this study reveals a long-term subsidence of -2.69 ± 0.69 mm/yr with a superposed 10–15 mm annual oscillation in phase with Mississippi River stage and confined-aquifer head. This positive correlation indicates subsurface poroelastic expansion rather than surface elastic loading. An analytical poroelastic model treating the semi-confined aquifer as an oblate spheroidal Eshelby inclusion subject to radial pressure diffusion from a flux source reproduces both the secular subsidence and the logarithmic spatial decay of seasonal amplitude away from the Baton Rouge Fault–Mississippi River intersection. The novelty lies in demonstrating that growth fault–river intersections act as localized seasonal hydraulic conduits into deep aquifers, providing critical constraints for coastal hazard forecasting and Gulf Coast geological CO2 storage security.
本研究结合2004—2024年连续GNSS观测、密西西比河水位及深部承压含水层水头数据，揭示路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日存在-2.69±0.69 mm/yr的长期沉降，并叠加10–15 mm的季节性垂直振荡。高水位对应地表抬升的正相关性证实其主控机制为地下孔隙弹性响应而非地表弹性载荷。通过构建基于Eshel……

t: Models the semi-confined aquifer as an oblate spheroidal Eshelby inclusion in an elastic half-space driven by axisymmetric radial pressure diffusion with a periodic flux boundary condition at the fault–river intersection.

Twenty years (2004–2024) of daily GNSS vertical positions from southern Louisiana stations, USGS Mississippi River stage at gauge 07374000, and hydraulic heads from deep monitoring wells (Eb-778, Eb-1274).
2004—2024年路易斯安那南部GNSS垂直位置、USGS密西西比河水位及深井（Eb-778、Eb-1274）水头数据…

The radial decay is only resolved on Pleistocene terraces and is masked on Holocene alluvium by shallow compaction; separating saltwater intrusion effects requires joint chloride analysis.

tm.why: The study investigates fault-zone hydrogeology and poroelastic crustal deformation across growth faults (Baton Rouge Fault) acting as fluid conduits.
The paper examines hydrologically driven seasonal solid-Earth deformation and subsidence in coastal Louisiana due to river stage and aquifer head variations.
The paper explicitly analyzes reservoir poroelasticity, fluid extraction, and fault-mediated pressure migration relevant to geological CO2 storage security and fluid injection along the Gulf Coast.

sum: This study investigates the mechanisms of present-day vertical crustal deformation along the northeastern Tibetan Plateau using 3-D viscoelastic finite element modeling. By comparing the Liupanshan tectonic belt and the Maxianshan Fault, the authors show that uniform mid-lower crustal viscosity reproduces the observed ~2 mm/a uplift at Liupanshan through pure shear crustal shortening. Conversely, the ~4 mm/a uplift along the Maxianshan Fault requires a weak mid-lower crust and enhanced crustal flow beneath the Linxia Basin. This indicates that the Maxianshan Fault acts as the northeastern termination of mid-lower crustal flow within the Qilian Block. The study highlights the critical role of lateral rheological heterogeneity in controlling vertical deformation and lateral growth of the Tibetan Plateau.

sum: This study investigates the physical origin of glaciohydraulic tremor (GHT) quieting prior to stick-slip basal motion at Rhône Glacier, Switzerland. Combining surface and deep-borehole seismic arrays, borehole water-pressure sensors, GNSS surface velocities, Shreve hydraulic routing, seismic interferometry, and Bartlett Matched-Field Processing (MFP), the authors analyze GHT in 10–20 Hz and 6–8 Hz bands. Results show that 10–20 Hz seismic power drops by ~2 dB during rising basal water pressure, while coherent GHT sources persist within a compact ~35 m × 40 m region near an inferred drainage junction. Rather than source disappearance, quieting reflects reduced seismic radiation. Using a Darcy–Weisbach roof-friction model, the authors demonstrate that near-complete filling of broad, low-aspect-ratio conduits increases wetted perimeter and frictional resistance, cutting discharge by ~20–28% and seismic power by ~1.1–1.8 dB. This localized constriction redistributes water into distributed storage, lowering effective pressure and promoting stick-slip motion.

t: Combines Shreve hydraulic routing, ambient-noise interferometry, 3D Bartlett Matched-Field Processing with Nelder–Mead optimization, and Darcy–Weisbach conduit flow modeling coupled to turbulent seismic power scaling.
结合Shreve水力路径、背景噪声干涉、三维MFP优化定位及耦合湍流地震标度律的Darcy-Weisbach水力模型。
Uses 2020 melt-season data at Rhône Glacier from 8 near-surface seismometers, 5 deep-borehole geophones (~150 m depth), borehole water-pressure sensors, kinematic GNSS, and proglacial runoff.

Demonstrates that GHT quieting reflects reduced seismic radiation from persistent sources due to roof-contact friction in filling broad conduits, acting as a hydraulic switch redistributing basal pressure.

Proposed and quantified a roof-friction mechanism where water contacting the roof of broad, low-aspect-ratio conduits increases wetted perimeter, reducing local discharge by 20–28% and seismic power by 1.1–1.8 dB.
Linked localized conduit pressurization to subglacial water redistribution into surrounding distributed systems, explaining rising basal water pressure and subsequent stick-slip motion.

sum: This preprint investigates the 1–20 August 2026 earthquake cluster near Adalar in the eastern Marmara Sea, close to Istanbul. The author integrates a reconciled multi-agency catalog (AFAD, EMSC, USGS), automatic P-phase picks from 49 FDSN/EIDA stations, 1D trial relocations, first-motion focal mechanisms, geostatistical clustering (Moran's I, Getis-Ord Gi*, bootstrap standard deviational ellipses), point-source Coulomb stress modeling, and literature-based geotechnical screening. Out of 127 regional events, 79 occurred within 40 km of Adalar, including 62 on 19–20 August (largest ML 3.2). Geostatistics confirm strong 10-km clustering (Moran z = 21.69; 13 FDR-corrected 99% hot cells), though poor station geometry and depth uncertainties limit exact fault-plane or stress-tensor inversion. Point-source Coulomb stress change from the April 2025 Mw 6.2 event is minimal (+0.204 kPa). The study provides a transparent rapid-response screening framework that connects offshore source observations with coastal site-response and geotechnical investigation priorities.

sum: This study presents a scalable, cost-effective approach for structural health monitoring by repurposing pre-existing telecommunication fiber-optic cables as dense dynamic strain sensor arrays. By capturing guided wavefields across bridge superstructures, the method overcomes the scalability and cost limitations of traditional sensors. It successfully estimates quasi-static displacements with millimeter-level accuracy and extracts modal parameters, demonstrating robustness against noise from imperfect fiber-bridge coupling. The approach was validated through field tests on six bridges in the US and South Korea, offering a new paradigm for real-time, large-scale infrastructure monitoring.
本研究利用现有通信光纤作为密集动态应变传感器阵列，实现了低成本、大尺度的桥梁结构健康监测。该方法成功捕获了桥梁导波场，实现了毫米级精度的准静态位移估计并提取了模态参数，且对光纤-桥梁非完美耦合噪声具有鲁棒性。通过美、韩六座桥梁的现场验证，展示了利用既有光纤网络进行实时基础设施监测的潜力。
