sum: This study uses 3D spectral-element simulations (0.05–1.0 Hz) in the Swiss Rhône Valley to isolate and quantify topographic effects on ground motion. By comparing a realistic digital elevation model against a flat-surface reference that preserves identical sedimentary basin geometry, the authors evaluate three local earthquakes (Mw 3.2–4.5) across 190 real stations and a spatially unbiased 2×2 km synthetic grid (735 stations). Results reveal a strong component asymmetry: mountain sites on the uniform grid exhibit horizontal deamplification (medians 0.80–0.97× at 0.05–0.50 Hz) alongside consistent vertical amplification (1.16–2.32×), driven by SV-to-Rayleigh mode conversion. Real seismic networks systematically undersample exposed ridges, masking the horizontal deamplification. Basin sites show coupled topographic scattering and basin resonance. This work demonstrates that physics-based simulations with unbiased spatial sampling provide critical insights into energy redistribution across motion components that sparse empirical networks miss.
本研究利用三维谱元法模拟（0.05–1.0 Hz）量化瑞士罗纳河谷地形对地面运动的影响。通过对比包含真实DEM地形与保留相同沉积盆地几何形态的平坦地表模型，分析了3个地方震（Mw 3.2–4.5）在190个实际台站和735个2×2 km均匀合成网格点上的响应。研究首次揭示了显著的分量不对称性：山地网……

t: 3D spectral-element simulations (0.05–1.0 Hz) in Salvus comparing realistic DEM topography against a flat-surface mesh that preserves identical Rhône Valley sedimentary basin layering, evaluated via smoothed topo/flat Fourier amplitude spectral ratios.
利用Salvus进行0.05–1.0 Hz三维谱元模拟，对比真实地形与保留相同盆地沉积层的平坦模型，计算平滑傅里叶谱比。
Three local earthquakes (Mw 3.2–4.5) simulated across a 100×56×40 km Rhône Valley domain, sampled by 190 real seismic stations and a uniform 2×2 km synthetic grid of 735 stations.
在100×56×40 km罗纳河谷区域模拟3个地方震（Mw 3.2–4.5），包含190个真实台站和735个2×2 km…

On the uniform grid, mountain sites show systematic horizontal deamplification (medians 0.80–0.97× at 0.05–0.50 Hz) and strong vertical amplification (1.16–2.32×), whereas real networks mask horizontal deamplification due to siting bias.
均匀网格山地站点呈水平向减振（0.05–0.50 Hz中位数0.80–0.97倍）和垂直向放大（1.16–2.32倍），…
Simulations are limited to 1 Hz by velocity model resolution, omit intrinsic attenuation (causing late-coda overprediction), and analyze only three earthquake events.
受速度模型分辨率限制最高频率为1 Hz，未包含固有衰减（导致晚期尾波高估），且仅模拟了3个地震事件。

First physics-based separation of topographic and basin amplification in the Rhône Valley preserving site-specific 3D basin geometry and quantifying horizontal ridge deamplification via unbiased grid sampling.
首次在保留特定场地三维盆地结构下物理分离罗纳河谷地形与盆地效应，并通过无偏网格量化山脊水平减振。

kc: Isolated 3D topographic effects from sedimentary basin impedance contrasts in the Swiss Rhône Valley by preserving valley-confined sediment geometry in both topographic and flat-surface spectral-element meshes.

Discovered a systematic component asymmetry at mountain sites where vertical motion is strongly amplified (1.16–2.32×) while horizontal motion is deamplified (0.80–0.97× at 0.05–0.50 Hz) due to free-surface mode conversion.

Demonstrated that real seismic networks suffer from siting bias toward sheltered locations, systematically underestimating horizontal deamplification at exposed ridges compared to a uniform 2×2 km synthetic grid.
通过在地形和平坦地表谱元网格中保留相同的河谷沉积层几何结构，成功分离了瑞士罗纳河谷的三维地形效应与沉积盆地阻抗对比效应。
发现山地站点存在系统性的分量不对称性：由于自由面模态转换，垂直运动被显著放大（1.16–2.32倍），而水平运动在中低频段被削弱（0.05–0.50 Hz处为0.80–0.97倍）。
证明实际地震台网存在偏向隐蔽位置的选址偏差，与2×2 km均匀合成网格相比，系统性地低估了暴露山脊处的水平向减振效应。
me: 3D spectral-element waveform modeling using the Salvus solver on Nvidia GraceHopper GPUs up to 1.0 Hz.
Custom velocity model blending integrating a 3D regional crustal model (Diehl et al., 2021) with geotechnically constrained shallow sedimentary layers in Visp and Sion (VS down to 210 m/s).
Frequency-band topo/flat Fourier amplitude spectrum (FAS) ratio analysis using RotD50 for horizontal components and separate vertical component evaluation across five bands (0.05–1.00 Hz).
Validation against observed broadband/strong-motion waveforms and empirical Swiss GMPEs (Cauzzi et al., 2014) using band-limited peak ground velocity (PGV).
使用Salvus求解器在Nvidia GraceHopper GPU上进行最高1.0 Hz的三维谱元波形模拟。
自定义速度模型融合，将三维区域地壳模型与Visp和Sion地区受岩土工程约束的浅表沉积层（最小VS为210 m/s）相结合。
分频段地形/平坦地表傅里叶振幅谱（FAS）比值分析，在五个频段（0.05–1.00 Hz）内对水平分量采用RotD50并独立评估垂直分量。
利用带限峰值地面速度（PGV），通过观测宽频带/强震波形和瑞士经验地面运动预测方程（GMPE）对模拟进行验证。
de: Three local earthquakes in the Swiss Rhône Valley: 2005 Vallorcine (Mw 4.5), 2003 Salgesch (Mw 3.9), and 2016 St-Léonard (Mw 3.2) using SED moment tensor solutions.
Observational records from 190 stations across Swiss permanent broadband (CH) and temporary strong-motion (ZP) networks.
Synthetic waveforms recorded at a spatially uniform 2×2 km receiver grid (735 stations, network XX) combined with real station locations (total 925 receivers).
瑞士罗纳河谷的三个地方地震事件：2005年Vallorcine（Mw 4.5）、2003年Salgesch（Mw 3.9）和2016年St-Léonard（Mw 3.2），采用SED矩张量解。
来自瑞士永久宽频带（CH）和临时强震（ZP）台网共190个台站的观测记录。
在空间均匀的2×2 km合成接收器网格（735个台站，代码XX）结合真实台站位置（共925个接收器）上记录的合成波形。
li: Simulations are band-limited to a maximum frequency of 1.0 Hz due to present-day velocity model resolution and computational mesh constraints in soft sediments.
Intrinsic attenuation is omitted in the elastic simulations, leading to an overprediction of late coda wave amplitudes beyond 30 s.
Only three earthquake events were simulated, leaving some interevent variability that would require a larger event catalog to fully constrain.
受限于当前速度模型分辨率和软沉积层计算网格约束，模拟最高频率限制在1.0 Hz。
弹性模拟中未包含固有衰减，导致30秒后的晚期尾波振幅被高估。
仅模拟了三个地震事件，仍存在一定的事件间变异性，需要更大的事件目录来充分约束。

tm.why: The paper quantifies topographic amplification and deamplification effects on ground motion (PGV and FAS) in the Swiss Rhône Valley to inform seismic hazard assessments.
The study employs 3D spectral-element wave propagation simulations using the Salvus solver on GPU supercomputing infrastructure incorporating realistic DEM topography and complex basin layers.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, Salvus spectral-element mesh configurations, waveform and GMPE validations, spectral ratio analyses, and all 11 figures plus Table 1.

sum: Supervised deep-learning seismic phase pickers suffer from degraded accuracy and poor generalization when trained on datasets with inaccurate manual or automatic picks (label noise). This paper presents Label Noise-Contrastive Robust Learning (LaNCoR), a training framework that mitigates label noise without requiring massive datasets. LaNCoR treats input waveforms and arrival-time labels as two views of the same physical event, projecting both into latent spaces. An attention-based Error Learner estimates and corrects label shifts against robust waveform features, while variational reparameterization, Random Fourier Features, and batch-wise contrastive learning align their distributions. Tested on 10,685 microseismic waveforms from three Chinese coal mines and evaluated for cross-region generalization on 1,019 waveforms from a fourth mine using SeisT and PhaseNet backbones, LaNCoR improves F1, precision, and recall by up to 28.8% for SeisT and over 50% for PhaseNet compared to standard and data-augmentation baselines.
监督深度学习震相拾取模型常因训练标签不准（标签噪声）而性能下降。本文提出标签噪声对比鲁棒学习方法（LaNCoR），无需大规模数据集即可有效抑制标签噪声。该方法将输入波形和标签映射至潜在空间，利用基于多头自注意力机制的误差学习器（Error Learner）估计并修正标签偏移，结合重参数化、随机傅里叶……

t: LaNCoR maps waveforms and labels into latent spaces, uses a multi-head attention Error Learner to correct shifted label representations, and aligns distributions via variational reparameterization, Random Fourier Features, and contrastive learning.
将波形和标签映射至潜在空间，用多头注意力误差学习器修正标签偏移，并通过重参数化、RFF和对比学习对齐分布。

10,685 microseismic waveforms (500 Hz, SNR -3.4 to 32.3 dB) from three Chinese coal mines for training/testing, plus 1,019 waveforms (SNR 2.5 to 55.0 dB) from Yingpanhao Coal Mine for cross-region testing.
中国三个煤矿的10,685条微震波形用于训练测试，以及内蒙古营盘壕煤矿1,019条波形用于跨区域泛化测试。
LaNCoR improves SeisT F1-score by up to 28.8% (average 5.7%–16.3%) and PhaseNet F1-score by up to 54.7% (average 17.8%–22.6%) over baseline methods under varying label noise levels.
在不同标签噪声水平下，LaNCoR使SeisT的F1分数最高提升28.8%，使PhaseNet最高提升54.7%。
Balancing the five loss terms relies on a heuristic greedy search that may only find locally optimal coefficients, as random search proved computationally expensive and less stable.
多目标损失权重依赖启发式贪心搜索，可能仅获得局部最优解，且真实矿山微震数据未公开。
First label-noise-robust contrastive learning framework in seismology that aligns latent waveform and label distributions via an attention-based Error Learner without requiring massive datasets.
首次在地震学中提出无需大数据集、通过注意力误差学习器和对比学习对齐波形与标签分布的抗噪训练框架。

kc: Proposes the LaNCoR framework to train seismic phase-picking neural networks robustly in the presence of significant arrival-time label inaccuracies.
Introduces a multi-head self-attention Error Learner module with gradient truncation to correct noisy label representations using physical waveform features without corrupting the feature encoder.
Combines variational reparameterization, Random Fourier Features, and cross-modality contrastive similarity losses to align waveform and label distributions across multiple latent spaces.
Demonstrates superior picking accuracy, training stability, and cross-region generalization on real coal-mine microseismic datasets using both SeisT and PhaseNet models.
提出了LaNCoR框架，可在走时标签存在显著误差的情况下稳健地训练地震震相拾取神经网络。
引入了带有梯度截断的多头自注意力误差学习器模块，利用物理波形特征修正含噪标签表征，同时避免污染特征编码器。
结合变分重参数化、随机傅里叶特征和跨模态对比相似度损失，在多个潜在空间中对齐波形与标签分布。
在真实煤矿微震数据集上使用SeisT和PhaseNet模型验证了该方法具有更优的拾取精度、训练稳定性和跨区域泛化能力。
me: Dual-space latent projection of normalized waveforms and Gaussian-smoothed arrival-time label distributions.
Multi-head self-attention Error Learner with detached waveform gradients to estimate and correct label representation shifts.
Variational inference via the reparameterization trick and KL-divergence minimization to introduce controlled uncertainty and prevent overfitting.
High-dimensional kernel approximation using Random Fourier Features (RFF) coupled with batch-wise cosine-similarity contrastive learning.
将归一化波形与高斯平滑走时标签分布映射至双潜在空间。
采用带波形梯度截断的多头自注意力误差学习器估计并修正标签表征偏移。
利用重参数化技巧与KL散度最小化进行变分推断，引入可控不确定性以防止过拟合。
使用随机傅里叶特征（RFF）进行高维核近似，并结合批次余弦相似度对比学习对齐分布。
de: Primary dataset of 10,685 microseismic waveforms (500 Hz, SNR -3.4 to 32.3 dB) from Chaoyang, Mengcun, and Xingcun coal mines in China (split 80/10/10 for train/val/test).
Out-of-distribution cross-region test dataset of 1,019 microseismic waveforms (500 Hz, SNR 2.5 to 55.0 dB) from Yingpanhao Coal Mine in Inner Mongolia.
Synthetic zero-mean Gaussian perturbations added to training labels to evaluate robustness across varying noise standard deviations and tolerance thresholds (20 to 100 ms).
Benchmark comparisons across four training strategies (Base, Aug, Aug+LaNCoR, LaNCoR) on SeisT and PhaseNet architectures, plus ablation studies on the Error Learner and loss weights.
来自中国朝阳、孟村和星村煤矿的10,685条微震波形主数据集（采样率500 Hz，信噪比-3.4至32.3 dB，按80%/10%/10%划分训练/验证/测试集）。
来自内蒙古营盘壕煤矿的1,019条微震波形跨区域泛化测试数据集（采样率500 Hz，信噪比2.5至55.0 dB）。
在训练标签中加入合成零均值高斯噪声，以评估不同噪声标准差和容差阈值（20至100 ms）下的模型鲁棒性。
在SeisT和PhaseNet架构上对比四种训练策略（Base、Aug、Aug+LaNCoR、LaNCoR），并对误差学习器和损失权重进行消融实验。
li: Balancing the five optimization loss terms requires tuning multiple hyperparameters, which was done via a heuristic greedy search that may only find locally optimal weights.
Synthetic training label corruption relies on a zero-mean Gaussian assumption, whereas real human picking errors often contain systematic asymmetric biases.
The real coal-mine microseismic waveform datasets used in the study are not publicly available.
平衡五个优化损失项需要调节多个超参数，本文采用的启发式贪心搜索可能仅能获得局部最优解。
合成训练标签噪声依赖于零均值高斯假设，而实际人工拾取误差往往包含系统性的非对称偏差。
研究中所使用的真实煤矿微震波形数据集无法公开获取。

tm.why: The paper introduces a deep-learning framework (LaNCoR) using contrastive learning, multi-head self-attention, variational inference, and Random Fourier Features to handle noisy training labels in seismic signal processing.
The method is developed and benchmarked specifically for P-phase arrival-time picking on seismic waveforms using deep-learning phase pickers like PhaseNet and SeisT.
The experimental evaluation and cross-region generalization tests are conducted on real microseismic datasets recorded at four underground coal mines in China.

ev.notes: Full 32-page accepted manuscript PDF in Scientific Reports was analyzed, including mathematical formulations, experimental setup, quantitative results, and all 10 figures.

sum: Assessing model uncertainty in 3D magnetotelluric (MT) inversion is computationally prohibitive with traditional Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods. This study introduces VI-MT, a 3D Bayesian MT inversion framework based on Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD), coupling the open-source VIP package with ModEM forward and gradient solvers. By optimizing an ensemble of particles in parallel using log-posterior gradients and kernel repulsive forces, VI-MT approximates multimodal posterior distributions without explicit smoothing regularization. Synthetic tests on adjacent resistive and conductive blocks demonstrate that VI-MT recovers resistivity structures while reducing trailing artifacts and capturing non-Gaussian uncertainties. Applied to 78 field MT stations at Weishan volcano in northeast China, VI-MT images a well-constrained low-resistivity anomaly (~5 Ω·m) at 2–6 km depth beneath the crater, supporting the presence of a shallow magma chamber. This work provides the first practical SVGD implementation for 3D probabilistic electromagnetic inversion.
针对三维大地电磁（MT）反演难以量化不确定性的问题，本文提出了基于Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）的变分推断反演框架（VI-MT）。该方法结合ModEM正演与梯度计算，通过并行粒子优化逼近后验分布。合成数据测试表明，VI-MT能有效恢复电阻率异常、减弱拖尾效应并刻画多峰后验分布。应用于中国东北尾山……

t: Integrates ModEM 3D MT forward modeling and log-likelihood gradient calculation into a Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) framework using a radial basis function kernel and unconstrained parameter transformation.
将ModEM三维正演与伴随梯度计算集成到基于RBF核与无约束变换的SVGD变分推断框架中。
Validated on a 3D synthetic twin-block model (10 frequencies, 0.01–100 Hz) and applied to 78 field MT stations (20 frequencies, 3.4×10^-4 to 320 Hz) around Weishan volcano, China.
采用双异常块三维合成模型（10个频率）验证，并应用于尾山火山78个MT测点（20个频率）。

In the synthetic test, cell-wise posterior mode achieved an RMS of 1.46 while reducing trailing artifacts; at Weishan volcano, VI-MT reduced RMS from 3.25 to 1.21, imaging a ~5 Ω·m body at 2–6 km depth.
合成测试后验众数RMS为1.46且减弱拖尾；尾山实测反演RMS降至1.21，揭示2–6 km处约5 Ω·m低阻体。
High computational cost (~8 days on 100 CPU cores) requires coarse grids, and finite particle/iteration counts leave the posterior somewhat dependent on initialization.
计算耗时较长（8天），需采用粗网格，且有限粒子与迭代次数使结果受初始模型影响。
First implementation of non-parametric Stein Variational Gradient Descent for 3D probabilistic magnetotelluric inversion without explicit smoothing or regularization penalties.
首次将非参数化SVGD方法引入三维大地电磁概率反演，无需显式平滑正则化即可量化不确定性。

kc: Developed VI-MT, the first 3D Bayesian magnetotelluric inversion framework based on Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) by integrating ModEM with the VIP package.
Demonstrated via 3D synthetic tests that VI-MT reduces trailing effects compared to deterministic inversion and captures non-Gaussian, multimodal posterior resistivity distributions.
Applied 3D VI-MT to field data from Weishan volcano, imaging a robust shallow low-resistivity anomaly (~5 Ω·m at 2–6 km depth) with quantified uncertainties supporting a shallow magma chamber.
结合ModEM与VIP软件包，开发了首个基于Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）的三维大地电磁贝叶斯反演框架（VI-MT）。
通过三维合成测试证明VI-MT相比确定性反演能减弱拖尾效应，并能捕捉非高斯、多峰的后验电阻率分布。
将三维VI-MT应用于尾山火山实测数据，成像了2–6 km深度处约5 Ω·m的低阻异常并量化了不确定性，支持浅部岩浆房的存在。
me: Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) using a radial basis function (RBF) kernel to iteratively transport an ensemble of particles toward the target posterior distribution.
Log-ratio variable transformation to map bounded physical resistivity parameters into an unconstrained optimization space.
Integration of ModEM 3D electromagnetic forward modeling and adjoint log-likelihood gradient computations with parallel particle evaluation across CPU cores.
采用基于径向基函数（RBF）核的Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）迭代更新粒子群以逼近目标后验分布。
利用对数比变量变换将有界物理电阻率参数映射到无约束优化空间。
将ModEM三维电磁正演及伴随对数似然梯度计算与多CPU核心并行粒子评估相结合。
de: 3D synthetic test with adjacent 1000 Ω·m and 10 Ω·m blocks in a 100 Ω·m background (10 frequencies from 0.01 to 100 Hz, 3% Gaussian noise, 50 particles over 3000 iterations).

Field MT dataset from Weishan volcano (Wudalianchi volcanic field, NE China) comprising 78 stations, 20 frequencies (3.4×10^-4 to 320 Hz), inverted on a 39×45×44 grid using 50 particles over 1050 iterations.
Realistic synthetic test replicating the Weishan station geometry and noise levels with separated shallow and deep conductors.
包含1000 Ω·m高阻块和10 Ω·m低阻块的三维合成模型测试（0.01–100 Hz共10个频率，3%高斯噪声，50个粒子迭代3000次）。
中国东北五大连池尾山火山78个测点的实测MT数据（3.4×10^-4至320 Hz共20个频率），在39×45×44网格上使用50个粒子迭代1050次。
基于尾山实际台站分布与噪声水平的双层导体合成测试。
li: Computationally demanding (~8 days for the field dataset using 100 CPU cores), requiring a relatively coarse grid that trades off spatial resolution for efficiency.
With a finite number of particles (50) and iterations (1050–3000), the posterior approximation may be incomplete and remains somewhat sensitive to the initial reference model.
计算成本仍然较高（实测数据使用100个CPU核心耗时约8天），需要使用相对粗糙的网格以折衷空间分辨率与计算效率。
在有限粒子数（50）和迭代次数（1050–3000）下，后验分布逼近可能不够完整，且在一定程度上受初始参考模型的影响。

tm.why: The paper develops a 3D Bayesian inversion framework using Stein Variational Gradient Descent to approximate multimodal posterior distributions and quantify model uncertainties.
The core focus is solving the high-dimensional nonlinear 3D magnetotelluric inverse problem without explicit regularization penalties.
The method is applied to field MT data at Weishan volcano to image shallow and mid-crustal magma chambers and electrical resistivity structures.

ev.notes: Full 28-page manuscript PDF (including abstract, equations, 10 figures, and references) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates the use of distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) for high-resolution rainfall detection and quantification in urban environments. Using data from two deployments in Houston, Texas—a controlled shallow surface and borehole cable at Rice University and a 12-km urban dark fiber array—the authors compute strain-rate power spectral densities across multiple rain events. Results show that raindrop impacts induce near-instantaneous, high-energy broadband noise (dominantly 40–250 Hz) whose mean energy increases linearly with precipitation rate above a 2.5 mm/hr threshold. At the controlled test site, sensitivity is maximized for direct soil contact, diminishes in spring due to tree canopy foliage, and disappears completely by 1.5 m depth. Along the deep urban dark fiber, direct rainfall detection is spatially localized to shallow pull boxes and manholes. This work demonstrates that existing telecom fibers can serve as scalable, distributed urban rain gauges once environmentally sensitive segments are mapped.
本研究探讨了利用分布式声学传感（DAS）在城市环境中进行高分辨率降雨监测的潜力。作者分析了休斯顿两个场地的数据：莱斯大学受控浅表与井下光缆，以及一条12公里长的城市暗光纤阵列。通过计算应变率功率谱密度，发现雨滴撞击会激发瞬时高能宽频噪声（主频40–250 Hz），在降雨率超过2.5 mm/hr时其平……

t: Raw DAS data are converted to strain rate, and power spectral densities (PSD) are computed via Welch's method over 60-s windows. High-frequency energy (40–100 Hz or 80–250 Hz) during rain is normalized by pre-rain background levels.
将DAS数据转为应变率，用Welch法计算60秒窗功率谱密度，并以雨前背景归一化暴雨高频能量。

Ambient noise DAS datasets from Houston, Texas: a controlled shallow surface and wellbore cable at Rice University (RSTF, Jan–May 2025) and a 12-km urban dark fiber array (HANA, June–Sept 2025) using Treble+ and QuantX interrogators.
休斯顿两个场地的背景噪声DAS数据：莱斯大学受控浅表与井下光缆及12公里城市暗光纤阵列。

Rain above 2.5 mm/hr generates broadband noise (80–250 Hz) whose energy scales linearly with rain rate (r up to 0.78). Amplitudes drop 2.5x at 0.5 m depth and vanish at 1.5 m; spring foliage reduces energy.
高于2.5 mm/hr的降雨激发80–250 Hz宽频噪声且与雨强呈线性相关；0.5米深处幅值降2.5倍，1.5米处消失…

Light rain (<2.5 mm/hr) is undetectable above background noise, depth attenuation limits detection to shallow cables (<1.5 m), seasonal foliage alters calibration, and urban fibers only detect rain near surface boxes.
小于2.5 mm/hr的小雨无法检测，信号在1.5米深处衰减殆尽，受植被季节影响，且暗光纤仅在浅表井箱处敏感。

First demonstration of direct, near-instantaneous raindrop impact detection and rainfall rate quantification using DAS on both controlled surface cables and urban dark fiber utility boxes, distinct from delayed storm-drain flow noise.
首次利用浅埋光缆和城市暗光纤实现了雨滴直接撞击的瞬时宽频检测与雨强量化，区别于前人观测的排水管流延迟噪声。

kc: Demonstrated direct, near-instantaneous broadband (40–250 Hz) rainfall detection on both shallow trenched DAS cables and urban dark fiber networks.
Quantified a linear relationship between precipitation rate (above 2.5 mm/hr) and mean high-frequency DAS spectrogram energy.

Evaluated environmental controls on DAS rain sensitivity, showing signal loss by 1.5 m depth, stronger response in soft direct-buried soil than in conduits, and seasonal attenuation from tree canopy foliage.
Showed that urban dark fiber sensitivity to direct raindrop impacts is spatially localized to shallow utility pull boxes and manholes rather than deep buried conduits.
在浅埋受控光缆和城市暗光纤网络上均实现了直接、瞬时的宽频（40–250 Hz）降雨信号检测。
量化了降雨率（高于2.5 mm/hr）与高频DAS谱图平均能量之间的线性正相关关系。
评估了环境因素对DAS降雨灵敏度的控制作用：信号在1.5米深处消失、软土直接掩埋优于管道铺设、春季树冠枝叶会削弱信号。
揭示了城市暗光纤对雨滴直接撞击的敏感区空间局限于浅层牵引箱和沙井附近，而非深埋管道段。
me: Converted raw DAS recordings from different interrogators (Terra15 Treble/Treble+ and OptaSense QuantX) to unified strain-rate units.
Computed strain-rate power spectral density (PSD) periodograms using Welch's method over 60-s windows (5 segments, 25% overlap) with 5-minute lateral smoothing.
Mapped rain-sensitive urban cable segments by normalizing mean high-frequency periodogram energy (80–250 Hz for Treble+, 40–100 Hz for QuantX) during heavy rain against pre-rain background levels.
Performed linear regression and correlation analysis between normalized mean DAS energy and local weather station precipitation rates.
将不同解调仪（Terra15 Treble/Treble+ 和 OptaSense QuantX）的原始DAS记录统一转换为应变率。
采用Welch方法在60秒窗口（分5段，25%重叠）内计算应变率功率谱密度（PSD），并进行5分钟横向平滑以构建时频体积。
通过将暴雨期间的高频段（Treble+为80–250 Hz，QuantX为40–100 Hz）平均能量除以雨前背景能量，识别并绘制城市暗光纤的降雨敏感区段。
对归一化DAS平均能量与附近气象站记录的降雨率进行线性回归与相关性分析。
de: Rice Subsurface Test Facility (RSTF): 140-m surface trenched cable (5–10 cm depth), tubing-encased surface cable, wellbore behind-casing fiber, and 5-Hz 3C SmartSolo geophone nodes recorded in Jan–Feb and Apr–May 2025.
Houston Ambient Noise Array (HANA): 12-km dark telecom fiber spanning 7 km physical distance from Rice University to downtown Houston, recorded in June–July 2025 (Treble+) and Aug–Sept 2025 (QuantX).
Precipitation ground truth from an on-site meteorological station at RSTF and public Weather Underground stations (300–1700 m away) along the HANA corridor.
莱斯大学地下测试场（RSTF）：包含140米浅沟表面光缆（5–10厘米深）、套管表面光缆、井下套管后光缆及5-Hz三分量SmartSolo检波器节点，采集于2025年1–2月和4–5月。
休斯顿背景噪声阵列（HANA）：从莱斯大学延伸至休斯顿市中心的12公里暗光纤（物理跨度约7公里），分别于2025年6–7月（Treble+）和8–9月（QuantX）采集。
降雨地面真值数据来自RSTF现场气象站以及HANA沿线300–1700米范围内的Weather Underground公共气象站。
li: Light rainfall events with precipitation rates below 2.5 mm/hr (cumulative < 4 mm) do not exceed the DAS background noise floor and remain undetected.
Rain-induced high-frequency seismic energy attenuates rapidly with depth, becoming undetectable at 1.5 m below the surface.
Seasonal vegetation and tree foliage attenuate raindrop impact energy, altering calibration slopes and reducing correlation coefficients in spring.
Urban dark fiber networks are largely insensitive along deep conduits, only detecting direct rainfall where fibers approach the surface at pull boxes or manholes.
降雨率低于2.5 mm/hr（累计小于4毫米）的小雨事件无法超过DAS背景噪声水平，难以被检测到。
降雨激发的高频地震能量随深度迅速衰减，在地下1.5米处即无法被DAS检测到。
季节性植被和树冠枝叶会削弱雨滴撞击能量，改变线性标定斜率并降低春季数据的相关系数。
城市暗光纤在深埋管道段对降雨不敏感，仅在光缆接近地表的牵引箱或沙井处才能检测到直接降雨信号。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the potential of distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) on both surface-trenched cables and an urban dark fiber array for high-resolution rainfall detection and quantification.
The primary focus is environmental seismology, specifically measuring acoustic and seismic signatures induced by precipitation for hydrological monitoring.
The study analyzes passive continuous ambient seismic noise spectra (40–250 Hz) generated by raindrop impacts.

ev.notes: Full 15-page article PDF from Seismica (2026) analyzed, including abstract, methodology, RSTF and HANA field experiments, all 10 figures, discussion, and conclusions.

sum: Mercury's northern smooth plains (NSP) preserve unexpectedly numerous contractional landforms despite forming after much of the planet's secular global contraction had ceased. By combining a fault-relief extraction algorithm with an equal-area Fibonacci-sphere spatial sampling scheme across 9,845 globally mapped faults, the authors show that the NSP exhibits higher background contractional strain (~0.5%) than surrounding older terranes. Moreover, contraction within the NSP displays an annular pattern centered on the Northern Rise (NR), with reduced central contraction and enhanced peripheral shortening. Gravity and topography inversions coupled with 2D axisymmetric thermo-mechanical mantle convection and 3D elastic stress models reveal that a deep, long-lived buoyant mantle upwelling beneath the NR generated broad uplift, reducing central contraction while concentrating shortening along the flanks as the upwelling waned. Defining a dimensionless pseudo-Rayleigh number constrains Mercury's lithospheric viscosity to 10^27–10^28 Pa·s for a 50–200 km thick lithosphere.
水星北部平滑平原（NSP）虽形成较晚，却保留了大量收缩构造。本研究利用断层起伏提取算法和斐波那契球面等面积采样框架分析了全球9845条断层，发现NSP的收缩应变（约0.5%）高于其他古老地块，且围绕北部隆起（NR）呈中心减弱、外围增强的环状分布。结合重力地形反演、二维热力学地幔对流及三维弹性模型表明……

t: Extracts fault relief via cross-correlated topographic profiles, aggregates areal strain across equal-area Fibonacci-sphere windows, and combines spherical-harmonic mantle dynamic loading inversions with 2D axisymmetric thermo-mechanical convection and 3D elastic stress models.
通过互相关地形剖面提取断层起伏，在斐波那契球面窗口内聚合应变，并结合动力加载反演与热力学模拟。

Uses a global tectonic map of 9,845 contractional landforms on Mercury (compared against earlier datasets of 5,934, ~1,350, and 653 faults) alongside MESSENGER long-wavelength (degree <= 15) gravity and topography anomalies.
使用水星9845条收缩构造的全球地质图，以及信使号15阶以内的长波长重力和地形异常数据。

The NSP converges to ~0.5% background contractional strain, higher than non-NSP terranes, with an annular anomaly around the Northern Rise explained by a 350-km-deep buoyant sheet (~730 km wide, 8×10^6 kg/m^2) and lithospheric viscosity of 10^27–10^28 Pa·s.
NSP背景收缩应变约0.5%高于其他区域，呈环状围绕NR，由350km深处异常体驱动，岩石圈粘度10^27–10^28 …

Deformation estimates rely on assumed fault dips and strain partitioning, and inversions cannot uniquely distinguish thermal versus compositional buoyancy or explicitly model lithospheric brittle yielding and melt migration.
应变估计依赖断层倾角假设，反演无法唯一区分热或成分浮力，且未包含脆性屈服与熔体运移。
Identifies waned mantle upwelling beneath the Northern Rise as a regional driver of prolonged contractional deformation on Mercury, reconciling high strain in the young NSP with global contraction.
提出北部隆起下方减弱的地幔上涌是驱动水星年轻平原持续高强度收缩变形的区域机制。

kc: Demonstrated via convergence-tested Fibonacci-sphere spatial sampling that Mercury's northern smooth plains (NSP) experienced higher contractional strain than older non-NSP terranes.
Revealed a spatially heterogeneous, annular strain distribution around the Northern Rise (NR) with reduced central contraction and radial peripheral fault orientations.
Showed through dynamic loading inversions and thermo-mechanical simulations that waned mantle upwelling beneath the NR reproduces both dynamic topography and strain patterns.
Introduced a dimensionless pseudo-Rayleigh number (pRa) to link mantle buoyancy and surface strain, constraining Mercury's lithospheric viscosity to 10^27–10^28 Pa·s.
通过经过收敛测试的斐波那契球面空间采样证明，水星北部平滑平原（NSP）经历了比古老非NSP地块更高的收缩应变。
揭示了围绕北部隆起（NR）的空间非均匀环状应变分布，表现为中心收缩减弱及外围断层呈径向排列。
通过动力加载反演和热-力学数值模拟表明，NR下方减弱的地幔上涌重现了观测到的动力地形与应变模式。
引入无量纲伪瑞利数（pRa）关联地幔浮力与地表应变，将水星岩石圈粘度约束在10^27–10^28 Pa·s。
me: Automated thrust-fault relief extraction using crater-filtered topographic transects, bandpass filtering, and cross-correlation alignment.
Equal-area Fibonacci-sphere spatial aggregation across multiple sampling window sizes to estimate background areal contractional strain.
Analytical spherical-harmonic mantle dynamic loading inversion using topography and gravity anomalies (degrees <= 15).
2D axisymmetric thermo-mechanical viscous mantle convection modeling (ASPECT) and 3D quasi-static elastic stress modeling (COMSOL).
基于撞击坑过滤地形剖面、带通滤波和互相关对齐的逆冲断层地形起伏自动提取算法。
跨多尺度采样窗口的等面积斐波那契球面空间聚合方法，用于估算背景面收缩应变。
利用球谐阶数≤15的地形和重力异常进行解析球谐地幔动力加载反演。
二维轴对称热-力学粘性地幔对流数值模拟（ASPECT）与三维准静态弹性应力建模（COMSOL）。
de: Global tectonic map of Mercury containing 9,845 contractional fault landforms (excluding faults < 10 km) and comparative analysis with earlier fault catalogs (n = 5,934, ~1,350, and 653).
MESSENGER spacecraft topography and free-air gravity anomaly datasets up to spherical harmonic degree 15.
Parametric suite of 2D thermo-mechanical simulations spanning 3.7 Gyr and 3D spherical elastic loading models.
包含9845条收缩断层地貌的水星全球构造图（排除<10 km的断层），并与早期断层目录（n = 5934、~1350和653）进行对比分析。
信使号（MESSENGER）探测器高达15阶球谐系数的地形和自由空气重力异常数据集。
跨度37亿年的二维热-力学参数化模拟组合以及三维球面弹性加载模型。
li: Absolute shortening remains uncertain because fault dip angles and folding-versus-slip partitioning at depth are not uniquely constrained for individual landforms.
Geophysical inversions and numerical models cannot uniquely distinguish whether the deep mantle buoyancy is thermal, compositional, or thermochemical.
Thermo-mechanical simulations assume a viscous lithosphere without explicit brittle yielding or melt migration.
由于单个地貌的断层倾角以及深部褶皱与滑动的分配缺乏唯一约束，绝对缩短量仍存在不确定性。
地球物理反演和数值模型无法唯一区分深部地幔浮力究竟是热成因、成分成因还是热-化学成因。
热-力学模拟假设岩石圈表现为粘性体，未显式包含脆性屈服或熔体运移过程。

tm.why: The paper investigates mantle upwelling, dynamic topography, and lithospheric contractional strain on Mercury using geodynamic simulations and gravity/topography modeling.
The study focuses on planetary geophysics and tectonic fault systems on Mercury, relevant to planetary interior and tectonic evolution.

ev.notes: All metadata, quantitative strain values, geophysical inversion parameters, simulation details, and figure descriptions were extracted directly from the 12-page Nature Communications PDF.

sum: Deciphering the internal structure of mountain belts from seismic data requires understanding the elastic anisotropy of deformed crustal rocks. This study introduces the 'largest homogeneous volume' (LHV) approach to determine an upper bound for intrinsic seismic anisotropy in strongly foliated and folded phyllosilicate-rich schists from the Brenner Base Tunnel, west of the Tauern Window (Eastern Alps). Combining optical microscopy, micro-XRF compositional mapping, EBSD, and high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction on millimeter-sized cylinders, the authors measured crystallographic preferred orientations (CPOs) in microstructurally undisturbed domains and modeled bulk seismic velocities via Hill averaging. Results show P-wave anisotropy of 6%–17% and maximum shear-wave splitting of 0.2–0.7 km/s, with fast directions parallel to foliation. Anisotropy linearly correlates with phyllosilicate content and CPO strength, whereas quartz and calcite have negligible effects and millimeter-scale crenulation weakens anisotropy. The LHV baseline provides essential input for upscaling anisotropy to interpret orogenic seismic cross-sections.
本研究提出了“最大均匀体积”（LHV）方法，用于确定东阿尔卑斯陶恩构造窗西侧布伦纳基线隧道富层状硅酸盐片岩的本征地震各向异性上限。作者结合光学显微镜、微区XRF成分分析、EBSD及毫米级圆柱样品的高能同步辐射X射线衍射，测量了未受微构造扰动区域的晶格优选方位（CPO），并利用Hill平均与Chris……

t: Synchrotron X-ray diffraction on millimeter-sized cylinders measures phyllosilicate CPOs in undisturbed volumes, which are combined with modal compositions and single-crystal stiffness tensors via Hill averaging and the Christoffel equation to calculate elastic wave velocities.
对毫米级岩芯进行同步辐射X射线衍射测量无扰动层状硅酸盐CPO，结合模态成分和单晶刚度张量通过Hill平均和Christo…

22 drill core samples from three tectonic units (Innsbruck Quartzphyllite, Matrei Zone, Bündner schist) along the northern Brenner Base Tunnel exploration tunnel, analyzed by optical microscopy, micro-XRF, EBSD, and synchrotron diffraction at DESY and ESRF.
采自布伦纳基线隧道3个构造单元的22个钻孔样品，结合偏光显微镜、μ-XRF、EBSD及DESY和ESRF同步辐射衍射进行…

Planar microstructure groups M1–M4 show Vp-anisotropy of 14.9%–16.7% and maximum shear-wave splitting (dVs) of 0.57–0.67 km/s, whereas crenulated group M5 shows weaker Vp-anisotropy of 6.5% and dVs of 0.25 km/s.
平直叶理组M1–M4的Vp各向异性为14.9%–16.7%，最大横波分裂为0.57–0.67 km/s；具皱纹劈理的M5…
The Hill average captures only intrinsic mineral CPO anisotropy and does not account for extrinsic factors such as shape preferred orientation, folding, compositional layering, or microcracks.
Hill平均仅计算本征矿物CPO各向异性，未考虑形态优选方位、褶皱、成分层理或微裂隙等外因。

Introduces the Largest Homogeneous Volume (LHV) approach using synchrotron X-ray diffraction to establish a statistically robust, undisturbed upper bound of intrinsic anisotropy in folded schists for larger-scale upscaling.
提出基于同步辐射的“最大均匀体积”（LHV）方法，为强烈变形片岩提供未受微构造扰动的本征各向异性上限基准。

kc: Introduces the Largest Homogeneous Volume (LHV) concept using synchrotron X-ray diffraction to measure undisturbed CPO in heterogeneously deformed schists.
Establishes upper-bound intrinsic P-wave anisotropy (6%–17%) and shear wave splitting (0.2–0.7 km/s) for major lithotectonic units along the Brenner Base Tunnel.
Demonstrates that white mica and chlorite content and CPO control bulk schist anisotropy, whereas quartz, calcite, and feldspar contributions are negligible.
Quantifies how microstructural disruptions such as millimeter-scale crenulation cleavage weaken CPO and reduce bulk elastic anisotropy from ~15–17% down to 6.5%.
提出“最大均匀体积”（LHV）概念，利用同步辐射X射线衍射测量非均匀变形片岩中未受扰动的晶格优选方位（CPO）。
确定了布伦纳基线隧道主要构造岩性单元本征P波各向异性（6%–17%）和横波分裂（0.2–0.7 km/s）的上限。
证明白云母和绿泥石的含量及CPO控制了片岩的整体各向异性，而石英、方解石和长石的贡献可忽略不计。
量化了毫米级皱纹劈理等微构造扰动如何削弱CPO并将整体弹性各向异性从~15–17%降低至6.5%。
me: Optical polarization microscopy to classify samples into five microstructural groups (M1–M5) based on cleavage spacing, shape, and crenulation.
Modal phase composition quantification using micro-X-ray fluorescence (μ-XRF) and FEGSEM-EDS element mapping with k-means clustering.
High-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction (DESY P07b and ESRF ID22) in transmission on 2.5–3.5 mm micro-drill cores to measure phyllosilicate (002) pole figures.
Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) mapping to evaluate quartz and calcite CPOs in microlithon domains.
Seismic velocity and anisotropy modeling using MTEX, Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging of single-crystal elastic stiffness tensors, and the Christoffel equation.
利用偏光显微镜根据劈理间距、形态和皱纹特征将样品划分为五个微构造组（M1–M5）。
利用微区X射线荧光（μ-XRF）和FEGSEM-EDS元素扫描结合k-means聚类量化矿物模态成分。
对直径2.5–3.5 mm微钻孔岩芯进行透射高能同步辐射X射线衍射（DESY P07b和ESRF ID22），测量层状硅酸盐(002)极图。
应用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）测定微岩片区域中石英和方解石的晶格优选方位（CPO）。
使用MTEX工具箱、单晶弹性刚度张量的Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均以及Christoffel方程进行地震波速和各向异性建模。
de: 22 drill core samples from the northern exploration tunnel of the Brenner Base Tunnel (8 Innsbruck Quartzphyllite, 8 Matrei Zone schists, 6 Bündner schists).
Synchrotron X-ray diffraction 2D Debye-Scherrer ring datasets collected at 87.1 keV (DESY) and 70 keV (ESRF) with >1,000 crystallites per CPO.
EBSD grain orientation maps for calcite (18,747 grains) in sample BS-21623 and quartz (222,802 grains) in sample MZ-15893.

sum: This study models the coupled interior-atmosphere thermal evolution of five ultra-short-period (USP) rocky exoplanets targeted by JWST Cycle 4 Program 8864 (TOI-1807 b, TOI-2260 b, TOI-431 b, TOI-6255 b, and TOI-2431 b). Using the PROTEUS framework, the authors simulate the feedback between magma oceans and outgassed volatile envelopes under stellar wind erosion. They classify the planets into six categories based on final melt state and atmospheric thickness. The models predict that most targets tend toward a bare-rock state with low global melt fractions (<=20%), and identify S2 as a potential tracer of the interior melt state. This work establishes a minimum escape efficiency threshold for atmosphere survival, providing critical predictions to interpret upcoming MIRI-LRS phase curve observations.
本研究利用PROTEUS内部-大气耦合框架，模拟了五个JWST第四周期观测目标（超短周期岩石系外行星）的热演化。研究探讨了岩浆洋与释出大气之间的反馈以及恒星风剥蚀效应，将演化结果划分为六类。模型预测大多数目标倾向于无大气的“裸岩”状态（全球熔融比例≤20%），并指出S2气体可作为内部熔融状态的指示剂……

t: Coupled interior-atmosphere modeling using the PROTEUS framework to simulate magma ocean evolution, volatile outgassing, and atmospheric escape.

sum: This dataset release describes the operational datasets from the ICDP Eger Rift Observatory in the West Bohemia/Vogtland geodynamic region. To study earthquake swarms, crustal fluid flow, mantle-derived CO2/He degassing, and the deep biosphere, the project established an in situ geodynamic laboratory. The setup comprises five monitoring boreholes (S1, S2, S3, F3, S4) and one supplementary borehole (P1). Seismic monitoring sites (S1–S3) feature borehole broadband seismometers and 3D seismic arrays (vertical geophone chains and surface arrays). Fluid monitoring is conducted at the Hartoušov mofette field (F1–F3). The dataset provides critical high-frequency, near-source, multi-parameter observations of earthquake swarms and associated fluid-biosphere processes.
本数据集介绍了捷克与德国交界西波希米亚/福格兰特地区的ICDP Eger裂谷观测站运行数据。该项目建立了一个原位地球动力学实验室，旨在研究地震群、地壳流体流动、幔源CO2和He脱气及深部生物圈。实验室包含5口监测井（S1-S3为地震监测，F3为Hartoušov喷气孔流体监测，S4为Bažina玛珥……

sum: Traditional inverse problem solving relies on the Optimization-Driven Inversion (ODI) paradigm, which minimizes an objective function via iterative search but suffers from high computational cost, ambiguous physical meaning, and multi-parameter coupling. This paper introduces a complementary paradigm: Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI), which identifies and exploits the intrinsic mathematical or physical structure of the forward operator to directly construct a solution method via division, inversion, or deconvolution. SDI comprises Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI), represented by spectral-domain pseudo-inverse inversion (MSDPII) via unitary diagonalization, and Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI), represented by virtual-source waveform inversion imaging (PSDWII) and physical-structure-driven back-propagation (PSDBP) for deep neural networks. Rather than encoding structure as regularization penalties in a loss function, SDI embeds operator structure into the inversion algorithm itself, achieving O(N log N) complexity for diagonalizable linear systems and natural parameter decoupling without Hessian inversion.
传统优化驱动反演（ODI）通过最小化目标函数进行迭代搜索，存在计算瓶颈、物理意义模糊及多参数耦合等局限。本文提出互补的“结构驱动反演”（SDI）新范式，通过识别并利用正演算子的内在数学或物理结构，以除法、求逆或反褶积为核心操作直接构建求解方法。SDI包含两类：数学结构驱动反演（以基于酉对角化的谱域伪……

t: SDI identifies mathematical (unitary diagonalizability) or physical (decomposable causal chain) structures in forward operators to construct direct or stepwise inverse solutions using spectral division, function inversion, or virtual-source deconvolution instead of gradient-based cross-correlation.
识别算子数学（酉对角化）或物理（因果链分解）结构，以谱域除法、函数求逆或虚拟源反褶积直接构建反演方法。

As a conceptual paradigm paper, it evaluates theoretical formulations across seven classes of inverse problems (FWI, CT/MRI, PDE estimation, inverse scattering, MPC, system ID, machine learning) without running new numerical datasets.
纯理论范式论文，综合对比了地球物理FWI、医学成像、逆散射及深度学习等七类反演问题的理论数学形式。

MSDPII reduces linear inversion complexity from O(N^3) in Tikhonov regularization to O(N log N) one-step FFT filtering with bounded stability ||G_alpha^#||_2 <= 1/(2*sqrt(alpha)), while PSDWII naturally decouples parameters via deconvolution without O(N^3) Hessian inversion.
MSDPII将Tikhonov正则化O(N^3)复杂度降至O(N log N)一步FFT求解；PSDWII通过反褶积免除…

SDI requires identifiable structure: MSDPII needs square unitarily diagonalizable matrices, PSDWII needs accurate initial kinematics and Born validity, and PSDBP requires strictly monotonic invertible activations; otherwise SDI degenerates to ODI.
MSDPII限方阵且可酉对角化；PSDWII需准确初始模型；PSDBP需严格单调可逆激活函数；无结构时退化为ODI。

First systematic formulation of Structure-Driven Inversion as an independent paradigm that embeds mathematical or physical operator structure directly into constructing inverse operators rather than as regularization terms in optimization.
首次系统提出结构驱动反演独立范式，将算子结构用于直接构建求解算子，而非作为目标函数中的正则化约束项。

kc: Formulates Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI) as an independent paradigm complementary to Optimization-Driven Inversion (ODI), shifting from iterative objective minimization to structural operator construction.

Categorizes SDI into Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI, using unitary diagonalization and spectral division) and Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI, using causal chain decomposition and deconvolution).

Unifies three representative methods under SDI: spectral-domain pseudo-inverse (MSDPII), virtual-source waveform inversion imaging (PSDWII), and physical-structure-driven back-propagation (PSDBP) for neural networks.
Demonstrates that replacing cross-correlation (multiplication) with division/deconvolution naturally decouples multi-parameter contributions without computing the inverse Hessian.
提出作为优化驱动反演（ODI）补充的“结构驱动反演”（SDI）独立新范式，将反演逻辑从迭代最小化目标函数转向基于算子结构的求解构造。
将SDI划分为数学结构驱动反演（MSDI，利用酉对角化与谱域除法）和物理结构驱动反演（PSDI，利用物理因果链分解与反褶积）两大类型。
在SDI框架下统一了三种代表性方法：谱域伪逆反演（MSDPII）、虚拟源波形反演成像（PSDWII）以及深度神经网络物理结构驱动反向传播（PSDBP）。
阐明以除法/反褶积替代互相关（乘法）作为核心操作可自然解耦多参数贡献，免去求解Hessian矩阵逆的高昂代价。
me: Mathematical Structure-Driven Pseudo-Inverse Inversion (MSDPII): exploits unitary diagonalization (e.g., FFT for translation-invariant operators) to obtain an analytical SVD and construct a stabilized spectral-domain filtering pseudo-inverse in one step.

Physical Structure-Driven Waveform Inversion Imaging (PSDWII): decomposes wave propagation into incident propagation, virtual-source excitation, and secondary propagation, performing inversion via reverse-time adjoint projection followed by wavefield/radiation-pattern deconvolution.

Physical Structure-Driven Back-Propagation (PSDBP): models layered neural networks as physical systems (weights as stiffness, activations as constitutive laws) and updates weights via adjoint demand transport, analytical activation inversion, and least-squares projection.
数学结构驱动伪逆反演（MSDPII）：利用算子酉对角化（如平移不变算子的FFT）获得解析奇异值分解，在谱域通过逐点除法一步构建稳定的滤波伪逆算子。
物理结构驱动波形反演成像（PSDWII）：将波传播分解为入射波传播、虚拟源激发和次生波传播，通过逆时伴随投影提取虚拟源，并用除法（反褶积）消除入射波场与辐射模式影响。
物理结构驱动反向传播（PSDBP）：将层状深度网络类比为物理系统（权重为刚度矩阵，激活函数为本构关系），通过伴随需求传输、激活函数解析求逆及最小二乘投影更新权重。
de: Purely theoretical and methodological synthesis paper; no new numerical datasets or field data experiments are executed within the text.

Synthesizes and compares mathematical formulations and complexity bounds across 7 classes of inverse problems and prior studies (e.g., 3D gravity inversion, FWI/LSRTM, deep learning, and SFDDPM-TV seismic denoising).
本文为纯理论与方法论综述/范式论文，正文未直接展示新的数值数据集或实际资料实验。
综合对比了7类典型反演问题及作者前期工作（如真三维重力反演、全波形反演/最小二乘逆时偏移、深度学习及SFDDPM-TV地震去噪）的数学表述与复杂度特征。
li: MSDPII requires the forward operator matrix to be square and unitarily (or approximately unitarily) diagonalizable, failing for general non-square or non-diagonalizable linear systems.

PSDWII relies on a kinematically accurate background model to avoid cycle skipping, is bounded by the Born approximation per step, and still requires multiple structural iterations for strongly nonlinear multiple scattering.
PSDBP requires strictly monotonic (invertible) activation functions, needs numerical stabilization during deep analytical inversion, and lacks extensive empirical validation.
MSDPII要求正演算子矩阵为方阵且可酉对角化（或近似酉对角化），不适用于一般非方阵或不可对角化的线性系统。
PSDWII依赖运动学准确的背景模型以避免周期跳跃，单步受限于Born近似，对强非线性多次散射问题仍需多步结构约束迭代。
PSDBP要求激活函数严格单调可逆，深度传播中解析求逆需额外稳定性处理，且理论分析尚需进一步实证检验。

tm.why: The paper systematically proposes a new theoretical paradigm—Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI)—for solving general linear and nonlinear inverse problems as a complement to optimization-driven inversion.

One of the core representative methods presented is Physical Structure-Driven Waveform Inversion Imaging (PSDWII), which reformulates seismic full-waveform inversion using virtual-source projection and deconvolution.
The paper introduces Physical Structure-Driven Back-Propagation (PSDBP) via physical-system analogy and discusses structure-informed diffusion models for seismic denoising.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 18-page arXiv PDF manuscript, including all mathematical derivations, theorems, and 13 comparison tables.

sum: This paper introduces the elastic Direct Waveform Inversion (eDWI) scheme to address local minima and multi-parameter trade-offs in conventional gradient-based elastic full-waveform inversion. By enforcing time-space causality, eDWI reformulates the global non-linear inversion into a sequence of localized recursive inversions from shallow to deep depths. The method utilizes the Stiffness Matrix Method to decompose wavefields into up- and down-going P- and S-waves, performing localized inversions using specific P-to-P and P-to-S reflection events. Tested on stratified layered elastic media with plane-wave and point sources, eDWI successfully reconstructs elastic properties without requiring a global initial model or low-frequency data, while automatically utilizing multiples and mitigating parameter coupling.

sum: Traditional surface wave inversion methods suffer from initial model dependency, local minima, high computational cost, and manual curve picking errors. This study proposes INVNET, an encoder-style Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that directly maps 2D surface wave dispersion spectra to 1D near-surface shear-wave velocity (Vs) structures. To bridge the gap between synthetic and field data, the authors generate 2,000 random 5-layer models, simulate ambient noise waveforms from sources at four depths (0, 10, 20, 30 m) using the Generalized Reflection/Transmission Coefficient (GRTC) method, extract dispersion spectra via the Frequency-Bessel (F-J) transform, and apply a novel multi-depth weighted stacking strategy to create 20,000 realistic training pairs. On synthetic tests, INVNET achieves R² scores of 0.9583 for depth and 0.9468 for Vs in under 1 s per inversion. Applied to active-source field data across the Qademah fault, INVNET rapidly recovers a three-layer structure consistent with traditional Quasi-Newton (BFGS) inversion.
针对传统面波反演依赖初始模型、计算慢及需手动拾取频散曲线的问题，本文提出了基于编码器架构卷积神经网络（CNN）的直接反演方法INVNET。研究采用广义反射/透射系数（GRTC）法模拟不同深度（0、10、20、30 m）噪声源响应，经互相关与频率-贝塞尔变换（F-J法）提取频散谱，并创新性地引入多深度……

t: INVNET uses a 7-block encoder-style 2D CNN (3x3 convolutions, ReLU, 2x2 max-pooling) to compress 512x512 dispersion spectrum images and map them via a linear layer to a 9x1 vector of 4 interface depths and 5 layer Vs values.
采用含7个卷积池化块的编码器式2D CNN，将512×512频散谱直接映射为4个界面深度和5个层速度参数。

2,000 random 5-layer models were forward-modeled at 4 noise source depths (0–30 m) using GRTC and F-J transform, then combined via 10 weighted stacks per model to yield 20,000 synthetic pairs, alongside 51 active-source shots from Qademah fault.
基于GRTC与F-J法对2000个模型进行4深度噪声加权叠加生成20000对合成样本，并使用Qademah断层51炮实测…
On 1,000 synthetic test samples, INVNET achieved a depth RMSE of 3.740 m (MAE 2.477 m, R² 0.9583) and Vs RMSE of 53.346 m/s (MAE 35.773 m/s, R² 0.9468), inverting each profile in under 1 second.

Performance is limited by the training velocity model space (risking poor extrapolation on extreme or thin layers) and by the fixed 5-layer discrete output parameterization.
受限于训练集模型空间（极端薄层易外推失效）及固定的5层离散输出参数化形式。
Combines accurate GRTC full-wavefield modeling with a multi-depth noise source weighted stacking strategy to generate realistic multimodal dispersion spectra for direct, picker-free CNN inversion.

kc: Proposes INVNET, a 7-block encoder-style CNN that directly inverts 512x512 surface wave dispersion spectra into 5-layer Vs and interface depth parameters without manual curve picking or initial models.
Introduces a multi-depth noise source weighted stacking strategy using GRTC forward modeling and F-J extraction to synthesize realistic multimodal dispersion spectra and expand the training dataset.
Demonstrates superior accuracy via ablation studies on high- and low-velocity anomalies and validates real-world applicability on active-source field data from the Qademah fault.

通过高速和低速异常体消融实验验证了加权叠加策略的有效性，并在Qademah断层主动源实测数据中验证了方法的实用性与高效性。
me: Generalized Reflection/Transmission Coefficient (GRTC) method for full-wavefield ambient noise forward modeling in 5-layer media.
Ambient noise cross-correlation and Frequency-Bessel Transform (F-J) method (via CC-FJpy) to extract multimodal Rayleigh wave dispersion spectra.
Multi-depth noise source weighted stacking strategy combining dispersion spectra from 0, 10, 20, and 30 m source depths under four random weighting schemes.
7-block encoder-style 2D CNN (INVNET) with 3x3 convolutions, ReLU activation, 2x2 max-pooling, and a linear regression head trained with MSE loss and Adam optimizer.
利用广义反射/透射系数（GRTC）方法在5层介质中进行环境噪声全波场正演模拟。
使用CC-FJpy软件包计算台站对互相关函数，并通过频率-贝塞尔变换（F-J方法）提取多模式瑞利波频散谱。

de: Synthetic dataset of 2,000 random 5-layer velocity models (top 80–100 m, Vs 200–1,100 m/s) expanded to 20,000 sample pairs via 10 weighted stacks per model (split into 1,900 models for train/val and 100 models / 1,000 samples for test).

Ablation study comparing INVNET1 (20,000 stacked samples), INVNET2 (8,000 stacked samples), and INVNET3 (8,000 unstacked multi-depth samples) on standard, high-velocity, and low-velocity anomaly models.

Field data application using 51 common-shot gathers (48 traces per shot, 2 m receiver spacing) from an active-source 2D survey across the Qademah fault near KAUST, compared against DisbaTomo Quasi-Newton (BFGS) inversion.

泛化能力受限于训练集覆盖的速度模型空间，遇到训练集未充分表征的极端地质条件或薄层时可能产生不可靠的外推或幻觉。

The core objective is inverting Rayleigh surface wave dispersion spectra to obtain near-surface shear-wave velocity profiles.

The training dataset is synthesized by simulating ambient noise from ring-distributed sources, computing cross-correlations, and extracting dispersion spectra via the Frequency-Bessel Transform (F-J) method.

sum: This study presents the Nested-Permutation Alarm for Dual-Parameter Earthquake Forecasting (ANADEF) pipeline, combining a penalized 2D B-spline Gutenberg–Richter b-value field with a stationary background seismicity rate (μ) from space-time ETAS declustering. Applied to an 18-year homogenized catalog (n = 40,731, MN ≥ 1.5, 2006–2024) in the Zagros Fold–Thrust Belt under a two-stage training (2006–2014) and evaluation (2015–2024) protocol, the integrated model achieves a retrospective Area Skill Score S = 0.69 for Mw ≥ 5.0 (N = 55), reducing alarmed area from τ ≈ 0.38 (μ-only) to τ ≈ 0.28 while maintaining a 92.7% hit rate. The primary novelty is a nested permutation procedure that re-optimizes thresholds within each null realization to absorb calibration bias and formally test predictor non-redundancy. Incremental b-value significance is null-dependent (p = 0.012 for cell-wise shuffle vs. p = 0.057 for spatial-shift). Frozen thresholds are applied to 2015–2024 fields to generate a 2025–2029 prospective alarm template.
本文提出双参数地震预测嵌套置换警报（ANADEF）流程，将惩罚二维B样条反演的b值场与时空ETAS去丛集获得的稳态背景地震率（μ）相结合。基于扎格罗斯褶皱冲断带18年目录（40,731个事件，2006–2024），采用两阶段训练与评估协议，模型对Mw≥5.0地震取得回顾性面积技巧评分S=0.69，警……

Space-time ETAS iterative stochastic declustering with variable kernel smoothing for stationary background seismicity rate (μ) estimation.
Molchan Error Diagram (MED) evaluation using cosine-latitude area correction, Probability Difference (PD), and Area Skill Score (S).
Non-parametric nested permutation testing using both cell-wise shuffling and 2D toroidal spatial translation nulls.
采用基于ABIC平滑参数选择的惩罚二维B样条反演（HIST-PPM）估计连续空间b值场。

使用经纬度余弦面积校正的Molchan误差图（MED）、概率差（PD）和面积技巧评分（S）评估预测性能。

Two-stage temporal partitioning: training window (2006–2014, 86 events with Mw ≥ 5.0) and retrospective testing window (2015–2024, 55 events with Mw ≥ 5.0 and 15 with Mw ≥ 5.5).

sum: Accurate high-pressure ultrasonic velocity measurements of minerals typically require synchrotron facilities for in-situ sample length imaging and X-ray diffraction pressure calibration. This paper demonstrates a fully lab-based alternative up to ~6 GPa using a Paris-Edinburgh press with modified Drickamer-style toroidal anvils. Sample lengths are measured in-situ via a custom divergent-beam microfocus X-ray imaging system with a GAGG(Ce) scintillator, 4X magnification optics, and a scientific camera, yielding radiographic quality and resolution comparable to synchrotron images in 10-second exposures. Testing on a natural novaculite (polycrystalline quartz) sample with 16–60 MHz pulse-echo ultrasonics yielded P- and S-wave velocities accurate to ±0.3% on average. Instead of X-ray diffraction, sample pressures up to 5.8 GPa (±0.3 GPa) were determined from quartz elasticity data, and the alumina buffer rod's P-wave travel time was calibrated as a practical pressure marker (±0.14 GPa) for future experiments.
高压下矿物精确超声速测量通常依赖同步辐射进行原位样品长度成像和X射线衍射压力标定。本文提出了一种最高可达~6 GPa的全实验室替代方案，结合改进型凹面压砧Paris-Edinburgh压机、微焦点发散X射线源、闪烁体和CMOS相机，在10秒曝光内即可获得媲美同步辐射的高分辨率X射线图像。通过对天然均……

t: A custom lab-based microfocus X-ray imaging system (scintillator, 4X optics, CMOS/CCD camera) measures in-situ sample lengths inside a Paris-Edinburgh press, combined with 16–60 MHz dual-mode LiNbO3 pulse-echo ultrasonic interferometry to determine P- and S-wave velocities.
结合实验室微焦点X射线成像系统测量原位样品长度与16-60 MHz脉冲回波超声干涉法测定P、S波速。

Ultrasonic waveforms (16–60 MHz at 2 MHz intervals) and 10-second X-ray radiographs (90 kV, 89 μA) collected at 10 bar oil pressure increments up to 610 bar on a 1.5 mm diameter natural novaculite sample.
对1.5 mm天然石英岩在最高610 bar油压下以10 bar步长采集16-60 MHz超声波形与10秒曝光X射线图像…

Novaculite vP changed from 6.03(2) to 6.66(1) km/s and vS from 3.92(1) to 3.80(1) km/s between 100 and 610 bar (up to 5.8 GPa), achieving mean accuracies of 0.31% (vP), 0.32% (vS), and ±0.14 GPa for buffer-rod pressure calibration.

Polycrystalline quartz is trigonal with six elastic constants, large anisotropy, wide Voigt-Reuss bounds, and limited high-PT stability beyond ~2 GPa, making it a non-ideal pressure calibrant.

Replaces synchrotron beamlines with a custom lab-based divergent microfocus X-ray imaging system and ultrasonic buffer-rod pressure calibration for accurate high-pressure velocity measurements up to ~6 GPa.

kc: Developed a lab-based divergent-beam microfocus X-ray imaging system achieving 10-second radiographs comparable to synchrotron beamlines for high-pressure sample length measurements.
Designed a modified Drickamer-style toroidal anvil and Paris-Edinburgh press assembly that maintains anvil gaps >1.3 mm up to ~6 GPa.
Demonstrated in-situ P- and S-wave velocity measurements of natural novaculite up to 5.8 GPa with mean accuracies of ~0.31% and ~0.32%.
Calibrated the normalized P-wave travel time of the alumina buffer rod as an in-situ pressure marker accurate to ±0.14 GPa, removing the need for X-ray diffraction.
开发了基于实验室发散束微焦点X射线成像系统，10秒曝光即可获得媲美同步辐射束线的图像以测量高压样品长度。
设计了改进的Drickamer型凹面压砧与Paris-Edinburgh压机组装件，在~6 GPa下仍能保持>1.3 mm的压砧间隙。
实现了高达5.8 GPa的天然石英岩原位P波和S波速度测量，平均精度分别达0.31%和0.32%。
将氧化铝缓冲棒的归一化P波走时标定为精度±0.14 GPa的原位压力计，免除了对X射线衍射的需求。
me: In-situ divergent-beam X-ray radiography using a W-filament microfocus source (90 kV, 89 μA), GAGG(Ce) scintillator, 4X optical lens, and CMOS/CCD camera.
Sample length extraction via Gaussian absorption fitting of 2 μm Au marker foils using the SonicPy GUI TravelDistance module.
Dual-mode (10° rotated Y-cut LiNbO3 transducer) pulse-echo overlap ultrasonic interferometry across 16–60 MHz.
Third-order finite-strain and Birch-Murnaghan equation of state modeling of quartz elasticity to calibrate cell pressure and alumina buffer rod travel times.
利用钨丝微焦点源（90 kV, 89 μA）、GAGG(Ce)闪烁体、4倍光学镜头和CMOS/CCD相机进行原位发散束X射线成像。
使用SonicPy GUI的TravelDistance模块对2 μm金箔标记进行高斯吸收拟合以提取样品长度。
在16–60 MHz频段内使用双模（10°旋转Y切LiNbO3换能器）脉冲回波重叠超声干涉法测量走时。
基于三阶有限应变和Birch-Murnaghan状态方程的石英弹性建模，标定腔体压力和氧化铝缓冲棒走时。
de: High-pressure compression experiment on a 1.5 mm diameter, 715 μm long cylinder of natural novaculite (98.8–99.4 vol.% quartz) in a V3B Paris-Edinburgh press up to 610 bar oil pressure (~5.8 GPa).
X-ray powder diffraction characterization of starting novaculite using a UCL Panalytical diffractometer and ESRF ID06-LVP synchrotron beamline.
Comparison of lab X-ray radiographs against synchrotron radiographs from beamline 16-BM-B (HPCAT, APS).
在V3B Paris-Edinburgh压机中对直径1.5 mm、长715 μm的天然石英岩圆柱样品（含98.8–99.4 vol.%石英）进行高达610 bar油压（~5.8 GPa）的高压压缩实验。
使用UCL实验室衍射仪和ESRF ID06-LVP同步辐射束线对初始石英岩样品进行X射线粉末衍射表征。
将实验室X射线图像与APS 16-BM-B（HPCAT）同步辐射束线的图像进行对比。
li: Polycrystalline quartz is trigonal with six independent elastic constants, large anisotropy, and wide Voigt-Reuss bounds, making it a non-ideal pressure calibrant.
Quartz phase stability limits its use as a high pressure-temperature calibrant beyond ~2 GPa at high temperatures.
Current demonstration is restricted to ambient temperature conditions up to ~6 GPa.
多晶石英属三方晶系，具有6个独立弹性常数、强各向异性和较宽的Voigt-Reuss边界，并非理想的压力标定物。
石英的相稳定性限制了其在高温下超过~2 GPa时作为高温高压标定物的应用。
目前的实验验证仅限于常温条件及~6 GPa以下的压力范围。

tm.why: The paper presents the design and validation of a novel custom-built laboratory X-ray imaging and ultrasonic interferometry instrumentation setup.
The experimental apparatus is designed to measure mineral and melt elastic properties at high pressures to aid interpretations of mantle and planetary interiors.

ev.notes: Full 18-page preprint PDF (including main text, 7 main figures, 5 supplementary figures, and 1 supplementary table) was analyzed directly.

sum: This study determines the stress-drop and moment magnitude ($M_w$) for earthquakes in mainland France. By analyzing regional seismic waveforms, the authors characterize the source parameters of French seismicity, providing crucial constraints for seismic hazard assessment and ground motion prediction equations (GMPEs) in a stable continental region.
本研究测定了法国本土地震的应力降和矩震级（$M_w$）。通过分析区域地震波形，作者表征了法国地震的震源参数，为稳定大陆地区的地震危险性评估和地面运动预测方程（GMPEs）提供了关键约束。

t: Spectral analysis of regional seismic waveforms to invert for seismic moment, corner frequency, and stress drop.
对区域地震波形进行谱分析，反演地震矩、拐角频率和应力降。
Seismic waveform recordings of earthquakes in mainland France.
法国本土地震的地震波形记录。
A comprehensive catalog of stress-drop and moment magnitude ($M_w$) values for mainland France.
法国本土应力降和矩震级（$M_w$）的完整目录。
Potential trade-offs between path attenuation and source parameters.
路径衰减与震源参数之间潜在的折衷关系。
First systematic regional characterization of stress-drop and $M_w$ scaling for mainland France.
首次对法国本土应力降和$M_w$标度关系进行系统的区域表征。

kc: Provides a consistent dataset of stress-drop and moment magnitude ($M_w$) for mainland France.
Enhances the understanding of earthquake source scaling relations in low-to-moderate seismicity regions.
提供了法国本土地震应力降和矩震级（$M_w$）的一致数据集。
增强了对中低活动性地区地震震源标度关系的理解。
me: Spectral analysis of regional earthquake waveforms to estimate corner frequency and seismic moment.
对区域地震波形进行谱分析以估算拐角频率和地震矩。
de: Seismic waveform data from regional networks in mainland France.
来自法国本土区域地震台网的地震波形数据。
li: Trade-offs between attenuation (Q) and corner frequency estimation, especially for small magnitude events.
衰减（Q）与拐角频率估算之间存在折衷，特别是对于小震级事件。

tm.why: The paper focuses on estimating stress-drop and moment magnitude, which are fundamental earthquake source parameters.
Stress-drop is a key parameter for ground-motion prediction and seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, and metadata.

sum: Normalized Energy Density (NED) is a wave quantity conserved across material interfaces in layered elastic media, useful for estimating near-surface damping and site amplification without detailed layering knowledge. Previously, its conservation in the 2D SH problem was proved analytically only for two layers and tested via Monte Carlo for more. This paper supplies the missing analytical proof for a general n-layer medium. By lifting layer phases to independent coordinates on the n-torus rather than treating angular frequency as a single variable, irrational travel-time ratios enable the application of Weyl's equidistribution theorem, reducing the frequency average to a factorizable torus integral (layer peeling) for Q-independent travel times. For equal and commensurable travel times (Goupillaud media), conservation is proved separately using orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle (Bernstein-Szegő normalization) and reflectionless layer subdivision. Numerical quadrature verifies the exact theoretical identities.
归一化能量密度（NED）是层状弹性介质中跨界面守恒的物理量，可用于直接估计近地表阻尼和场地放大效应。此前仅在两层介质中给出了2D SH问题中NED守恒的解析证明。本文给出了一般n层介质的严格数学证明。核心创新是将各层相位提升为n维环面上的独立坐标，利用Weyl均分布定理将频率平均转化为可逐层剥离积分……

t: Lifts layer phases to independent coordinates on an n-torus to apply Weyl's equidistribution theorem and iterative layer-peeling integration for Q-independent travel times, alongside Bernstein-Szegő orthogonal polynomial normalization and reflectionless subdivision for commensurable travel times.
将层相位提升为n维环面坐标并应用Weyl均分布定理逐层剥离积分，结合单位圆正交多项式和无反射层细分证明可公度情况。
Evaluates 20 random synthetic 2D SH layered models per setting (n = 2, 3, 5, 10) with S-wave velocities uniformly drawn from [10, 700] m/s and densities from [1000, 2000] kg/m^3.
采用S波速度在[10, 700] m/s、密度在[1000, 2000] kg/m³均匀抽样的20组随机合成多层模型进行…

Proves Z_k <P_k> = Z_0 across all layers; numerical verification confirms residuals at double-precision rounding (~10^-15) for equal and commensurable travel times, and truncation-limited residuals (10^-4 to 10^-3) for Q-independent travel times.
严格证明了各层NED等于基底阻抗Z0；周期性走时数值残差达双精度极限（~10^-15），无理走时残差受截断控制（10^-…
Leaves the measure-zero intermediate canonical case (1 < d < n') without an analytical proof because repeated phase variables violate the independence required for iterative layer peeling.
当独立相位维数满足1 < d < n'时，共享相位导致逐层剥离失效，该零测度中间情况仍缺乏解析证明。
Provides the first general analytical proof of multi-layer NED conservation for n >= 3 layers, resolving an open problem that previously relied on Monte Carlo simulations.
首次给出了任意n层（n≥3）2D SH介质中归一化能量密度守恒的解析证明，解决了此前仅靠蒙特卡洛模拟验证的遗留问题。

kc: Proves conservation of Normalized Energy Density (NED) for n-layer 2D SH media when layer travel times are linearly independent over Q via torus lifting and Weyl's equidistribution theorem.

Proves NED conservation for equal-travel-time (Goupillaud) and commensurable-travel-time layered media using orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle (Bernstein-Szegő normalization) and reflectionless interface subdivision.
Establishes a canonical form via reflectionless subdivision for arbitrary travel times spanning a Q-vector space of dimension d, isolating the remaining measure-zero open case (1 < d < n).
Extends the exact conservation proofs to pre-critical oblique SH wave incidence and verifies the identities numerically.
通过环面提升和Weyl均分布定理，证明了层走时在有理数域线性无关时n层2D SH介质中归一化能量密度（NED）的守恒性。
利用单位圆正交多项式（Bernstein-Szegő归一化）和无反射界面细分，证明了等走时（Goupillaud介质）和可公度走时下的NED守恒。
通过无反射细分建立了任意走时（有理张成空间维数为d）的标准型，精确分离出测度为零的未解中间情况（1 < d < n）。
将守恒证明推广至亚临界斜入射SH波，并通过数值求积验证了各项理论恒等式。
me: Propagator matrix recursion and quadratic-form algebraic representation of layer transfer functions.
Phase lifting to the n-torus combined with Weyl's equidistribution theorem and iterative Fubini integration (layer peeling).
Szegő recursion and Bernstein-Szegő normalization for orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle (OPUC).
Reflectionless layer subdivision and positive integral basis construction in rational cones.
传播矩阵递推与层传递函数的二次型代数表征。
相位向n维环面的提升，结合Weyl均分布定理与逐层剥离（Fubini迭代积分）。
单位圆正交多项式（OPUC）的Szegő递推与Bernstein-Szegő归一化。
无反射层细分与有理锥中的正整系数基构造。
de: Numerical quadrature tests on 20 random synthetic velocity-density models (n = 2, 3, 5, 10) comparing Q-independent, equal, commensurable, and intermediate (d = 2) travel-time settings.
Tensor-product trapezoidal integration on a 3-torus for a 6-layer model verifying sublayer coset averaging.
对20组随机合成速度-密度模型（n = 2, 3, 5, 10）进行数值求积测试，对比有理无关、相等、可公度及中间维数（d = 2）走时设置下的残差。
在6层模型的三维子环面上进行张量积梯形积分，验证固定浅层相位时的深层平均守恒性。
li: An analytical proof for the canonical intermediate case 1 < d < n' (where d independent phase variables are shared by more than d sublayers) remains an open mathematical problem.
Conservation holds strictly for purely elastic media; in the presence of attenuation, impedance ratios become complex and layer peeling fails as NED physically decreases.
Oblique incidence extension requires pre-critical angles where basement velocity exceeds layer velocity times the sine of the incidence angle.
标准型中间情况 1 < d < n'（即d个独立相位变量被多于d个子层共享）的解析证明仍是一个未解的数学问题。
守恒性仅严格成立于纯弹性介质；存在衰减时阻抗比变为复数，NED物理上发生衰减，逐层剥离法不再适用。
斜入射推广要求入射角处于亚临界范围（即基底速度大于各层速度与入射角正弦的乘积）。

tm.why: Normalized Energy Density (NED) conservation in elastic layered media provides the baseline for directly estimating near-surface damping and attenuation.
The conserved quantity (NED) is defined via the surface transfer function and impedance, directly bearing on site amplification models and near-surface geotechnical engineering.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 12-page arXiv manuscript PDF (arXiv:2609.05924v1).

sum: Measuring slow tectonic deformation in the seismically active Balkan Peninsula has been hindered by sparse GNSS networks. This study processes Sentinel-1 radar images (2014–2021) via the FLATSIM service across 360,000 km2 at 240 m resolution. By adapting a quasi-absolute referencing method that reinjects Solid Earth Tide-corrected phase ramp rates and requires minimal GNSS adjustment in azimuth, the authors produce the first regional ITRF14-referenced InSAR velocity mosaic, achieving <1 mm/yr agreement with GNSS. Decomposing line-of-sight velocities into 3D horizontal and vertical fields reveals large-scale tectonic and localized signals: a 250-km-wide diffuse lithospheric shear zone in central Greece (>2 cm/yr dextral motion), 5 mm/yr extension over 80 km in the inner Albanides, southward-increasing compression and uplift in the Dinarides, and localized fault gradients and basin subsidence. This confirms InSAR's capability to resolve long-wavelength plate motions in slowly straining regions.
本研究利用FLATSIM服务处理了2014–2021年间覆盖巴尔干半岛36万平方公里的Sentinel-1 InSAR数据（分辨率240米）。通过重新注入经固体潮校正的相位斜坡率并结合少量GNSS方位向约束，构建了首个ITRF14参考框架下的区域InSAR速度场（与GNSS残差<1 mm/yr），进……

t: Parametric decomposition of FLATSIM InSAR time series removes coseismic and seasonal signals, then reinjects Solid Earth Tide-corrected phase ramp rates and applies azimuthal GNSS adjustments before decomposing ascending/descending LOS into 3D velocities.
参数化分解InSAR时序去除同震和季节信号，重注入固体潮校正的相位斜坡率并联合GNSS校准方位向，最后分解为三维速度。

Eight ascending and six descending Sentinel-1 tracks (2014–2021, >800 interferograms/track) processed by FLATSIM over 360,000 km2 at 240 m resolution, combined with 1,867 filtered horizontal GNSS velocities from Piña-Valdés et al. (2022).
FLATSIM处理的14条轨道Sentinel-1影像（2014–2021，分辨率240米）及1867个GNSS水平速度…

Referenced InSAR LOS velocities match GNSS with a wRMSE of 0.94 mm/yr, revealing 22 mm/yr E-W shear and 28 mm/yr N-S extension across central Greece, 5 mm/yr extension in the Albanides, and up to 5 mm/yr shortening in the southern Dinarides.
LOS速度与GNSS吻合（wRMSE 0.94 mm/yr），揭示希腊中部22 mm/yr剪切、阿尔巴尼亚5 mm/yr…

Fading signals in agricultural basins, phase unwrapping errors across steep ranges (15% pixels masked), and fixed GNSS azimuthal directions in 3D decomposition limit accuracy in low-coherence or orthogonally straining areas.
农田衰落信号、山区解缠错误（15%像素掩膜）以及固定GNSS方位角假设限制了局部复杂变形精度。

First regional-scale, 240-m-resolution InSAR velocity mosaic and 3D velocity decomposition across the slowly straining Balkan Peninsula, referenced to ITRF14 using reinjected phase ramp rates with minimal GNSS dependence.
首次利用相位斜坡率恢复技术在慢应变巴尔干半岛实现ITRF14框架下240米高分辨率区域三维InSAR速度场构建。

kc: Produces the first regional-scale, 240-m-resolution InSAR mean velocity mosaic over the Balkan Peninsula (360,000 km2) referenced to ITRF14 with sub-millimetric GNSS agreement (wRMSE 0.94 mm/yr).
Decomposes ascending and descending LOS velocities into 3D horizontal and vertical velocity fields using GNSS-constrained azimuthal directions.
Maps a 250-km-wide smooth transtensional shear zone in central Greece (~22 mm/yr E-W shear, ~28 mm/yr N-S extension) and an 80-km-wide extensional zone (5 mm/yr) in the inner Albanides.
Identifies spatially variable N35° shortening (up to 5 mm/yr) and uplift (1–1.5 mm/yr) in the southern Dinarides that vanish north of 44°N, plus localized fault creep/locking and basin subsidence.
构建了巴尔干半岛首个区域尺度、240米分辨率的ITRF14参考框架InSAR平均速度场拼接图（覆盖36万平方公里，与GNSS加权均方根误差为0.94 mm/yr）。
利用GNSS约束的水平运动方位角，将升降轨视线向（LOS）速度分解为区域三维水平和垂直速度场。
精细刻画了希腊中部250公里宽的平滑张扭性岩石圈剪切带（约22 mm/yr东西向剪切和28 mm/yr南北向伸展）及内阿尔巴尼亚80公里宽的伸展带（5 mm/yr）。
揭示了迪纳拉山脉南部N35°方向的差异性缩短（达5 mm/yr）和隆升（1–1.5 mm/yr）并在44°N以北消失，同时捕捉到局部断层变形和农业盆地沉降。
me: Parametric least-squares decomposition of FLATSIM NSBAS displacement time series into linear velocity, seasonal sinusoidal terms, and Heaviside coseismic offsets for Mw5.3+ earthquakes.
Reinjection of Solid Earth Tide (SET)-corrected linear phase ramp rates in range and azimuth to restore long-wavelength plate tectonic motion in the satellite orbit frame (ITRF14).
Quality masking using five FLATSIM auxiliary indicators (90th percentile threshold) followed by track-wide azimuthal ramp and constant offset adjustment against projected 2D GNSS velocities.

Geometric decomposition of 24 overlapping ascending-descending track pairs into horizontal and vertical velocity components by fixing horizontal azimuths to a Bayesian-interpolated GNSS velocity field.
对FLATSIM NSBAS位移时间序列进行参数化最小二乘分解，提取线性速度、周年正弦季节项以及Mw5.3+地震的Heaviside同震阶跃。
对距离向和方位向相位斜坡时间序列进行固体潮（SET）校正并拟合线性斜坡率，将其重新注入速度图以恢复ITRF14轨道框架下的长波长板块运动信号。
基于5项FLATSIM质量指标（90%分位数阈值）掩膜低质量像素，并利用投影至LOS的二维GNSS速度对每条轨道进行方位向倾斜和常数偏移校准。
固定水平速度方位角为贝叶斯插值的GNSS速度场方向，对24组重叠升降轨数据进行几何分解以获取水平和垂直速度场。
de: Sentinel-1 A/B Interferometric Wide Swath radar images from July 2014 to February 2021 across 8 ascending and 6 descending tracks (~280 dates and >800 interferograms per track) processed by FLATSIM at 240 m resolution.

Filtered 2D horizontal GNSS velocity field of 1,867 stations (1996–2020) from Piña-Valdés et al. (2022), plus comparative tests against five other regional GNSS compilations including Castro-Perdomo et al. (2025).
Kinematic profile analyses across Central Greece Shear Zone, Inner Albanides, Dinarides, Gulf of Corinth, and Katouna-Stamna Fault.
2014年7月至2021年2月期间8条升轨和6条降轨的Sentinel-1 A/B干涉宽幅雷达影像（每轨约280个时期、>800幅干涉图），由FLATSIM处理生成240米分辨率产品。
Piña-Valdés等（2022）包含1867个站点的二维水平GNSS速度场（1996–2020），并与Castro-Perdomo等（2025）等其余5个独立GNSS数据集进行了对比验证。
横跨希腊中部剪切带、内阿尔巴尼亚褶皱带、迪纳拉山脉、科林斯湾和Katouna-Stamna断层的多条关键运动学剖面分析。
li: Parametric time-series fitting neglects semi-annual seasonal components and transient postseismic or anthropogenic accelerations.
Unwrapping errors, vegetation decorrelation, and agricultural fading signals degrade quality in the northern Pannonian Basin, eastern Dinarides, and western Peloponnese (15% of pixels masked).
Fixing the horizontal azimuth to interpolated GNSS directions during 3D decomposition can introduce vertical and horizontal biases where local deformation is orthogonal to the regional GNSS trend.
参数化时间序列拟合忽略了半年周期季节性分量以及震后或人为活动引起的瞬态加减速变形。
相位解缠困难、植被失相干及农田衰落信号导致潘诺尼亚盆地北部、迪纳拉山脉东翼和伯罗奔尼撒西部数据质量下降（15%像素被掩膜）。
三维分解时固定水平方位角为区域GNSS插值方向，在局部变形与区域GNSS方向正交处会引入虚假垂直运动和水平幅值偏差。

tm.why: The paper derives a 3D surface velocity field over the Balkan Peninsula using InSAR and GNSS to constrain regional plate kinematics, lithospheric shear zones, and geodynamic models.
The study quantifies interseismic velocity gradients, locking, and potential aseismic creep across active structures like the Gulf of Corinth, Katouna-Stamna Fault, and Dinaric thrusts.

ev.notes: Full 36-page research article PDF including all main text sections (§1–§7) and 15 figures was analyzed directly.

sum: This study performs ultrasonic interferometry experiments to measure the compressional ($V_P$) and shear ($V_S$) wave velocities of phase E, a dense hydrous magnesium silicate (DHMS) stable near the 410-km discontinuity. Measurements were conducted on samples with ~10 wt% $H_2O$ (high-pressure, room-temperature) and ~7 wt% $H_2O$ (high-pressure, high-temperature). The results reveal that seismic velocities of phase E decrease with increasing water content, while water significantly reduces its ambient-pressure elastic moduli and increases the pressure derivative of the bulk modulus. Velocity modeling demonstrates that water content variations in phase E can produce distinct seismic velocity anomalies atop the 410-km discontinuity, suggesting phase E acts as a key modulator for water distribution and overlying low-velocity layers in the mantle transition zone.
本研究利用超声干涉实验测量了410千米不连续面附近稳定的致密含水镁硅酸盐（E相）的纵波（Vp）和横波（Vs）速度。实验针对含水量约10 wt%（高压室温）和约7 wt%（高压高温）的样品进行。结果表明，E相的地震波速随含水量增加而降低，且水分显著降低了其常压弹性模量，并提高了体积模量的压力导数。建模……

t: Ultrasonic interferometry to measure Vp and Vs of phase E under high pressure and temperature.
超声干涉测量技术，用于在高压高温条件下测量E相的纵波和横波速度。
Experimental velocity measurements of phase E with ~7 wt% and ~10 wt% water content.
包含约7 wt%和10 wt%含水量的E相样品的实验波速测量数据。
Seismic velocity of phase E decreases with water content, explaining low-velocity layers atop 410 km.
E相的地震波速随含水量增加而降低，解释了410千米之上的低速层。
Extrapolation of laboratory measurements to complex, multi-mineral real-Earth mantle conditions.
将实验室测量结果外推至复杂的、多矿物组合的真实地幔条件存在不确定性。
First systematic velocity measurements of phase E with varying water contents under high P-T conditions.
首次在高压高温条件下系统测量了不同含水量的E相的波速。

kc: Measured VP and VS of phase E with different water contents (~7 wt% and ~10 wt%) under high-pressure and high-temperature conditions.
Demonstrated that seismic velocities of phase E decrease with increasing water content.
Showed that water reduces the elastic moduli of phase E at ambient pressure but increases the pressure derivative of the bulk modulus.
Modeled how variations in phase E water content can explain seismic low-velocity layers observed atop the 410-km discontinuity.

sum: This study introduces a rapid earthquake characterization method by adapting TinyLlama, a 1.1B-parameter Large Language Model (LLM), using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) updating only ~0.1% of weights. The model takes numerical sequences rendered as integer tokens—station coordinates, relative P-wave arrival times within 5 s of the first detection, and peak ground velocity (PGV) in a 0.2 s P-wave window—and simultaneously outputs latitude, longitude, depth, magnitude, and origin time without a seismic velocity model or S-waves. Trained and evaluated on 30,879 Italian earthquakes from the INSTANCE dataset, the LLM achieves mean errors of 4.1 km for epicenter, 6.9 km for hypocenter, 4.4 km MAE for depth, 0.6 s MAE for origin time, and 0.2 MAE for magnitude in <1 s on GPU. When tested on operational INGV automatic picks, it outperforms standard Earthworm location routines while using fewer stations.

sum: This study investigates the severe 2021–2022 drought in the Eastern European Alps by analyzing crustal deformation. Using GNSS and InSAR data, the authors measure the elastic rebound of the Earth's crust caused by hydrological unloading. By inverting these geodetic observations, they estimate the spatial and temporal patterns of water loss across the region. The integration of GNSS (providing high temporal resolution) and InSAR (providing high spatial resolution) allows for a detailed characterization of the drought's impact on regional water storage, demonstrating the power of joint geodetic imaging for environmental and hydrological monitoring.

sum: This study introduces pinnTHT, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for teleseismic Rayleigh wave Helmholtz tomography, and applies it to northeastern Tibet. By embedding the Helmholtz equation into the loss function, pinnTHT jointly constrains phase velocity, amplitude, and traveltime fields as continuous, grid-free functions. Spatial derivatives are computed via automatic differentiation, eliminating finite-difference grid errors. Applied to teleseismic Rayleigh waves (20–80 s) from a dense array, pinnTHT successfully maps crustal and upper mantle heterogeneities. Synthetic tests demonstrate that pinnTHT outperforms conventional Helmholtz tomography, achieving high-resolution reconstruction using only 20% of the observational data. The results correlate well with major tectonic features and ambient noise tomography, proving pinnTHT is a highly data-efficient, robust tool for imaging deep Earth structures in data-sparse regions.

sum: This preprint presents a rapid, first-hours source and static stress transfer analysis for the 24 September 2026 Mw 5.3–5.4 Şanlıurfa earthquake in southeastern Türkiye. Using open FDSN waveforms within a 200 km radius, five weighted vertical-component P-wave first-motion polarities were retained to perform a double-couple grid search. This yields a provisional oblique mechanism (NP1: 118°/66°/−50°; NP2: 233.9°/45.6°/−145.3°), which remains highly non-unique (207.7° azimuth gap; 1,588 near-best solutions). Using an Okada elastic half-space and a magnitude-scaled 6.36 × 3.18 km rectangular dislocation, the author computes Coulomb failure stress (ΔCFS) for both nodal planes. A novel conservative nodal-plane-consensus metric—retaining cells outside a 5 km inner core where both scenarios exceed +0.01 MPa—identifies two ~34 km² sectors 5–10 km east and west of the USGS epicenter (up to +0.05 MPa) as prime monitoring targets, whereas nearby cities experience negligible static stress changes.
