Rapid agency hypocentral catalogs from USGS (M 5.3, 10 km depth) and AFAD (Mw 5.4, 7 km depth, displaced ~5.9 km), plus an early AFAD ML 2.4 aftershock.
Same-day USGS Did You Feel It? (DYFI) citizen-science macroseismic reports (8 responses, community intensity V).
200 km半径内的开源FDSN数据集：32个MiniSEED文件、199条SAC波形和25个StationXML元数据文件，筛选出5个保留的HHZ宽频带初动极性。
来自USGS（M 5.3，深度10 km）和AFAD（Mw 5.4，深度7 km，震中相差约5.9 km）的快速机构目录，以及一次早期AFAD ML 2.4余震数据。
地震当天的USGS“Did You Feel It?”（DYFI）公众宏观震害报告（8份反馈，社区烈度V度）。
li: The focal mechanism is derived from only 5 P-wave polarities (including 2 lower-weight fallback picks) with a 207.7° maximum azimuth gap, resulting in 1,588 near-best solutions.
USGS and AFAD rapid epicenters differ by ~5.9 km and depths by ~3 km, an uncertainty comparable to the radial distance of the near-source Coulomb stress lobes.
Source dimensions and uniform slip are scaled from Mw 5.3 and an assumed 3 MPa stress drop rather than constrained by finite-fault or geodetic inversions.
Okada modeling uses a homogeneous half-space and resolves stress only on self-oriented source nodal planes rather than realistic 3-D mapped receiver faults.
震源机制仅由5个P波极性（含2个低权重备选拾取）导出，最大方位角空区达207.7°，导致存在1,588个近似最优解。
USGS和AFAD快速震中位置相差约5.9 km，深度相差约3 km，该不确定性与近源库仑应力瓣的径向距离相当。
震源尺寸和均匀滑动量系根据Mw 5.3和假设的3 MPa应力降标度所得，而非由有限断层或大地测量反演约束。
Okada建模采用均匀半空间假设，且仅在自定向的震源节面上分解应力，未考虑实际测绘的三维接收断层几何。

tm.why: The paper derives a provisional P-wave first-motion focal mechanism and scales a finite rectangular dislocation source for the 2026 Şanlıurfa earthquake.
The study calculates 2-D and 3-D static Coulomb failure stress transfer (ΔCFS) on alternative nodal planes to evaluate fault interaction and identify monitoring priorities.

ev.notes: Full 23-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF examined, including all text sections, 5 main tables, 11 main figures, 5 supplementary figures, and 1 supplementary table.

sum: This paper presents a unified theoretical hypothesis of plate dynamics based on the effects of dispersed melt microdomains in the asthenosphere on horizontal stress transmission. The author proposes two testable predictions: the mean slope of the basal lithospheric boundary is proportional to plate velocity, and the equivalent basal friction coefficient is approximately 0.67%. By establishing a constitutive relation linking microscopic melt fraction and microdomain density to macroscopic horizontal compressive stress, the model explains key observations including the Lehmann discontinuity, subduction dips, and deep-focus earthquakes. A global energy budget analysis shows that shallow trench frictional heating (2.5–3.9 TW) accounts for a significant portion of plate motion power, with results consistent with observed arc-volcanic thermal outputs.
本文提出软流圈弥散熔体微区影响应力传递的板块动力学假说。预测洋盆岩石圈底部平均坡度与板块速度成正比，等效基底摩擦系数为0.67%。通过建立微观熔体与宏观压应力的本构关系，解释了Lehmann面和俯冲倾角。全球能量预算表明浅部海沟摩擦生热占板块运动总功率的25%-39%，与弧火山热释放量吻合。

t: Analytical geodynamical modeling establishing a constitutive relation between microscopic melt microdomains and macroscopic horizontal stress transmission.
基于软流圈微观弥散熔体微区与宏观水平压应力关系的解析地球动力学建模。
Global geodynamical parameters, plate velocities, and arc-volcanic thermal power observations.
全球地球动力学参数、板块运动速度以及弧火山热功率观测数据。
Derivation of a 0.67% basal friction coefficient and estimation of trench frictional heating at 2.5–3.9 TW.
推导出0.67%的等效基底摩擦系数，并估算浅部海沟摩擦生热为2.5-3.9 TW。
Relies on simplified statistical assumptions of melt distribution and assumes a high subduction friction coefficient (0.4).
依赖于熔体微区分布的简化统计假设，且采用较高的俯冲带摩擦系数。
A unified hypothesis linking microscopic melt physics directly to macroscopic plate dynamics and energy budgets without adjustable parameters.
无自由参数地将微观熔体物理与宏观板块动力学及能量预算相统一。

kc: Proposes a unified constitutive relation for horizontal stress transmission in the asthenosphere based on dispersed melt microdomains.
Derives a parameter-free equivalent friction coefficient of ~0.67% for the ocean-basin basal boundary.
Provides a physical explanation for the Lehmann discontinuity, ~45-degree subduction dip, and deep-focus earthquake distributions.
Constrains the global energy budget of plate tectonics, showing trench frictional heating accounts for 25%-39% of total mechanical power.
提出了基于弥散熔体微区的软流圈水平应力传递统一本构关系。
推导出了洋盆基底边界无参数的等效摩擦系数（约0.67%）。
为Lehmann不连续面、约45度俯冲倾角及深源地震分布提供了物理学解释。
约束了板块构造的全球能量预算，表明海沟摩擦生热占总机械功率的25%-39%。
me: Theoretical geodynamical modeling and statistical superposition of microscopic melt microdomain stresses.
Analytical derivation of basal boundary slopes and equivalent friction coefficients.
Global energy budget inversion and thermodynamic calculations of subduction zone frictional heating.
基于微观熔体微区应力统计叠加的理论地球动力学建模。
基底边界坡度与等效摩擦系数的解析推导。
全球能量预算反演及俯冲带摩擦生热的热力学计算。
de: Global geodynamical observations of plate velocities, lithospheric boundary geometries, and subduction zone parameters.
Global arc-volcanic thermal power data (1.5–4 TW) used for validation.
板块运动速度、岩石圈边界几何形状及俯冲带参数的全球地球动力学观测数据。
用于验证的全球弧火山热功率数据（1.5-4 TW）。
li: The model relies on simplified geometric and statistical assumptions for melt microdomain distributions.
The effective friction coefficient of the subduction interface (0.4) contrasts with much lower values commonly used in some conventional models.
该模型依赖于熔体微区分布的简化几何与统计假设。
俯冲界面有效摩擦系数（0.4）与传统模型中常用的极低值存在冲突。

tm.why: The paper proposes a unified hypothesis for plate dynamics, asthenospheric stress transmission, and subduction zone energetics.

ev.notes: Analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the complex source process of the 2 May 2025 Mw 7.5 Drake Passage earthquake near the Antarctic–Scotia plate boundary. Because preliminary centroid moment tensor solutions showed steep dips atypical of shallow interplate thrusting, the authors applied Potency Density Tensor Inversion (PDTI) with five basis double-couple components to teleseismic P-waveforms from 40 stations. Testing 20 model setups across four 1-D velocity models and five dip-depth pairs, they identified three rupture episodes within the first 36 seconds. The rupture initiated near the hypocenter as a low-angle oblique-thrust event consistent with interplate slip along the plate convergence direction. Following brief rupture-front stagnation at 4–7 s, it transitioned continuously into a steeper reverse-faulting phase (30°–40° dip) with rotated slip vectors, indicating propagation onto an intraplate fault. This provides the first detailed source-process evidence of interplate faulting in this subduction-to-fracture-zone transition region.
本研究利用包含五个双力偶基底分量的势密度张量反演（PDTI）方法，结合40个台站的远震P波数据，研究了2025年5月2日德雷克海峡Mw 7.5地震的破裂过程。通过4种一维速度模型和5组倾角-深度组合的20组模型测试，确认了前36秒内的三个破裂阶段。破裂始于震源附近的低角度斜逆冲事件，走向与滑动矢量符……

t: Applied Potency Density Tensor Inversion (PDTI) with five basis double-couple components, Green's function error covariance, and time-adaptive ABIC smoothing to estimate spatiotemporal fault geometry and slip evolution without prescribing fault planes.
应用包含五个双力偶分量的势密度张量反演（PDTI），结合格林函数误差协方差与时间自适应平滑估计断层几何与滑动。

Used vertical-component teleseismic P-waveforms from 40 broadband stations (30°–90° epicentral distance) resampled at 0.8 s, tested across 20 setups combining four 1-D velocity models and five dip-depth pairs.
使用震中距30°–90°的40个台站远震P波数据，测试4种一维速度模型与5组倾角-深度组合共20组模型。

Total seismic moment was 3.0–3.8 × 10^20 N m (Mw 7.6–7.7) across 90 km southeastward propagation, transitioning after a 4–7 s stall from low-angle interplate oblique thrust to steeper (30°–40° dip) intraplate reverse faulting.
总地震矩为3.0–3.8×10^20 N m（Mw 7.6–7.7），破裂在4–7秒停滞后从低角度板间斜逆冲过渡到30°…
The inversion only uses teleseismic P-waves, cannot robustly resolve rupture features after OT + 36 s, and imposes smoothing that may mask abrupt jump-like fault transitions.
仅使用远震P波，36秒后破裂特征不够稳健，且反演平滑约束可能掩盖断层几何的跳跃式突变。
First detailed source-process analysis revealing interplate rupture and continuous interplate-to-intraplate rupture transition in the Antarctic–Scotia plate boundary transition zone.
首次揭示南极-斯科舍板块边界转换带内的板间破裂证据以及从板间到板内断层的连续破裂演化。

kc: Resolved continuous rupture evolution across geometrically distinct interplate and intraplate faults during the 2025 Mw 7.5 Drake Passage earthquake using Potency Density Tensor Inversion.
Demonstrated solution robustness across 20 modeling setups combining four 1-D structural models and five fault-plane dip-depth configurations.
Provided the first source-process evidence of interplate thrust faulting near the transition between the Antarctic–Scotia subduction zone and the Shackleton Fracture Zone.
利用势密度张量反演揭示了2025年德雷克海峡Mw 7.5地震跨越板间和板内不同几何形态断层的连续破裂演化。
通过结合4种一维结构模型和5组断层倾角-深度配置的20组模型设置，验证了反演结果的稳健性。
首次提供了南极-斯科舍俯冲带向沙克尔顿断裂带过渡区域的板间逆冲断层破裂震源过程证据。
me: Potency Density Tensor Inversion (PDTI) using five basis double-couple components to simultaneously estimate fault geometry and slip rate without strict a priori fault plane constraints.
Incorporation of Green's function uncertainty into the data covariance matrix with Akaike Bayesian Information Criterion (ABIC) minimization and time-adaptive smoothing.
Sensitivity testing across 20 model configurations (4 velocity models: CRUST1.0, CRUST2.0, ak135-F, PREM × 5 dip-depth pairs).
采用包含五个基本双力偶分量的势密度张量反演（PDTI），在无严格先验断层几何约束下同时估计断层几何与滑动速率。
将格林函数不确定性显式纳入数据协方差矩阵，结合赤池贝叶斯信息准则（ABIC）最小化与时间自适应平滑。
跨越20种模型配置（4种速度模型：CRUST1.0、CRUST2.0、ak135-F、PREM × 5组倾角-深度对）进行敏感性测试。
de: Vertical-component teleseismic P-waveforms from 40 broadband stations at epicentral distances of 30°–90° retrieved via EarthScope SAGE Wilber 3.
Three-day aftershock catalog from USGS ANSS ComCat and historical focal mechanisms from the GCMT catalog.
Regional stress field orientations from the World Stress Map 2025 and plate motion vectors.
通过EarthScope SAGE Wilber 3获取的震中距30°–90°内40个宽频带台站的垂直分量远震P波波形。
来自USGS ANSS ComCat的震后三天余震目录以及GCMT目录中的历史震源机制解。
来自2025年世界应力图的区域应力场方向数据及板块运动矢量。
li: The PDTI framework currently cannot directly incorporate seismic phases other than teleseismic P-waves due to phase-specific Green's function error model requirements.
Rupture characteristics and non-double-couple components after origin time + 36 s show high variability across models and cannot be robustly resolved.
Temporal smoothing imposed in the inversion may make abrupt, jump-like changes in actual fault parameters appear artificially smooth.
由于需要针对特定震相开发格林函数误差模型，当前PDTI框架无法直接纳入远震P波以外的其他震相。
发震时刻36秒后的破裂特征和非双力偶分量在各模型间表现出很大差异，无法得到稳健解析。
反演中施加的时间平滑约束可能使实际断层参数的突变或跳跃式变化在模型中表现为平滑过渡。

tm.why: The paper investigates the spatiotemporal rupture evolution and fault geometry transitions of the 2025 Mw 7.5 Drake Passage earthquake using Potency Density Tensor Inversion.
The study provides constraints on the style of plate subduction and faulting regime along the Antarctic–Scotia plate boundary transition.

sum: This study integrates petrography, mineral chemistry, rock magnetism, and electron microscopy to investigate magnetite formation in abyssal peridotites from the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. It identifies two distinct pathways controlled by protolith mineralogy: olivine alteration produces lizardite and submicron dendritic magnetite aggregates dominated by vortex states, while orthopyroxene alteration sequentially replaces Mg-Al spinel with Cr-Fe chromite and crystallographically oriented Cr-rich magnetite. These divergent pathways explain the complementary magnetic carriers and fabrics within serpentinites, providing a process-based framework for interpreting oceanic magnetic anomalies.
本研究结合岩相学、矿物化学、岩石磁学和电子显微镜技术，研究了中大西洋脊深海橄榄岩中磁铁矿的形成机制。研究发现了两种受原岩矿物控制的截然不同的蚀变路径：橄榄石蚀变产生蛇纹石和亚微米级树枝状磁铁矿聚集体；而斜方辉石蚀变则使镁铝尖晶石逐步被铬铁矿和定向排列的富铬磁铁矿取代。这些不同的路径解释了蛇纹岩中互补……

t: Integration of petrography, mineral chemistry, rock magnetism, and electron microscopy to analyze abyssal peridotites.
结合岩相学、矿物化学、岩石磁学和电子显微镜分析深海橄榄岩。
Moderately to highly serpentinized abyssal peridotite samples from the Mid-Atlantic Ridge (7-8°N).
采集自中大西洋脊（7-8°N）的中度至高度蛇纹石化深海橄榄岩样品。
Discovery of dual magnetite formation pathways: olivine alteration yields vortex-state magnetite, while orthopyroxene alteration yields crystallographically oriented Cr-bearing magnetite.
发现双重磁铁矿形成路径：橄榄石蚀变产生涡旋态磁铁矿，斜方辉石蚀变产生定向富铬磁铁矿。
Geographically limited to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge (7-8°N), potentially omitting variations in other tectonic settings.
研究区域局限于中大西洋脊（7-8°N），可能未涵盖其他构造背景下的变化。
Resolving two distinct, protolith-controlled end-member pathways of magnetite formation and their specific microstructural and magnetic expressions.
解析了两种由原岩矿物控制的磁铁矿形成端元路径及其具体的微观结构与磁学表现。

kc: Identified two distinct, protolith-controlled pathways (olivine- vs. orthopyroxene-derived) for magnetite formation in abyssal serpentinites.
Characterized the microstructural and magnetic properties of magnetite formed from olivine alteration, showing vortex domain states and suppressed Verwey transitions.
Documented the sequential replacement of Mg-Al spinel by Cr-Fe chromite and Cr-rich magnetite during orthopyroxene alteration.
发现了深海蛇纹岩中两种由原岩矿物（橄榄石与斜方辉石）控制的截然不同的磁铁矿形成路径。
表征了橄榄石蚀变形成的磁铁矿的微结构和磁学性质，展示了涡旋磁畴态和受抑制的Verwey转变。
记录了斜方辉石蚀变过程中镁铝尖晶石逐步被铬铁矿和富铬磁铁矿取代的序列。

Mineral chemistry and electron microscopy (SEM/TEM) to resolve microstructures.
Rock magnetic measurements (Curie temperature, Verwey transition, hysteresis).
深海橄榄岩样品的岩相学分析。
利用矿物化学和电子显微镜（SEM/TEM）解析微观结构。
岩石磁学测量（居里温度、Verwey转变、磁滞回线）。
de: Abyssal peridotite samples collected from the Mid-Atlantic Ridge (7–8°N).
采集自中大西洋脊（7–8°N）的深海橄榄岩样品。
li: The study is based on samples from a specific region (7–8°N on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge), which may not capture all global variations in serpentinization conditions.
研究基于特定区域（中大西洋脊7–8°N）的样品，可能无法完全涵盖全球蛇纹石化条件的所有变化。

tm.why: The paper investigates the magnetic properties and mineralogical alteration (serpentinization) of abyssal peridotites, which directly impacts the magnetic signature of the oceanic lithosphere and mantle.

sum: This paper addresses the systematic overestimation of shear-wave velocities (VS) in weakly cemented sandstones by traditional Contact Cement Theory (CCT). The authors identify that CCT neglects grain lateral displacement, which couples with the tangential displacement of cement. By solving coupled integral equations, they formulate a revised model that accurately calculates the tangential stiffness of grain-cement assemblies. This modification significantly reduces the predicted shear modulus and increases the VP/VS ratio, aligning predictions with ultrasonic measurements on synthetic shaly sandstones. The model is highly applicable to dry, weakly cemented, quartz-dominated sandstones, offering a robust tool for reservoir seismic characterization.
本文针对传统接触水泥理论高估弱胶结砂岩剪切波速的问题，提出考虑颗粒侧向位移的改进模型。颗粒侧向位移与水泥切向位移耦合，会显著降低组合体切向刚度。通过求解耦合积分方程，新方法准确计算了剪切模量，提高了剪切波速预测精度。经合成砂岩超声实验验证，该模型显著改善了预测与实验的一致性，对储层地震表征有重要价值……

t: Solving coupled integral equations linking grain lateral displacement and cement tangential displacement to formulate tangential stiffness.
通过求解颗粒侧向位移与水泥切向位移耦合的积分方程来构建切向刚度公式。
Ultrasonic P- and S-wave velocity measurements on synthetic shaly sandstone samples.
人工合成泥质砂岩样品的超声纵波和横波速度测量数据。
Incorporating grain lateral displacement reduces tangential stiffness, lowering predicted shear-wave velocities and improving agreement with experimental data.
引入颗粒侧向位移降低了切向刚度，从而降低了预测的剪切波速，改善了与实验数据的一致性。
Applicable only to dry, weakly cemented, quartz-dominated sandstones with small contact regions and low grain Poisson's ratio.
仅适用于干燥、弱胶结、石英为主且接触区域小、颗粒泊松比低的砂岩。
First to incorporate grain lateral displacement into Contact Cement Theory to resolve the overestimation of shear-wave velocities.
首次将颗粒侧向位移引入接触水泥理论，解决了剪切波速被高估的问题。

kc: Identified the omission of grain lateral displacement in traditional Contact Cement Theory (CCT) as the primary cause for overestimating shear-wave velocities.
Developed a new formulation by solving coupled integral equations linking grain lateral displacement and cement tangential displacement.
Demonstrated improved agreement with ultrasonic laboratory measurements on synthetic shaly sandstone samples.
指出传统接触水泥理论（CCT）中忽略颗粒侧向位移是导致高估剪切波速度的主要原因。
通过求解颗粒侧向位移与水泥切向位移耦合的积分方程，建立了新的理论公式。
通过人工合成泥质砂岩的超声实验室测量数据，验证了新模型预测精度的显著提升。
me: Coupled integral equation formulation to link grain lateral displacement and cement tangential displacement.
Analytical derivation of tangential stiffness for grain-cement assemblies.
Modification of the classical Contact Cement Theory (CCT) framework.
建立耦合积分方程，将颗粒侧向位移与水泥切向位移联系起来。
解析推导颗粒-水泥组合体的切向刚度。
修正经典的接触水泥理论（CCT）框架。
de: Ultrasonic wave velocity measurements (P- and S-wave) on synthetic shaly sandstone samples.
Theoretical modeling and sensitivity analysis of grain Poisson's ratio and grain-cement contact parameters.
人工合成泥质砂岩样品的超声波速度（纵波和横波）测量数据。
颗粒泊松比及颗粒-水泥接触参数的理论建模与敏感性分析。
li: Primarily applicable to dry, weakly cemented, quartz-dominated sandstones.
Requires small grain-cement contact regions (low cement content).
Relies on the low grain Poisson's ratio and elastic half-space approximation.
主要适用于干燥、弱胶结、石英为主的砂岩。
要求较小的颗粒-水泥接触区域（低水泥含量）。
依赖于低颗粒泊松比和弹性半空间近似。

tm.why: The paper develops a rock physics model to improve the seismic characterization of weakly cemented sandstone reservoirs.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the paper's abstract and metadata from Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the processed experimental data and MATLAB scripts associated with the study 'How granular friction increases with velocity: Experiments establishing a local friction law and its structural origin.' The dataset enables the reproduction of the main-text figures, facilitating the investigation of granular friction mechanisms, velocity-dependence, and structural evolution in granular shear zones, which are critical for understanding fault mechanics.
该Zenodo数据仓库包含与研究“颗粒摩擦如何随速度增加：建立局部摩擦定律及其结构起源的实验”相关的处理后实验数据和MATLAB脚本。该数据集可用于重现论文中的主要插图，有助于深入研究颗粒摩擦机制、速度依赖性以及颗粒剪切带中的结构演化，这对于理解断层力学至关重要。

t: Laboratory shear experiments on granular materials to establish a local friction law and analyze its structural origin.
对颗粒材料进行实验室剪切实验，以建立局部摩擦定律并分析其结构起源。

sum: This study presents an integrated earthquake detection strategy combining machine learning and similarity-based methods applied to the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory in Southern Italy. By leveraging data from the permanent ISNet network, a temporary dense array of 200 stations, and two DAS systems, the authors successfully lower the catalog completeness magnitude to M 0. This high-resolution catalog illuminates active seismogenic structures at a decametric scale. Furthermore, the study demonstrates the transferability of machine learning models to native DAS records for P- and S-wave phase identification, bridging the gap between conventional seismic networks and high-resolution fiber-optic sensing.

sum: To overcome magnitude completeness limitations in traditional earthquake catalogs, this study integrates machine learning (ML) and similarity-based detection across multiscale monitoring infrastructure at the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory (Southern Italy). The dataset spans a 31-station permanent network (~10 km spacing), a 1-year temporary deployment of 200 stations in 20 dense arrays (~100 m spacing, DETECT experiment), and two continuous DAS systems (~80 km total length, 20 m channel spacing). In one year of dense array monitoring, ML pickers and template matching identified ~3,600 earthquakes (a 9-fold increase) and lowered the magnitude of completeness by over one unit. CNN-derived P-wave polarities yielded 289 focal mechanisms, revealing a homogeneous normal-faulting stress regime whose stress ratio R fluctuates seasonally with karst aquifer discharge. Furthermore, single-station ML pickers (PhaseNet) and associators (GaMMA) were exported directly to native DAS records for automated event detection and local magnitude estimation.

sum: Implicit full waveform inversion (IFWI) parameterizes subsurface velocity models with coordinate-based neural networks, but plain networks suffer from spectral bias, while activating all levels of multi-resolution hash encoding simultaneously introduces unconstrained high-wavenumber artifacts and exacerbates cycle skipping. This paper proposes coarse-to-fine IFWI (C2F-IFWI), which keeps only coarse base hash levels active initially and progressively unfreezes finer resolution levels using a continuous activation index and a smooth cosine ramp weighting. Frozen levels receive zero gradient, forcing the inversion to reconstruct the long-wavelength background before admitting fine-scale features, without adding extra parameters or computational overhead. Evaluated on synthetic Overthrust and BP 2004 benchmarks (across smoothed, linear, and constant initial models and up to 0 dB noise) and the 2D Viking marine field dataset, C2F-IFWI achieves faster convergence, lower model RMSE, near-invariance to starting models on BP 2004, and cleaner, better well-tied velocity images than baseline IFWI and grid-based FWI.
针对隐式全波形反演（IFWI）的频谱偏差及全分辨率哈希编码早期引入高波数伪影加剧周波跳跃的问题，本文提出由粗到细的隐式全波形反演（C2F-IFWI）。该方法初始仅激活粗尺度哈希网格，随迭代推进通过连续激活指数与余弦平滑权重渐进解冻细尺度层级，迫使模型先恢复长波长背景再刻画精细构造，且不增加额外参数与……

t: C2F-IFWI masks multi-resolution hash features with per-level weights driven by a continuous activation index and cosine ramp, keeping coarse levels active while progressively fading in finer levels before decoding velocity perturbations via a SIREN MLP.
利用连续激活指数与余弦权重对多分辨率哈希特征进行由粗到细的渐进掩码激活，再经SIREN网络解码预测速度扰动。

Evaluated on 2D synthetic Overthrust and BP 2004 models (using smoothed, linear, and constant initial models, plus 10/5/0 dB noise) and the 2D Viking marine field dataset (1001 shots, 120 receivers, 2-20 Hz).
采用二维Overthrust和BP 2004合成模型（3种初始模型及0-10 dB噪声）与Viking海洋实测数据集进行…

C2F-IFWI lowers Overthrust RMSE to 196.3, 250.1, and 437.0 m/s (vs 237.0, 280.7, 461.1 m/s for IFWI) and achieves near-invariant BP 2004 RMSE of 259.8, 257.5, and 259.6 m/s (vs 338.9, 410.9, 512.4 m/s).
Overthrust模型RMSE降至196.3–437.0 m/s，BP 2004在三种初始模型下均稳定在约259 m/…
Tested only in 2D constant-density acoustic media (leaving anisotropy misties at wells), and joint gradient learning of the schedule fails because instantaneous misfit favors premature level opening.
局限于二维常密度声波近似（存在各向异性井震误差），且无法通过瞬时残差梯度直接学习最优激活进度。

Introduces progressive coarse-to-fine hash level activation with smooth cosine gating into implicit FWI, realizing parameter-space wavenumber continuation with zero extra parameters or computational cost.
首次在隐式FWI中引入多分辨率哈希编码的由粗到细渐进平滑激活机制，零额外开销实现模型波数延拓。

kc: Proposes C2F-IFWI, reparameterizing the velocity model with multi-resolution hash encoding and a SIREN backbone while activating resolution levels progressively from coarse to fine.
Designs a parameter-free continuous activation schedule with a cosine fade-in ramp that blocks gradients to frozen fine levels, acting as a parameter-space wavenumber continuation.
Demonstrates superior accuracy, initial-model robustness (e.g., ~259 m/s RMSE across all starts on BP 2004), noise resilience (down to 0 dB SNR), and field applicability on the Viking marine dataset.
提出C2F-IFWI框架，结合多分辨率哈希编码与SIREN网络参数化速度模型，并由粗到细渐进激活哈希分辨率层级。
设计了无额外可训练参数的连续激活调度与余弦渐入权重，阻断冻结细层级的梯度更新，实现参数空间的波数延拓。
在合成基准与Viking海洋实测数据上验证了该方法具有更高的反演精度、对恶劣初始模型和0 dB强噪声的鲁棒性及优异的测井吻合度。
me: Coordinate-based implicit neural representation using a two-layer sine-activated multilayer perceptron (SIREN) combined with Instant-NGP style multi-resolution spatial hash tables.
Coarse-to-fine level masking via a continuous epoch-dependent activation index and a cosine ramp function that smoothly transitions per-level weights from 0 to 1.
End-to-end gradient computation coupling an 8th-order differentiable time-domain acoustic finite-difference wave solver with automatic differentiation and Adam optimization.
采用两层正弦激活多层感知机（SIREN）结合Instant-NGP风格的多分辨率空间哈希表构建坐标基隐式神经表征。
通过随迭代轮数增长的连续激活指数与余弦斜坡函数对各哈希层级进行掩码加权，实现权重从0到1的平滑激活。
将8阶可微时域声波有限差分求解器与自动微分耦合，利用Adam优化器端到端联合更新网络权重与哈希表参数。
de: Synthetic 2D Overthrust model (94x400 grid, 25 m spacing, 8 Hz Ricker source) and BP 2004 salt model (68x188 grid, 12.5 m spacing, 2-8 Hz multiscale Ricker), tested with smoothed, 1D linear, and constant initial models.
Noise robustness experiments on Overthrust and BP 2004 adding zero-mean Gaussian noise at SNRs of 10, 5, and 0 dB.

2D Viking marine field dataset (320x2281 grid at 12.5 m spacing, 1001 shots, 120-channel streamer, 3 km max offset, 2-20 Hz multiscale inversion) evaluated via RTM image overlays, interleaved shot gathers, and two well logs.
2D Overthrust合成模型（94×400网格，8 Hz单频震源）和BP 2004盐丘模型（68×188网格，2–8 Hz多尺度震源），测试平滑、线性梯度和均匀常数三种初始模型。
在Overthrust和BP 2004合成记录中加入信噪比为10、5和0 dB的零均值高斯噪声进行抗噪鲁棒性实验。
2D Viking海洋拖缆实测数据集（320×2281网格，1001炮，最大偏移距3 km，2–20 Hz多尺度反演），结合RTM叠前深度偏移剖面、道集拼接对比及两口测井曲线进行验证。
li: Currently restricted to 2D constant-density acoustic isotropic wave propagation; depth misties with well logs in the Viking field test occur due to unaccounted seismic anisotropy.

Directly learning the hash activation schedule via gradient descent on instantaneous data misfit degrades accuracy because it opens fine levels prematurely, requiring a fixed schedule unless bilevel trajectory optimization is used.
目前仅限于二维常密度声波各向同性介质假设，Viking实测数据反演结果与测井曲线之间存在由未建模各向异性引起的深度误差。
基于瞬时数据残差梯度直接学习激活调度会导致细层级过早开启而降低精度，目前需依赖固定超参数调度。

tm.why: The paper develops an implicit full-waveform inversion (IFWI) framework to reconstruct subsurface seismic velocity models by minimizing waveform data misfit through a differentiable acoustic wave solver.
It parameterizes the velocity model using coordinate-based implicit neural representations (SIREN MLP) coupled with learnable multi-resolution hash feature encoding.
It analyzes how progressive coarse-to-fine hash level activation acts as a wavenumber-domain continuation that improves Gauss-Newton Hessian conditioning and suppresses cycle skipping.

ev.notes: Full 49-page manuscript PDF (including all text, equations, 14 figures, 4 tables, and Algorithm 1) was read and analyzed directly.

sum: This study reconstructs the Viking 2 seismic workflow to demonstrate how its unique sampling strategy altered recorded seismic signals on Mars. The authors re-evaluate Viking seismic events, suggesting they potentially originated within the northern-plains region, which was later identified by the InSight mission as a source of seasonal marsquakes. Additionally, they discuss alternative interpretations for the sol 80 event, including a distant tectonic marsquake or a meteorite impact, showing that these possibilities cannot be ruled out due to signal alterations. This work provides critical historical context and methodological insights for planetary seismology.
本研究重构了海盗2号（Viking 2）的地震工作流，展示了其独特的采样策略如何改变记录到的地震信号。作者重新评估了海盗号检测到的地震事件，指出其可能源于北部平原地区（后被InSight任务推断为季节性火震源区）。此外，研究表明由于信号失真，不能排除sol 80事件是远距离构造火震或陨石撞击的交替解……

sum: The 2020 Mw7.6 Sand Point, Alaska, oblique strike-slip earthquake generated an unexpectedly large tsunami. This study analyzes the most complete land-based dataset—including static and high-rate GNSS, InSAR, teleseismic waveforms, and relocated aftershocks—alongside DART buoy tsunami records. Using nonlinear wavelet-based finite-fault inversions, the authors test a single intraslab strike-slip model and a two-fault model including the megathrust. While the single-fault model fits land-based seismo-geodetic data best (and InSAR rejects deep coseismic megathrust slip), neither model reproduces the DART tsunami waveforms, and long-period seismic records rule out a submarine landslide. Systematic unit-source tsunami modeling and Coulomb stress calculations reveal that the tsunami was generated by delayed (~6.5–8 minutes post-mainshock), slow (50–200 s rise time), concentrated thrust slip near the trench (2.5–10 km depth) in a zone of mainshock-induced stress increase, representing a triggered tsunami earthquake undetectable by land-based networks.
2020年阿拉斯加Sand Point Mw7.6走滑地震引发了异常大的海啸。本研究综合静态与高频GNSS、InSAR、远震波形、重定位余震及DART浮标海啸数据，利用非线性小波有限断层反演测试了单走滑断层和包含板块界面的双断层模型。单断层模型能很好地拟合陆地地震大地测量数据（InSAR排除了深部同……

t: Joint nonlinear wavelet-based kinematic slip inversion of static/high-rate GNSS, floating InSAR, and teleseismic waveforms, coupled with finite-difference nonlinear shallow-water tsunami modeling of unit megathrust sources and Coulomb stress change calculations.
利用静态/高频GNSS、浮动InSAR和远震波形进行非线性小波运动学反演，结合浅水方程海啸模拟与库仑应力计算。

Static and 1-Hz high-rate GNSS displacements, Sentinel-1 InSAR interferograms across the Shumagin Islands, 39 P and 27 SH teleseismic waveforms, three DART buoy tsunami records, and >12,000 relocated regional earthquakes.
静态和1-Hz高频GNSS、Sentinel-1 InSAR干涉图、39个P波和27个SH波远震波形、3个DART浮标记…

The preferred 350°-striking, 49°-dipping intraslab strike-slip model releases up to 2.1 m slip (22–38 km depth) and induces up to 3.6–4.9 MPa Coulomb stress increase, triggering ~1.7–6.8 m shallow (2.5–10 km) megathrust slip delayed by ~480 s.
走向350°、倾角49°的板内走滑断层释放最大2.1米滑移，产生3.6-4.9 MPa库仑应力增量，触发延迟约480秒的…

Land-based observations cannot uniquely resolve the spatial extent of slow offshore slip, and 1-D velocity models neglect steep forearc bathymetry effects on teleseismic waveforms and shallow-water tsunami propagation.
陆基观测无法唯一确定近海沟慢滑移范围，一维速度模型忽略了陡峭前弧海底地形对波形的影响。

Incorporates Shumagin Islands InSAR data to rule out deep coseismic megathrust slip and demonstrates that mainshock-triggered, delayed, very slow near-trench megathrust slip explains the anomalous tsunami.
首次引入岛屿InSAR排除了深部同震逆冲滑移，证实主震应力触发的浅部延迟无震慢滑移导致了异常海啸。

kc: Inferred a comprehensive coseismic finite-fault model for the 2020 Mw7.6 Sand Point earthquake using joint inversion of static/high-rate GNSS, InSAR, and teleseismic waveforms.
Demonstrated using floating InSAR island patches and DART records that simultaneous coseismic megathrust slip at 12-20 km depth did not cause the tsunami.
Ruled out a submarine landslide hypothesis by showing the absence of delayed long-period (50-300 s) Rayleigh wave signals in regional seismic networks.
Identified a delayed (~480 s), slow, shallow (2.5-10 km depth) megathrust slip source triggered by mainshock Coulomb stress increases up to 3.6-4.9 MPa that reproduces the tsunami.
利用静态/高频GNSS、InSAR和远震波形联合反演，建立了2020年Sand Point Mw7.6地震完整的同震有限断层滑移模型。
结合岛屿InSAR数据和DART海啸记录，证明12-20 km深度的同震巨型逆冲断层滑移并非海啸成因。
通过检验区域地震台网中缺失延迟长周期（50-300 s）面波信号，排除了海底滑坡引发海啸的假说。
识别出由主震库仑应力增加（达3.6-4.9 MPa）触发的近海沟浅部（2.5-10 km）延迟（约480秒）慢速逆冲滑移源，成功复现了海啸观测。
me: Nonlinear wavelet-based kinematic finite-fault slip inversion combining static geodetic offsets, floating InSAR LOS deformation, high-rate GNSS, and teleseismic waveforms.
Double-difference earthquake relocation (tomoDD) with 3-D ray tracing in an amphibious regional velocity model.
Finite-difference numerical modeling of nonlinear shallow water equations for tsunami propagation from distributed unit slip sources.
Elastic half-space Coulomb stress change modeling interpolated onto the 3-D Slab2 subduction interface.
结合静态大地测量位移、浮动InSAR视线向形变、高频GNSS及远震波形的非线性小波运动学有限断层反演。
基于海陆联合区域三维速度模型的双差地震重定位（tomoDD）与三维射线追踪。
基于分布式单位滑移源求解非线性浅水方程的有限差分海啸传播数值模拟。

de: Daily static GNSS time series and 1-Hz high-rate GNSS waveforms from regional Alaska stations processed with GIPSY/OASIS and GipsyX.
Sentinel-1 two-pass InSAR interferograms (2020-10-04 to 2020-10-28) across the Shumagin Islands processed with GMTSAR.
39 P and 27 SH teleseismic body-wave waveforms (30° to 90° epicentral distance) and regional long-period vertical seismograms (<600 km).
Tide-removed water level records from three near-field DART buoys (46402, 46409, 46414) and >12,000 relocated regional earthquakes.
利用GIPSY/OASIS和GipsyX处理的阿拉斯加区域台站每日静态GNSS时间序列与1-Hz高频GNSS波形。
利用GMTSAR处理的覆盖Shumagin群岛的Sentinel-1双轨InSAR干涉图（2020-10-04至2020-10-28）。
震中距30°至90°的39条P波和27条SH波远震体波波形，以及震中距600 km以内的区域长周期垂直向地震记录。
3个近场DART浮标（46402、46409、46414）去潮汐水位记录及超过12,000个区域重定位地震目录。
li: Land-based geodetic and seismic observations lack sensitivity to slow, shallow, trench-proximal megathrust slip, leading to spatial non-uniqueness in the tsunami source.
Use of a 1-D layered velocity model (LITHO 1.0) for Green's functions underpredicts teleseismic amplitudes perpendicular to fault strike due to unmodeled steep forearc bathymetry.
The tsunami model assumes instantaneous seafloor deformation and relies on ad-hoc onset time delays to approximate finite rupture and slow slip rise times.
陆基大地测量和地震观测对近海沟浅部缓慢逆冲滑移缺乏敏感性，导致海啸源空间分布存在非唯一性。
使用一维层状速度模型（LITHO 1.0）计算格林函数未考虑陡峭前弧海底地形，低估了垂直断层走向的远震振幅。
海啸模型假设海底瞬间形变，需依赖人为设定的延迟时间来近似有限破裂过程和慢滑移上升时间。

sum: This paper presents a high-resolution seismicity analysis of the Western Branch of the East African Rift System (EARS) in Uganda. By leveraging advanced deep learning algorithms for phase picking and earthquake detection, the authors construct a highly resolved seismic catalog. This refined catalog provides detailed insights into active faulting, crustal deformation, and rifting processes in this region, demonstrating the power of machine learning to enhance seismic monitoring in areas with sparse station coverage.
本文对乌干达东非裂谷系统（EARS）西支进行了高分辨率地震活动性分析。作者利用先进的深度学习算法进行震相拾取与地震检测，构建了高精度地震目录。该目录为该地区的活动断裂、地壳形变和裂谷演化过程提供了详细的见解，展示了机器学习在稀疏台网环境下提升地震监测能力的巨大潜力。

t: Application of deep learning algorithms for automated seismic phase picking and event association to detect microearthquakes.

Continuous seismic waveform data from regional and local networks in the Western Branch of the East African Rift System, Uganda.

A newly compiled, high-resolution earthquake catalog that delineates active fault geometries and seismicity patterns in Uganda.
新编制的高分辨率地震目录，描绘了乌干达境内的活动断层几何形状和地震活动模式。
Detection performance is inherently limited by the sparse station density of the regional Ugandan seismic network.

First systematic application of modern deep learning phase pickers to refine the seismicity catalog of the Ugandan rift sector.

sum: Characterizing earthquake ground motion requires both translational and rotational components, yet simulating point rotations in 3D media has relied on receiver-spacing-dependent finite-difference approximations. This study extends the spectral-element package SPECFEM3D to evaluate rotational ground motions directly from spatial displacement gradients at Gauss-Lobatto-Legendre (GLL) integration points during the numerical solution. Validated against analytical solutions in a homogeneous elastic half-space, the method accurately reproduces arrival times, amplitudes, and waveforms. The authors introduce Peak Ground Rotation Rate (PGRR) maps as the rotational analogue to Peak Ground Velocity (PGV) maps. Simulations in homogeneous, generic layered, and 3D Indo-Gangetic Basin models for strike-slip and oblique-normal sources demonstrate that critical locations of peak rotations and translations do not coincide. Furthermore, low-velocity sedimentary basins amplify PGRR by nearly four times and significantly alter radiation patterns and dominant rotational components (tilt vs. torsion).
本研究扩展了谱元法程序SPECFEM3D，在数值求解过程中直接利用高斯-洛巴托-勒让德（GLL）积分点处的位移空间梯度计算旋转地震动，克服了传统有限差分法对台站间距的依赖。该方法在均匀弹性半空间中与解析解进行了验证，波形与振幅吻合良好。作者提出了峰值地面旋转率（PGRR）图，并与峰值地面速度（PGV……

t: SPECFEM3D is extended to directly evaluate the rotational wavefield (half the curl of displacement) from spatial derivatives of Lagrange interpolation functions at Gauss-Lobatto-Legendre points at every time step.
扩展SPECFEM3D，在每个时间步利用GLL点拉格朗日插值函数的空间导数直接计算旋转波场。
Numerical experiments use a 100 km x 100 km x 30 km domain with concentric receiver rings up to 40 km epicentral distance across homogeneous, 7-layer, and 3D Indo-Gangetic Basin models.
在100×100×30 km区域内设置同心圆台站阵列，对均匀、7层和三维恒河盆地模型进行数值模拟。

PGRR and PGV maxima occur in different locations. In the Indo-Gangetic Basin, low-velocity sediments amplify maximum PGRR nearly fourfold (from 1.84 to 7.1 mrad/s for strike-slip; 2.1 to 8.0 mrad/s for oblique-normal).
PGRR与PGV极值位置不同；恒河盆地低速沉积层使PGRR放大近4倍（最高达8.0 mrad/s）。
The 3D Indo-Gangetic Basin model neglects topography and does not directly quantify structural damage.
三维恒河盆地模型未考虑地形效应，且未直接量化结构损伤。

Direct mesh-based computation of point rotational ground motions in SPECFEM3D without array-derived finite-difference approximations, alongside introducing Peak Ground Rotation Rate (PGRR) hazard maps.
在SPECFEM3D中实现免有限差分的点旋转地震动直接计算，并首次提出PGRR分布图。

kc: Extended SPECFEM3D to directly compute 3C rotational ground motions at GLL points without external finite-difference post-processing.
Validated the numerical implementation against analytical solutions in a homogeneous medium, achieving low MAE and RMSE across 41 stations.
Introduced Peak Ground Rotation Rate (PGRR) maps, showing that maximum rotational and translational (PGV) demands occur in different locations.
Demonstrated that the 3D Indo-Gangetic sedimentary basin amplifies PGRR by nearly a factor of four and alters dominant tilt/torsion radiation patterns.
扩展了SPECFEM3D，直接在GLL积分点计算三分量旋转地震动，无需外部有限差分后处理。
在均匀介质中通过解析解验证了数值实现，41个台站的MAE和RMSE均极低。
提出了峰值地面旋转率（PGRR）图，证明最大旋转需求与最大平动需求（PGV）的空间位置不重合。
揭示了三维恒河沉积盆地可将PGRR放大近4倍，并改变倾斜与扭转分量的主导辐射特征。
me: Direct evaluation of the curl of the displacement wavefield using spatial derivatives of Lagrange interpolation functions at GLL points in SPECFEM3D.
Validation against analytical solutions for a double-couple strike-slip source in a homogeneous elastic half-space up to 2.5 Hz.
Spatial mapping and comparison of Peak Ground Rotation Rate (PGRR) and Peak Ground Velocity (PGV) across homogeneous, 7-layer, and 3D basin models.
在SPECFEM3D中利用GLL点处拉格朗日插值函数的空间导数直接计算位移波场的旋度。
在均匀弹性半空间中针对双力偶走滑震源，在2.5 Hz频带内与解析解进行验证。
在均匀、7层及三维盆地模型中构建并对比峰值地面旋转率（PGRR）与峰值地面速度（PGV）空间分布图。
de: Homogeneous half-space model (100 km x 100 km x 30 km, 1.14M spectral elements) with a 5 km deep strike-slip source (M0 = 10^24 dyne-cm, 1 Hz Ricker wavelet).

3D Indo-Gangetic Basin velocity model (~26.2M elements, minimum Vs = 475 m/s, resolving down to 0.52 s) simulated on 512 CPU cores.

7层通用地壳模型（约240万个谱元），测试左旋走滑和斜正断层双力偶震源。
三维恒河盆地速度模型（约2620万个谱元，最低Vs = 475 m/s，最短解析周期0.52 s），在512个CPU核上运行模拟。

sum: The paper presents 'mhs', a software library that computes mollified Mindlin half-space Green's functions for triangular dislocation elements in a homogeneous half-space. By replacing point forces with a smooth blob of width epsilon (following Cortez's regularized Stokeslets method), the elastostatic equations are solved exactly. This eliminates singularities, allowing stress to be defined directly on the fault itself, which is a major limitation of classical dislocation theory. The free surface is handled via Mindlin image terms, avoiding the need for boundary meshing, linear system solving, or box truncation. The library is designed to construct on-fault interaction matrices for static stress transfer, rate-and-state friction, and earthquake-cycle simulations. A key limitation is that the free-surface traction condition is satisfied to O(epsilon^2) rather than exactly.
本文介绍了“mhs”软件库，用于计算均匀半空间中三角形位错单元的磨光Mindlin半空间格林函数。该方法采用Cortez的正则化斯托克斯子方法，将点力替换为宽度为epsilon的平滑斑，从而精确求解弹性静力学方程。这消除了奇异性，使得应力可以直接在断层上定义，克服了经典位错理论的局限。自由表面通过M……

Provides a singularity-free formulation where stress is well-defined on the fault itself, avoiding boundary meshing and linear system solving.
提供了无奇异性的公式，使应力在断层上定义明确，避免了边界网格化和线性方程组求解。
The free-surface traction condition is satisfied only to O(epsilon^2) accuracy rather than exactly, and it assumes a homogeneous half-space.
自由表面牵引力条件仅满足到O(epsilon^2)精度，且假设为均匀半空间。
First application of regularized Stokeslets to Mindlin half-space triangular dislocations, enabling singularity-free on-fault stress calculations without boundary discretization.
首次将正则化斯托克斯子应用于Mindlin半空间三角形位错，实现了无需边界离散的无奇异性断层应力计算。

kc: Developed 'mhs', a singularity-free library for mollified Mindlin half-space Green's functions.
Enabled well-defined stress calculations directly on the fault itself by replacing point forces with smooth blobs.
Eliminated the need for boundary meshing, collocation, or solving linear systems by using Mindlin image terms.
开发了“mhs”软件库，用于计算无奇异性的磨光Mindlin半空间格林函数。
通过将点力替换为平滑斑，实现了在断层上直接定义且无奇异性的应力计算。
利用Mindlin镜像项消除了边界网格化、配置法或求解线性方程组的需要。
me: Cortez's method of regularized Stokeslets to smooth point forces into blobs of width epsilon.
Exact analytical solution of elastostatic equations for the regularized body force.
Mindlin image terms to satisfy free-surface boundary conditions without boundary discretization.
采用Cortez的正则化斯托克斯子方法，将点力平滑为宽度为epsilon的斑。
针对正则化体变力精确求解弹性静力学方程。
利用Mindlin镜像项满足自由表面边界条件，无需边界离散化。
de: Synthetic generation of on-fault interaction matrices for triangular dislocation elements in a homogeneous half-space.
均匀半空间中三角形位错单元断层相互作用矩阵的合成计算与测试。
li: The free-surface traction condition is satisfied only to O(epsilon^2) accuracy rather than exactly.
Assumes a homogeneous half-space with no topography.
自由表面牵引力条件仅满足到O(epsilon^2)精度，而非完全精确满足。
假设为无地形的均匀半空间。

tm.why: The library calculates on-fault interaction matrices used in rate-and-state and earthquake-cycle models.
It computes triangular dislocation Green's functions for static stress transfer and fault slip modeling.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study presents an integrated seismic and petrophysical characterization of the Lower Cretaceous Kharita Formation in the SELKIT and SETHOS fields, Western Desert, Egypt. Utilizing thirty 2D seismic profiles and well-log data from three wells, the authors delineated the structural framework, major normal faults, and four-way dip anticlinal closures that control hydrocarbon trapping. Petrophysical analysis identified seven hydrocarbon-bearing zones with favorable reservoir properties, including low shale volume (4–20%), good total porosity (8–18%), and high hydrocarbon saturation (55–80%). The study demonstrates that reservoir distribution and hydrocarbon accumulation are jointly controlled by depositional architecture and fault-related structural trapping, highlighting the most prospective intervals in Zone D (SELK-6) and Zone F (SETHOS-16).
本研究对埃及西部沙漠SELKIT和SETHOS油田的下白垩统Kharita组进行了地震与测井物理综合表征。通过解释30条二维地震剖面和3口井的测井数据，圈定了控制油气圈闭的主断层及四向倾角背斜构造。测井分析识别出7个含油气层段，具有低泥质含量（4-20%）、良好孔隙度（8-18%）和高油气饱和度（5……

t: Integration of 2D seismic structural interpretation with petrophysical well-log analysis and neutron-density crossplots to evaluate reservoir characteristics.
结合二维地震构造解释与测井物理分析及中子-密度交会图评估储层特征。
Thirty 2D seismic profiles and conventional well-log data from three wells (SELK-6, SELK-7, and SETHOS-16) in the South Umbaraka Area, Egypt.
埃及南Umbaraka地区30条二维地震剖面及3口井的常规测井数据。
Identification of seven hydrocarbon-bearing zones with 8-18% porosity, 4-20% shale volume, and 55-80% hydrocarbon saturation, controlled by four-way dip closures.
识别出7个含油气层，孔隙度8-18%，受四向倾角背斜圈闭控制。
The study is limited by the use of 2D seismic profiles instead of 3D seismic, and a sparse dataset of only three wells.
受限于使用二维而非三维地震数据，且仅有3口井的稀疏数据集。
First integrated seismic-petrophysical characterization of the Kharita Formation in the SELKIT and SETHOS fields, defining specific high-potential reservoir zones.
首次对该区Kharita组进行地震-测井综合表征，明确了高潜力储层段。

kc: Delineated the structural framework and fault-bounded anticlinal closures of the Kharita Formation using 2D seismic data.
Evaluated reservoir petrophysical properties (porosity, shale volume, water saturation) across three key wells.
Identified seven prospective hydrocarbon-bearing zones, highlighting Zone D in SELK-6 and Zone F in SETHOS-16 as primary targets.
利用二维地震数据圈定了Kharita组的构造框架和受断层控制的背斜圈闭。
评估了三口关键井的储层物性参数（孔隙度、泥质含量、含水饱和度）。
识别出7个潜在的含油气层段，并指出SELK-6井D区和SETHOS-16井F区为主要勘探目标。
me: 2D seismic structural interpretation (fault mapping, time- and depth-structure mapping).
Petrophysical well-log analysis (lithology identification, shale volume, porosity, fluid saturation calculation).
Neutron-density crossplots for lithology and gas-interval identification.
二维地震构造解释（断层制图、时间及深度构造图绘制）。
测井物理分析（岩性识别、泥质含量、孔隙度及流体饱和度计算）。
利用中子-密度交会图进行岩性及气层识别。
de: Thirty 2D seismic reflection profiles.
Conventional well-log data from SELK-6, SELK-7, and SETHOS-16 wells.
30条二维地震反射剖面。
SELK-6、SELK-7和SETHOS-16井的常规测井数据。
li: Reliance on 2D seismic profiles rather than higher-resolution 3D seismic data, which limits spatial resolution of complex fault networks.
Limited number of wells (three) for regional reservoir correlation and lateral facies variation mapping.
依赖二维地震剖面而非高分辨率三维地震数据，限制了复杂断裂系统的空间分辨率。
用于区域储层对比和横向相变制图的井位数量（3口）较少。

tm.why: The study utilizes 2D seismic profiles to interpret the structural framework, fault architecture, and subsurface geometry of the Kharita Formation.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the abstract and metadata.

sum: Short-term aftershock incompleteness biases Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimates because small events go undetected immediately following large mainshocks. This study systematically compares two strategies for addressing this bias: reconstructing missing earthquakes via nonparametric catalog replenishment (AutoBETA) versus directly estimating b-values from incomplete catalogs using robust positive-difference estimators (b-more-positive and b-more-incomplete). Using 500 synthetic Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) catalogs degraded by time- and magnitude-dependent incompleteness (ETASI) alongside three Southern California aftershock sequences (1992 Landers, 1999 Hector Mine, and 2019 Ridgecrest), the authors evaluate conventional maximum-likelihood and positive-difference estimators before and after replenishment. Replenishment restores much of the missing population and reduces conventional maximum-likelihood bias from 10–12% to 1–2%, whereas positive-difference estimators directly recover the true b-value without replenishment. In real catalogs, b-more-incomplete proves most stable across replenishment realizations. Thus, replenishment and robust estimation are complementary tools suited to different scientific objectives.
短期余震目录不完整性会导致古登堡-里克特b值估计产生偏差。本研究对比了两种解决策略：利用非参数目录补充算法（AutoBETA）重建缺失地震，以及使用稳健正差估计器（b-more-positive和b-more-incomplete）直接从不完整目录中估计b值。基于500个经受时间和震级依赖不完整性（……

t: Compares nonparametric catalog replenishment (AutoBETA via biscale empirical probability integral transformation) against conventional maximum-likelihood, b-more-positive, and blind-time filtered b-more-incomplete estimators on synthetic ETAS/ETASI and real aftershock catalogs.
在合成和真实余震目录上对比AutoBETA非参数目录补充与MLE、b-more-positive和b-more-inco…
500 synthetic ETAS aftershock sequences (M_M = 7.2, b_true = 1.0) thinned by the ETASI model, plus instrumental catalogs for the 1992 Landers, 1999 Hector Mine, and 2019 Ridgecrest sequences.
500个经ETASI稀释的合成ETAS序列（b_true=1.0），及南加州Landers、Hector Mine和Ri…

AutoBETA replenishment reduces conventional MLE b-value relative error from 10–12% in thinned catalogs to 1–2%, while b-more-positive (0.005±0.036) and b-more-incomplete (-0.003±0.022) accurately recover b_true directly from incomplete catalogs.
补充将MLE相对误差从10–12%降至1–2%，而正差估计器无需补充即可直接从不完整目录恢复真实b值。

Assumes time-magnitude separability, tests only three Southern California sequences, and relies on hard-threshold ETASI thinning where AutoBETA failed on 3.2% of realizations and struggles with gradual detection transitions.
假设震级与时间可分离，仅测试硬阈值稀释模型（3.2%失败率），难以适应渐进检测过渡。

First controlled benchmark evaluating whether nonparametric catalog replenishment (AutoBETA) and robust positive-difference estimators provide equivalent inferences for Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimation under short-term aftershock incompleteness.
首次在受控条件下系统评估非参数目录补充与稳健正差估计器在b值估计上的等效性与互补性。

kc: Systematically benchmarks nonparametric earthquake replenishment (AutoBETA) against robust positive-difference estimators (b-more-positive, b-more-incomplete) using 500 controlled ETAS/ETASI synthetic catalogs.
Demonstrates that AutoBETA replenishment reduces conventional maximum-likelihood b-value bias from 10–12% down to a small residual bias of 1–2%.

Shows that b-more-incomplete is highly invariant to catalog replenishment in both synthetic and Southern California instrumental sequences, whereas b-more-positive decreases by 11–12% after replenishment in real catalogs.
Clarifies that catalog replenishment and robust b-value estimators are complementary rather than statistically equivalent tools.
利用500个受控的ETAS/ETASI合成地震目录，系统地将非参数地震目录补充（AutoBETA）与稳健正差估计器（b-more-positive、b-more-incomplete）进行了基准对比。
证明AutoBETA目录补充可将传统最大似然b值估计的偏差从10–12%显著降低至1–2%的微小残余偏差。
发现在合成和南加州实际观测序列中，b-more-incomplete对目录补充具有高度稳定性，而b-more-positive在真实目录补充后下降了11–12%。
阐明了地震目录补充与稳健b值估计器在统计上并非等价，而是互为补充的工具。
me: Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) forward modeling coupled with deterministic post-generation short-term aftershock incompleteness thinning (ETASI).
Nonparametric missing-event reconstruction using the Auto-Biscale Empirical Transformation Application (AutoBETA) based on biscale empirical probability integral transformation (BEPIT).
Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimation via Aki's maximum-likelihood estimator (MLE), b-more-positive estimator, and artificial blind-time filtered b-more-incomplete estimator.
Bootstrap uncertainty analysis (100 replicates) and stochastic replenishment stability testing across 10 independent random seeds.
结合传染型余震序列（ETAS）正演模拟与确定性生成后短期余震不完整性稀释模型（ETASI）。
基于双尺度经验概率积分变换（BEPIT），使用自动双尺度经验变换应用（AutoBETA）进行非参数缺失事件重建。
通过Aki最大似然估计器（MLE）、b-more-positive估计器以及应用人工盲时间滤波的b-more-incomplete估计器计算古登堡-里克特b值。
开展自助法（Bootstrap）不确定性分析（100次重复）以及跨10个独立随机种子的随机补充稳定性测试。
de: 500 synthetic ETAS aftershock sequences initiated by a fixed M 7.2 mainshock over 38 years (m0 = 1.0, mmax = 7.5, b_true = 1.0), thinned via ETASI (w = 1.4, delta = 0.9, sigma = 0).

Southern California waveform-relocated instrumental catalogs (Hauksson et al., 2012) down to m = 1.0 for the 1992 Mw 7.3 Landers (16,749 events), 1999 Mw 7.1 Hector Mine (16,636 events), and 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest (14,308 events) sequences.
由固定M 7.2主震触发、持续38年的500个合成ETAS余震序列（m0 = 1.0，mmax = 7.5，b_true = 1.0），并通过ETASI模型（w = 1.4，delta = 0.9，sigma = 0）进行不完整性稀释。
南加州波形重定位观测目录（Hauksson et al., 2012，下限m = 1.0），包含1992年Mw 7.3 Landers（16,749个事件）、1999年Mw 7.1 Hector Mine（16,636个事件）和2019年Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest（14,308个事件）余震序列。
li: Synthetic evaluation relies on a single deterministic hard-threshold incompleteness formulation (ETASI with sigma = 0); preliminary tests with gradual detection transitions (sigma > 0) yielded diffuse depletion patterns that AutoBETA could not reliably bound.
AutoBETA failed to converge on a valid depleted-region polygon in 16 out of 500 synthetic realizations (3.2%).

Both replenishment and positive-difference estimators assume magnitude distributions are statistically separable from occurrence times, making genuine temporal b-value changes hard to separate from detection artifacts.
Instrumental validation is restricted to three strike-slip sequences in Southern California.
合成评估依赖于单一的确定性硬阈值不完整性模型（sigma = 0的ETASI）；在渐进检测过渡（sigma > 0）的初步测试中，缺失区域边界弥散，AutoBETA无法可靠恢复有效多边形。
在500次合成实现中，AutoBETA有16次（3.2%）未能识别出满足几何准则的有效缺失区域多边形。
目录补充和正差估计器均假设震级分布与发震时间在统计上可分离，因此难以将真实的b值时间演化与检测效应区分开。
实际观测验证仅限于南加州的三个余震序列。

tm.why: The study focuses on short-term aftershock catalog incompleteness, missing-event replenishment using AutoBETA, and unbiased estimation of the Gutenberg-Richter b-value from earthquake catalogs.
Accurate estimation of the Gutenberg-Richter b-value and aftershock sequence parameters (ETAS) is fundamental to statistical seismology and seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 26-page arXiv manuscript PDF was read and analyzed, including all equations, synthetic ETAS/ETASI experiments, Southern California case studies, tables, and appendix figures.

sum: Estimating spatially heterogeneous fault friction directly from geodetic observations while honoring rate-and-state friction (RSF) mechanics has been limited by the computational cost of high-dimensional dynamic inversion. This study applies Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to assimilate daily GNSS displacement time series from 86 GEONET stations during the 2010 Bungo Channel Slow Slip Event (SSE) in southwest Japan. Using two fully-connected neural networks to represent spatio-temporal slip/state evolution and continuous frictional parameters (a, a-b, L), along with transfer learning from a uniform-patch prior, the inversion resolves a localized strong velocity-weakening patch with small nucleation length beneath southwest Shikoku. This heterogeneity explains SSE initiation in southwest Shikoku followed by rapid westward propagation into the Bungo Channel, outperforming homogeneous-patch MCMC inversions and avoiding ad hoc kinematic smoothing. Forward simulations forecast a subsequent SSE around 2014–2015, highlighting the need to assimilate multi-cycle and interseismic locking data.
本研究利用物理信息神经网络（PINN），结合速率-状态摩擦定律（RSF）与准动态弹性力学，同化日本西南86个GEONET站点2006–2012年的GNSS位移时间序列，反演2010年丰后水道慢滑移事件（SSE）的空间非均匀摩擦参数。通过两个全连接神经网络分别表征时空滑移状态演化和摩擦参数（a、a-b……

t: Two fully-connected Physics-Informed Neural Networks jointly represent spatio-temporal fault slip/state evolution (V, θ) and spatially heterogeneous rate-and-state friction parameters (a, a-b, L), optimized via L-BFGS against GNSS data and quasi-dynamic governing equations.
构建两个全连接物理信息神经网络分别表征时空滑移状态演化与空间连续摩擦参数，结合准动态控制方程与GNSS数据进行L-BFG…

Daily three-component surface displacement time series from 86 GEONET GNSS stations around the Bungo Channel, southwest Japan, covering July 2006 to June 2012 (2,192 epochs), detrended for interseismic motion.
采用日本丰后水道周边86个GEONET站点2006年7月至2012年6月共2192天的日解三分量GNSS地表位移时间序列…

PINN resolves strong velocity-weakening friction with small characteristic slip distance L and nucleation length Rc beneath southwest Shikoku, accurately reproducing SSE initiation there (2009.7–2010.1) and subsequent rapid westward propagation into the Bungo Channel.
反演揭示四国西南下方存在小特征滑移距离L和小成核长度Rc的强速度弱化区，重现了慢滑移在此成核并向西快速扩展的过程。
Removing the linear interseismic trend prior to inversion discards fault locking constraints, preventing the post-2010 fault state from reaching a limit cycle and skewing single-cycle forecasts.
预先扣除震间线性趋势丢失了断层闭锁信息，导致单周期反演未能进入稳定极限环，影响未来滑移峰值预测。
First application of PINN-based dynamic inversion to real GNSS observations of a slow slip event to resolve continuous 2D spatial heterogeneity of rate-and-state friction parameters.
首次将PINN动力学同化应用于真实慢滑移GNSS观测，直接反演二维连续非均匀速率-状态摩擦参数。

kc: Applies PINN-based dynamic data assimilation to real GNSS time series of the 2010 Bungo Channel SSE to invert for continuous spatially varying rate-and-state frictional parameters.

Identifies a localized small nucleation length (Rc) region beneath southwest Shikoku that drives SSE initiation and subsequent westward propagation, greatly improving fits to rapid displacement changes over homogeneous-patch models.
Demonstrates that governing RSF and elasticity equations act as physics-based spatio-temporal regularization, resolving late-stage spatial slip separation without ad hoc Laplacian smoothing.

Evaluates multi-year forward slip predictions up to 2026.5, showing reasonable recurrence intervals (~6 years) and magnitudes (Mw 6.7–6.8) while identifying limitations from single-cycle detrended assimilation.
首次将基于PINN的动力学数据同化应用于2010年丰后水道慢滑移事件的真实GNSS时间序列，反演连续空间变化的速率-状态摩擦参数。
揭示了四国西南下方局部小成核长度（Rc）强不稳定性区域，解释了慢滑移在此成核并向西扩展引起位移突增的机制，显著优于均匀摩擦斑块模型。
证明了引入断层摩擦与弹性力学控制方程可提供物理一致的时空正则化，无需人为拉普拉斯平滑即可清晰分辨慢滑移后期的空间滑移分离。
开展了截至2026.5年的未来断层滑移预测，重现了约6年的复发周期和Mw 6.7–6.8震级特征，并指出了单周期去趋势同化对震间闭锁约束的不足。
me: Quasi-dynamic 3D planar fault modeling (120 km × 100 km, 2 × 2 km subfaults) governed by rate-and-state friction (aging law) in a homogeneous elastic half-space.
Dual fully-connected Physics-Informed Neural Networks: NN A maps (t, x, y) to slip velocity V and state θ; NN B maps (x, y) to frictional parameters a, a-b, and L.

Composite loss function combining weighted GNSS displacement misfit (Jdata), normalized PDE/ODE governing equation residuals at collocation points (Jode), and steady-state initial stress prior (Jini).

Transfer learning pre-optimization using synthetic GNSS data generated from a previous circular-patch MCMC solution (K24), followed by L-BFGS optimization on real data with laboratory-derived parameter bounds.
基于均匀弹性半空间中速率-状态摩擦定律（老化律）的准动态三维平面断层建模（120×100 km，划分为2×2 km子断层）。
双全连接物理信息神经网络架构：NN A将时空坐标映射为滑移速度V和状态变量θ；NN B将空间坐标映射为摩擦参数a、a-b和L。
复合损失函数优化：结合加权GNSS地表位移残差（Jdata）、配点处归一化控制方程残差（Jode）以及近稳态初始应力先验正则化项（Jini）。
利用前人圆形斑块MCMC反演模型（K24）生成的合成GNSS数据进行迁移学习预训练，再结合实验室摩擦参数界限约束使用L-BFGS算法同化真实数据。
de: Daily 3-component GNSS coordinate time series from 86 GEONET stations around the Bungo Channel spanning July 2006 to June 2012 (2,192 days), detrended for steady interseismic motion.
Synthetic GNSS dataset based on the K24 circular-patch MAP model with realistic covariance noise used for neural network pre-training.
Sensitivity inversion removing laboratory inequality constraints (0 ≤ a, b ≤ 0.01) and forward Runge-Kutta integration up to 2026.5 to test robustness and forecasting.
丰后水道周边86个GEONET站点2006年7月至2012年6月（共2192天）的三分量日解GNSS位移时间序列（已扣除震间线性趋势）。
基于K24圆形斑块模型生成并添加真实协方差高斯噪声的合成GNSS数据集，用于神经网络迁移学习预训练。
去除实验室摩擦参数不等式约束（0 ≤ a, b ≤ 0.01）的敏感性反演实验，以及使用龙格-库塔法积分至2026.5年的前向滑移预测验证。
li: Subtracting a constant linear interseismic trend prior to inversion removes information about interseismic fault locking and creeping outside the SSE patch.
Single-cycle data assimilation cannot bring the post-2010 fault state into a stable limit cycle, causing the predicted 2014 SSE to exhibit overly high peak slip rates.

Small timing misfits around SSE nucleation (2010.0–2010.3) remain, likely due to simplified planar fault geometry, homogeneous elasticity, and pure RSF physics neglecting fluids or brittle-ductile transitions.
反演前扣除线性震间趋势导致丢失了震间断层闭锁和SSE斑块外蠕滑约束信息。
单周期数据同化未能使断层状态达到稳定极限环，导致预测的2014年慢滑移峰值滑移速率偏高且空间分布偏移。
在2010.0–2010.3成核阶段仍存在微小时间偏差，可能源于简化平面断层几何、均匀弹性介质假设以及未考虑孔隙流体或脆韧性转换等复杂物理机制。

tm.why: The paper directly models slow slip events (SSEs) in the Bungo Channel using rate-and-state friction laws and estimates spatially heterogeneous fault frictional properties.
The core methodology employs Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to represent continuous spatial friction parameters and temporal slip evolution.
The study formulates a high-dimensional non-linear dynamic inversion assimilating geodetic time series into coupled differential equations of elasticity and friction.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 10-page article PDF including main text, equations, figures 1–4, and Methods section.

sum: This study investigates the effect of structural slenderness on the seismic reliability of dual frame-wall buildings in Mexico City's soft-soil Lake Zone, designed per the 2017 building regulations (RCCDMX17/NTC17). Using OpenSees and SIB platforms, the authors perform nonlinear Monte Carlo simulations on 11-, 15-, and 20-story regular building archetypes (aspect ratios 2.1 < λ < 3.89) subjected to hybrid simulated orthogonal earthquake motions. A cascade-forward backpropagation neural network with 18 inputs and two hidden layers (30 and 35 neurons) is trained as a surrogate model to predict the Secant Stiffness Reduction Index and Cornell reliability index (β). The neural surrogate achieves correlation coefficients around R=0.87 and reveals that structural reliability progressively decreases as slenderness and correlated height, mass, and period increase, showing lower reliability near λ≈3.0 (β=3.41 for 250-year return period). This provides a data-driven framework for evaluating seismic code irregularity thresholds.

sum: This study presents the first regional, partially nonergodic ground-motion model (GMM) using strain-rate data from a 400-channel DAS array in Hualien City, Taiwan. Analyzing peak strain rates and Fourier amplitudes from 77 earthquakes, the authors extend classical GMM frameworks to incorporate DAS-specific factors: cable coupling (installation/environment), cable orientation, and channel correlation (modeled via Matérn kernels). The model achieves magnitude-distance scaling comparable to classical GMMs. Cable coupling is identified as a dominant, frequency-dependent source of within-event variability, while orientation plays a minor role. Modeling channel correlation significantly reduces channel-related standard deviations, demonstrating that DAS-derived ground motions require a fundamentally different framework from seismometer-based GMMs for seismic hazard assessment.
本文利用台湾花莲400通道DAS阵列数据，构建了首个区域半非遍历性DAS地震动模型（GMM）。研究分析了77次地震数据，在传统GMM中引入光缆耦合、方向及通道相关性。结果表明，光缆耦合是事件内变率的主要频变来源，而方向性影响较小；引入通道相关性显著降低了标准差。该研究为密集光纤地震危险性评估奠定了基……

sum: Locating earthquakes near or outside seismic network perimeters is challenging because standard network methods suffer from poor azimuthal coverage and distance–depth trade-offs, while array methods assume planar wavefronts valid only for distant sources. This paper introduces NetArray, a unified location framework based on a planar–radial decomposition of interstation P-wave lag times that accounts for wavefront curvature. The resulting semianalytical cost function jointly resolves back azimuth, epicentral distance, and horizontal slowness without requiring a velocity model. Source depth is determined subsequently from a 1D velocity model, decoupling epicentral distance from depth. Synthetic tests and an application to 17 earthquakes recorded by a five-station virtual array near the Mendocino Triple Junction demonstrate that NetArray outperforms standard array back-azimuth estimates, establishes minimum/maximum distance bounds via regularization, and mitigates the severe offshore distance overestimation observed in the ShakeAlert EPIC earthquake early warning system.
针对台网边缘及网外地震定位难题，本文提出统一台网与台阵方法的NetArray算法。该方法利用台站间P波到时差的平面-径向分解显式考虑波前曲率，构建不依赖速度模型的半解析代价函数，联合反演反方位角、震中距和水平慢度；随后结合一维速度模型约束震源深度，从而解耦震中距与深度的折衷关系，并通过正则化方法给出……

t: NetArray decomposes interstation lag times into planar and radial wavefront curvature terms, solving for back azimuth, epicentral distance, and horizontal slowness via Monte Carlo downhill simplex optimization before inferring depth from a 1D velocity model.
将台站间时差分解为平面与径向曲率项，通过蒙特卡洛单纯形法求解方位角、震中距和慢度，再由1D模型确定深度。
Tested on two sets of 10,000 synthetic AK135 sources and applied to 17 real earthquakes recorded by a five-station virtual array (2.5–25 km intersensor spacing) near the Mendocino Triple Junction.

Introduces a regularization-based bilinear fitting scheme to quantify minimum and maximum epicentral distance bounds.

Downhill simplex optimization (Nelder-Mead) combined with Monte Carlo random initialization and cosine parameter mapping.
Regularized cost function inversion with bilinear curve fitting to evaluate minimum and maximum epicentral distance bounds.
基于余弦定理的台站间P波到时差平面-径向分解。
结合蒙特卡洛随机初始化与余弦参数映射的下山单纯形优化算法（Nelder-Mead）。
利用带正则化项的代价函数反演及双线性拟合确定最小和最大震中距界限。

Real P-wave arrival times from 17 offshore and coastal earthquakes (selected from a 53-event catalog) recorded by a 5-station virtual array (networks BK, NC, CE) near the Mendocino Triple Junction.
基于AK135一维模型和TauP工具包生成的3个台阵内外典型合成算例，以及两组各10,000个随机合成震源测试。
门多西诺三联点附近5个永久台站（属BK、NC、CE台网）组成的虚拟台阵记录的17次地震实时P波到时数据。
li: Assumes a single constant horizontal slowness across the entire array (array-constant slowness approximation), which introduces errors where the slowness-distance gradient is steep (e.g., 130–140 km Moho refraction crossover or <20 km).
Depth sensitivity diminishes at larger epicentral distances (>140 km) where horizontal slowness curves converge to a depth-independent constant.

在较大震中距（>140 km）处，不同深度的水平慢度曲线趋于合并，导致深度分辨率降低。

sum: Slow earthquakes have traditionally been studied using either continuum elastic/frictional models to capture propagation patterns or stochastic Brownian walk models to explain statistical properties like constant scaled energy and f^-1 high-frequency spectral decay. This paper bridges both approaches using a simple quasi-static discrete elastic model. Fault elements are either locked or slipping at a fixed speed V_slip, with locked elements possessing either an intact static strength or a reduced strength if recently slipped. Tuned to Cascadia parameters, the model reproduces characteristic events with ~1-year recurrence intervals, ~10 km/day propagation speeds, rapid tremor reversals, proportionality between squared moment acceleration and moment rate, and f^-1 spectral decay. By approximating the slipping element population as a linear birth-death process weighted by elastic interaction kernels, the authors analytically link frictional parameters to Brownian stochastic attributes. However, simulated scaled energy is six orders of magnitude below observations, suggesting natural slip involves wider slip-speed variations.
本研究开发了一个简单的准静态离散弹性模型，将慢滑移的弹性摩擦迁移模型与布朗随机统计模型相结合。断层单元处于锁定或恒定速度滑动状态，近期滑动过的锁定单元具有较低的静摩擦强度。通过调整静态强度、滑动速度和网格间距以匹配卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带参数，模型成功生成复发周期约1年、传播速度约10 km/天以及快速反向……

t: A 2D discrete quasi-static fault model in a 3D elastic medium uses event-driven timesteps, constant slip velocity, and two static friction levels (intact and reduced) plus stochastic birth-death analysis.
采用事件驱动时间步长、恒定滑移速度和双静摩擦强度的二维离散准静态弹性模型，结合线性生灭随机分析。
Numerical simulations on a 120 km × 2.5 km fault grid (50 m elements) driven at 10^-9 m/s, parameterized to mimic Episodic Tremor and Slip in northern Cascadia.
在120 km × 2.5 km断层网格（50 m单元）上进行数值模拟，参数设定模拟北卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带ETS事件。
For epsilon_D = 0.6, the model produces ~1-year recurrence intervals, ~10 km/d propagation speeds, f^-1 high-frequency spectral decay above ~2×10^-5 Hz, and constant scaled energy (~1.3×10^7 Nm/s^3).
当epsilon_D=0.6时，模型重现约1年复发周期、10 km/d传播速度、f^-1高频谱衰减及恒定标度能量。
The simulated scaled energy is six orders of magnitude lower than subduction zone observations, and moment rates lack observed strong intermittency due to the fixed slip speed restriction.
因固定滑移速度假设，模拟标度能量比观测值低6个数量级，且矩率缺乏强间歇性。

Unifies elastic/frictional migration models and Brownian walk statistical models of slow slip within a single minimal-parameter discrete model and links them analytically via a linear birth-death SDE.
在单一离散模型中统一了慢滑移的摩擦迁移与布朗统计特征，并通过线性生灭随机微分方程建立解析关联。

kc: Developed a minimal-parameter discrete quasi-static elastic model with two static friction levels and a constant slip speed that reproduces both SSE migration patterns and Brownian statistical properties.
Derived fracture-mechanics analytical estimates for minimum recurrence interval, rupture propagation speed, and highest resolvable frequency, showing close agreement with numerical simulations.

Formulated a linear birth-death stochastic differential equation weighted by elastic kernels to analytically predict equilibrium moment rate, lower corner frequency, and the ratio of squared moment acceleration to moment rate.

Demonstrated that constant-slip-speed models underpredict natural slow earthquake scaled energy by six orders of magnitude, pointing to intermittent slip with a much wider range of slip speeds in nature.
开发了一个具有两个静摩擦强度水平和恒定滑动速度的极简参数离散准静态弹性模型，同时重现了慢滑移迁移模式和布朗统计特性。
利用断裂力学推导出最小复发周期、破裂传播速度和最高可分辨频率的解析估计，与数值模拟结果高度吻合。
建立了由弹性核加权的线性生灭随机微分方程，解析预测了平衡矩率、低频转折频率以及矩加速度平方与矩率的比值。
证明恒定滑移速度模型预测的标度能量比自然慢地震观测值低6个数量级，表明自然界慢滑移具有更宽的滑移速度范围和更强的间歇性。
me: Discrete 2D quasi-static fault simulation embedded in a 3D elastic medium bounded by rigid driving walls, solved via an efficient O(N) event-driven timestep algorithm.
Wavenumber-domain elastic stiffness kernel computation assuming zero Poisson's ratio for pure dip-direction slip.
Linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM) analysis of the effective slip-weakening cohesive zone behind the rupture tip.
Stochastic calculus and linear birth-death process modeling of active interior slipping elements to derive moment rate statistics and spectra.
在受刚性驱动壁边界限制的三维弹性介质中嵌入二维离散准静态断层模型，采用高效的O(N)事件驱动时间步长算法求解。
假设泊松比为零（纯倾向滑动），在波数域计算弹性刚度核函数。
对破裂前端后方的有效滑移弱化内聚区进行线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）分析。
采用随机微积分和线性生灭过程对内部活跃滑动单元进行建模，推导矩率统计特征与频谱。

sum: Estimating eruptive volumes from volcano deformation alone often underestimates totals due to magma compressibility. This study integrates 15 years of TerraSAR-X and Sentinel-1 InSAR time series, TROPOMI satellite SO2 data, airborne gas measurements, petrologic constraints, and thermodynamic volatile solubility modeling (Sulfur_X) to constrain the 2014–2023 unrest and eruption at Semisopochnoi, Alaska. Bayesian inversions of ramp-corrected InSAR data resolve a spherical magma source at 6.5–7.5 km depth bsl, offset ~5 km east of the vent, with 42 Mm³ inflation and 12.4 Mm³ deflation. Accounting for ~1.7 vol% exsolved volatiles increases magma compressibility and yields a best-estimate dense-rock equivalent eruptive volume of 20.3 Mm³ (bounded between 12.4 and 32.0 Mm³), indicating only ~30% of intruded magma erupted. Additionally, Coulomb stress modeling shows that inflation-induced stresses explain the offset vent location, while unclamping from the 2014 M7.9 Rat Island earthquake promoted prolonged eruptive activity.
本研究整合15年TerraSAR-X与Sentinel-1 InSAR时序数据、TROPOMI卫星SO2及机载气体观测、岩石学约束与热力学挥发分溶解度模型，研究了阿拉斯加Semisopochnoi火山2014–2023年的动荡与喷发。经轨道趋势校正的贝叶斯反演揭示了位于海平面下6.5–7.5 km、……

t: Combines Bayesian spherical-source InSAR inversions (VMOD), petrologic sulfur degassing calculations, thermodynamic volatile solubility modeling (Sulfur_X), multiphase magma compressibility corrections, and Coulomb static stress modeling.
结合贝叶斯球形源InSAR反演、岩石学硫脱气计算、热力学挥发分模型、压缩性校正及库仑应力模拟。
A 15-year dual-satellite InSAR time series from descending TerraSAR-X (2011–2015) and Sentinel-1 (2014–2024) SAR scenes, alongside TROPOMI satellite SO2 data and 2021 USGS airborne gas measurements.
2011–2024年TerraSAR-X与Sentinel-1双卫星InSAR时序、TROPOMI卫星SO2及2021年…

Geodetic deflation (12.4 Mm³) and SO2 degassing (32.0 Mm³) bound the eruptive volume, while thermodynamic compressibility corrections yield a best estimate of 20.3 Mm³ from a reservoir at 6.5–7.5 km depth.
储层位于6.5–7.5 km深处；大地测量收缩（12.4 Mm³）与脱气量（32 Mm³）限定了喷发体积，最佳估计为20…

Lack of direct melt inclusion volatile measurements for the 2018–2023 eruption and TROPOMI detection limits introduce large uncertainties, expanding the 90th percentile eruptive volume range to 10.3–105.1 Mm³.
缺乏该次喷发熔体包裹体挥发分实测数据及卫星SO2检测限制，导致90%置信区间达10.3–105.1 Mm³。

Integrates 15-year ramp-corrected multi-sensor InSAR, airborne/satellite sulfur data, and thermodynamic degassing models to partition the Semisopochnoi magma budget and link regional megathrust unclamping to prolonged eruption.
融合多源InSAR、硫脱气与热力学模型量化岩浆收支，并揭示区域大地震应力解耦对长期喷发的作用。

kc: Constructed a 15-year dual-satellite (TerraSAR-X and Sentinel-1) InSAR time series with a joint spherical-source and bi-linear orbital ramp correction for small volcanic islands.
Constrained the 2018–2023 Semisopochnoi dense-rock equivalent eruptive volume between 12.4 Mm³ and 32.0 Mm³, with a compressibility-corrected best estimate of 20.3 Mm³.
Established a complete magma budget showing ~30% of the 65.6 Mm³ intruded magma erupted, leaving ~11.7 Mm³ in the shallow conduit and ~33.6 Mm³ in the deep reservoir.
Demonstrated through Coulomb stress modeling that the 2014 M7.9 Rat Island earthquake caused >10 kPa unclamping beneath the volcano, facilitating magma ascent.
构建了跨越15年的双卫星（TerraSAR-X与Sentinel-1）InSAR时序，并提出了适用于小型火山岛的球形源与双线性轨道趋势联合校正方法。
将2018–2023年Semisopochnoi火山喷发体积约束在12.4至32.0 Mm³之间，经压缩性校正后的最佳估计值为20.3 Mm³。
建立了完整的岩浆收支平衡，表明65.6 Mm³侵入岩浆中仅约30%喷出，约11.7 Mm³残留于浅部通道，约33.6 Mm³残留于深部储层。
通过库仑应力模拟证明2014年M7.9 Rat Island地震在火山下方产生了>10 kPa的解耦张应力，促进了岩浆上升与长期喷发。

sum: This study integrates vintage 2D seismic reflection data with geomorphic analyses of river longitudinal profiles to reconstruct the temporal and spatial evolution of active normal faults in the South Gulf of Evia rift, Central Greece. By establishing a new offshore seismic-stratigraphic age model, the authors constrain the linkage of the Varnavas Fault segments to between 12 and 245 ka. They couple these subsurface constraints with tectonic knickzone analyses to estimate fault initiation times across different bedrock erodibility scenarios. This integrated workflow successfully bridges the gap between millennial and million-year timescales, providing a comprehensive framework for understanding fault growth, interaction, and associated seismic hazards in active rift settings.

sum: This paper presents a novel 3D magnetic inversion framework that accounts for self-demagnetization, designed to image shallow volcanic structures with high susceptibility. By combining finite-element and volume-integral formulations, the method decouples the internal magnetization calculation from the external anomaly evaluation, avoiding mesh refinement around dense flight lines and reducing artifacts. The framework is validated using an analytical ellipsoid benchmark and applied to helicopter-borne magnetic data from Izu-Oshima volcano. The resulting 3D susceptibility model successfully images shallow magnetic layers from recent volcanic activity, deeper low-susceptibility zones indicating hydrothermal demagnetization, and buried magnetic bodies around Mt. Mihara. This approach provides a robust tool for interpreting high-resolution magnetic surveys in basaltic volcanic environments.
本文提出了一种考虑自退磁效应的全新三维磁反演框架，用于成像高磁化率的浅部火山结构。该方法结合有限元与体积积分公式，将内部磁化强度计算与外部异常评估解耦，避免了密集测线周围的网格细化，减少了伪影。通过解析椭球体基准测试验证后，该框架被应用于伊豆大岛火山的直升机磁测数据。反演结果成功重建了浅部近期火山产……

sum: This Zenodo repository hosts the three-dimensional P-wave velocity (Vp) and Vp/Vs ratio models of Mauna Loa and Kilauea volcanoes on the Island of Hawaii, originally published by Lin et al. (2014). The models were constructed using local earthquake tomography. The dataset includes Vp and Vp/Vs models in text and CSV formats, mapped on a grid with 3 km horizontal node spacing and 10 depth layers ranging from -1 to 35 km. It serves as a valuable resource for studying volcanic plumbing systems, magma reservoirs, and seismic hazards in Hawaii.
