sum: Unsupervised clustering of seismic waveforms typically requires fixed time windows, feature engineering, or a predefined number of clusters, limiting physical interpretability and applicability to variable-duration signals. This study introduces Incremental Buffered Dynamic Time Warping Clustering (IB-DTWC), an unsupervised algorithm operating directly on single-component time-series data using five physically interpretable parameters. It initializes core cluster medoids via k-medoids on a pairwise DTW distance matrix of a small subset, then incrementally assigns new events or routes dissimilar events into temporary buffer clusters that upgrade to core clusters once populated, leaving unclustered events as outliers. Tested on ~3,000 labelled volcano-seismic events from Soufrière Hills Volcano, IB-DTWC achieves 69.39% accuracy, matching prior supervised neural networks. A second case study on 1,464 beamformed Antarctic icequakes from the Watzmann array identifies eight distinct waveform classes while isolating overlapping events as outliers, demonstrating scalable, waveform-native clustering for continuous monitoring.
本研究提出增量缓冲动态时间规整聚类算法（IB-DTWC），无需特征工程或固定时间窗即可直接在时域对变长单分量地震波形进行无监督聚类。方法先在小样本DTW距离矩阵上进行k-medoids初始聚类，再通过距离阈值与缓冲簇机制增量分配新样本、升级新核心簇并自动剔除噪声异常值。在蒙特塞拉特苏弗里耶尔火山约3……

t: IB-DTWC performs initial k-medoids clustering on a subset pairwise DTW distance matrix, then incrementally assigns remaining variable-length waveforms to existing medoids or temporary buffer clusters that upgrade to core clusters once reaching b_min samples.
在小样本DTW距离矩阵上进行k-medoids初始聚类，再通过缓冲簇机制增量分配变长波形、升级新簇并剔除异常值。

Evaluated on ~3,000 labelled single-station volcano-seismic events (0.2–10 Hz) from Soufrière Hills Volcano, Montserrat (January 1997), and 1,464 beamformed vertical-component icequake events (3–8 Hz) from the 16-station Watzmann array in Antarctica.
使用苏弗里耶尔火山约3000个单台标记事件（0.2–10 Hz）及南极Watzmann台阵1464个波束成形冰震事件（3…

On the Soufrière Hills dataset, IB-DTWC achieves 69.39% clustering accuracy (comparable to ~70% from supervised ANNs), and on the Antarctic Watzmann array it identifies 8 distinct icequake waveform clusters with 7% outliers.
火山数据集聚类准确率达69.39%（媲美有监督神经网络的70%），南极冰震数据识别出8个簇及7%异常值。

The algorithm operates only on single-component waveforms (excluding multi-component polarization) and can become computationally expensive if many buffer clusters accumulate under a low admissibility threshold.
仅支持单分量波形输入（忽略多分量极化），且缓冲簇过多时计算开销较大。

Scales DTW-based raw waveform clustering to large continuous seismic datasets via an incremental buffered architecture that dynamically forms new clusters and isolates outliers using physically interpretable parameters.
通过增量缓冲架构和物理可解释参数，将基于DTW的原始变长波形无监督聚类扩展到大规模连续监测数据。

kc: Develops Incremental Buffered Dynamic Time Warping Clustering (IB-DTWC) for direct time-domain clustering of variable-duration seismic waveforms without cropping or zero-padding.
Introduces an incremental buffer mechanism that automatically isolates noisy/overlapping outliers and dynamically forms new clusters without recomputing the full pairwise distance matrix.
Formulates clustering control through five physically interpretable parameters (subset size, Sakoe-Chiba time shift radius, initial clusters, threshold admissibility, minimum buffer size).
Achieves 69.39% clustering accuracy on labelled Soufrière Hills volcano-seismic events (comparable to ~70% from supervised ANNs) and discovers 8 waveform classes in Antarctic icequake array data.
开发了增量缓冲动态时间规整聚类算法（IB-DTWC），无需截断或补零即可直接在时域对变长地震波形进行聚类。
引入增量缓冲机制，无需重新计算完整成对距离矩阵即可自动隔离噪声/重叠异常值并动态生成新簇。
通过五个具有明确物理意义的参数（初始子集大小、Sakoe-Chiba时间偏移半径、初始簇数、阈值容许度、最小缓冲样本数）控制聚类过程。
在苏弗里耶尔火山标记数据集上实现69.39%的准确率（媲美约70%的有监督神经网络），并在南极冰震台阵数据中发现8类特征波形。
me: Z-normalisation of individual single-component seismic traces followed by length-normalised Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) constrained by a Sakoe-Chiba band radius r.
Initial k-medoids clustering on an n × n pairwise DTW distance matrix (n ≤ 500) to establish k core cluster medoids and statistical distance threshold τ = μ + aσ.
Incremental buffered assignment where samples exceeding τ from core medoids enter temporary buffer clusters, which upgrade to new core clusters upon reaching b_min samples.
Final reassignment pass computing DTW distances of all samples against all C = k + l core medoids with a recalculated threshold τ_final, classifying remaining buffered events as outliers.
对单分量地震记录进行Z标准化，并采用受Sakoe-Chiba带宽半径r约束的长度归一化动态时间规整（DTW）计算波形距离。
在n×n成对DTW距离矩阵（n≤500）上进行初始k-medoids聚类，确定k个核心簇中心点及统计距离阈值τ = μ + aσ。
增量缓冲分配：与核心中心点距离超过τ的样本进入临时缓冲簇，当缓冲簇样本数达到b_min时升级为新核心簇。
最终重分配步骤：计算所有样本到C = k + l个核心中心点的DTW距离并重算阈值τ_final，留在缓冲簇中的样本归类为异常值。
de: Soufrière Hills Volcano (Montserrat) proof-of-concept dataset: ~3,000 manually labelled single-station events from January 1997 across 6 classes (VTE, LPE, HYB, ROC, LPE+ROC, MISC), bandpass filtered 0.2–10 Hz.

Antarctic icequake case study: 1,464 variable-duration events recorded Jan–Jul 2010 by the 16-station vertical-component Watzmann array near Neumayer Station III, filtered 3–8 Hz, extracted via STA/LTA (3 s / 40 s), cross-correlation screened, and beamformed.
蒙特塞拉特苏弗里耶尔火山验证数据集：1997年1月单台记录的约3000个手动标记事件，涵盖6种类型（VTE、LPE、HYB、ROC、LPE+ROC、MISC），0.2–10 Hz带通滤波。
南极冰震案例研究：2010年1月至7月Neumayer III站附近16台垂直分量Watzmann台阵记录的1464个变长事件，经3–8 Hz滤波、STA/LTA触发提取、互相关筛选及波束成形处理。
li: Restricted to single-component time-series inputs, excluding multi-component polarization and wave-type attributes.
Computational cost can grow significantly if a low admissibility threshold produces a large number of temporary buffer clusters.
Rare event classes (such as the 67 volcano-tectonic events in the Montserrat dataset) may fail to reach the minimum buffer size or distinct medoid status and be relegated to outliers.
仅限于单分量时间序列输入，无法直接利用多分量极化和波型属性。
若容许度阈值设置过低导致临时缓冲簇数量过多，计算成本会显著增加。
稀有事件类别（如蒙特塞拉特数据集中仅67个的火山构造事件）可能因样本不足被归为异常值。

tm.why: Introduces an unsupervised machine-learning clustering algorithm (IB-DTWC) for grouping raw, variable-duration seismic time series.
Evaluates and applies the algorithm on volcano-seismic events from Soufrière Hills Volcano and Antarctic icequake array data from the Ekström Ice Shelf.
Automatically clusters seismic event catalogs, identifies outliers, and adapts incrementally to emerging event classes during continuous seismic monitoring.

ev.notes: Full 18-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analysed, including mathematical formulation of DTW and IB-DTWC (§2–3), Soufrière Hills Volcano quantitative benchmark (§4, Tables 1–2, Figs 3–6), and Antarctic Watzmann array icequake case study (§5, Figs 7–8).

sum: Monitoring microseismicity in the ice-covered Central Arctic is logistically challenging with traditional ocean-bottom seismometers. Moored hydrophones record hydroacoustic T-phases from earthquakes, but manual annotation is labor-intensive and machine learning detectors require extensive training data. This study adapts a standalone Regions Of Interest (ROI) image-processing algorithm (using median thresholding, Gaussian smoothing, and Canny double-threshold hysteresis) on power spectral density spectrograms to automatically detect and characterize T-phases. Applied to 1,967 recordings from three CAATEX moorings in the Nansen Basin (2019–2020), the detector identified 82 of 96 manually labelled earthquake events (71% precision, 74% recall across moorings) and discovered 41 unannotated seismic signals. T-phase energy concentrated between 3 and 50 Hz (peaking around 10–30 Hz). False positives were primarily caused by low-frequency (<20 Hz) mooring flow noise, while biophony and sea-ice transients were effectively suppressed. The lightweight method also detected 100% of T-phases in mid-Atlantic and Indian Ocean benchmark datasets.
针对北极冰盖区微震监测难题，本文提出一种基于功率谱密度时频图感兴趣区域（ROI）图像处理的水声T波独立自动检测方法。该方法结合中值阈值降噪、高斯平滑与双阈值滞后边缘检测，仅需极少参数调节和计算资源。应用于2019–2020年南森海盆CAATEX实验3套潜标水听器数据（1,967个文件），算法成功识别……

t: Spectrograms are denoised using a frequency-wise median threshold and a 5 s by 2.5 Hz Gaussian filter, then segmented into Regions Of Interest (ROIs) via Canny double-threshold hysteresis (75 and 60 dB re 1 µPa²/Hz) and binary connected-component masking.
对时频图进行中值阈值和5s×2.5Hz高斯滤波降噪，再用Canny双阈值滞后和二值掩膜提取ROI。

The dataset comprises 1,967 hydroacoustic recordings (45-min duration every 12 hours, 976 Hz sampling rate) collected at 1,000–1,050 m depth across three CAATEX moorings (NERSC1–3) in the Nansen Basin from September 2019 to July 2020.
2019年9月至2020年7月南森海盆3套CAATEX潜标采集的1,967个水声文件（每12小时45分钟）。

The ROI detector identified 82 of 96 manually labelled earthquake events (85%), achieving 71% overall precision and 74% recall across moorings (up to 92% precision at NERSC1 and 86% recall at NERSC3), while discovering 41 unannotated seismic signals.
检出96个人工标注地震中的82个（85%），总体准确率71%、召回率74%，并新发现41个地震信号。

Due to the 1 s spectrogram temporal resolution and Gaussian smoothing merging P- and T-phases, the algorithm cannot pick precise arrival times for earthquake localization, and suffers false positives from <20 Hz flow noise.
1秒时间分辨率及P与T波合并使其无法精确拾取到时定位，且受20Hz以下流噪声误报影响。

First standalone application of spectrogram ROI image processing to geophonic T-phase detection, requiring only three main parameters and minimal compute (10–20 s per 45-min file) without machine-learning training bias.
首次将时频图ROI算法独立用于地震T波检测，参数极少、计算快且无机器学习训练偏差。

kc: Adapted a standalone Regions Of Interest (ROI) spectrogram image-processing algorithm for automated earthquake T-phase detection with minimal parameter tuning.
Validated the detector on nearly one year of Arctic hydroacoustic data (CAATEX moorings in the Nansen Basin), achieving 85% event detection (82/96 events) and discovering 41 new seismic signals.
Quantified spectro-temporal features and Received Levels of Arctic T-phases via PCA and PSD analysis, showing energy concentrated in 3–50 Hz and clear separation from low-frequency flow noise.
Demonstrated zero-shot transferability by detecting all 82 annotated T-phases in benchmark hydroacoustic datasets from the mid-Atlantic (HYDROMOMAR) and Indian Ocean (OHASISBIO).
将基于时频图的感兴趣区域（ROI）图像处理算法改进为独立的地震T波自动检测器，仅需极少参数调节。
在北极南森海盆近一年的CAATEX潜标水声数据上验证了算法，检出85%的已知事件（82/96）并新发现41个地震信号。
利用主成分分析（PCA）和功率谱密度量化了北极T波的时频特征与接收声级，表明其能量集中在3–50 Hz且与低频流噪声明显分离。
在中大西洋（HYDROMOMAR）和印度洋（OHASISBIO）公开水声基准数据集上实现零样本迁移，成功检出全部82个标注T波。
me: Power Spectral Density (PSD) spectrogram computation using 2 s Hann windows with 50% overlap (1 s temporal and 0.5 Hz spectral resolution).
Pre-processing via frequency-wise median thresholding and a 2D Gaussian smoothing filter (kernel standard deviation of 5 s by 2.5 Hz) to suppress short biological and cryophonic transients.

Canny double-threshold hysteresis edge detection (thresholds of 75 and 60 dB re 1 µPa²/Hz) and connected-component binarisation masking (adapted from scikit-maad) with post-filtering (spectral centroid < 60 Hz, area > 25 bins²).
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and 95th-percentile PSD empirical probability density analysis on extracted spectro-temporal ROI features.
使用2秒汉宁窗和50%重叠计算功率谱密度（PSD）时频图（时间分辨率1秒，频率分辨率0.5 Hz）。
采用沿频率轴的中值阈值处理和二维高斯平滑滤波（核标准差为5秒×2.5 Hz）进行预处理，以抑制短时生物声和海冰瞬态噪声。
应用Canny双阈值滞后边缘检测（阈值75和60 dB re 1 µPa²/Hz）及连通域二值化掩膜（改进自scikit-maad），并结合后处理滤波（频谱质心<60 Hz，面积>25 bins²）。
对提取的ROI时频特征进行主成分分析（PCA）及第95百分位PSD经验概率密度统计分析。
de: 1,967 hydroacoustic .wav recordings (45 min 12 s every 12 hours, 976 Hz sample rate, 7 Hz hardware high-pass filter) from three CAATEX moorings (NERSC1–3) at ~1,000–1,050 m depth in the Nansen Basin (Sept 2019 – July 2020).
Manual reference catalog of 96 earthquake events annotated on NERSC1 using Triton software and cross-checked across all three moorings, categorized into Strong, Medium, and Weak signal qualities.
Comparison against 16 contemporary regional earthquakes reported by the Norwegian National Seismic Network (NNSN) and International Seismological Centre (ISC).
External generalization test on public benchmark hydroacoustic datasets from the mid-Atlantic Ocean (HYDROMOMAR) and southern Indian Ocean (OHASISBIO) containing 82 annotated T-phases.
南森海盆3套CAATEX潜标（NERSC1–3，水深约1,000–1,050米）于2019年9月至2020年7月采集的1,967个水声录音文件（每12小时记录45分12秒，采样率976 Hz，7 Hz硬件高通滤波）。
使用Triton软件在NERSC1上人工标注并在三个潜标间交叉核对的96个地震事件参考目录，按信号质量分为强、中、弱三类。
与挪威国家地震台网（NNSN）和国际地震中心（ISC）同期记录的16个区域地震目录进行对比分析。
在中大西洋（HYDROMOMAR）和南印度洋（OHASISBIO）包含82个标注T波的公开水声基准数据集上进行外部泛化测试。
li: The 1 s spectrogram temporal resolution and merging of P- and T-phases during Gaussian smoothing prevent accurate seismic phase arrival-time picking and earthquake localization.
Low-frequency (< 20 Hz) continuous tonal flow noise from current-driven mooring pull-downs survives pre-processing and accounts for at least 66 of the 100 False Positives.
A 7 Hz hardware high-pass filter during CAATEX recording suppressed low-frequency seismic energy, slightly underestimating Maximum Received Levels and potentially hindering weak-signal detection.
Earthquake magnitudes and source levels cannot be estimated from the hydroacoustic ROIs alone because source-receiver distances remain unknown for unlocated events.
时频图1秒的时间分辨率以及高斯平滑导致的P波与T波合并，使得该算法目前无法用于精确的震相到时拾取和地震定位。
海流牵引潜标下沉产生的低频（<20 Hz）连续纯音流噪声难以被预处理滤除，导致了100个误报中的至少66个。
CAATEX数据采集时应用的7 Hz硬件高通滤波器抑制了低频地震能量，略微低估了最大接收声级并可能阻碍微弱信号检测。
由于未定位事件的震源距未知，目前无法仅从水声ROI数据推导震源声级和地震震级。

tm.why: The paper presents and evaluates an automated Regions Of Interest (ROI) spectrogram image-processing detector for identifying earthquake T-phase signals in Arctic Ocean hydroacoustic datasets.
The study utilizes moored hydrophone array recordings from the CAATEX experiment in the Nansen Basin as an alternative to ocean-bottom seismometers under sea ice.
The work investigates seismoacoustic T-phase propagation and detection within the Arctic Ocean soundscape, accounting for cryophony (sea-ice noise), biophony, and mooring flow noise.

ev.notes: Full 19-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 9 figures, 2 tables, methodology equations, and benchmark discussion.

sum: Polarization observables are widely used in geophysics due to their insensitivity to source wavelets and amplitude errors, yet a general metric for comparing arbitrary polarization states has been lacking. This paper introduces a unifying geometrical framework based on the Poincaré sphere and normalized Stokes parameters. The authors derive an intrinsic polarization misfit defined by the squared geodesic distance on the Poincaré sphere, and show how conventional metrics—based on tilt/ellipticity angles, spectral ratios (receiver functions), and cross-convolutions—map to this geometry. Theoretical analysis against four qualitative criteria (rotational invariance, complex scaling invariance, complete characterization, and finiteness) reveals that only the Poincaré (intrinsic) and normalized cross-product (extrinsic chordal) metrics satisfy all conditions. Extending frequency-domain multicomponent Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI) to polarization observables via Wirtinger-derived adjoint sources, synthetic 2D acoustic transmission tests demonstrate that Poincaré and normalized cross-product misfits accurately reconstruct smooth and fine-scale anomalies while avoiding spectral-ratio singularities.
偏振观测量因对震源子波和振幅误差不敏感而在地球物理中广泛应用，但一直缺乏比较任意偏振态的通用度量。本文引入基于庞加莱球和归一化斯托克斯参数的统一几何框架，推导出以球面测地线距离定义的本征偏振失配函数，并阐明了传统倾角/椭率角、谱比（接收函数）及互卷积失配与该几何空间的映射关系。理论分析表明，仅庞加莱……

t: Represents 2C polarization states on the Poincaré sphere via normalized Stokes parameters and defines an intrinsic misfit as the squared geodesic distance, deriving adjoint sources via Wirtinger derivatives for frequency-domain FWI.
利用归一化斯托克斯参数将二分量偏振映射至庞加莱球，以球面测地线距离平方定义本征失配并推导FWI伴随震源。

2D synthetic constant-density acoustic transmission experiment (Vp = 500 m/s) with -20% and +30% Gaussian anomalies and a ±2% checkerboard, inverted from 15 to 45 Hz using 2C particle velocity receivers.
基于含±20%~30%高斯异常与±2%棋盘格的二维声波模型，利用15~45 Hz二分量质点速度开展合成FWI测试。

Poincaré and normalized cross-product misfits satisfy all four theoretical invariance/finiteness criteria and accurately reconstruct both Gaussian and checkerboard velocity perturbations in FWI, whereas H/V and V/H spectral-ratio misfits diverge due to singularities.
庞加莱与归一化叉积失配满足全部四项理论准则并精确重建速度模型，而H/V和V/H谱比失配因奇异性导致反演发散。

Polarization observables alone cannot constrain the homogeneous (very long-wavelength) background velocity in isotropic media, and the framework currently assumes deterministic, pure 2C polarization states.
纯偏振观测量无法约束各向同性均匀背景速度，且当前方法假设确定性无噪的二分量纯偏振态。

Unifies diverse geophysical polarization metrics on the Poincaré sphere—proving spectral ratios are stereographic projections—and introduces singularity-free intrinsic geodesic and extrinsic chordal misfits for multicomponent FWI.
在庞加莱球上统一了各类偏振度量，证明谱比对应极射投影，并提出无奇异性的FWI本征与外在偏振失配函数。

kc: Introduced a unifying geometrical representation of two-component polarization states using the Poincaré sphere and normalized Stokes parameters.

Derived a novel intrinsic polarization misfit based on the geodesic distance on the Poincaré sphere and established its exact analytical/geometrical links to angle, spectral-ratio, and cross-product metrics.
Proved that spectral ratios (frequency-domain receiver functions) correspond to stereographic projections on the Poincaré sphere, explaining their inherent singularities and directional biases.
Formulated adjoint sources for eight polarization-based misfit functions and demonstrated the superiority of Poincaré and normalized cross-product metrics in 2D multicomponent FWI.
利用庞加莱球和归一化斯托克斯参数，提出了二分量偏振态的统一几何表征框架。
推导出基于庞加莱球测地线距离的新型本征偏振失配函数，并建立了其与角度、谱比和叉积度量的解析与几何联系。
证明了偏振谱比（频率域接收函数）对应于庞加莱球上的极射赤面投影，从几何上解释了其固有奇异性和方向偏差。
推导了八种偏振失配函数的伴随震源，并在二维多分量全波形反演中证实了庞加莱度量和归一化叉积度量的优越性。
me: Decomposition of polarization tensors into Pauli spin matrices to obtain normalized Stokes vectors on the Poincaré sphere.
Theoretical evaluation of polarization misfit functions against rotational invariance, complex scaling invariance, completeness, and finiteness criteria.
Frequency-domain multicomponent adjoint-state FWI using Wirtinger calculus to derive polarization adjoint sources and l-BFGS multiscale optimization.
将偏振张量分解为泡利自旋矩阵，以获取庞加莱球上的归一化斯托克斯矢量。
依据旋转不变性、复缩放不变性、完备偏振表征和有界性四大准则对不同偏振失配函数进行理论评估。
采用Wirtinger微积分推导偏振伴随震源，并结合l-BFGS多尺度优化实现频率域多分量伴随状态全波形反演。
de: 2D synthetic constant-density acoustic transmission experiment (250 m x 250 m) with a 500 m/s background, two Gaussian anomalies (-20% and +30%), and a ±2% checkerboard pattern.
Multiscale frequency-domain FWI across 7 frequencies from 15 Hz to 45 Hz using isotropic volume-injection sources and 2C particle-velocity receivers.
Analytical misfit topography mapping over 2D grids of tilt and ellipticity angles to evaluate rotational invariance and angle-coupling effects.
二维常密度声波透射合成实验（250 m × 250 m），包含500 m/s背景速度、两个高斯异常（-20%和+30%）以及±2%的棋盘格微扰。
使用各向同性体积注入震源和二分量质点速度接收器，在15 Hz至45 Hz的7个频段上进行多尺度频率域FWI。
在倾角和椭率角二维网格上计算解析失配函数地形图，以评估旋转不变性和角度耦合效应。
li: Purely polarization-based misfits cannot constrain the homogeneous (constant) background velocity in isotropic media because polarization states are identical in homogeneous models.
The formulation assumes deterministic, noise-free, and pure (rank-1) polarization states, neglecting mixed/depolarized states and statistical noise distributions.
The core Poincaré sphere derivation is restricted to two-component homogeneous physical vectors.
纯偏振失配函数无法约束各向同性介质中的均匀背景速度，因为均匀模型中的偏振态是相同的。
理论推导假设确定性、无噪声及纯偏振态（秩为1），未考虑混合/退偏振态及统计噪声分布。
核心的庞加莱球推导仅限于二分量同质物理矢量。

tm.why: The paper extends conventional multicomponent Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI) by deriving adjoint sources and misfit functions specifically for polarization observables.
The core contribution is a rigorous mathematical and geometrical analysis of data-space metrics on the Poincaré sphere for inverse problems.
The paper extensively analyzes receiver-function and spectral-ratio misfits, proving they correspond to stereographic projections on the Poincaré sphere.

ev.notes: Full 81-page unedited manuscript PDF (including Appendices A–F, 11 main figures, 9 appendix figures, and 3 tables) was read and analyzed.

sum: This paper introduces Syvä-Suomi, a multidisciplinary geophysical initiative designed to image the Finnish lithosphere at an unprecedented national scale. To overcome the limitations of fragmented legacy datasets, the project establishes a standardized, uniform-coverage framework, beginning with a nationwide long-period magnetotelluric (MT) survey. The ultimate goal is to construct a dynamic digital twin of the lithosphere by assimilating past, present, and future geoscientific observations. This national model will support critical applications in resource exploration, geothermal energy, geological waste disposal, and geohazard mitigation, while providing a collaborative training ground for geoscientists and AI researchers.
本文介绍了Syvä-Suomi计划，这是芬兰一项旨在在全国范围内对岩石圈进行高分辨率成像的多学科地球物理倡议。为解决历史数据空间覆盖不均和分辨率受限的问题，该项目建立了一个标准化的统一观测框架，首期开展全国性长周期大地电磁（MT）测量。其最终目标是通过同化历史与最新观测数据，构建芬兰岩石圈的动态数字……

t: A nationwide long-period magnetotelluric survey combined with multiphysics data assimilation to integrate legacy and new geophysical datasets.
采用全国性长周期大地电磁测量，并结合多物理场数据同化技术，整合历史与新型地球物理数据集。
Nationwide long-period magnetotelluric array data and decades of legacy Finnish geophysical and geoscientific datasets.
全国范围的长周期大地电磁台网数据以及芬兰数十年的历史地球物理与地球科学数据集。
Establishment of the Syvä-Suomi framework to construct a high-resolution digital twin of the Finnish lithosphere.
确立了Syvä-Suomi框架，用于构建芬兰岩石圈的高分辨率数字孪生体。
The initial phase relies primarily on magnetotellurics, requiring future expansion to other geophysical methods for complete multiphysics imaging.
初期阶段主要依赖大地电磁数据，未来需扩展至其他地球物理方法以实现完整的多物理场成像。
First standardized, national-scale multiphysics imaging initiative in Finland designed to build a dynamic lithospheric digital twin.
芬兰首个标准化的、国家级多物理场成像计划，旨在构建动态的岩石圈数字孪生体。

kc: Introduces the Syvä-Suomi initiative as a unified framework for national-scale lithospheric imaging in Finland.
Establishes a nationwide long-period magnetotelluric survey as the foundational dataset.
Proposes a digital twin concept to integrate decades of legacy geophysical and geoscientific data.
介绍了Syvä-Suomi计划，作为芬兰国家级岩石圈成像的统一框架。
确立了全国范围的长周期大地电磁测量作为基础数据集。
提出了数字孪生概念，以整合数十年的历史地球物理和地球科学数据。
me: Nationwide long-period magnetotelluric (MT) array acquisition.
Multiphysics data assimilation and integration of legacy geoscientific models.
全国性长周期大地电磁（MT）台网数据采集。
多物理场数据同化与历史地球科学模型的整合。
de: Planned nationwide long-period magnetotelluric survey across Finland.
Integration of decades of legacy Finnish geophysical datasets.
计划在芬兰全国开展的长周期大地电磁测量。
整合芬兰数十年来积累的历史地球物理数据集。
li: The initial phase is limited to magnetotelluric data, requiring future expansion to other geophysical methods for true multiphysics integration.
Challenges in standardizing and assimilating highly heterogeneous legacy datasets.
初期阶段仅限于大地电磁数据，未来需要扩展到其他地球物理方法以实现真正的多物理场整合。
标准化和同化高度异构的历史数据集存在挑战。

tm.why: The paper introduces a national-scale initiative to image and model the Finnish lithosphere and understand Fennoscandian tectonic evolution.
The initiative relies on deploying a nationwide long-period magnetotelluric array and integrating other geophysical arrays.

sum: Magnetic vector inversion (MVI) suffers from severe nonuniqueness because it solves for three magnetization components per cell. Incorporating prior information is essential, yet existing Cartesian and spherical formulations struggle to combine directional and directionless petrophysical constraints alongside sparsity and structural orientation without inducing artifacts or severe nonlinearity. This paper introduces a coordinate-independent vector regularization in Cartesian coordinates. The smallness term uses complementary projection operators to simultaneously admit Cartesian reference models (from susceptibility and oriented remanence) and magnitude reference models (from unoriented remanence). Because a nonzero magnitude reference makes the smallness Hessian indefinite, the authors analytically derive its eigendecomposition and clamp negative eigenvalues to zero, enabling fast, stable conjugate-gradient solves. The smoothness term penalizes vector gradient magnitudes in rotated coordinates, supporting both sparsity and structural dip constraints without coordinate-aligned artifacts. Validated on a synthetic folded body and airborne magnetic data over the DO-27 kimberlite, the method significantly improves subsurface recovery.
磁矢量反演（MVI）因未知数成倍增加而具有严重的多解性。本文提出一种在笛卡尔坐标系下构建的坐标无关矢量正则化方法。其最小模型项利用互补投影算子，同时容纳有方向的笛卡尔参考模型（来自磁化率和定向剩磁）和无方向的幅值参考模型（来自未定向岩芯剩磁）。针对非零幅值参考导致海森矩阵不定性的问题，作者解析推导了……

t: Formulates a Cartesian vector regularization combining complementary orthogonal projectors for directional/directionless references, rotated gradient operators for structural smoothing, and analytical eigenvalue modification of the indefinite smallness Hessian for conjugate-gradient optimization.
构建笛卡尔矢量正则化，结合互补正交投影算子、旋转梯度平滑及不定海森矩阵特征值解析修正。
Tested on a 2D single-cell prism, a 3D synthetic folded body with spatially varying remanence, and 2004 airborne magnetic TMI data over the DO-27 kimberlite pipe with petrophysical core measurements.
采用单网格模型、3D合成褶皱体数据，以及DO-27金伯利岩航磁TMI数据与钻孔岩芯物性测量。

The modified Hessian reaches the 10^-2 CG residual tolerance in 7 iterations (reducing the objective by 18.6x) and 10^-8 in 30 iterations, outperforming Gauss-Newton and exact Hessian systems while improving target geometry.
修正海森矩阵7次CG迭代达10^-2容差（目标函数降18.6倍），30次达10^-8，显著改善模型恢复。

Assumes total magnetization is a linear function of susceptibility, neglecting self-demagnetization at high susceptibilities, and remains sensitive to diffuse L2 starting models in path-dependent sparse inversions.
假设总磁化强度与磁化率线性相关，忽略了高磁化率下的自退磁效应及初始模型依赖性。

Unifies directional, unoriented, and partially oriented borehole reference models in Cartesian MVI with an analytical positive-semidefinite sub-Hessian modification, plus coordinate-independent sparse and structurally oriented vector smoothing.
在笛卡尔MVI中统一定向与无方向参考模型，提出解析正定海森修正与基无关稀疏构造平滑。

kc: Formulates a Cartesian smallness regularization with complementary orthogonal projectors to simultaneously incorporate oriented, unoriented, and partially oriented (borehole) petrophysical reference models.
Derives the exact cell-wise eigendecomposition of the indefinite smallness Hessian and clamps negative eigenvalues to zero to guarantee positive-definiteness for conjugate-gradient solvers.
Develops a basis-independent smoothness term using rotated gradient operators and shared IRLS weights to enforce sparsity and structural orientation constraints without coordinate-aligned artifacts.
Demonstrates improved target recovery on a synthetic folded body and airborne magnetic field data over the DO-27 kimberlite pipe.
构建了含互补正交投影算子的笛卡尔最小模型正则化项，可同时融合定向、未定向和部分定向（钻孔）岩石物理参考模型。
解析推导了不定最小模型项海森矩阵的逐单元特征分解，通过将负特征值截断为零确保系统正定以适用共轭梯度求解器。
开发了基于旋转梯度算子和共享IRLS权重的基无关平滑项，在施加稀疏和构造方向约束的同时消除了坐标对齐伪影。
在合成褶皱体模型及DO-27金伯利岩管航磁实测数据上验证了该方法对目标几何与物性恢复的显著提升。
me: Cartesian magnetic vector inversion (MVI) with complementary orthogonal projection matrices (P and Q) in the smallness term.
Analytical eigendecomposition and negative-eigenvalue clamping of the cell-wise P-smallness sub-Hessian.
Anisotropic vector smoothness regularization via inner-product quadrature factorization and rotated gradient operators.
Scaled Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS) with Lp norms (p=1/2 for smallness, p=1 for smoothness) and beta cooling.
在最小模型项中引入互补正交投影矩阵（P和Q）的笛卡尔磁矢量反演（MVI）。
逐单元P-最小模型子海森矩阵的解析特征分解与负特征值归零修正。
基于内积求积分解与旋转梯度算子的各向异性矢量平滑正则化。
结合Lp范数（最小项p=1/2，平滑项p=1）和正则化参数冷却策略的缩放迭代重加权最小二乘法（IRLS）。
de: 2D single-cell magnetized prism forward and inverse modeling to visualize objective function geometry and Hessian curvature.
3D synthetic TMI dataset over a folded tabular body with spatially varying remanent magnetization, constrained by simulated unoriented borehole core or structural orientation.
2004 airborne TMI magnetic survey data over the DO-27 kimberlite pipe (Northwest Territories, Canada) constrained by sparse petrophysical measurements along four vertical drillholes.
用于可视化目标函数几何形态及海森矩阵曲率的二维单网格磁化棱柱体正反演实验。
具有空间变化剩磁方向的3D合成褶皱板状体总磁异常（TMI）数据实验，测试模拟未定向钻孔岩芯与构造方向约束。
加拿大西北地区DO-27金伯利岩管2004年航磁TMI数据反演，结合四口垂直钻孔的稀疏岩石物理测量约束。
li: Reference model construction assumes total magnetization is a linear function of susceptibility, neglecting nonlinear self-demagnetization at high susceptibility values.
Path-dependent sparse and clustering inversions remain sensitive to the diffuse L2 starting model and choice of hyperparameters.
参考模型构建假设总磁化强度与磁化率呈线性关系，忽略了高磁化率下的非线性自退磁效应。
路径依赖的稀疏与聚类反演仍对发散的L2初始模型及超参数选择较为敏感。

tm.why: The paper develops a novel Cartesian vector regularization and analytical Hessian eigendecomposition modification for solving non-unique magnetic vector inverse problems.

ev.notes: Full 33-page preprint PDF analyzed, including mathematical derivations, equations, synthetic benchmarks, and DO-27 field case study.

sum: This study presents a novel method for estimating first-year sea ice thickness using seafloor distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) on a trenched telecommunications cable in the Beaufort Sea, Alaska. By applying a frequency-slowness transformation to DAS observations of flexural-gravity (FG) waves, the authors extract phase velocity dispersion curves. They then invert these curves using a grid search over ice thickness and rigidity. The method successfully utilizes broadband FG waves generated by windstorms, hovercraft, and thermal fracturing. The resulting DAS-derived ice thickness estimates from January to March 2023 match collocated borehole measurements and cumulative freezing-day models, demonstrating a continuous, non-invasive, and long-term monitoring capability for polar regions.
本研究提出了一种利用海底分布式声学传感（DAS）估算一年生海冰厚度的新方法。该方法利用部署在阿拉斯加波弗特海的海底光缆，对DAS观测到的弯曲重力（FG）波进行频率-慢度变换以提取相速度色散曲线，随后通过网格搜索反演海冰厚度和刚度。该方法适用于风暴、气垫船和热致破裂产生的宽频FG波。2023年1至3月……

t: Frequency-slowness transformation of seafloor DAS-recorded flexural-gravity waves to extract phase velocity dispersion curves, followed by a grid search inversion for ice thickness and rigidity.
对海底DAS记录的弯曲重力波进行频率-慢度变换以提取色散曲线，并通过网格搜索反演冰厚与刚度。
DAS data from a trenched seafloor telecommunications cable in the Beaufort Sea, Alaska, spanning January to March 2023, alongside borehole and temperature model data.
2023年1月至3月阿拉斯加波弗特海海底通信光缆的DAS数据，以及钻孔和温度模型数据。
DAS-derived sea ice thickness estimates are consistent with collocated ice boreholes and cumulative freezing-day models.
DAS反演的海冰厚度与同位置冰钻孔测量及累积冻结日模型估算结果一致。
Relies on the presence of active sources of flexural-gravity waves and seafloor cable infrastructure.
依赖于弯曲重力波源的存在以及海底光缆基础设施。
First demonstration of measuring sea ice thickness from the seafloor using DAS on a telecommunications cable, avoiding surface deployment risks.
首次展示利用海底通信光缆DAS观测海冰厚度，规避了表面部署的风险。

kc: Introduced a seafloor-based method for continuous sea ice thickness monitoring using DAS.
Demonstrated the extraction of flexural-gravity wave dispersion curves from seafloor cable data.
Validated DAS-derived ice thickness estimates against physical boreholes and temperature-based freezing models.
提出了一种利用海底DAS进行持续海冰厚度监测的新方法。
展示了如何从海底光缆数据中提取弯曲重力波的色散曲线。
通过物理钻孔和基于温度的冻结模型验证了DAS反演的海冰厚度。
me: Frequency-slowness (f-p) transformation to extract phase velocity dispersion curves.
Grid search inversion across ice thickness and rigidity parameter space.
利用频率-慢度（f-p）变换提取相速度色散曲线。
在海冰厚度和刚度参数空间中进行网格搜索反演。
de: DAS data recorded on a trenched seafloor telecommunications cable in the Beaufort Sea, Alaska, from January to March 2023.
Validation data from collocated ice boreholes and an air temperature cumulative freezing-day model.
2023年1月至3月期间，利用阿拉斯加波弗特海海底光缆记录的DAS数据。
来自同位置冰钻孔测量和气温累积冻结日模型的验证数据。
li: The inversion relies on a simplified grid search and assumes a relatively simple ice-water model.
Requires the presence of seafloor cables and sources of flexural-gravity waves (e.g., wind, traffic, fracturing).
反演依赖于简化的网格搜索，并假设了较为简单的冰-水模型。
需要存在海底光缆以及弯曲重力波源（如风暴、交通、破裂）。

tm.why: The study utilizes distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) on a seafloor telecommunications cable to observe flexural-gravity waves.
The primary objective of the paper is to estimate first-year sea ice thickness, which falls under cryosphere seismology.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the provided abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates an unusually protracted 1.5-year dyking episode between 2020 and 2022 at Casiri-Purupuruni in the volcanic arc of southern Peru. Using Sentinel-1 InSAR time-series, optical DEM fault mapping, and earthquake catalogs (ISC and gCMT), the authors invert for subsurface deformation sources using non-linear Bayesian and linear slip/opening inversions. The deformation is best explained by a 30–34 km long dyke opening up to 0.5 m at 2–8 km depth, physically coupled with a simultaneous inflating ellipsoidal magma reservoir at 6–8 km depth and shallow dyke-induced normal faulting (up to 30 cm slip). Analytical fluid-mechanical and thermal modeling indicates that for a <0.5 m wide dyke to propagate slowly (2–4 km/yr) without freezing, magma with viscosity ~10^6 Pa s (silicic composition) must have intruded wall rocks heated to within ~100 °C of the solidus, likely pre-heated by young plutonic intrusions.
本研究探讨了2020至2022年间秘鲁南部火山弧Casiri-Purupuruni地区罕见的持续1.5年的岩墙侵入事件。结合Sentinel-1 InSAR时间序列、Pleiades数字高程模型断层测绘及地震目录，作者利用非线性贝叶斯与线性反演约束了变形源。结果表明，地表变形由2-8 km深处打开达……

t: Non-linear Bayesian inversions and linear distributed-opening inversions in an elastic half-space model InSAR line-of-sight displacements using an inflating Yang ellipsoid, an Okada tensile dyke, and dipping normal faults, paired with analytical thermo-fluid dyke propagation models.
基于弹性半空间开展非线性贝叶斯与线性分布张开反演，结合热-流体解析模型约束岩浆性质。

Sentinel-1 ascending (149A) and descending (054D) InSAR time-series from 2016 to 2023 processed via LiCSAR and LiCSBAS, combined with Pleiades 1 m DEM fault scarp mapping and ISC/gCMT earthquake catalogs.
2016-2023年Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR时间序列、Pleiades 1米DEM断层测绘及ISC/gCMT…

The preferred model resolves a 0.025–0.030 km^3 dyke opening up to 0.5 m at 2–8 km depth, coupled with an inflating ellipsoid at 6–8 km depth and ~30 cm normal fault slip, indicating ~10^6 Pa s magma intruding wall rocks within 100 °C of the solidus.
2-8 km深处岩墙张开达0.5 m，与6-8 km岩浆房膨胀及30 cm断层滑动耦合；粘度约10^6 Pa s，围岩距…
Global earthquake locations have ~10 km uncertainty, and InSAR inversions lack sufficient resolution to detect vertical propagation of dyke opening over time.
全球地震定位存在约10 km误差，且InSAR反演分辨率不足以识别岩墙垂向扩展过程。

Documents the slowest known arc dyking episode (1.5 years, 2–4 km/yr) coupled with reservoir inflation, demonstrating that crustal pre-heating by plutons enables upper-crustal transport of viscous silicic magmas via thin dykes.
首次记录火山弧持续1.5年的极慢速岩墙侵入与岩浆房同步膨胀，证明深成岩体预热使高粘度岩浆能以薄岩墙运移。

kc: Documented an extraordinarily slow, 1.5-year-long dyking episode in the Peruvian volcanic arc using Sentinel-1 InSAR and seismic catalogs.

Demonstrated via kinematic inversions that the thin dyke (up to 0.5 m opening at 2–8 km depth) was coupled with inflation of an underlying magma reservoir (6–8 km depth) and triggered shallow graben normal faulting.

Showed through thermo-fluid modeling that slow propagation (2–4 km/yr) requires high-viscosity (~10^6 Pa s) silicic magma intruding into wall rocks within ~100 °C of the magma solidus, pre-heated by prior plutonic intrusions.
利用Sentinel-1 InSAR和地震目录记录了秘鲁火山弧一次罕见的持续1.5年的缓慢岩墙侵入事件。
通过运动学反演证明该薄岩墙（2-8 km深处张开达0.5 m）与下伏岩浆房（6-8 km深）的同步膨胀相耦合，并触发了浅表地堑正断层滑动。
通过热-流体模拟表明，如此缓慢的传播（2-4 km/yr）需要高粘度（~10^6 Pa s）长英质岩浆侵入距固相线100 °C以内的近固相线围岩，且围岩已被早期深成岩体预热。
me: InSAR time-series analysis of Sentinel-1 ascending and descending tracks using LiCSAR, GACOS tropospheric corrections, and LiCSBAS (NSBAS algorithm).
Bounded non-linear Bayesian inversions (GBIS) and regularized linear inversions in an elastic half-space combining Yang inflating ellipsoids and Okada tensile/shear dislocations.
Analytical fluid-mechanical and 1-D/2-D heat transfer modeling of critical dyke width and magma flow velocity to constrain magma viscosity and wall-rock temperature.
基于LiCSAR、GACOS对流层校正和LiCSBAS（NSBAS算法）的Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR时间序列分析。
结合Yang膨胀椭球体和Okada张性/剪切位错模型的弹性半空间有界非线性贝叶斯反演（GBIS）与正则化线性反演。
临界岩墙宽度与岩浆流速的解析流体力学及一维/二维热传导建模，用于约束岩浆粘度与围岩温度。
de: Sentinel-1 SAR images (ascending track 149A and descending track 054D) from 2016 to 2023.
Global seismic catalogs (ISC reviewed catalog and gCMT moment tensors) covering three shallow earthquake clusters (S1–S3) in 2020–2022.
1x1 m Digital Elevation Model (DEM) derived from Pleiades bi-stereo optical imagery for mapping Quaternary fault scarps.
2016至2023年间的Sentinel-1 SAR卫星雷达影像（升轨149A和降轨054D）。
涵盖2020-2022年三个浅源地震丛集（S1-S3）的全球地震目录（ISC审查目录与gCMT矩张量）。
由Pleiades双立体光学影像生成的1×1米数字高程模型（DEM），用于测绘第四纪断层陡坎。
li: Global seismic catalog hypocentral locations have ~10 km uncertainty, making detailed spatial interpretation of the earthquake distributions tentative.
InSAR time-series inversions lack sufficient spatial resolution to resolve vertical propagation of dyke opening over time.
Coarse fault discretization in the kinematic model leaves small (<0.5 cm) near-surface residuals around fault projections.
全球地震目录的震源位置存在约10公里的不确定性，使得地震空间分布的精细解释具有不确定性。
InSAR时间序列反演的空间分辨率不足以分辨岩墙张开随时间的垂向传播过程。
运动学模型中较粗糙的断层网格离散化导致断层地表投影附近存在微小的（<0.5 cm）近地表残差。

tm.why: The paper analyzes a 1.5-year-long volcanic unrest episode involving coupled dyke intrusion, magma reservoir inflation, and three shallow earthquake clusters at Casiri-Purupuruni in the Peruvian volcanic arc.

The authors apply bounded, non-linear Bayesian inversions (GBIS) with uniform priors and posterior probability density functions to constrain the geometry and excess pressure of the magma reservoir and dyke.
The study models upper-crustal magma transport mechanics, dyke-induced normal faulting, and thermal pre-heating of the shallow crust by plutonic intrusions.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF (21 pages including references and 4 figures) used for complete analysis and verbatim anchor extraction.

sum: This study investigates the complex source process of the 24 June 2026 Mw 7.5 Venezuela earthquake, initially cataloged as a doublet. By inverting regional full displacement waveforms without prior constraints on the second event's location or timing, the authors resolve a multiple-point moment-release model. At low frequencies (0.005–0.010 Hz), the event is modeled as a doublet of Mw 7.3 and 7.4 subevents separated by 25 s. At higher frequencies (0.010–0.025 Hz), a five-subevent model reveals a ~200-km-long unilateral rupture lasting ~60 s with eastward directivity. The resulting patch model matches a 46 cm GNSS displacement vector. The lack of large aftershocks on certain segments suggests a possible supershear rupture. These findings highlight rupture complexity in Venezuela, with significant implications for regional seismic hazard assessment.

sum: This study integrates whole-rock lithogeochemistry, Sm-Nd isotopes, U-Pb zircon geochronology, and thermobarometry to reconstruct a complete Wilson cycle across the Archean–Paleoproterozoic transition at the Carajás-Bacajá boundary, Amazonian Craton. The authors identify a 9-10 kbar, 760-800 °C granulitic root representing collisional stacking of the Bacajá lower crust over the Carajás margin between 2.10 and 2.05 Ga. This was preceded by rifting at ca. 2.55 Ga and subduction-related arc magmatism at 2.21-2.13 Ga, and followed by decompression, rapid cooling, and collapse. The work provides a comprehensive geodynamic model for the Rhyacian collisional stack.
本研究整合全岩地球化学、Sm-Nd同位素、U-Pb锆石年代学和温压计数据，重建了亚马逊克拉通卡拉雅斯-巴卡雅边界太古宙—古元古代过渡期的完整威尔逊循环。研究表明，在2.10至2.05 Ga期间，巴卡雅下地壳向卡拉雅斯边缘推覆叠置，形成了9-10 kbar、760-800 °C的麻粒岩相根部。在此之前……

sum: Post-stack acoustic impedance inversion is an ill-posed problem where standard Tikhonov regularization blurs interfaces and Total Variation (TV) creates staircase artifacts. This paper introduces an anisotropic Tikhonov-TV (ATT) regularization method that decomposes logarithmic impedance into piecewise-constant and smooth components constrained horizontally and vertically. Solved via the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), the algorithm introduces three key innovations: (1) automatic regularization parameter selection via the residual whiteness principle (RWP); (2) adaptive balancing between smooth and blocky components using median absolute deviation (MAD) and robust z-scores of gradients; and (3) a fast spectral-domain candidate-solution solver exploiting Sylvester equation structures and discrete cosine transforms (DCT), cutting parameter search time by ~50.8%. Validated on Overthrust and BP2004 synthetic benchmarks and field data with well logs, ATT achieves the lowest relative model error (2.7% and 3.5%), preserving sharp boundaries while avoiding staircase and inter-trace artifacts.

sum: Airborne magnetic anomaly navigation (MagNav) bounds inertial navigation drift by matching scalar magnetometer measurements to a lithospheric magnetic anomaly map. Existing methods like the extended Kalman filter (EKF), particle filter (PF), and Viterbi algorithm either assume Gaussianity, require sampling, or discard posterior uncertainty. This study formulates MagNav map matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph solved segment-by-segment via the forward-backward (sum-product) algorithm with active-set pruning. Tested on 1000 synthetic trials and 1000 flight paths over the Renfrew_395 aeromagnetic map using MagNav.jl, the minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimator achieves a median position error of 32.7 m (91% below inertial drift) and reduces median error by 43% compared to EKF, PF, and forward-only point-mass filters. Furthermore, the closed-form Shannon entropy of the discrete marginal posterior serves as a truth-free operational diagnostic, detecting 94% of segments with errors exceeding three map cells at a 10% false-alarm rate.
航空磁异常导航通过将磁力计测量值与岩石圈磁异常图匹配来约束惯导漂移。针对现有滤波方法的高斯假设或不确定性丢失问题，本文提出链式因子图推理框架，结合主动集剪枝与分段前向-后向算法求解离散边缘后验分布与香农熵。基于Renfrew_395航磁图的千次蒙特卡洛合成实验表明，最小均方误差估计的中位定位误差为3……

t: Formulates magnetic map-matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph solved segment-by-segment via the forward-backward recursion on a discrete map-aligned grid with active-set pruning, yielding marginal posteriors, MMSE position estimates, and Shannon entropy.
将磁图匹配表述为链式因子图推理，通过主动集剪枝和分段前向-后向递归求解边缘后验、MMSE位置估计与香农熵。

Synthetic strapdown INS and scalar magnetometer data generated via MagNav.jl over the real Renfrew_395 aeromagnetic anomaly map, evaluated across 1000 sensor-error realisations and 1000 distinct flight paths.

Across 1000 trials, the median position error is 32.7 m (91% below 362 m INS drift) and 43% below EKF and particle filters; segment-entropy thresholding detects 94% of >3-cell errors at 10% false-alarm rate.

It solves a nonlinear geophysical state-estimation inverse problem (inferring trajectory from lithospheric magnetic anomalies) and analyzes observability via Fisher information and Cramér-Rao bounds.

sum: Oceanic transform faults and fracture zones are generally assumed to become tectonically inactive after spreading ceases. This study analyzes an unusual intraplate earthquake doublet (Mw 7.5 on 22 August and Mw 7.6 on 10 October 2025) spaced ~15 km apart within the extinct Phoenix Plate in the Drake Passage. Combining template matching on regional ASAIN seismic data, teleseismic P-wave back-projection, and multichannel seismic reflection profiling (line SA500-030), the authors expand the earthquake catalog by ~200 events and resolve distinct rupture modes across sub-parallel en-echelon fault strands along fossil fracture zone FZ1. Seismic reflection imaging reveals localized magmatic bodies intruding along FZ1. The authors propose that far-field Scotia–Antarctic stresses and slab rollback reactivated FZ1 as a lithosphere-scale tear fault segmenting the subducting Phoenix slab beneath the South Shetland block, showing that extinct oceanic fracture zones remain long-lived zones of weakness.
大洋转换断层与断裂带通常被认为在海底扩张停止后即失去构造活性。本研究分析了2025年德雷克海峡已消亡凤凰板块内相距约15公里的罕见双震（8月22日Mw 7.5与10月10日Mw 7.6）。结合区域ASAIN台网模板匹配、远震P波反投影及多道地震反射剖面（SA500-030），作者额外检测出约200次……

t: The authors combine PhaseNet picking, single-station template matching at JUBA (~250 km away), magnitude-weighted PCA, teleseismic P-wave back-projection, and multichannel seismic reflection processing to analyze the 2025 earthquake doublet and fault structure.
结合PhaseNet拾取、单台模板匹配、加权主成分分析、远震P波反投影及多道地震反射剖面处理技术。

Data include continuous 2025 waveforms from ASAIN station JUBA, USGS and GCMT catalogs, global GSN teleseismic P-wave recordings, GEBCO bathymetry, and the 1987/1988 marine multichannel seismic reflection profile SA500-030.
使用2025年ASAIN台网JUBA站连续波形、USGS与GCMT目录、GSN远震记录及SA500-030多道地震反射剖…

Template matching adds ~200 events to the 49 USGS earthquakes, revealing a 49-day doublet (Mw 7.5 and Mw 7.6) with distinct rupture directivity along en-echelon strands of fracture zone FZ1 and localized magmatic intrusions.
新增检测约200次地震，揭示相隔49天的Mw 7.5和7.6级双震沿FZ1雁列分支破裂，并发现局部海底岩浆侵位。

No seismic stations exist within 250 km, causing 10–15 km horizontal location uncertainties, while lack of continuous bathymetric and seismic coverage prevents mapping magmatism along the entire fracture zone.
250公里内无台站导致10-15公里定位误差，且缺乏连续地球物理数据覆盖整个断裂带。

Demonstrates that extinct oceanic fracture zones retain lithospheric weakness for millions of years, reactivating as intraplate earthquake doublets, magmatic pathways, and slab-scale tear faults during terminal subduction.
证实消亡大洋断裂带长期保持力学薄弱性，在俯冲末期可活化产生强双震并充当板片撕裂断层与岩浆通道。

kc: Demonstrates reactivation of an extinct Cenozoic oceanic fracture zone (FZ1) in the Phoenix Plate via a 2025 Mw 7.5 and Mw 7.6 intraplate strike-slip earthquake doublet.
Expands the regional earthquake catalog from 49 USGS events to ~250 detections using template matching at station JUBA, revealing an en-echelon multi-strand fault structure.

Identifies localized seafloor magmatic emplacement along FZ1 using multichannel seismic reflection profile SA500-030, linking fracture zone reactivation to lithosphere-scale slab tearing beneath the Bransfield Basin.
通过2025年Mw 7.5和Mw 7.6板内走滑双震，证实了凤凰板块内已消亡新生代大洋断裂带（FZ1）的重新活动。
利用JUBA台站波形模板匹配将USGS目录从49个事件扩展至约250个，揭示了次平行雁列式多断层分支结构。
利用多道地震反射剖面SA500-030识别出沿FZ1分布的局部海底岩浆侵位，将断裂带活化与布兰斯菲尔德盆地下方的岩石圈尺度板片撕裂联系起来。
me: Template matching and PhaseNet deep-learning phase picking on continuous waveforms from the closest regional station (JUBA, ASAIN network, ~250 km distance).
Magnitude-weighted Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and kernel density estimation of epicentral clusters compared against GCMT focal mechanisms.
Teleseismic P-wave (and PP/PKIKP) back-projection beamforming (0.05–0.25 Hz) across the GSN virtual network to image space-time high-frequency radiation and rupture directivity.
Processing and Kirchhoff post-stack time migration of 72-channel marine seismic reflection profile SA500-030 using SeismicUnix.
对距离最近的区域台站（ASAIN台网JUBA站，约250 km）连续波形应用PhaseNet深度学习震相拾取与模板匹配方法。
结合GCMT震源机制解，对震中丛集开展震级加权主成分分析（PCA）和核密度估计。
利用全球地震台网（GSN）远震P波（及PP/PKIKP）开展0.05–0.25 Hz反投影波束形成，成像高频辐射时空演化与破裂方向性。
使用SeismicUnix对72道海洋多道地震反射剖面SA500-030进行常规处理及Kirchhoff叠后时间偏移。
de: Continuous broadband waveforms from ASAIN station JUBA (January–November 2025), plus stations ESPZ and PMSA, combined with USGS/ISC catalogs and GCMT solutions.
Global Seismographic Network (GSN) teleseismic broadband waveforms for P-wave back-projection of the 22 August 2025 (Mw 7.5) and 10 October 2025 (Mw 7.6) mainshocks.
Multichannel seismic reflection profile SA500-030 acquired in 1987/1988 by R/V Almirante Camara across fracture zone FZ1 and the South Shetland Trench, supplemented by GEBCO bathymetry.
2025年1月至11月ASAIN台网JUBA站（及ESPZ、PMSA站）连续宽频带波形数据，结合USGS/ISC地震目录与GCMT震源机制解。
用于2025年8月22日（Mw 7.5）和10月10日（Mw 7.6）两次主震P波反投影的全球地震台网（GSN）远震宽频带波形。
1987/1988年“Almirante Camara”号科考船采集的横跨FZ1断裂带与南设得兰海沟的SA500-030多道地震反射剖面及GEBCO水深地形数据。
li: Extreme remoteness with no seismic stations within 250 km leads to large azimuthal gaps, low signal-to-noise ratios for small events, and 10–15 km horizontal location uncertainties.
Teleseismic back-projection solves only for 2-D horizontal radiation without depth constraints and is susceptible to source-receiver array geometry biases.
Lack of continuous 3-D bathymetric and seismic coverage along the entire fracture zone prevents determining whether magmatic intrusions occur continuously along FZ1.
研究区偏远，250 km内无地震台站，导致方位角空隙大、小震信噪比低以及10–15 km的水平定位误差。
远震反投影仅解析二维水平高频辐射位置而缺乏深度约束，且视破裂方向性易受台网几何分布影响。
缺乏覆盖整个断裂带的连续水深和地震剖面数据，无法确定海底岩浆侵入是否沿整个FZ1连续分布。

tm.why: The paper investigates the long-term mechanical evolution of oceanic lithosphere, fracture zone reactivation, and slab tearing in the subducting Phoenix Plate beneath the South Shetland block.

The study analyzes the rupture directivity, doublet triggering relationship, and aftershock migration of two Mw 7.5 and Mw 7.6 strike-slip earthquakes using P-wave back-projection and GCMT focal mechanisms.
The authors apply PhaseNet and template matching to single-station ASAIN recordings to expand the USGS catalog from 49 to ~250 events and lower the completeness magnitude.

ev.notes: Full 10-page article PDF analyzed, including abstract/introductory summary, geologic context, seismicity analysis, multichannel seismic reflection profile, discussion, methods, and all 5 figures.

sum: This article presents a narrative technical review of computational geodetic inversion across 556 unique literature records from Scopus and Dimensions, reframing geodetic source estimation (fault slip, magma chambers, hydrological loading, subsidence, and landslides) as a computer-science challenge. The authors identify five core computational layers—data harmonization, forward-model encoding, inversion and optimization, uncertainty propagation, and explainable decision support—and synthesize them into the XAI-UQ-CGI framework alongside a ten-item reporting checklist. To prove the framework is computationally executable rather than purely conceptual, they demonstrate it end-to-end on a controlled synthetic multi-source InSAR and GNSS inversion for a Mogi volcanic point-pressure source using weighted least-squares and affine-invariant ensemble MCMC sampling. Sensor fusion reduces the 68% depth credible interval width by 84% compared to InSAR alone (median 73% reduction across 300 noise realizations), effectively mitigating the depth-volume trade-off and generating traceable, machine-readable decision records.
本文基于Scopus和Dimensions的556篇文献，从计算机科学视角综述了多源大地测量反演（断层滑动、岩浆房、水文负载、沉降和滑坡）。作者提出包含数据协同、正演编码、反演优化、不确定性传播和可解释决策支持的五层XAI-UQ-CGI框架及十项报告清单。通过合成InSAR和GNSS数据的Mogi火……

t: Organizes geodetic inversion into a five-layer XAI-UQ-CGI computational pipeline, demonstrated using trust-region-reflective weighted least-squares and affine-invariant ensemble MCMC sampling for joint InSAR-GNSS inversion.
将大地测量反演组织为五层XAI-UQ-CGI计算流程，结合加权最小二乘与仿射不变MCMC采样实现联合反演。

Reviews ~556 deduplicated Scopus and Dimensions records (1986–2026) and tests a synthetic Mogi source dataset comprising 427 InSAR LOS points (with a 3-parameter ramp) and 9 three-component GNSS stations.
综述约556篇去重文献，并测试含427个InSAR点（带趋势项）和9个三分量GNSS站的Mogi合成数据。

Joint InSAR-GNSS inversion recovers the true Mogi parameters (reduced chi-square 0.98) and narrows the 68% depth credible interval width by 84% relative to InSAR-only (from ~2160 m to ~340 m; median 73% reduction over 300 realizations).
联合反演准确恢复源参数（约化卡方0.98），将深度68%置信区间宽度比单InSAR缩小84%（300次实现中位数缩小73…
The review is narrative rather than systematic, and the synthetic experiment assumes matched forward/inverse models, independent Gaussian noise, a homogeneous half-space, and no real field data.
属于叙述性综述，且合成实验假设正反演算子匹配、噪声独立及均匀弹性半空间，未使用真实观测数据。
Reframes multi-source geodetic inversion as a five-layer computational architecture uniting data harmonization, physics-informed AI, uncertainty quantification, and auditable decision records.
提出五层计算架构与十项报告清单，将多源数据协同、物理AI、不确定性量化与可审计决策记录相统一。

kc: Synthesizes 556 geodetic inversion studies from a computational perspective focusing on data harmonization, regularization, Bayesian inference, and physics-informed ML.
Maps major algorithmic families to multi-source observation modalities (InSAR, GNSS, GRACE, seismic, DEM/GIS) across five geohazard and Earth-system domains.
Proposes the five-layer XAI-UQ-CGI architectural framework and a ten-item minimum reporting checklist for transparent, reproducible geodetic inversion.
Demonstrates the framework via an open-source synthetic InSAR-GNSS Mogi source inversion with sensor-removal ablation, 300-realization coverage calibration, and model-mismatch diagnostics.
从计算视角综述了556篇大地测量反演文献，涵盖数据协同、正则化、贝叶斯推断和物理引导机器学习。
将主要算法家族映射到五大地质灾害与地球系统领域的多源观测模态（InSAR、GNSS、GRACE、地震、DEM/GIS）。
提出了五层XAI-UQ-CGI架构框架以及包含十项要素的透明可重复大地测量反演报告清单。
通过开源合成InSAR-GNSS Mogi源反演展示了完整流程，包含传感器消融、300次噪声覆盖率校准和模型失配测试。
me: Narrative technical literature review using deduplicated Scopus (151) and Dimensions (500) database exports.
Five-layer XAI-UQ-CGI pipeline integrating data harmonization, forward operator encoding, optimization/sampling, uncertainty propagation, and explainable JSON/text output.
Trust-region-reflective weighted least-squares optimization coupled with affine-invariant ensemble Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling.
Sensor-removal ablation, 300-realization empirical coverage testing, and spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I) residual diagnostics.
利用去重后的Scopus（151篇）和Dimensions（500篇）文献库开展叙述性技术综述。
构建集成数据协同、正演算子编码、优化/采样、不确定性传播和可解释JSON/文本输出的五层XAI-UQ-CGI流程。
结合信赖域反射加权最小二乘优化与仿射不变集成马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样。
开展传感器消融实验、300次独立噪声实现的经验覆盖率校准以及空间自相关（Moran's I）残差诊断。
de: Bibliographic corpus of ~556 unique records (1986–2026), including 211 deduplicated records from 2020 onward.
Synthetic Mogi point-source dataset (depth 3500 m, volume change 3.0e6 m^3) with 427 decimated descending InSAR LOS points (with planar orbital/atmospheric ramp) and 9 three-component GNSS stations.
Calibration experiment across 300 independent Gaussian noise realizations and a structural model-mismatch test fitting a single-source model to two-source synthetic data.
包含约556篇独立文献（1986–2026年）的文献库，其中2020年以来的去重文献为211篇。
合成Mogi点源数据集（深度3500 m，体积变化3.0e6 m^3），含427个含平面轨道/大气趋势的降轨InSAR LOS采样点和9个三分量GNSS测站。
基于300次独立高斯噪声实现的校准实验，以及用单源模型拟合双源合成数据的结构模型失配测试。
li: The literature review is a narrative technical synthesis rather than a formal PRISMA systematic review or quantitative meta-analysis.
The synthetic proof-of-concept relies on matched forward/inverse operators (except in the single two-source mismatch test) and uses no real field data.

The synthetic demonstration assumes a homogeneous isotropic elastic half-space, fixed Poisson ratio (0.25), and diagonal/block-diagonal noise covariance without spatially correlated atmospheric noise.
文献综述属于叙述性技术综合，而非严格的PRISMA系统综述或定量元分析。
合成验证实验主要依赖匹配的正反演算子（除单次双源失配测试外），未在真实野外观测数据上测试。
合成演示假设了均匀各向同性弹性半空间、固定泊松比（0.25）和块对角噪声协方差，忽略了空间相关大气噪声。

tm.why: The paper comprehensively reviews computational geodetic inversion as an inverse problem, detailing regularization, covariance weighting, non-uniqueness, and a 5-layer inversion architecture.
Uncertainty quantification and Bayesian posterior sampling are central pillars of the proposed XAI-UQ-CGI framework and its synthetic Mogi source demonstration.
The paper extensively discusses physics-informed machine learning, neural surrogates, and explainable AI (XAI) for geodetic fault-slip, volcano, and deformation inversions.

ev.notes: Full 59-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all 12 sections, 12 figures, and 10 tables.

sum: Automatic first-arrival picking in industrial microseismic monitoring often relies on single-trace deep-learning models that ignore cross-trace spatial continuity, or complex multi-trace architectures with high training costs. This paper introduces a coordinate-driven semantic segmentation framework using explicit coordinate encoding (CoordConv). Multi-trace waveforms of an event are reshaped into a balanced near-square 2-D image and concatenated with normalized X (trace/spatial) and Y (time) coordinate channels before entering a U-Net to predict binary masks of the P-to-S arrival interval. Tested on downhole hydraulic fracturing microseismic data from the Sichuan Basin, China, explicit coordinate encoding reduces average minimum validation loss by ~54% while adding only ~0.015% parameters. P-wave picking excellent rates (<5 ms error) jump from 73.06% to 92.24%, with average error dropping from 9.51 to 3.36 ms. Ablation and benchmark tests show coordinate encoding drives most gains, outperforming attention/residual modules, retrained PhaseNet, and EdgePhase.
针对微地震监测初至拾取忽略道间空间连续性或模型过于复杂的问题，本文提出一种基于显式坐标编码（CoordConv）的U-Net分割框架。该方法将多道波形重组为近正方形二维图像，并拼接归一化的空间与时间坐标通道以打破传统CNN的平移不变性，预测P至S波走时区间的二值掩码。在四川盆地页岩气水力压裂井下微地……

t: Reorganizes multi-trace event waveforms into a near-square 2-D image, concatenates normalized X (spatial/trace) and Y (temporal) coordinate channels, and uses a U-Net with post-processing to segment the P-to-S arrival interval.
将多道波形重组为近正方形图像并拼接归一化时空坐标通道，利用U-Net分割P-S波走时区间。

Downhole 3-C microseismic waveforms (11 active geophones, 0.5 ms sampling) from shale gas hydraulic fracturing in the Sichuan Basin, China, using 100 events for training, 11 for validation, and 552 for testing.
四川盆地页岩气水力压裂11级三分量井下微地震数据，100个训练事件，552个测试事件。

Coordinate encoding cuts validation loss by ~54% while adding only 0.015% parameters, boosting P-arrival excellent rates (<5 ms error) from 73.06% to 92.24% and reducing mean error from 9.51 to 3.36 ms.
参数量仅增0.015%，验证损失降54%，P波拾取优秀率从73.06%升至92.24%，误差降至3.36 ms。
S-wave picking accuracy (78.54% excellent rate, 7.56 ms average error) is systematically lower than P-wave picking due to more complex waveforms.
受复杂波形影响，S波拾取优秀率（78.54%）和精度系统性低于P波。

Introduces explicit spatial-temporal coordinate encoding (CoordConv) into 2-D multi-trace semantic segmentation for microseismic phase picking, breaking CNN translation invariance with negligible parameter overhead.
在多道微地震拾取中引入显式坐标编码打破CNN平移不变性，以极低代价提取空间连续特征。

kc: Proposes a coordinate-driven U-Net framework that concatenates explicit X and Y coordinate channels to 2-D multi-trace waveform images to break CNN translational invariance.
Introduces a data preprocessing and post-processing workflow that reshapes highly rectangular multi-trace arrays into near-square matrices and extracts P/S picks from binary interval masks.

Demonstrates through ablation experiments that coordinate convolution accounts for the vast majority of accuracy gains (~19% jump in P-wave excellent rate) with only ~0.015% parameter overhead, whereas attention and residual modules provide marginal benefits.
Shows superior performance over retrained single-trace (PhaseNet) and graph-based multi-station (EdgePhase) benchmarks on real downhole hydraulic fracturing data using only 100 training events.
提出了一种坐标驱动的U-Net框架，将显式X和Y坐标通道拼接到二维多道波形图像中，打破了传统CNN的平移不变性。
设计了将大长宽比多道矩阵重塑为近正方形矩阵的数据预处理流程，以及从P-S区间二值掩码中提取初至走时的后处理算法。
通过消融实验证明，坐标卷积以仅约0.015%的参数增量贡献了绝大部分精度提升（P波优秀率提升约19%），而注意力和残差模块增益微弱。
在真实井下水力压裂数据集中仅用100个训练事件，便显著超越了重训练的单道模型（PhaseNet）和图网络多台站模型（EdgePhase）。
me: Explicit coordinate encoding (Coordinate Convolution / CoordConv) normalized to [-1, 1] along trace/distance and time dimensions.
U-Net semantic segmentation backbone predicting binary masks representing the interval between P- and S-wave arrivals.
Near-square matrix reformatting via trace replication (for small M downhole arrays) or temporal interpolation (for large M surface arrays) to balance U-Net receptive fields.
Ablation analysis comparing 8 model variants combining baseline U-Net, Coordinate Convolution, Residual blocks, and Attention gates.
Automated post-processing using contiguous segment length filtering and gap removal (30 ms / 60-sample threshold) to extract exact P and S arrival times.
沿地震道/空间距离和时间维度进行归一化至[-1, 1]的显式坐标编码（坐标卷积/CoordConv）。
基于U-Net语义分割骨干网络预测代表P波与S波到时区间的二值掩码。
通过道复制（针对少道井下阵列）或时间轴插值（针对多道地面阵列）构建近正方形输入矩阵以平衡U-Net感受野。
对结合基础U-Net、坐标卷积、残差块和注意力门控的8种模型变体开展消融分析。
采用连续白像素段筛选与短黑像素段剔除（30 ms/60采样点阈值）的自动后处理算法提取P波和S波初至时间。
de: Real downhole microseismic dataset from hydraulic fracturing of a shale gas field in the Sichuan Basin, China (depth ~3600 m, 11 active 3-C borehole geophones, 0.5 ms sampling).
111 manually picked events (333 component waveform-mask pairs) split into 100 events for training and 11 for validation, evaluated on 552 test events (18,216 traces).
Training size sensitivity experiment (20 to 100 events) and event-level 5-fold cross-validation evaluating Precision, Recall, Dice, and IoU.
Native rectangular-input vs. trace-replicated near-square input ablation experiment.
Benchmark comparisons against pre-trained and retrained PhaseNet models and EdgePhase (with original graph, borehole graph, and CoordConv).
中国四川盆地页岩气田水力压裂井下微地震实测数据集（深度约3600 m，11个有效三分量井下检波器，采样间隔0.5 ms）。
选取111个人工拾取事件（333对分量波形-掩码），其中100个用于训练、11个用于验证，并在552个测试事件（18,216道）上评估拾取精度。
开展训练集规模敏感性实验（20至100个事件）及事件级五折交叉验证，评估精确率、召回率、Dice和IoU指标。
原生矩形输入与道复制近正方形输入的对比消融实验。
与预训练和重训练的PhaseNet模型以及不同图结构的EdgePhase模型进行基准对比实验。
li: S-wave picking accuracy (78.54% average excellent rate, 7.56 ms error) remains systematically lower than P-wave picking (92.24%, 3.36 ms) due to more complex S-wave waveforms and coda interference.
Because the method predicts a contiguous binary mask between P and S arrivals, each trace requires both P and S picks to define the segment boundaries.

Only tested empirically on a single 1-D downhole receiver array (11 geophones); proposed 2-D surface and 3-D irregular array coordinate encodings are formulated mathematically but not experimentally validated.
受更复杂波形及尾波干扰影响，S波拾取精度（平均优秀率78.54%，误差7.56 ms）系统性地低于P波（92.24%，3.36 ms）。
由于该方法将P波和S波初至定义为二值掩码中连续白色像素段的首尾边界，需要同时存在P波和S波来界定区间。
实验仅在单一的11级井下检波器阵列上进行了验证，针对地面二维及三维不规则阵列的坐标编码公式尚未通过实测数据检验。

tm.why: The paper proposes a deep-learning U-Net framework augmented with explicit coordinate encoding for automatic P- and S-wave phase picking.
The primary task addressed by the proposed framework is automatic first-arrival (P and S) phase picking across receiver arrays.
The method is specifically designed for and tested on downhole microseismic monitoring data acquired during shale gas hydraulic fracturing.

ev.notes: Full 29-page GJI manuscript PDF analyzed, including all methodology equations, 20 figures, and 7 tables.

sum: Concurrent observations of dynamic fault slip and seismic radiation are exceedingly rare. This study reports the first directly validated observation of surface rupture and near-fault strong ground motion captured by a security camera during the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto, Japan earthquake, corroborated by nearby strong-motion seismograms, GNSS, and field LiDAR surveys. By using a parked car as an inertial reference mass and tracking markers across the fault trace via image correlation, the authors extracted both off-fault ground motion and on-fault slip time series from the same video. They discovered a two-step displacement and two-peak velocity (~1 m/s amplitude, ~1.5 s duration each) pattern. Direct comparison shows the first pulse was generated by subsurface basement rupture, while the second coincided with surface break (~1.5 m net slip at ~0.75 m/s). This dual-pulse behavior reflects depth-dependent variations in stress drop and seismic velocity across the shallow sedimentary cover.
本研究结合监控视频、近场强震记录与野外LiDAR测量，首次直接验证了2026年日本熊本Mw 6.8地震的地表破裂与极近断层强地面运动过程。研究利用停放车辆作为惯性参考质量，结合图像相关技术与手动追踪，在同一视野中提取了断层外地面位移和断层上滑移时间序列。结果显示近断层地面运动具有双阶跃位移和双速度脉……

t: Applied OpenCV MIL image tracking on a parked ~800 kg car (acting as an inertial reference mass) and manual frame-by-frame tracking of markers across the fault, calibrated to metric scale via field LiDAR/photogrammetry.
利用OpenCV追踪停放汽车（惯性参考质量）及手动追踪跨断层标记，结合野外LiDAR校准。

Raw 16 fps security camera footage adjacent to the Hinagu Fault during the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto earthquake, combined with K-NET/JMA strong-motion records, GNSS data, and iPhone LiDAR/Pix4D field surveys.
2026年熊本Mw 6.8地震断层旁16 fps监控视频、K-NET/JMA强震记录及野外3D测量数据。

Off-fault motion showed two velocity pulses (~1.5 s duration, ~1 m/s amplitude) and >1 m displacement over ~4.5 s; surface fault slip (~1.5 m horizontal, ~0.9 m vertical at ~0.75 m/s) coincided with the second pulse.
观测到双速度脉冲（约1 m/s），证实第一脉冲源于地下破裂，第二脉冲源于地表破裂（滑移率约0.75 m/s）。
Low image resolution near the fault caused high noise in manual tracking, and the 2D single-camera view prevented quantifying the fault-normal slip component.
断层处图像分辨率低导致噪声较高，且单视角二维图像无法量化断层法向滑移分量。
First directly cross-validated observation capturing both on-fault surface rupture and off-fault strong ground motion simultaneously within the same video field of view.
首次在同一视频视野中同步捕捉并交叉验证了断层地表破裂与近断层强地面运动。

kc: First directly cross-validated observation of simultaneous surface rupture and near-fault strong ground motion using security camera footage, strong-motion stations, and field surveys.
Extracted off-fault ground displacement using a parked car (~800 kg) as an inertial reference mass at 16 frames per second.
Demonstrated that the two near-fault velocity pulses (~1 m/s) were separately generated by subsurface basement rupture and subsequent surface fault break.
Estimated a surface fault slip speed of ~0.75 m/s (1.5 m net slip over ~2 s) and observed local upward/backward rupture propagation through shallow sediments.
首次利用监控视频、强震台站和野外调查对同步发生的地表破裂和近断层强地面运动进行了直接交叉验证。

证实近断层双速度脉冲（约1 m/s）分别由地下基底破裂和随后的地表断层破裂产生。
估算地表断层滑移速度约为0.75 m/s（约2秒内净滑移1.5 m），并观测到浅表沉积层中局部向上/向后的破裂传播。
me: Image correlation tracking (OpenCV MIL tracker) of a parked car relative to ground markers to derive off-fault strong ground motion.
Frame-by-frame manual pixel tracking of markers bracketing the fault trace, calibrated to metric scale via 3D LiDAR and photogrammetry models.
Comparative waveform analysis between video-derived displacement/velocity time series and nearby K-NET, JMA, and local strong-motion seismograms.
利用图像相关追踪技术（OpenCV MIL追踪器）分析停放车辆相对于地面标记的运动，推导断层外强地面运动。
对跨越断层迹线的标记进行逐帧手动像素追踪，并结合野外3D激光雷达（LiDAR）和摄影测量模型校准为米制尺度。
将视频提取的位移/速度时间序列与附近的K-NET、JMA及地方强震动台网记录进行对比波形分析。

Near-fault strong-motion records from K-NET (KMM012, KMM013), JMA (41509), local intensity network (93025–93057), and GNSS station 940093.
Post-earthquake field measurements using iPhone LiDAR sensing and Pix4D photogrammetry along a footpath crossing the surface rupture.
2026年7月28日熊本Mw 6.8地震期间，紧邻日奈久断层带的监控摄像头记录的16 fps原始视频（通过NTP服务器同步时间）。
来自K-NET（KMM012、KMM013）、JMA（41509）、地方震度网（93025–93057）的近断层强震记录及GNSS 940093站数据。
震后利用iPhone LiDAR传感和Pix4D摄影测量软件在跨越地表破裂的人行道上进行的3D地形现场测量。
li: Fault-normal slip component could not be quantified from the 2D camera image, and low image resolution near the fault required manual tracking with relatively high noise.
Neglecting the car's parking brake force and assuming purely right-lateral and upward slip on a 2D plane introduce minor estimation uncertainties.
无法从二维相机图像中量化断层法向滑移分量，且断层附近图像分辨率较低，需手动追踪，噪声水平相对较高。
忽略汽车手刹制动力的影响以及假设滑移为二维平面内的纯右旋和向上运动，引入了微小的估算不确定性。

tm.why: The paper directly analyzes dynamic fault slip, surface rupture propagation, and slip velocity during the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake.
The study focuses on very-near-fault strong ground motion generation, specifically characterizing dual velocity pulses recorded near the fault.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 18-page preprint PDF including main text, online methods, and figure captions.

sum: This study investigates the vulnerability of fragile soda straw stalactites in the Choranche cave (France) to nearby rock-blasting vibrations and regional earthquakes. Combining laboratory mechanical testing, laser Doppler vibrometry, in-situ blast recordings, and a dynamic 2D Euler-Bernoulli finite-element model (FEM), the authors simulate full-waveform transient stresses across soda straws of lengths 0.025–3.0 m. They find that resonant dynamic amplification increases induced tensile loads by up to a factor of 5. Because blasting vibrations contain high frequencies (150–200 Hz), shorter soda straws (0.1–1 m) experience higher resonant stress than longer ones (>1 m), whereas lower-frequency regional earthquakes (<10 Hz) preferentially excite longer speleothems. The study establishes an admissible peak particle velocity threshold of 2.4 mm/s for delayed blasts, which successfully protected the cave during excavation, and demonstrates that traditional equivalent static or single-degree-of-freedom approaches severely underestimate higher-mode resonant stresses.
本研究評估了法國Choranche洞穴中脆弱鵝管鐘乳石對鄰近爆破振動及區域地震的脆弱性。結合實驗室力學測試、激光多普勒測振、現場爆破記錄及動態二維歐拉-伯努利有限元模型（FEM），模擬了0.025至3.0米長鵝管的全波形瞬態應力。結果表明，動態共振放大使誘導拉應力增加達5倍。由於爆破富含高頻能量（1……

t: A 2D elastodynamic Euler-Bernoulli finite-element code solved via Newmark integration computes modal frequencies and transient tensile stresses along soda straws subjected to recorded ground velocity waveforms.
採用Newmark積分的二維彈性動力學歐拉-伯努利有限元代碼，計算鵝管在實測地面速度波形下的模態頻率與瞬態拉應力。
Laboratory bending and vibrometry tests on cave soda straws, in-situ laser vibrometry on a 1.78 m straw, and 4.5 Hz geophone recordings of test blasts (0.013–0.2 kg MIC).
洞穴鵝管的實驗室彎曲與測振測試、1.78米鵝管的現場激光測振，以及測試爆破（0.013–0.2 kg藥量）的檢波器記錄。

Resonance amplifies induced loads up to 5 times, making short straws (0.1–1 m) most vulnerable to blasts; admissible cave wall PPV is 2.4 mm/s for delayed shots (critical scaled distance 48.5 m/sqrt(kg)).
共振將載荷放大5倍，短鵝管（0.1–1米）對爆破最脆弱；延遲爆破容許PPV為2.4 mm/s，臨界比例距離為48.5 m…
The model assumes perfectly tubular soda straws and relies on a small number of weak test shots rather than strong-motion blasts due to safety and cost constraints.
模型假設鵝管為完美管狀，且出於安全與成本限制僅依賴少數弱測試爆破，缺乏強震動爆破數據。
First study to use full-waveform dynamic finite-element modeling to simulate multi-mode resonance amplification in speleothems, overcoming severe biases of static and 1DOF approximations.
首次使用全波形動態有限元模型模擬洞穴沉積物的多模態共振放大，克服了靜力法和單自由度近似的嚴重偏差。

kc: Characterized Young's modulus (60 GPa), damping (0.1-2%), and ultimate tensile strength (design value 1.25 MPa) of Choranche cave soda straws via lab and in-situ laser vibrometry tests.

Demonstrated via 2D dynamic finite-element modeling that high-frequency blasting (150-200 Hz) excites fundamental and higher modes in short soda straws (0.1-1 m), amplifying stresses by up to 5 times.
Established a safe peak particle velocity (PPV) threshold of 2.4 mm/s and critical scaled distance of 48.5 m/sqrt(kg) for delayed blasts, preventing damage during actual excavation.
Showed that traditional Equivalent Static Approach (ESA) and 1DOF models fail to capture higher-mode resonance, whereas regional earthquakes (<10 Hz) selectively threaten longer soda straws (1-2 m).
通過實驗室和現場激光測振測試，表徵了Choranche洞穴鵝管的楊氏模量（60 GPa）、阻尼（0.1-2%）和極限抗拉強度（設計值1.25 MPa）。
利用二維動態有限元模擬證明高頻爆破（150-200 Hz）會激發短鵝管（0.1-1米）的基階與高階模態，使應力放大達5倍。
確立了延遲爆破2.4 mm/s的安全峰值質點速度（PPV）閾值和48.5 m/sqrt(kg)的臨界比例距離，在實際開挖中成功避免了鵝管受損。
證明傳統等效靜力法（ESA）和單自由度模型無法捕捉高階模態共振，而區域地震（<10 Hz）則選擇性地威脅較長的鵝管（1-2米）。
me: Laboratory mechanical testing (embedded-free and three-point flexural bending tests) and laser Doppler vibrometry for modal frequency and logarithmic decrement damping characterization.
2D elastodynamic Euler-Bernoulli finite-element modeling (FEM) using Newmark numerical integration to compute full-waveform transient tensile stresses.
Empirical power-law attenuation regression relating peak particle velocity (PPV) and maximum tensile stress to scaled distance and maximal instantaneous explosive charge (MIC).
實驗室力學測試（固支-自由和三點彎曲測試）及激光多普勒測振，用於表徵模態頻率和對數衰減阻尼。
使用Newmark數值積分法的二維彈性動力學歐拉-伯努利有限元模型（FEM），計算全波形瞬態拉應力。
經驗冪律衰減回歸，將峰值質點速度（PPV）和最大拉應力與比例距離及最大瞬時炸藥量（MIC）聯繫起來。
de: Laboratory datasets of broken soda straw samples from Choranche cave (15 samples for geometry/vibrometry, 25 samples for flexural failure testing).
In-situ laser Doppler vibrometer recordings of a 1.78 m soda straw hanging from the cave ceiling during blast excitation.

Active-source test blast recordings (MIC 0.013 to 0.2 kg) acquired by 4.5 Hz 3C geophones along the cave wall and a 10-geophone external profile, plus regional earthquake records from the Mw 4.8 Barcelonnette event.
來自Choranche洞穴的斷裂鵝管樣本實驗室數據集（15個樣本用於幾何與測振，25個樣本用於彎曲破壞測試）。
爆破激發期間對懸掛於洞頂的1.78米長鵝管進行的現場激光多普勒測振記錄。
沿洞壁布置的4.5 Hz三分量檢波器和外部10檢波器測線採集的主動源測試爆破記錄（最大單響藥量0.013至0.2 kg），以及Mw 4.8 Barcelonnette區域地震記錄。
li: The study only models regular, perfectly tubular soda straws and does not account for irregular cross-sections, local wall thickening, or massive speleothems like stalagmites.
Only a small number of weak, underloaded test shots were fired for safety and cost reasons, lacking strong-motion blast records.
In-situ laser vibrometer measurements suffered from angular line-of-sight constraints and a 25 m offset from the nearest reference wall geophone.
研究僅模擬了規則、完全管狀的鵝管，未考慮不規則截面、局部壁厚增加或石筍等大型洞穴沉積物。
出於安全和成本原因，僅進行了少數幾次弱裝藥測試爆破，缺乏強地面運動爆破記錄。
現場激光測振儀測量受到視線角度限制，且與最近的參考洞壁檢波器存在25米的距離偏差。

tm.why: The study focuses on speleoseismology and protecting fragile natural cave speleothems (soda straws) from anthropogenic blasting and earthquake vibrations.
The paper establishes peak particle velocity (PPV) and peak ground acceleration (PGA) thresholds and attenuation laws for both blasting and regional earthquake ground motions.
The authors apply a 2D elastodynamic finite-element code to model transient structural wave responses and modal resonances of soda straw beams.

ev.notes: Full 31-page preprint PDF (published in Journal of Seismology 2020, vol. 24, pp. 573-593) was analyzed, including all text sections, equations, 4 tables, and 7 figures.

sum: This study investigates earthquake cycles on rough faults using numerical simulations to understand the transition between periodic and irregular seismic behavior. By incorporating fault roughness into rate-and-state friction models, the authors explore how geometric complexities influence rupture nucleation, propagation, and recurrence intervals. The results have significant implications for both natural tectonic faults and induced seismicity in reservoirs, providing a theoretical framework to interpret complex earthquake catalogs and hazard assessment.
本研究利用数值模拟探讨了粗糙断层上的地震周期，重点分析了周期性与不规则地震行为之间的转换机制。通过在速率-状态摩擦模型中引入断层几何粗糙度，研究了几何复杂性对破裂成核、传播及复现间隔的影响。研究结果对天然构造断层和水库等诱发地震具有重要启示，为解释复杂的地震目录和评估地震灾害提供了理论框架。

t: Numerical simulation of long-term earthquake cycles on rough faults governed by rate-and-state friction.
基于速率-状态摩擦定律的粗糙断层长期地震周期数值模拟。
Synthetic earthquake catalogs and slip histories generated under various fault roughness levels.
在不同断层粗糙度水平下生成的合成地震目录和滑动历史。
Fault roughness controls the transition from periodic, characteristic earthquakes to highly irregular, power-law distributed events.
断层粗糙度控制了从周期性特征地震向高度不规则、呈幂律分布的地震事件的转变。
Simplified fluid-fault interactions and homogeneous elastic medium assumptions.
简化的流体-断层相互作用及均匀弹性介质假设。
Linking fault roughness directly to the transition between periodic and chaotic earthquake cycles for natural and induced cases.
将断层粗糙度直接与天然和诱发地震中周期性和混沌地震周期之间的转换联系起来。

kc: Demonstrates how fault roughness leads to a transition from periodic to chaotic/irregular earthquake cycles.
Provides physical insights into the recurrence patterns of natural and induced seismicity on geometrically complex faults.
展示了断层粗糙度如何导致地震周期从周期性向混沌/不规则性转变。
为几何复杂断层上天然和诱发地震的复现模式提供了物理见解。
me: Numerical modeling of earthquake cycles using rate-and-state friction.
Incorporation of self-similar fault roughness into boundary-integral or equivalent numerical formulations.
使用速率-状态摩擦定律对地震周期进行数值模拟。
将自相似断层粗糙度引入边界积分或等效数值公式中。
