在不同粗糙度参数下通过长期地震周期模拟生成的合成地震目录。
li: Simplified rheology and fluid pressure assumptions compared to highly complex real-world reservoir settings.
Computational limitations in resolving very high-frequency wave propagation over multiple cycles.
与高度复杂的真实水库环境相比，流体压力和流变学假设较为简化。
在多个周期内解析极高频波传播时存在计算限制。

tm.why: The paper models earthquake cycles and rupture dynamics on geometrically complex rough faults.
It investigates how fault roughness affects friction, slip, and earthquake cycle regularity.
The title explicitly highlights implications for both natural and induced seismicity.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, publication year, and general scientific context of earthquake cycle modeling on rough faults.

sum: This study demonstrates that landfalling tropical cyclones can transiently alter Earth's rotation (length of day, LOD) by amounts comparable to great earthquakes. Using atmospheric reanalysis data and numerical simulations, the authors show that Hurricanes Harvey (2017) and Katrina (2005) lengthened the day by 1.87 and 2.29 microseconds, respectively. This reveals a previously unrecognized meteorological source of LOD variability, which may become increasingly significant under climate warming.
本研究表明，登陆的热带气旋可以瞬态改变地球自转（昼长，LOD），其影响程度堪比大地震。作者利用大气再分析数据和数值模拟，发现2017年哈维飓风和2005年卡特里娜飓风分别使昼长延长了1.87微秒和2.29微秒。这揭示了此前未被认识的地球自转变化的气象源，在气候变暖背景下其重要性可能进一步增加。

t: Atmospheric reanalysis estimation and numerical simulations of Earth's rotational response to tropical cyclones.
利用大气再分析估算以及地球对热带气旋自转响应的数值模拟。
Atmospheric reanalysis data and simulated rotational responses for Hurricanes Harvey (2017) and Katrina (2005).
哈维（2017）和卡特里娜（2005）飓风的大气再分析数据及模拟自转响应。
Hurricanes Harvey and Katrina transiently lengthened the day by 1.87 and 2.29 microseconds, respectively.
哈维和卡特里娜飓风分别使昼长瞬态延长了1.87微秒和2.29微秒。
Relies on atmospheric reanalysis and simulations rather than direct geodetic detection of individual transient events.
依赖于大气再分析和模拟，而非对单个瞬态事件的直接大地测量检测。
First to demonstrate that landfalling tropical cyclones can transiently alter Earth's rotation by amounts comparable to great earthquakes.
首次证明登陆的热带气旋能瞬态改变地球自转，其幅度堪比大地震。

kc: Discovered that landfalling tropical cyclones can transiently alter Earth's length of day (LOD) by microsecond-level amounts.
Quantified the LOD changes for major hurricanes, showing Katrina and Harvey lengthened the day by 2.29 and 1.87 microseconds, respectively.
Highlighted tropical cyclones as an increasingly important source of Earth's rotation variability under climate warming.
发现登陆的热带气旋可以使地球昼长（LOD）发生微秒级的瞬态改变。
量化了主要飓风对昼长的影响，表明卡特里娜和哈维飓风分别使昼长延长了2.29和1.87微秒。
指出在气候变暖背景下，热带气旋正成为地球自转变化中日益重要的源。
me: Atmospheric reanalysis data analysis to estimate angular momentum and mass distribution changes.
Numerical simulations of Earth's rotation to confirm the transient perturbations in the length of day.
利用大气再分析数据分析角动量和质量分布的变化。
进行地球自转的数值模拟，以证实昼长的瞬态扰动。
de: Atmospheric reanalysis datasets for historical tropical cyclones (e.g., Hurricanes Harvey and Katrina).
Numerical simulation experiments modeling Earth's rotational response to cyclone-induced mass and wind changes.
历史热带气旋（如哈维和卡特里娜飓风）的大气再分析数据集。
模拟地球对气旋引起的质量和风场变化的自转响应的数值模拟实验。
li: The study relies on reanalysis data and simulations; direct geodetic observation of such transient microsecond-level changes remains challenging due to other background noise.
该研究依赖于再分析数据和模拟；由于其他背景噪声的存在，对这种微秒级瞬态变化的直接大地测量观测仍具挑战性。

tm.why: The paper investigates changes in Earth's rotation (length of day) caused by landfalling tropical cyclones, which is a key geodynamics topic.
It explores the environmental and meteorological impacts of tropical cyclones on global Earth systems.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract as no PDF was available.

sum: This study applies first-arrival travel-time tomography to a 55-km-long deep seismic reflection profile in the Longwei Co area of the northern Qiangtang Basin, Tibet. It resolves the shallow crustal velocity structure down to 2 km depth, revealing a 'three uplifts and four depressions' structural configuration. These structures are primarily controlled by the Longwei Co Thrust (LCT) and Amu Co Thrust (ACT). The study identifies two distinct conjugate shear fault systems with shallow extensions. The results show stronger north-south compressional deformation compared to the east-west direction, driven by the northward subduction of the Indian plate. These low-velocity depressions and fault networks provide favorable conditions for hydrocarbon systems.
本研究对藏北羌塘盆地北部龙尾错地区一条长约55公里的深地震反射剖面应用了初至波走时断层成像，获得了2公里深度内的浅表地壳细微速度结构。结果揭示了该地区“三隆四坳”的构造格局，这些隆起主要受龙尾错断裂（LCT）和阿木错断裂（ACT）控制。研究识别出两组呈共轭剪切特征的浅表断裂系统，并指出南北向的挤压褶……

t: First-arrival travel-time tomography applied to a 55-km-long deep seismic reflection profile.
对55公里长的深地震反射剖面应用初至波走时断层成像技术。
First-arrival travel times from a 55-km-long north-south deep seismic reflection profile in the Longwei Co area.

sum: This paper proposes a novel seismogenic mechanism coupling core magma thermal energy, electron thermal-diffusion power generation, and the plate piezoelectric effect. It suggests that deep-Earth magma charges overlying rock plates, causing inverse-piezoelectric deformation and subsequent discharge that triggers earthquakes and electromagnetic waves. Based on this, the author outlines a multi-parameter monitoring framework using GNSS, geoelectric, and geomagnetic data, and proposes a non-delay, blind-zone-free early-warning system exploiting the speed difference between electromagnetic and seismic waves.
本文提出了一种耦合地核岩浆热能、电子热扩散发电与板块压电效应的新型致震机制。该理论认为深部岩浆通过电子热扩散产生电荷分离并对上覆岩石充电，逆压电效应引发形变，而放电过程则触发地震并产生电磁波。基于此，作者设计了结合GNSS、地电和地磁的多参数监测框架，并利用电磁波与地震波的传播速度差，构建了无延迟、……

sum: This study deploys a temporary seismometer network at Mt. Aso volcano to perform high-resolution 3D ambient-noise surface-wave tomography. The authors identify an ellipsoidal low S-wave velocity (Vs ~1.5 km/s) anomaly at 2.5–4.5 km depth beneath the Nakadake crater, interpreted as a highly fractured, pressurized shallow magma storage zone. Above this zone, a narrow, vertically elongated low-Vs structure is imaged, representing a hydrothermal conduit that transports pressurized fluids to the surface and likely generates very long-period (VLP) tremors. The findings provide critical insights into the volcano's shallow plumbing system and fluid pathways.
本研究在阿苏火山部署了临时地震台网，并应用背景噪声面波成像技术获取了高分辨率三维浅部地壳结构。在中岳火山口下方2.5-4.5公里深度处，发现了一个椭圆形的低剪切波速度（Vs ~1.5 km/s）异常区，解释为高度破裂且超压的浅部岩浆储集区。在该储集区上方，成像出了一个狭窄且垂直延伸的低速结构，解释为……

High-resolution imaging of both the shallow magma storage and its connection to the overlying hydrothermal conduit generating VLP tremors.

sum: Previous studies linked the November 2022 ML 5.6 induced earthquake near Peace River, Alberta, to a saltwater disposal well (Well 15) about 5 km away. However, other high-volume wells ~35 km away have injected into the Leduc Formation for decades. To test whether Well 15 dominates fault pressure loading across plausible hydraulic properties, the authors ran a 1,000-realization 3D finite-element pore-pressure diffusion ensemble using recorded histories from 15 wells, varying Leduc reservoir, fault damage zone, and fault gouge zone permeabilities. Using linear superposition to isolate individual well contributions averaged over the basement fault plane, they found Well 15 contributed more pressure than all other wells combined in only 26.6% of realizations, whereas distant Well 10 dominated in 67.9%. Faster regional pressure transmission (Leduc permeability >= 15.5 mD) allowed decades of distant injection to dominate, showing distant wells cannot be ruled out when regional diffusivity is poorly constrained.
针对加拿大阿尔伯塔省和平河2022年ML 5.6诱发地震的注水归因问题，本研究利用15口废水处理井的历史月度注水数据，构建了包含1000个水力参数实现的区域三维有限元孔隙压力扩散模型系综。通过改变Leduc储层及断层破碎带、断层泥的渗透率，评估了近场15号井（距震群5 km）与远场长期注水井（如距震……

t: Constructed a 3D finite-element pore-pressure diffusion model over an 84x70x10 km domain in OpenGeoSys, running 1,000 realizations across varied Leduc reservoir, fault damage zone, and fault gouge permeabilities, using linear superposition to isolate individual well contributions.
利用OpenGeoSys构建三维有限元孔隙压力扩散模型，对储层和断层渗透率进行1000次采样并分解单井贡献。

Monthly saltwater disposal volumes from 15 wells (1979–2024) from the Alberta Energy Regulator via geoSCOUT, combined with a 9-unit hydrostratigraphic model from the Geological Framework of Alberta Version 3.

In November 2022, nearby Well 15 dominated mean basement fault pressure in 26.6% of realizations, while distant Well 10 dominated in 67.9%; Well 15 was never dominant when Leduc permeability was >= 15.5 mD.

The model neglects poroelastic stress transfer, assumes homogeneous isotropic units, and ignores structural uncertainties and localized fault pressure peaks.

对Leduc储层渗透率（2–200 mD）、断层破碎带及断层泥渗透率比值进行10×10×10对数网格采样，构建1000个实现的参数系综。

忽略了孔隙弹性应力传递和地层形变，仅模拟了单相孔隙压力扩散。

sum: This book chapter provides a foundational overview of linear least-squares filters, framing them within classical linear inverse theory. It details two primary applications: prediction-error filters for forecasting future time-series measurements, and Wiener–Kolmogorov filters for noise suppression. The text connects theoretical least-squares formulations with practical signal processing, demonstrating how to systematically estimate filter coefficients from past observations to solve time-dependent inverse problems.
本章系统地介绍了线性最小二乘滤波器的基础理论，并将其纳入经典线性反演问题的框架中。重点探讨了两种核心应用：用于预测未来时间序列观测值的预测误差滤波器，以及用于抑制噪声的维纳-柯尔莫哥洛夫滤波器。该内容将最小二乘理论与实际信号处理相结合，展示了如何利用历史数据系统地估计滤波器系数，以解决与时间相关的反……

t: Linear least-squares optimization to systematically estimate filter coefficients for prediction-error and Wiener-Kolmogorov filtering.
利用线性最小二乘优化系统地估计预测误差和维纳-柯尔莫哥洛夫滤波的滤波器系数。
Illustrative time-series data used to demonstrate denoising and predictive capabilities.
用于演示去噪和预测能力的说明性时间序列数据。
Mathematical formulation showing how least-squares filters systematically suppress noise and forecast future observations.
展示最小二乘滤波器如何系统地抑制噪声并预测未来观测值的数学公式。
The methods are strictly linear and assume stationary statistics for optimal performance.
该方法严格限于线性，且假设平稳统计特性以获得最佳性能。
A pedagogical integration of classical filtering techniques directly into the modern geophysical inverse problem framework.

sum: This study uses spectral boundary-integral simulations of overstressed-patch configurations to systematically investigate how physical factors control the shape of earthquake source time functions (STFs). The authors find that rupture initiation location controls growth-phase curvature and symmetry, background stress gradients dictate the abruptness of the arrest phase, and overstress zone geometry governs plateau development. Crucially, strongly early-peaking, long-tailed STFs require a secondary frictional weakening distance comparable to or exceeding total fault slip, indicating scale-dependent breakdown. These controls are largely separable when combined, providing a physical framework for interpreting STF shapes in seismic source inversions and ground motion predictions.
本研究利用超应力斑块配置的谱边界积分模拟，系统探讨了物理因素对地震震源时间函数（STF）形状的控制机制。研究表明，破裂起始位置控制增长阶段的曲率与对称性；背景应力梯度决定破裂停止阶段的骤减程度；超应力区几何形状控制平台期的发育。特别地，强早期达峰和长尾部的STF形状需要次级摩擦弱化距离接近或超过总断……

t: Spectral boundary-integral simulations of idealized overstressed-patch configurations on a fault to model dynamic earthquake rupture.
利用断层上理想化超应力斑块配置的谱边界积分模拟来建模地震动态破裂。
Synthetic source time functions generated from parametric numerical simulations of dynamic rupture.
通过动态破裂的参数化数值模拟生成的合成震源时间函数。
Initiation location controls growth curvature, stress gradient controls arrest abruptness, patch geometry governs plateaus, and long tails require large secondary weakening distances.
起始位置控制增长曲率，应力梯度控制停止骤减度，斑块几何决定平台期，长尾部需要较大的次级弱化距离。
The simulations use idealized patch configurations and do not account for highly heterogeneous or complex fault geometries.
模拟采用了理想化的斑块配置，未考虑高度非均匀或复杂的断层几何。
Systematically isolates and pairs the individual and combined effects of multiple physical mechanisms on the detailed shape of source time functions.
系统地分离并配对了多种物理机制对震源时间函数详细形状的单独和组合影响。

kc: Identified that rupture initiation location controls the growth-phase curvature and symmetry of the STF.
Demonstrated that background stress gradients govern the abruptness of the STF arrest phase.
Showed that overstress zone geometry controls plateau development and pulse-like slip without explicit self-healing.
Revealed that long-tailed STF shapes require a secondary frictional weakening distance comparable to or exceeding total fault slip.
Proved that these physical controls are largely separable when combined.
确定了破裂起始位置控制STF增长阶段的曲率和对称性。
证明了背景应力梯度决定了STF停止阶段的骤减程度。
表明超应力区几何形状控制平台期发育并产生脉冲式滑动，而无需显式的自愈合机制。
揭示了长尾部STF形状需要次级摩擦弱化距离接近或超过总断层滑动量。
证明了这些物理控制机制在组合时具有较强的可分离性。
me: Spectral boundary-integral equation method (SBIEM) for simulating dynamic rupture.
Idealized overstressed-patch configurations on a fault.
Parametric analysis of initiation location, stress gradient, patch geometry, and slip-weakening friction parameters.
用于模拟动态破裂的谱边界积分方程方法（SBIEM）。
断层上理想化的超应力斑块配置。
对起始位置、应力梯度、斑块几何和滑移弱化摩擦参数进行参数化分析。
de: Numerical simulations of dynamic earthquake rupture under varying physical parameters (initiation location, stress gradient, patch geometry, and frictional weakening distance).
在不同物理参数（起始位置、应力梯度、斑块几何和摩擦弱化距离）下进行地震动态破裂的数值模拟。

该研究依赖于理想化的超应力斑块配置，未完全纳入复杂的断层几何或高度非均匀的应力场。

tm.why: The paper uses dynamic rupture simulations to investigate the physical controls on the shape of earthquake source time functions (STFs).

sum: This study utilizes a large dataset of Pn arrival times to construct a high-resolution anisotropic velocity model of the uppermost mantle beneath Southwestern Europe. The resulting tomographic images reveal prominent low-velocity Pn anomalies parallel to major Cenozoic orogenic belts and Variscan massifs, contrasted with high-velocity anomalies beneath the Adriatic microplate, western Mediterranean back-arc basins, and the Franconian Platform. The complex pattern of Pn fast-propagation directions correlates strongly with regional tectonic features. By integrating these seismic observations with geological data, the authors propose a comprehensive lithospheric evolution model for Southwestern Europe, highlighting the roles of Variscan accretion, Permo-Triassic slab dynamics, Jurassic rifting, and Cenozoic subduction/fragmentation. The work provides key insights into how hot collisional processes versus cold subduction zones differentially impact uppermost mantle structure and crustal accretion.
本研究利用大量Pn走时数据，构建了西南欧最上地幔高分辨率各向异性速度模型。结果显示，新生代主要造山带和海西期地块下方存在与造山走向平行的显著Pn低速异常，而亚德里亚微板块、西地中海弧后盆地和弗兰肯平台下方则呈现高速异常。Pn快波偏振方向与区域构造密切相关。结合地质信息，研究重建了西南欧岩石圈演化历史……

t: Pn travel-time anisotropic tomography to simultaneously invert for uppermost mantle lateral velocity variations and azimuthal anisotropy.
利用大量Pn走时数据进行高分辨率各向异性断层成像，反演最上地幔速度与各向异性。
A large dataset of Pn arrival times compiled from regional and local earthquakes across Southwestern Europe.
收集自西南欧区域地震台网的大规模Pn波震相走时数据集。
Revealed low-velocity Pn anomalies beneath Cenozoic orogens and Variscan massifs, high-velocity anomalies beneath the Adriatic microplate and back-arc basins, and complex tectonic-aligned anisotropy.
发现造山带下方呈Pn低速异常，微板块下方呈高速异常，且各向异性与构造走向一致。
Resolution is inherently restricted to the uppermost mantle depth range and depends on regional station and earthquake distribution.
仅敏感于最上地幔顶部，垂直分辨率有限，且受台站分布不均影响。
Provides the first highly coherent, high-resolution regional Pn anisotropic model linking deep uppermost mantle structure directly to multi-stage Phanerozoic tectonic evolution.
首次构建了该区域高分辨率Pn各向异性模型，系统阐明了多阶段岩石圈演化历史。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution Pn anisotropic velocity model of the uppermost mantle beneath Southwestern Europe.
Identified distinct Pn velocity and anisotropy patterns corresponding to Variscan massifs, Cenozoic orogens, and back-arc basins.
Proposed a coherent lithospheric evolution model for Southwestern Europe from the Variscan orogeny to Cenozoic fragmentation.
构建了西南欧最上地幔高分辨率Pn各向异性速度模型。
识别出与海西地块、新生代造山带及弧后盆地相对应的独特Pn速度和各向异性特征。
提出了一个连贯的西南欧岩石圈演化模型，涵盖从海西造山运动到新生代裂解的各个阶段。
me: Pn travel-time anisotropic tomography to image uppermost mantle velocity and anisotropy.
Pn走时各向异性断层成像，用于反演最上地幔速度与各向异性结构。
de: Compiled a large dataset of Pn arrival times from regional and local earthquakes across Southwestern Europe.
收集并整理了横跨西南欧区域及地方地震的大量Pn波走时数据集。
li: Pn waves primarily sample the uppermost mantle, limiting vertical resolution at deeper lithospheric levels.
Resolution is dependent on the spatial distribution of regional earthquakes and seismic stations.
Pn波主要采样最上地幔顶部，限制了更深部岩石圈的垂直分辨率。
成像分辨率受限于区域地震和地震台网的空间分布不均。

The study specifically images the Pn anisotropic velocity structure and fast-propagation directions.
The results are used to reconstruct the lithospheric evolution, crustal accretion, and fragmentation of Southwestern Europe.

sum: This study investigates the April and May 2026 M4 earthquakes (ML 4.07 and ML 4.33) near the Quest Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) project in Alberta, Canada, representing the largest known CCS-induced earthquakes in a saline aquifer worldwide. By compiling a composite catalog enhanced via single-station template matching, the authors reveal a 10-year outward diffusion of seismicity up to 50-70 km from the injection wells, correlating with CO2 injection at >99% confidence. Focal mechanisms indicate reverse-slip reactivation of shallow Precambrian basement faults (2.5-5.0 km depth) optimally oriented to the ambient stress field, located along major basement domain boundaries (Snowbird Tectonic Zone) despite discordant strikes. Complementary TOUGH3 multiphase reservoir simulations estimate far-field overpressures of ~2 to 40 kPa at the ML 4.07 hypocenter (~35 km away) and show that pressure will continue rising for years even if injection ceases, underscoring major challenges for far-field CCS risk management.
本研究分析了加拿大阿尔伯塔省Quest碳捕集与封存（CCS）项目附近于2026年发生的M4级地震（ML 4.07和ML 4.33），这是目前全球咸水层CCS诱发的最大地震。通过整合地震目录并应用单台模板匹配技术，研究揭示了自2015年注入CO2以来，地震活动向外扩散达50-70公里，且与注入量呈高度……

t: The authors combine single-station template matching (45 master events on CN.EDM), focal mechanism inversion, cross-correlation reshuffling statistical tests, and multiphase CO2-brine reservoir simulations using TOUGH3 to link seismicity with CO2 injection.
结合单台模板匹配、震源机制反演、互相关重排统计检验以及TOUGH3多相流体储层数值模拟。

A composite seismic catalog (1985–2026) combining regional networks and Shell's local downhole array, augmented with 244 matched-filter detections, alongside injection histories from three Quest wells (~1 Mt/year CO2 into the Basal Cambrian Sandstone).
1985至2026年区域与井下综合地震目录（含244个模板匹配事件）及三口Quest井CO2注入数据。

Seismicity correlates with injection (>99% confidence) and diffuses up to 50–70 km away (diffusivity 1.2–3.5 m2/s), inducing ML 4.07 and ML 4.33 basement reverse-faulting earthquakes at modeled overpressures of ~2 to 40 kPa.
地震与注入高度相关（>99%）并向外扩散达50-70公里，在2-40 kPa超压下诱发了M4级基底逆断层地震。
Lack of far-field downhole pressure constraints leads to an order-of-magnitude discrepancy (~2 kPa vs. ~40 kPa) between reservoir models grounded solely in near-field well logs and core data.
缺乏远场孔隙压力直接观测约束，导致储层模型对远场超压的预测存在数量级差异。
Characterizes the world's largest CCS-induced earthquakes in a saline aquifer (M4) and demonstrates long-range fault reactivation up to 35–70 km away from CO2 injection wells.
首次系统刻画全球最大的咸水层CCS诱发M4级地震，证实了远达35-70公里的超远距离断层活化。

kc: Documents the largest known earthquakes (ML 4.07 / MW 3.88 and ML 4.33 / MW 4.02) induced by CCS injection into a saline aquifer worldwide.
Demonstrates a decade-long outward spatiotemporal diffusion of seismicity up to 50-70 km from the Quest injection wells, matching hydraulic diffusivity of 1.2-3.5 m2/s.
Determines that events occur on optimally oriented NW-SE striking reverse faults in the shallow Precambrian basement along major domain boundaries of the Snowbird Tectonic Zone.
Shows via TOUGH3 reservoir modeling that far-field overpressures (~2 to 40 kPa at ~35 km) will continue to increase for years even if injection stops immediately.
记录并证实了全球已知由咸水层CCS注入诱发的最大规模地震（ML 4.07 / MW 3.88 和 ML 4.33 / MW 4.02）。
揭示了自Quest注入井向外长达十年、远达50-70公里的地震时空扩散模式，与1.2-3.5 m2/s的水力扩散系数一致。
查明发震构造为前寒武纪浅层基底中沿Snowbird构造带主要地体边界分布、在当前应力场下呈最优取向的NW-SE向逆断层。
通过TOUGH3储层模拟表明，35公里外的远场超压（约2至40 kPa）即使在立即停止注入的情况下仍将在未来数年内持续上升。
me: Single-station template matching on station CN.EDM using 45 master events (50 s segments, 1-5 Hz filter) to enhance historical catalog completeness.
Statistical cross-correlation reshuffling test to quantify temporal correlation between CO2 injection and earthquake rates.
Seismic focal mechanism inversion and Kagan angle stability analysis for larger basement earthquakes.
Multiphase fluid and heat flow numerical modeling (CO2 and brine) using TOUGH3 under base-case and modified permeability scenarios.
利用45个主事件（50秒窗长，1-5 Hz滤波）在CN.EDM台站进行单台模板匹配，以提高历史地震目录的完整性。
应用统计互相关重排检验量化CO2注入与地震发生率之间的时间相关性。
针对较大规模的基底地震开展震源机制反演及Kagan角稳定性分析。
使用TOUGH3模拟器在基准参数和修正渗透率情景下开展CO2和盐水两相流数值模拟。
de: Composite earthquake catalog from 1985 to 2026 combining regional networks (AGS, NRCan, RAVEN, CRANE, CNSN) and Shell's local downhole monitoring array (SCISMN).
Monthly CO2 injection records from three Quest CCS wells (08-19, 07-11, and 05-35) targeting the Basal Cambrian Sandstone at ~2.1 km depth since August 2015.
In situ hydraulic parameters from well logs and drill cores, regional stratigraphy, and aeromagnetic anomaly maps of Precambrian basement domains.
整合了1985年至2026年区域台网（AGS、NRCan、RAVEN、CRANE、CNSN）与壳牌公司井下监测台网（SCISMN）的综合地震目录。
自2015年8月以来靶向约2.1公里深寒武系底部砂岩层（BCS）的三口Quest注入井（08-19、07-11和05-35）的月度CO2注入数据。
来自测井和岩芯的原位水力参数、区域地层数据以及前寒武纪基底构造域的航磁异常图。
li: Lack of far-field downhole pressure monitoring data leaves an order-of-magnitude ambiguity (~2 kPa vs. ~40 kPa) between reservoir modeling scenarios.
Seismic station coverage is spatially and temporally heterogeneous, and the operator's downhole array only reported events out to ~15 km.
No InSAR-discernible geodetic surface deformation was observable to independently constrain subsurface pressure or fault slip.
缺乏远场井下压力监测数据，导致不同储层模型情景对远场超压的估计存在一个数量级的不确定性（约2 kPa对比约40 kPa）。
地震台站覆盖在时空上不均匀，且运营商的井下监测台网仅报告约15公里范围内的事件。
未能观测到InSAR可识别的地表形变，无法对地下压力变化或断层滑动提供独立的大地测量约束。

tm.why: The paper investigates M4 earthquakes induced by commercial CO2 injection at the Quest Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) project in Alberta, Canada.
The authors compile a composite earthquake catalog dating back to 1985 and enhance it using single-station template matching to track spatiotemporal seismicity diffusion.
The study determines focal mechanisms of larger induced events, showing reactivation of optimally oriented reverse faults in the shallow Precambrian basement.

ev.notes: Full 12-page GRL article PDF analyzed, including text, all 4 figures, and references.

sum: Direct geological evidence linking mid-crustal CO2 transport to transient seismic deformation is scarce. This study investigates previously unreported carbonate-bearing breccias and fault veins preserved within viscous mid-crustal shear zones (>350–400°C, 0.5–0.8 GPa) in the Central and Western European Alps. Combining field structural analysis, optical/SEM petrography, C-O-Sr isotope and trace-element geochemistry, and thermodynamic calcite solubility modeling, the authors show that these structures formed via fault-valve processes under supra-lithostatic (>500 MPa) pressures from low-salinity H2O–CO2 (<50 vol% CO2) metamorphic fluids. Because CO2-bearing fluids have poor wetting properties and large molar volumes, they promoted localized embrittlement within otherwise ductile shear zones. Solubility modeling demonstrates that a single dilatancy-induced pressure drop yields a sealing efficiency of <0.05%, requiring sustained fluid fluxes or repeated fracture-seal cycles. These rocks represent a fossil analogue for CO2-driven aftershocks and swarm seismicity beneath active collisional orogens like the Himalaya.
本研究结合野外构造分析、显微岩相学、C-O-Sr同位素与微量元素地球化学及方解石溶解度热力学模拟，研究了欧洲阿尔卑斯中地壳韧性剪切带（>350–400°C, 0.5–0.8 GPa）中的含碳酸盐角砾岩和断层脉。结果表明，这些构造是在超静岩流体压力（>500 MPa）下，由低盐度H2O–CO2变质流体……

t: The authors combine field drone mapping, microstructural petrography, C-O-Sr isotope and LA-ICP-MS trace-element geochemistry, and thermodynamic calcite solubility modeling in pure H2O to quantify mid-crustal fluid sources and fault-sealing efficiency.
结合无人机填图、显微岩相学、C-O-Sr同位素与微量元素分析及方解石溶解度模拟，量化中地壳流体来源与断层封闭效率。

Field observations, microstructures, and geochemical datasets (δ13C, δ18O, 87Sr/86Sr, trace elements) from carbonate-bearing breccias and fault-veins in the Gotthard, Mont Blanc, and Aar massifs, alongside a regional Alpine fluid-inclusion compilation.
采集自Gotthard、Mont Blanc和Aar地块含碳酸盐角砾岩与断层脉的构造、显微和地球化学数据及区域流体包裹体…

Carbonates precipitated at >350–400°C and >500 MPa from low-salinity H2O-CO2 fluids (<50 vol% CO2). Single-drop calcite sealing efficiency is <0.05% (and <<0.2% max), requiring 10^3–10^4 fluid volumes or events to explain field volumes.
碳酸盐在>350–400°C和>500 MPa下由低盐度H2O-CO2流体沉淀；单次封闭效率<0.05%，需10^3–1…

Using pure H2O simplifies multicomponent natural fluids in solubility models, and large uncertainties in duration and episodicity prevent reliable comparison between calculated CO2 storage and yearly orogenic degassing fluxes.
溶解度模型将天然多组分流体简化为纯水；持续时间和幕式特征的不确定性阻碍了与造山带年脱气通量的可靠对比。

Documents previously unreported mid-crustal carbonate breccias in viscous shear zones, demonstrating how CO2-bearing fluids drive transient embrittlement and inefficient fault sealing as a fossil analogue for deep orogenic seismicity.
首次报道中地壳韧性剪切带中的碳酸盐角砾岩，证实含CO2流体驱动瞬态脆化与低效封闭，提供深部地震的化石类比。

kc: Documents previously unreported volumes of carbonate-bearing breccias and fault veins within Alpine mid-crustal ductile shear zones.
Demonstrates through C-O-Sr isotopes and trace elements that carbonates precipitated from deeply sourced, low-salinity H2O–CO2 metamorphic fluids.
Shows via calcite solubility modeling that single-event sealing efficiency is <0.05%, requiring sustained fluid flow or thousands of fracture-seal cycles.
Establishes a fossil analogue linking CO2-driven transient embrittlement and fault-valving to mid-crustal swarm seismicity in active collisional orogens.
记录了阿尔卑斯中地壳韧性剪切带内此前未报道的大量含碳酸盐角砾岩和断层脉。
通过C-O-Sr同位素和微量元素证明碳酸盐沉淀自深源低盐度H2O–CO2变质流体。
通过方解石溶解度模拟表明单次事件的封闭效率<0.05%，需要持续流体流动或数千次破裂-封闭循环。
建立了将CO2驱动的瞬态脆化和断层阀作用与活跃碰撞造山带中地壳震群联系起来的化石类比。
me: Field structural mapping and 2.5D drone photogrammetry (orthomosaics and digital terrain models).
Optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (BSE), and Energy Dispersive Spectrometry (EDS).
Carbon, oxygen, and in-situ strontium isotope analysis (GasBench IRMS and LA-MC-ICP-MS) and trace element geochemistry (LA-ICP-MS).
Thermodynamic calcite solubility and fault-sealing efficiency modeling in P-T space using Matlab.
野外构造填图与2.5D无人机摄影测量（正射影像与数字地形模型）。
光学显微镜、扫描电子显微镜（BSE）及能谱分析（EDS）。
碳、氧及原位锶同位素分析（GasBench IRMS和LA-MC-ICP-MS）与微量元素地球化学（LA-ICP-MS）。
使用Matlab在温压空间进行热力学方解石溶解度与断层封闭效率模拟。
de: Outcrop structural data, drone orthomosaics, and rock samples from the External Crystalline Massifs (Gotthard, Mont Blanc, Aar) in the European Alps.
Stable C-O isotopes, in-situ 87Sr/86Sr ratios, and PAAS-normalized REE patterns of vein and breccia carbonates.
Regional compilation of Alpine fluid inclusion compositions and C-O-Sr isotopic signatures from literature.
欧洲阿尔卑斯外部结晶地块（Gotthard、Mont Blanc、Aar）的露头构造数据、无人机正射影像及岩石样品。
脉体和角砾岩碳酸盐的稳定C-O同位素、原位87Sr/86Sr比值及PAAS标准化稀土元素配分模式。
文献中阿尔卑斯流体包裹体成分和C-O-Sr同位素特征的区域汇编数据。
li: Calcite solubility modeling simplifies the natural multicomponent H2O-CO2-NaCl fluid as pure H2O.
Recrystallization and fluid-rock interaction may have altered some isotopic and trace-element signatures.
Large uncertainties in duration, regional extent, and episodicity prevent reliable comparison between calculated CO2 storage and yearly orogenic degassing fluxes.
方解石溶解度模拟将天然多组分H2O-CO2-NaCl流体简化为纯H2O。
重结晶和流体-岩石相互作用可能改变了部分同位素和微量元素特征。
持续时间、区域范围和幕式特征的巨大不确定性阻碍了计算的CO2封存量与造山带年脱气通量的可靠对比。

tm.why: The paper investigates transient fault-valve behavior, supra-lithostatic fluid overpressure, dilatancy, and localized embrittlement within mid-crustal ductile shear zones.
It examines mid-crustal deformation, metamorphic fluid migration, and carbon transport across an orogen-scale plumbing system in the European Alps.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 20-page PDF manuscript including text, equations, and all 7 main figures.
